/** Evalua alertas personalizadas y envia un unico resumen BBVA por usuario. */
var MARKETS_ALERT_EMAIL = Object.freeze({
  senderName: 'BBVA EDC Market Pulse',
  senderAddress: 'voc-commercial.group@bbva.com',
  senderMode: 'GROUP_ALIAS'
});

function summarizeMarketsReviewAlerts_(rows, now) {
  const groups = new Map();
  const start = now.getTime() - 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000;
  const seen = new Set();
  for (const row of rows) {
    const timestamp = Date.parse(row.updatedAt);
    if (!(timestamp > start && timestamp <= now.getTime()) || seen.has(row.key) ||
        !Number.isInteger(row.rating) || row.rating < 1 || row.rating > 5 ||
        !['Android', 'iOS'].includes(row.platform)) continue;
    // Las reseñas sin atribución sólo participan en el ámbito no territorial.
    const countryCode = row.countries.length === 1 && row.countries[0] !== 'UNKNOWN' && !row.sharedListing ? row.countries[0] : 'ALL';
    seen.add(row.key);
    const id = [row.platform, countryCode].join('|');
    const group = groups.get(id) || { platform: row.platform, countryCode, total: 0, low: 0 };
    group.total++;
    group.low += Number(row.rating <= 2);
    groups.set(id, group);
  }
  return [...groups.values()].filter(group => group.low);
}

function buildMarketsReviewAlertEvents_(groups, preferences, existing, now, day, preview = false) {
  if (!preferences.active || !preferences.reviewShareEnabled) return [];
  return groups.flatMap(group => {
    if (!marketsAlertScopeMatches_(preferences, group)) return [];
    const share = 100 * group.low / group.total;
    const severity = share >= preferences.reviewCriticalPct ? 'CRITICAL' : share >= preferences.reviewWarningPct ? 'WARNING' : preview ? 'PREVIEW' : '';
    const eventKey = ['REVIEW_LOW_SHARE', day, group.platform, group.countryCode, preferences.email].join('|');
    if (!severity || existing[eventKey]) return [];
    const threshold = severity === 'CRITICAL' ? preferences.reviewCriticalPct : preferences.reviewWarningPct;
    return [{ timestamp: now, eventKey, referenceDate: dateFromKey_(day), platform: group.platform,
      countryCode: group.countryCode, country: group.countryCode === 'ALL' ? 'Sin geografía' : group.countryCode,
      type: 'REVIEW_LOW_SHARE', severity, threshold, metricValue: round2_(share), reviewTotal: group.total, reviewLow: group.low,
      detail: group.low + ' de ' + group.total + ' reseñas públicas de BBVA Empresas fechadas en las últimas 24 horas. Umbral: ' + threshold + ' %.',
      recipients: preferences.email, userEmail: preferences.email, ruleId: 'REVIEW_LOW_SHARE', direction: 'UP',
      runId: 'review-' + day, source: 'REVIEW_ALERTS' }];
  });
}

function processMarketsReviewAlerts_(day) {
  const result = measureMarketsScheduledJob_('reviewAlerts', progress => deliverMarketsReviewAlertBatch_(day, progress));
  if (['PARTIAL', 'ERROR'].includes(result.status)) throw new Error(result.detail || 'Fallo en el envío de las alertas de reseñas.');
  return result.events;
}

const MARKETS_REVIEW_ALERTS_RUN = 'REVIEW_ALERTS_RUN';

function deliverMarketsReviewAlertBatch_(day, onProgress) {
  const empty = { events: 0, sent: 0, total: 0, status: 'NOT_REQUIRED' };
  const now = new Date();
  if (Utilities.formatDate(now, MARKETS_CONFIG.timeZone, 'yyyy-MM-dd') !== day) return empty;
  const ss = openMarketsSpreadsheet_(), control = readControl_(ss);
  const subscribers = readAllMarketsAlertPreferences_(ss).filter(item => item.active && item.reviewShareEnabled);
  let groups = [];
  if (subscribers.length) {
    const window = { start: shiftReviewDay_(day, -2), end: shiftReviewDay_(day, 1) };
    const rows = queryMarketsReviews_(ss, { country: 'ALL', platform: 'ALL', app: 'BBVA Empresas', deferBlocks: true }, window);
    groups = summarizeMarketsReviewAlerts_(rows, now);
  }
  const lock = LockService.getScriptLock();
  if (!lock.tryLock(1000)) throw new Error('La auditoría de alertas está ocupada.');
  try {
    let summary = empty;
    if (groups.length) {
      const existing = readExistingAlertKeys_(ss);
      const events = subscribers.flatMap(preferences => buildMarketsReviewAlertEvents_(groups, preferences, existing, now, day));
      const result = deliverMarketsAlertEvents_(ss, events, control, subscribers.length, onProgress);
      summary = { events: result.length, sent: result.deliveryCount, status: result.deliveryStatus,
        total: new Set(events.map(event => normalizeEmailForComparison_(event.recipients)).filter(Boolean)).size,
        attempted: result.deliveryFailures ? result.deliveryCount + result.deliveryFailures.length : undefined,
        failed: result.deliveryFailures?.length,
        detail: result.deliveryDetail };
    }
    if (summary.sent) summary.lastDeliveryAt = new Date().toISOString();
    // An audit error must not invalidate deliveries that Gmail already accepted.
    try {
      appendAlertEvents_(ss, [marketsReviewAlertRunEvent_(day, now, summary)]);
    } catch (error) {
      console.warn('No se pudo guardar la auditoría de alertas de reseñas: ' + errorToString_(error));
    }
    return summary;
  } finally {
    lock.releaseLock();
  }
}

function marketsReviewAlertRunEvent_(day, startedAt, summary) {
  return {
    timestamp: startedAt, eventKey: [MARKETS_REVIEW_ALERTS_RUN, startedAt.toISOString()].join('|'),
    referenceDate: dateFromKey_(day), platform: '', countryCode: '', type: MARKETS_REVIEW_ALERTS_RUN,
    severity: summary.status === 'ERROR' ? 'CRITICAL' : summary.status === 'PARTIAL' ? 'WARNING' : '',
    detail: JSON.stringify({ status: summary.status, deliveredAt: summary.lastDeliveryAt || '',
      attempted: summary.attempted, failed: summary.failed }),
    recipients: '', runId: 'review-' + day, source: MARKETS_REVIEW_ALERTS_RUN, userEmail: '', ruleId: '',
    metricValue: summary.sent, threshold: summary.total, appKey: '', direction: ''
  };
}

function buildAndProcessAlerts_(ss, referenceDate, catalog, runId, control, ratingObjects) {
  const ratings = ratingObjects || readRatingObjects_(ss);
  const subscribers = readAllMarketsAlertPreferences_(ss).filter(function (item) { return item.active; });
  const existing = readExistingAlertKeys_(ss);
  const catalogByKey = (catalog || []).reduce(function (out, app) { out[app.appKey] = app; return out; }, {});
  let events = [];
  subscribers.forEach(function (preferences) {
    events = events.concat(buildRatingDropAlerts_(ratings, referenceDate, preferences, existing));
    events = events.concat(buildCompetitiveCrossoverAlerts_(ratings, referenceDate, preferences, catalogByKey, existing));
  });
  events.forEach(function (event) { event.runId = runId; });
  return deliverMarketsAlertEvents_(ss, events, control, subscribers.length);
}

function deliverMarketsAlertEvents_(ss, events, control, subscriberCount, onProgress) {
  events.subscriberCount = subscriberCount;
  events.deliveryCount = 0;
  events.deliveryStatus = events.length ? 'DISABLED' : 'NOT_REQUIRED';
  events.deliveryDetail = '';
  if (!events.length || !parseBoolean_(control.SEND_ALERT_EMAILS, false)) {
    appendAlertEvents_(ss, events);
    return events;
  }
  try {
    events.deliveryCount = sendAlertEmails_(events, ss, onProgress);
    const delivered = events.deliveredRecipients || [];
    const acceptedEvents = events.filter(function (event) {
      return uniqueStrings_(trimString_(event.recipients).split(/[;,]/)).some(function (recipient) {
        return delivered.indexOf(normalizeEmailForComparison_(recipient)) >= 0;
      });
    });
    appendAlertEvents_(ss, acceptedEvents);
    const failed = events.deliveryFailures || [];
    events.deliveryStatus = failed.length ? (events.deliveryCount ? 'PARTIAL' : 'ERROR') : 'DELIVERED';
    events.deliveryDetail = failed.map(function (item) {
      return item.recipient + ': ' + item.error;
    }).join(' | ');
  } catch (error) {
    events.deliveryStatus = 'ERROR';
    events.deliveryDetail = errorToString_(error);
    console.error('Las alertas se conservaran para reintento porque Gmail no las ha aceptado: ' + events.deliveryDetail);
  }
  return events;
}

function buildRatingDropAlerts_(ratings, referenceDate, preferences, existing) {
  if (!preferences.active) return [];
  const definitions = marketsRatingDropDefinitions_(preferences);
  if (!definitions.length) return [];
  const byApp = marketsRatingSeriesByApp_(ratings, preferences);
  const referenceKey = dateKey_(referenceDate);
  return Object.keys(byApp).reduce(function (events, appKey) {
    const series = byApp[appKey];
    definitions.forEach(function (definition) {
      const observation = marketsRatingDropObservation_(series, referenceKey, definition);
      if (!observation) return;
      const baseline = observation.baseline;
      const latest = observation.latest;
      const drop = observation.drop;
      let severity = '';
      let threshold = null;
      if (drop >= definition.critical) {
        severity = 'CRITICAL'; threshold = definition.critical;
      } else if (drop >= definition.warning) {
        severity = 'WARNING'; threshold = definition.warning;
      }
      if (!severity) return;
      const eventParts = [definition.type, observation.periodKey, appKey, preferences.email, severity];
      if (preferences.repeatWhileBreached) eventParts.push(referenceKey);
      const eventKey = eventParts.join('|');
      if (existing[eventKey]) return;
      existing[eventKey] = true;
      events.push(marketsRatingDropEvent_(definition, observation, preferences, referenceDate, eventKey));
    });
    return events;
  }, []);
}

function marketsRatingDropDefinitions_(preferences) {
  return [
    { period: 'DAILY', enabled: preferences.dailyDropEnabled,
      warning: preferences.dailyWarningDrop, critical: preferences.dailyCriticalDrop,
      type: 'RATING_DROP_DAILY', ruleId: 'DAILY_DROP' },
    { period: 'MIDMONTH', enabled: preferences.mtdDropEnabled,
      warning: preferences.mtdWarningDrop, critical: preferences.mtdCriticalDrop,
      type: 'RATING_DROP_MTD', ruleId: 'MIDMONTH_DROP' },
    { period: 'YTD', enabled: preferences.ytdDropEnabled,
      warning: preferences.ytdWarningDrop, critical: preferences.ytdCriticalDrop,
      type: 'RATING_DROP_YTD', ruleId: 'YTD_DROP' }
  ].filter(function (definition) { return definition.enabled; });
}

function marketsRatingSeriesByApp_(ratings, preferences) {
  const byApp = {};
  (ratings || []).forEach(function (item) {
    if (!item.isBbva || !(item.observedDate instanceof Date) || item.rating === null ||
        !marketsAlertScopeMatches_(preferences, item)) return;
    (byApp[item.appKey] || (byApp[item.appKey] = [])).push(item);
  });
  Object.keys(byApp).forEach(function (appKey) {
    byApp[appKey].sort(function (a, b) { return a.observedDate - b.observedDate; });
  });
  return byApp;
}

function marketsRatingDropObservation_(series, referenceKey, definition) {
  const latest = ratingDropCurrent_(series, referenceKey, definition.period);
  if (!latest) return null;
  const baseline = ratingDropBaseline_(series, referenceKey, definition.period);
  if (!baseline || baseline.observedDate.getTime() >= latest.observedDate.getTime()) return null;
  const drop = round2_(baseline.rating - latest.rating);
  const periodKey = definition.period === 'DAILY' ? referenceKey :
    definition.period === 'MIDMONTH' ? marketsMidmonthAnchorKey_(referenceKey) : referenceKey.slice(0, 4);
  return { baseline: baseline, latest: latest, drop: drop, periodKey: periodKey };
}

function marketsRatingDropEvent_(definition, observation, preferences, referenceDate, eventKey) {
  const latest = observation.latest;
  return {
    timestamp: new Date(), eventKey: eventKey, referenceDate: referenceDate,
    platform: latest.platform, countryCode: latest.countryCode, type: definition.type,
    severity: observation.drop >= definition.critical ? 'CRITICAL' : 'WARNING',
    detail: ratingDropDetail_(definition.period, observation.baseline, latest, observation.drop),
    recipients: preferences.email, userEmail: preferences.email, ruleId: definition.ruleId,
    metricValue: observation.drop,
    threshold: observation.drop >= definition.critical ? definition.critical : definition.warning,
    warningThreshold: definition.warning, criticalThreshold: definition.critical,
    appKey: latest.appKey, direction: 'DOWN',
    runId: '', source: 'SELF_SERVICE_ALERTS', period: definition.period,
    appName: latest.appName || 'BBVA Empresas', country: latest.country || latest.countryCode,
    baselineRating: observation.baseline.rating, currentRating: latest.rating,
    baselineDate: observation.baseline.observedDate, currentDate: latest.observedDate
  };
}

/**
 * Al dar de alta a una cuenta no administradora reconoce las caídas YTD que
 * ya estaban activas. Se auditan, pero no se envían. Si la cuenta solicita
 * recordatorios, el siguiente día genera una clave nueva; una escalada
 * posterior de amarilla a roja también sigue siendo notificable.
 */
function buildMarketsEnrollmentYtdAcknowledgements_(ratings, referenceDate, preferences) {
  if (!preferences || !preferences.active || !preferences.ytdDropEnabled) return [];
  const baselinePreferences = Object.assign({}, preferences, {
    active: true,
    dailyDropEnabled: false,
    mtdDropEnabled: false,
    ytdDropEnabled: true
  });
  const events = buildRatingDropAlerts_(ratings, referenceDate, baselinePreferences, {});
  const acknowledged = [];
  events.forEach(function (event) {
    const levels = event.severity === 'CRITICAL' ? [
      { severity: 'WARNING', threshold: preferences.ytdWarningDrop },
      { severity: 'CRITICAL', threshold: preferences.ytdCriticalDrop }
    ] : [{ severity: event.severity, threshold: event.threshold }];
    levels.forEach(function (level) {
      const clone = Object.assign({}, event, level);
      const periodKey = dateKey_(referenceDate).slice(0, 4);
      const parts = ['RATING_DROP_YTD', periodKey, event.appKey, preferences.email, level.severity];
      if (preferences.repeatWhileBreached) parts.push(dateKey_(referenceDate));
      clone.eventKey = parts.join('|');
      clone.timestamp = new Date();
      clone.source = 'ADMIN_ENROLLMENT_BASELINE';
      clone.runId = 'ENROLL-' + Utilities.formatDate(clone.timestamp, MARKETS_CONFIG.timeZone, 'yyyyMMdd-HHmmss');
      clone.detail = 'Reconocida en el alta sin notificación. ' + event.detail;
      acknowledged.push(clone);
    });
  });
  return acknowledged;
}

function latestMarketsRatingDate_(ratings, preferences) {
  return (ratings || []).filter(function (item) {
    return item.isBbva && item.observedDate instanceof Date && item.rating !== null &&
      (!preferences || marketsAlertScopeMatches_(preferences, item));
  }).reduce(function (latest, item) {
    return !latest || item.observedDate.getTime() > latest.getTime() ? item.observedDate : latest;
  }, null);
}

function buildMarketsRealAlertPreviewEvents_(ratings, catalog, preferences, deliveryId) {
  const previewPreferences = Object.assign({}, preferences, { active: true, repeatWhileBreached: false });
  const referenceDate = latestMarketsRatingDate_(ratings, previewPreferences);
  if (!referenceDate) throw new Error('No hay ratings reales disponibles para el ámbito configurado.');
  const catalogByKey = (catalog || []).reduce(function (out, app) { out[app.appKey] = app; return out; }, {});
  let events = buildRatingDropAlerts_(ratings, referenceDate, previewPreferences, {});
  events = events.concat(buildCompetitiveCrossoverAlerts_(ratings, referenceDate, previewPreferences, catalogByKey, {}));
  if (!events.length) {
    events = buildMarketsBelowThresholdPreviewEvents_(ratings, referenceDate, previewPreferences);
  }
  const severityOrder = { CRITICAL: 0, WARNING: 1, PREVIEW: 2, POSITIVE: 3 };
  events.sort(function (a, b) {
    const aSeverity = Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(severityOrder, a.severity) ?
      severityOrder[a.severity] : 9;
    const bSeverity = Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(severityOrder, b.severity) ?
      severityOrder[b.severity] : 9;
    return aSeverity - bSeverity ||
      trimString_(a.countryCode).localeCompare(trimString_(b.countryCode)) ||
      compareMarketsPlatforms_(a, b);
  });
  if (!events.length) {
    const latest = (ratings || []).filter(function (item) {
      return item.isBbva && item.observedDate instanceof Date &&
        dateKey_(item.observedDate) === dateKey_(referenceDate) &&
        marketsAlertScopeMatches_(previewPreferences, item);
    }).sort(function (a, b) {
      return trimString_(a.countryCode).localeCompare(trimString_(b.countryCode)) ||
        compareMarketsPlatforms_(a, b);
    });
    if (!latest.length) throw new Error('No hay un cierre real utilizable para preparar la prueba.');
    events = latest.map(function (item) {
      return {
        timestamp: new Date(), referenceDate: referenceDate, currentDate: item.observedDate,
        platform: item.platform, countryCode: item.countryCode, country: item.country,
        type: 'TEST_SNAPSHOT', severity: 'POSITIVE', appKey: item.appKey,
        appName: item.appName || 'BBVA Empresas', currentRating: item.rating,
        ratingCount: item.ratingCount, metricValue: item.rating, threshold: null,
        detail: 'Ninguna regla activada ha superado los umbrales configurados en este cierre.',
        direction: 'SNAPSHOT'
      };
    });
  }
  const previewLimit = events.every(function (event) { return event.type === 'TEST_SNAPSHOT'; }) ? 24 : 8;
  return events.slice(0, previewLimit).map(function (event) {
    return Object.assign({}, event, {
      isTest: true, testId: deliveryId, recipients: preferences.email,
      userEmail: preferences.email, source: 'SELF_SERVICE_TEST_REAL_DATA',
      eventKey: 'TEST_PREVIEW|' + deliveryId + '|' + trimString_(event.eventKey || event.appKey)
    });
  });
}

function buildMarketsBelowThresholdPreviewEvents_(ratings, referenceDate, preferences) {
  const definitions = marketsRatingDropDefinitions_(preferences);
  const byApp = marketsRatingSeriesByApp_(ratings, preferences);
  const referenceKey = dateKey_(referenceDate);
  return Object.keys(byApp).reduce(function (candidates, appKey) {
    const observations = definitions.map(function (definition) {
      const observation = marketsRatingDropObservation_(byApp[appKey], referenceKey, definition);
      if (!observation || observation.drop <= 0 || observation.drop >= definition.warning) return null;
      return {
        definition: definition,
        observation: observation
      };
    }).filter(Boolean).sort(function (a, b) {
      return b.observation.drop - a.observation.drop;
    });
    if (!observations.length) return candidates;
    const selected = observations[0];
    const event = marketsRatingDropEvent_(
      selected.definition, selected.observation, preferences, referenceDate,
      ['TEST_BELOW_THRESHOLD', selected.observation.periodKey, appKey, selected.definition.ruleId].join('|'));
    event.type = selected.definition.type;
    event.severity = 'PREVIEW';
    event.threshold = selected.definition.warning;
    event.isBelowThresholdPreview = true;
    event.source = 'SELF_SERVICE_TEST_REAL_DATA';
    event.detail = ratingDropDetail_(
      selected.definition.period, selected.observation.baseline,
      selected.observation.latest, selected.observation.drop);
    candidates.push(event);
    return candidates;
  }, []);
}

function validateMarketsRealAlertPreviewEvents_(events, preferences) {
  if (!Array.isArray(events) || !events.length) {
    throw new Error('No hay datos reales utilizables para preparar la prueba.');
  }
  const hasNumber = function (value) { return toFiniteNumber_(value) !== null; };
  events.forEach(function (event) {
    const countryCode = trimString_(event && event.countryCode).toUpperCase();
    const platform = trimString_(event && event.platform);
    if (!countryCode || countryCode === 'GLOBAL' || !platform || platform.toUpperCase() === 'TODAS') {
      throw new Error('La prueba se ha cancelado: no existe una geografía y plataforma reales verificables.');
    }
    if (!marketsAlertScopeMatches_(preferences, { countryCode: countryCode, platform: platform })) {
      throw new Error('La prueba se ha cancelado: los datos no pertenecen al ámbito guardado.');
    }
    if (event.type === 'REVIEW_LOW_SHARE' && event.isTest) {
      if (!Number.isInteger(event.reviewTotal) || !Number.isInteger(event.reviewLow) || event.reviewTotal < event.reviewLow ||
          event.reviewLow <= 0 || Math.abs(event.metricValue - 100 * event.reviewLow / event.reviewTotal) > 0.01) {
        throw new Error('La muestra de reseñas de la prueba no es válida.');
      }
      return;
    }
    if (!(event.referenceDate instanceof Date) || !isFinite(event.referenceDate.getTime()) ||
        !trimString_(event.appKey)) {
      throw new Error('La prueba se ha cancelado: falta trazabilidad del cierre real.');
    }
    if (event.type === 'COMPETITIVE_CROSSOVER') {
      if (!hasNumber(event.bbvaRating) || !hasNumber(event.competitorRating)) {
        throw new Error('La prueba se ha cancelado: el cruce no contiene ratings reales comparables.');
      }
      return;
    }
    if (!hasNumber(event.currentRating)) {
      throw new Error('La prueba se ha cancelado: el cierre no contiene un rating real.');
    }
    if (event.type !== 'TEST_SNAPSHOT' &&
        (!hasNumber(event.baselineRating) || !hasNumber(event.metricValue) ||
         !hasNumber(event.threshold))) {
      throw new Error('La prueba se ha cancelado: la señal no puede justificarse con sus datos reales.');
    }
  });
  return events;
}

function ratingDropBaseline_(series, referenceKey, period) {
  if (period === 'MIDMONTH') {
    return marketsRatingAtDate_(series, marketsPreviousMidmonthAnchorKey_(referenceKey));
  }
  const previous = (series || []).filter(function (item) { return dateKey_(item.observedDate) < referenceKey; });
  if (period === 'DAILY') return previous.slice().sort(function (a, b) { return b.observedDate - a.observedDate; })[0] || null;
  const start = referenceKey.slice(0, 4) + '-01-01';
  return previous.filter(function (item) { return dateKey_(item.observedDate) >= start; })[0] || null;
}

function ratingDropCurrent_(series, referenceKey, period) {
  if (period === 'MIDMONTH') {
    return marketsRatingAtDate_(series, marketsMidmonthAnchorKey_(referenceKey));
  }
  return (series || []).find(function (item) { return dateKey_(item.observedDate) === referenceKey; }) || null;
}

function marketsRatingAtDate_(series, targetKey) {
  return (series || []).find(function (item) {
    return dateKey_(item.observedDate) === targetKey;
  }) || null;
}

function marketsMidmonthAnchorKey_(referenceKey) {
  const parts = trimString_(referenceKey).split('-').map(Number);
  const date = new Date(parts[0], parts[1] - 1, parts[2], 12);
  if (parts[2] < 15) date.setMonth(date.getMonth() - 1);
  date.setDate(15);
  return dateKey_(date);
}

function marketsPreviousMidmonthAnchorKey_(referenceKey) {
  const anchor = marketsMidmonthAnchorKey_(referenceKey).split('-').map(Number);
  const date = new Date(anchor[0], anchor[1] - 1, 15, 12);
  date.setMonth(date.getMonth() - 1);
  return dateKey_(date);
}

function ratingDropDetail_(period, baseline, latest, drop) {
  const label = period === 'DAILY' ? 'desde la observacion anterior' :
    period === 'MIDMONTH' ? 'en la ventana mensual del día 15 al día 15' : 'desde inicio de ano';
  return 'BBVA Empresas: ' + label + ' ' + baseline.rating.toFixed(2) + ' -> ' +
    latest.rating.toFixed(2) + ' (caida ' + drop.toFixed(2) + ')';
}

function buildCompetitiveCrossoverAlerts_(ratings, referenceDate, preferences, catalogByKey, existing) {
  if (!preferences.active || !preferences.crossoverEnabled) return [];
  const referenceKey = dateKey_(referenceDate);
  const byMarket = {};
  (ratings || []).forEach(function (item) {
    if (!(item.observedDate instanceof Date) || item.rating === null || !marketsAlertScopeMatches_(preferences, item)) return;
    const config = catalogByKey[item.appKey];
    if (config && config.competitorAlerts === false) return;
    const key = item.countryCode + '|' + item.platform;
    (byMarket[key] || (byMarket[key] = [])).push(item);
  });
  return Object.keys(byMarket).reduce(function (events, marketKey) {
    const rows = byMarket[marketKey];
    const current = rows.filter(function (item) { return dateKey_(item.observedDate) === referenceKey; });
    const bbva = current.find(function (item) { return item.isBbva; });
    if (!bbva) return events;
    current.filter(function (item) { return !item.isBbva; }).forEach(function (peer) {
      const previousPair = previousCommonAlertPair_(rows, bbva.appKey, peer.appKey, referenceKey);
      if (!previousPair) return;
      const previousDifference = round2_(previousPair.bbva.rating - previousPair.peer.rating);
      const currentDifference = round2_(bbva.rating - peer.rating);
      let direction = '';
      if (previousDifference >= 0 && currentDifference < 0) direction = 'LOST';
      else if (previousDifference <= 0 && currentDifference > 0) direction = 'GAINED';
      if (!direction || (preferences.crossoverDirection !== 'BOTH' && preferences.crossoverDirection !== direction)) return;
      const eventKey = ['COMPETITIVE_CROSSOVER', referenceKey, bbva.appKey, peer.appKey,
        preferences.email, direction].join('|');
      if (existing[eventKey]) return;
      existing[eventKey] = true;
      const peerName = peer.appName || peer.appKey;
      events.push({
        timestamp: new Date(), eventKey: eventKey, referenceDate: referenceDate,
        platform: bbva.platform, countryCode: bbva.countryCode, type: 'COMPETITIVE_CROSSOVER',
        severity: direction === 'LOST' ? 'WARNING' : 'POSITIVE',
        detail: direction === 'LOST' ? peerName + ' ha superado a BBVA Empresas (' +
          peer.rating.toFixed(2) + ' vs ' + bbva.rating.toFixed(2) + ')' :
          'BBVA Empresas ha superado a ' + peerName + ' (' + bbva.rating.toFixed(2) +
          ' vs ' + peer.rating.toFixed(2) + ')',
        recipients: preferences.email, userEmail: preferences.email, ruleId: 'COMPETITIVE_CROSSOVER',
        metricValue: currentDifference, threshold: 0, appKey: peer.appKey, direction: direction,
        runId: '', source: 'SELF_SERVICE_ALERTS', appName: bbva.appName || 'BBVA Empresas',
        country: bbva.country || bbva.countryCode, bbvaRating: bbva.rating,
        competitorName: peerName, competitorRating: peer.rating,
        previousBbvaRating: previousPair.bbva.rating, previousCompetitorRating: previousPair.peer.rating,
        baselineDate: previousPair.bbva.observedDate, currentDate: bbva.observedDate
      });
    });
    return events;
  }, []);
}

function previousCommonAlertPair_(rows, bbvaKey, peerKey, referenceKey) {
  const byDate = {};
  (rows || []).filter(function (item) { return dateKey_(item.observedDate) < referenceKey; })
    .forEach(function (item) {
      const key = dateKey_(item.observedDate);
      const bucket = byDate[key] || (byDate[key] = {});
      if (item.appKey === bbvaKey) bucket.bbva = item;
      if (item.appKey === peerKey) bucket.peer = item;
    });
  const date = Object.keys(byDate).filter(function (key) { return byDate[key].bbva && byDate[key].peer; }).sort().pop();
  return date ? byDate[date] : null;
}

function marketsAlertScopeMatches_(preferences, item) {
  return (preferences.countries.indexOf('ALL') >= 0 || preferences.countries.indexOf(item.countryCode) >= 0) &&
    (preferences.platforms.indexOf('ALL') >= 0 || preferences.platforms.indexOf(item.platform) >= 0);
}

function readExistingAlertKeys_(ss) {
  const sheet = ss.getSheetByName(MARKETS_CONFIG.sheets.alerts);
  if (sheet.getLastRow() <= 1) return {};
  const failedRuns = readFailedAlertRunIds_(ss);
  return sheet.getRange(2, 2, sheet.getLastRow() - 1, 9).getValues().reduce(function (out, row) {
    const key = trimString_(row[0]);
    const runId = trimString_(row[8]);
    if (key && !failedRuns[runId]) out[key] = true;
    return out;
  }, {});
}

function readFailedAlertRunIds_(ss) {
  const sheet = ss.getSheetByName(MARKETS_CONFIG.sheets.runs);
  if (!sheet || sheet.getLastRow() <= 1) return {};
  const width = Math.min(sheet.getLastColumn(), MARKETS_CONFIG.headers.runs.length);
  const headers = sheet.getRange(1, 1, 1, width).getValues()[0];
  const indexes = indexHeaders_(headers);
  return sheet.getRange(2, 1, sheet.getLastRow() - 1, width).getValues().reduce(function (out, row) {
    const runId = trimString_(row[indexes.run_id]);
    const status = trimString_(row[indexes.status]).toUpperCase();
    const delivery = indexes.alert_delivery_status === undefined ? '' :
      trimString_(row[indexes.alert_delivery_status]).toUpperCase();
    if (runId && (['ERROR', 'PARTIAL'].indexOf(delivery) >= 0 || (!delivery && status === 'ERROR'))) {
      out[runId] = true;
    }
    return out;
  }, {});
}

function appendAlertEvents_(ss, events) {
  if (!events.length) return;
  const sheet = ss.getSheetByName(MARKETS_CONFIG.sheets.alerts);
  const rows = events.map(function (event) {
    return [event.timestamp, event.eventKey, event.referenceDate, event.platform, event.countryCode,
      event.type, event.severity, event.detail, event.recipients, event.runId, event.source,
      event.userEmail, event.ruleId, event.metricValue, event.threshold, event.appKey, event.direction];
  });
  ensureSheetCapacity_(sheet, sheet.getLastRow() + rows.length, MARKETS_CONFIG.headers.alerts.length);
  sheet.getRange(sheet.getLastRow() + 1, 1, rows.length, rows[0].length).setValues(rows);
}

function sendAlertEmails_(events, ss, onProgress) {
  const grouped = {};
  (events || []).forEach(function (event) {
    uniqueStrings_(trimString_(event.recipients).split(/[;,]/)).forEach(function (recipient) {
      (grouped[recipient] || (grouped[recipient] = [])).push(event);
    });
  });
  const recipients = Object.keys(grouped);
  if (!recipients.length) return 0;
  const sender = requireMarketsAlertSender_(ss);
  const inlineImages = buildMarketsAlertInlineImages_();
  const deliveries = [];
  const failures = [];
  onProgress?.({ total: recipients.length, attempted: 0, sent: 0 });
  recipients.forEach(function (recipient) {
    try {
      const recipientEvents = grouped[recipient];
      const message = marketsAlertEmailMessage_(recipient, recipientEvents, inlineImages, sender);
      const accepted = Gmail.Users.Messages.send({ raw: message.raw }, 'me');
      if (!accepted || !trimString_(accepted.id)) {
        throw new Error('Gmail no ha devuelto un identificador de mensaje.');
      }
      deliveries.push({
        recipient: recipient, messageId: trimString_(accepted.id), threadId: trimString_(accepted.threadId),
        senderAddress: sender.address, senderName: sender.name,
        verificationStatus: sender.verificationStatus
      });
      if (ss) {
        try { touchMarketsAlertTimestamp_(ss, recipient, 'LAST_DELIVERY_AT', new Date()); }
        catch (auditError) { console.error('Email aceptado para ' + recipient + ', pero fallo LAST_DELIVERY_AT: ' + errorToString_(auditError)); }
      }
    } catch (error) {
      failures.push({ recipient: normalizeEmailForComparison_(recipient), error: errorToString_(error) });
    } finally {
      const attempted = deliveries.length + failures.length;
      if (attempted % 5 === 0 || attempted === recipients.length) {
        onProgress?.({ total: recipients.length, attempted, sent: deliveries.length, failed: failures.length });
      }
    }
  });
  events.deliveryResults = deliveries;
  events.deliveryFailures = failures;
  events.deliveredRecipients = deliveries.map(function (item) {
    return normalizeEmailForComparison_(item.recipient);
  });
  return deliveries.length;
}

function marketsAlertEmailMessage_(recipient, events, inlineImages, sender) {
  const normalizedRecipient = normalizeMarketsAlertEmail_(recipient);
  const language = marketsNewsletterLanguageFor_(normalizedRecipient);
  const token = Utilities.getUuid().replace(/-/g, '');
  let feedback = null;
  try { feedback = marketsAlertFeedbackLinks_(normalizedRecipient, token); }
  catch (error) { console.warn('No se pudo preparar la valoración de alertas. ' + error.message); }
  const localized = language === 'es' ? null : renderLocalizedMarketsAlert_(events, normalizedRecipient, feedback, language);
  const subject = localized?.subject || marketsAlertEmailSubject_(events);
  const plainText = localized?.plain || renderMarketsAlertPlainText_(events, normalizedRecipient, feedback?.open);
  const html = localized?.html || renderMarketsAlertEmail_(events, normalizedRecipient, feedback);
  const image = inlineImages && inlineImages.bbvaLogo;
  if (!image || typeof image.getBytes !== 'function') {
    throw new Error('No se ha podido incorporar el logotipo oficial de BBVA al correo.');
  }
  const relatedBoundary = 'bbva_related_' + token;
  const alternativeBoundary = 'bbva_alternative_' + token;
  const crlf = '\r\n';
  const mime = [
    'From: ' + marketsAlertEncodedHeader_(sender.name) + ' <' + sender.address + '>',
    'To: ' + normalizedRecipient,
    'Subject: ' + marketsAlertEncodedHeader_(subject, true),
    'Date: ' + new Date().toUTCString(),
    'Message-ID: <' + token + '@voc-commercial.bbva.com>',
    'X-Market-Pulse-Code-Version: ' + MARKETS_CONFIG.codeVersion,
    'X-Market-Pulse-Web-Version: ' + marketsAlertWebVersion_(),
    'MIME-Version: 1.0',
    'Content-Type: multipart/related; boundary="' + relatedBoundary + '"',
    '',
    '--' + relatedBoundary,
    'Content-Type: multipart/alternative; boundary="' + alternativeBoundary + '"',
    '',
    '--' + alternativeBoundary,
    'Content-Type: text/plain; charset="UTF-8"',
    'Content-Transfer-Encoding: base64',
    '',
    marketsAlertMimeText_(plainText),
    '--' + alternativeBoundary,
    'Content-Type: text/html; charset="UTF-8"',
    'Content-Transfer-Encoding: base64',
    '',
    marketsAlertMimeText_(html),
    '--' + alternativeBoundary + '--',
    '',
    '--' + relatedBoundary,
    'Content-Type: image/png; name="bbva.png"',
    'Content-Transfer-Encoding: base64',
    'Content-ID: <bbvaLogo>',
    'Content-Disposition: inline; filename="bbva.png"',
    '',
    marketsAlertMimeBytes_(image.getBytes()),
    ...marketsEmailFooterMime_(inlineImages, relatedBoundary),
    '--' + relatedBoundary + '--',
    ''
  ].join(crlf);
  return {
    raw: Utilities.base64EncodeWebSafe(mime, Utilities.Charset.UTF_8).replace(/=+$/g, ''),
    recipient: normalizedRecipient,
    subject: subject
  };
}

function marketsAlertEncodedHeader_(value, preserveWhitespace = false) {
  const text = preserveWhitespace ? String(value) : trimString_(value);
  return '=?UTF-8?B?' + Utilities.base64Encode(text, Utilities.Charset.UTF_8) + '?=';
}

function marketsAlertMimeText_(value) {
  return marketsAlertWrapBase64_(Utilities.base64Encode(String(value || ''), Utilities.Charset.UTF_8));
}

function marketsAlertMimeBytes_(bytes) {
  return marketsAlertWrapBase64_(Utilities.base64Encode(bytes));
}

function marketsAlertWrapBase64_(value) {
  return (String(value || '').match(/.{1,76}/g) || ['']).join('\r\n');
}

function marketsAlertConfiguredSenderAddress_(ss) {
  let address = MARKETS_ALERT_EMAIL.senderAddress;
  if (ss) {
    const control = readControl_(ss);
    address = trimString_(control.ALERT_SENDER_ALIAS) || address;
  }
  return normalizeMarketsAlertEmail_(address);
}

function marketsAlertSenderStatus_(ss) {
  const address = marketsAlertConfiguredSenderAddress_(ss);
  let response;
  try {
    response = Gmail.Users.Settings.SendAs.list('me');
  } catch (error) {
    return {
      address: address, name: MARKETS_ALERT_EMAIL.senderName, mode: MARKETS_ALERT_EMAIL.senderMode,
      available: false, verificationStatus: 'unavailable', error: errorToString_(error)
    };
  }
  const sendAs = (response && response.sendAs || []).find(function (item) {
    return normalizeEmailForComparison_(item.sendAsEmail) === normalizeEmailForComparison_(address);
  });
  const verificationStatus = trimString_(sendAs && sendAs.verificationStatus).toLowerCase() || 'unknown';
  return {
    address: address, name: MARKETS_ALERT_EMAIL.senderName, mode: MARKETS_ALERT_EMAIL.senderMode,
    available: Boolean(sendAs) && verificationStatus === 'accepted',
    verificationStatus: verificationStatus, isDefault: Boolean(sendAs && sendAs.isDefault),
    treatAsAlias: Boolean(sendAs && sendAs.treatAsAlias), error: ''
  };
}

function requireMarketsAlertSender_(ss) {
  const status = marketsAlertSenderStatus_(ss);
  if (status.available) return status;
  if (status.verificationStatus === 'pending') {
    throw new Error('El remitente ' + status.address + ' sigue pendiente de verificacion en Gmail > Enviar como. Confirma el mensaje recibido por el grupo antes de probar.');
  }
  if (status.verificationStatus === 'unavailable') {
    throw new Error('No se ha podido validar el remitente de grupo ' + status.address + ': ' + status.error);
  }
  throw new Error('El remitente ' + status.address + ' no esta autorizado en Gmail > Enviar como para la cuenta que ejecuta el trigger. Añadelo, verifica el grupo y vuelve a probar.');
}

function validateMarketsAlertSender() {
  const ss = openMarketsSpreadsheet_();
  ensureWorkbookSchema_(ss);
  const status = marketsAlertSenderStatus_(ss);
  let executor = '';
  try { executor = normalizeEmailForComparison_(Session.getEffectiveUser().getEmail()); } catch (ignored) {}
  return Object.assign({ executor: executor }, status);
}

function marketsAlertEmailSubject_(events) {
  const prefix = '[bIA] 🚀[EDC Market Pulse]  ·Alertas personalizadas · ';
  const tests = (events || []).filter(function (event) { return event.type === 'TEST' || event.isTest; });
  if (tests.length === (events || []).length && tests.length) {
    const result = marketsAlertPreviewHasNoSignals_(events) ? 'Sin alertas activas' :
      marketsAlertPreviewIsBelowThreshold_(events) ? 'Datos reales bajo umbral' : 'Datos reales';
    return '[PRUEBA] ' + prefix + result + ' · ' +
      trimString_(tests[0].testId || tests[0].ruleId || 'verificación');
  }
  if (marketsAlertIsReviewShare_(events)) return prefix + 'Alertas de reseñas';
  return prefix + events.length + ' cambio' +
    (events.length === 1 ? '' : 's') + ' en ratings ';
}

/** Render both MIME alternatives from the same recipient-specific alert copy. */
function renderLocalizedMarketsAlert_(events, recipient, feedback, language) {
  const copy = {
    en: {
      title: 'Rating alerts', shareTitle: 'Review alerts', test: 'TEST', preview: 'Preview using the latest available data and saved preferences.',
      below: 'Below threshold', quiet: 'No thresholds reached', critical: 'Critical', warning: 'Warning', positive: 'Positive',
      daily: 'Daily rating drop', mtd: 'Rating drop from the 15th to the 15th', ytd: 'Rating drop since the start of the year',
      crossover: 'Competitive ranking change', share: 'Share of one- and two-star reviews',
      before: 'Previous rating', current: 'Current rating', movement: 'Change', threshold: 'Threshold',
      competitor: 'Competitor rating', data: 'Data date', open: 'Open EDC Market Pulse', manage: 'Manage your alerts',
      privacy: 'This email contains signals configured for your account.', unsubscribe: 'Unsubscribe'
    },
    tr: {
      title: 'Puan uyarıları', shareTitle: 'Yorum uyarıları', test: 'TEST', preview: 'Son mevcut veriler ve kayıtlı tercihlerle hazırlanan önizleme.',
      below: 'Eşik altında', quiet: 'Hiçbir eşik aşılmadı', critical: 'Kritik', warning: 'Uyarı', positive: 'Olumlu',
      daily: 'Günlük puan düşüşü', mtd: 'Ayın 15’inden sonraki ayın 15’ine puan düşüşü', ytd: 'Yıl başından bu yana puan düşüşü',
      crossover: 'Rekabet sıralamasında değişim', share: 'Bir ve iki yıldızlı yorumların oranı',
      before: 'Önceki puan', current: 'Güncel puan', movement: 'Değişim', threshold: 'Eşik',
      competitor: 'Rakip puanı', data: 'Veri tarihi', open: 'EDC Market Pulse’u aç', manage: 'Uyarılarını yönet',
      privacy: 'Bu e-posta, hesabın için yapılandırılan uyarıları içerir.', unsubscribe: 'Abonelikten çık'
    }
  }[language];
  const locale = language === 'tr' ? 'tr-TR' : 'en-GB';
  const number = value => {
    const formatted = Number(value).toFixed(2);
    return language === 'tr' ? formatted.replace('.', ',') : formatted;
  };
  const esc = escapeMarketsAlertHtml_;
  const regions = typeof Intl !== 'undefined' && typeof Intl.DisplayNames === 'function'
    ? new Intl.DisplayNames([locale], { type: 'region' }) : null;
  const isTest = marketsAlertIsTest_(events);
  const title = marketsAlertIsReviewShare_(events) ? copy.shareTitle : copy.title;
  const loginUrl = marketsWebAppLoginUrl_(feedback?.open ? '' : recipient, feedback?.open);
  const manageUrl = marketsWebAppUrl_() + '?view=alerts';
  const date = value => {
    const parsed = value && new Date(value);
    return parsed && Number.isFinite(parsed.getTime())
      ? Utilities.formatDate(parsed, MARKETS_CONFIG.timeZone, language === 'tr' ? 'dd.MM.yyyy' : 'dd/MM/yyyy') : '';
  };
  const ruleKeys = { RATING_DROP_DAILY: 'daily', RATING_DROP_MTD: 'mtd', RATING_DROP_YTD: 'ytd',
    COMPETITIVE_CROSSOVER: 'crossover', REVIEW_LOW_SHARE: 'share' };
  const cards = events.map(event => {
    const severity = { CRITICAL: 'critical', WARNING: 'warning', POSITIVE: 'positive' }[event.severity];
    const status = event.type === 'TEST_SNAPSHOT' ? copy.quiet : event.isBelowThresholdPreview ? copy.below : copy[severity] || '';
    const geography = event.countryCode && /^[A-Z]{2}$/.test(event.countryCode) ?
      regions?.of(event.countryCode) || event.countryCode : event.country;
    const market = [geography, event.platform, event.appName].filter(Boolean).join(' · ');
    const metrics = [];
    const metric = (label, value, suffix = '') => {
      if (value !== null && value !== undefined && value !== '' && Number.isFinite(Number(value))) {
        metrics.push([label, number(value) + suffix]);
      }
    };
    if (event.type === 'COMPETITIVE_CROSSOVER') {
      metric('BBVA', event.bbvaRating);
      metric(event.competitorName || copy.competitor, event.competitorRating);
    } else {
      metric(copy.before, event.baselineRating);
      metric(copy.current, event.currentRating);
    }
    metric(copy.movement, event.metricValue, event.type === 'REVIEW_LOW_SHARE' ? '%' : '');
    metric(copy.threshold, event.threshold, event.type === 'REVIEW_LOW_SHARE' ? '%' : '');
    const observed = date(event.currentDate || event.referenceDate);
    if (observed) metrics.push([copy.data, observed]);
    return { label: [status, copy[ruleKeys[event.type]]].filter(Boolean).join(' · ') || title, market, metrics };
  });
  const preheader = isTest ? copy.preview : copy.privacy;
  const subject = (isTest ? '[' + copy.test + '] ' : '') + '[bIA] 🚀[EDC Market Pulse] · ' + title + ' · ' + events.length;
  const plain = ['EDC MARKET PULSE', title, preheader, ...cards.map(card =>
    [card.label, card.market, ...card.metrics.map(([label, value]) => label + ': ' + value)].filter(Boolean).join('\n')),
    copy.open + ': ' + loginUrl, copy.manage + ': ' + manageUrl,
    feedback?.unsubscribe ? copy.unsubscribe + ': ' + feedback.unsubscribe : ''].filter(Boolean).join('\n\n');
  const body = cards.map(card =>
    '<tr><td style="padding:10px 24px"><div style="padding:16px;border-radius:8px;background:#EAFBFA;color:#070E46">' +
    '<strong>' + esc(card.label) + '</strong><p>' + esc(card.market) + '</p>' +
    card.metrics.map(([label, value]) => '<div>' + esc(label) + ': <b>' + esc(value) + '</b></div>').join('') +
    '</div></td></tr>').join('');
  const html = protectMarketsEmailColors_(marketsLightEmailDocument_(language) +
    '<table role="presentation" width="100%" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0"><tr><td align="center" style="padding:24px 12px">' +
    '<table role="presentation" width="100%" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0" style="max-width:640px;background:#FFFFFF;color:#070E46">' +
    '<tr><td bgcolor="#001391" style="padding:24px;color:#FFFFFF"><img src="cid:bbvaLogo" width="156" alt="BBVA">' +
    '<h1>' + esc(title) + '</h1><p>' + esc(preheader) + '</p></td></tr>' + body +
    '<tr><td style="padding:18px 24px;text-align:center"><a href="' + esc(loginUrl) + '">' + esc(copy.open) + '</a>' +
    renderMarketsEmailFooter_(feedback, language) + '</td></tr></table></td></tr></table></body></html>');
  return { subject, plain, html };
}

function renderMarketsAlertPlainText_(events, recipient, destination) {
  const isTest = marketsAlertIsTest_(events);
  const noSignals = marketsAlertPreviewHasNoSignals_(events);
  const appUrl = marketsWebAppUrl_();
  const loginUrl = marketsWebAppLoginUrl_(destination ? '' : recipient, destination);
  const lines = (events || []).map(function (event) {
    if (event.type === 'TEST_SNAPSHOT') {
      return 'CIERRE REAL — NINGUNA REGLA ACTIVADA\n' +
        [event.country || event.countryCode, event.platform].filter(Boolean).join(' · ') +
        '\nRating actual: ' + marketsAlertNumberLabel_(event.currentRating) +
        (event.ratingCount === null || event.ratingCount === undefined ? '' :
          '\nValoraciones acumuladas: ' + Math.round(event.ratingCount)) +
        '\nLectura: ' + trimString_(event.detail);
    }
    if (event.type === 'REVIEW_LOW_SHARE') return marketsAlertCardTitle_(event) + '\n' + event.detail;
    if (event.isBelowThresholdPreview) {
      return '[PRUEBA · BAJO UMBRAL] ' + marketsAlertCardTitle_(event) +
        '\nMercado y plataforma: ' +
        [event.country || event.countryCode, event.platform].filter(Boolean).join(' · ') +
        '\nMovimiento real: ' + trimString_(event.detail) +
        '\nUmbral amarillo configurado: ' + marketsAlertNumberLabel_(event.threshold) + ' puntos' +
        '\nEn producción: no se enviaría esta alerta; solo se enviará al alcanzar o superar ese límite.';
    }
    return '[' + marketsAlertSeverityLabel_(event.severity).toUpperCase() + '] ' +
      marketsAlertCardTitle_(event) + '\nMercado y plataforma: ' +
      [event.country || event.countryCode, event.platform].filter(Boolean).join(' · ') + '\nQué ha cambiado: ' +
      trimString_(event.detail) + '\nUmbral configurado: ' + marketsAlertNumberLabel_(event.threshold) + ' puntos\n' +
      'Recomendación: ' + marketsAlertRecommendation_(event);
  });
  return 'EDC MARKET PULSE\nBBVA Banca de Empresas e Instituciones\n\n' +
    (noSignals ? 'Sin alertas activas en el ámbito seleccionado\n' :
      marketsAlertPreviewIsBelowThreshold_(events) ? 'Prueba con movimientos reales bajo umbral\n' :
        (marketsAlertIsReviewShare_(events) ? 'Alerta de reseñas\n' : 'Alerta por cambios en ratings\n')) +
    (isTest ? 'Vista previa construida exclusivamente con el último cierre real y la configuración vigente. No genera una alerta operativa.\n\n' : '\n') +
    lines.join('\n\n') + '\n\nDatos obtenidos: ' + marketsAlertDataDateLabel_(events) +
    '\nVersión: backend ' + MARKETS_CONFIG.codeVersion + ' / web ' + marketsAlertWebVersion_() +
    '\nGestiona tus alertas desde EDC Market Pulse.\nAbrir con la cuenta corporativa: ' + loginUrl + '\nURL directa: ' + (destination || appUrl);
}

/** Common light canvas for clients that honor email color-scheme hints. */
function marketsLightEmailDocument_(language = 'es') {
  return '<!doctype html><html lang="' + language + '" style="color-scheme:light only;background-color:#F7F8F8;">' +
    '<head><meta charset="UTF-8"><meta name="color-scheme" content="light only">' +
    '<meta name="supported-color-schemes" content="light">' +
    '<style>:root{color-scheme:light only;supported-color-schemes:light}</style></head>' +
    '<body bgcolor="#F7F8F8" style="margin:0;background-color:#F7F8F8;color:#000519;color-scheme:light only;' +
    "font-family:'BBVABentonSans','Benton Sans BBVA',Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif;\">";
}

/** Materialize the palette for clients that drop inheritance, without blocking paired recoloring. */
function protectMarketsEmailColors_(html) {
  const stack = [];
  const voidTags = new Set(['area', 'base', 'br', 'col', 'hr', 'img', 'input', 'link', 'meta', 'wbr']);
  const paint = new Set(['body', 'table', 'tr', 'td', 'th', 'header']);
  const colored = new Set([...paint, 'a', 'div', 'p', 'h1', 'h2', 'h3', 'span', 'strong', 'b', 'small']);
  return html.replace(/<(\/?)([a-z][a-z0-9]*)(\s+(?:"[^"]*"|'[^']*'|[^'"<>])*)?>/gi, (tag, closing, name, attributes = '') => {
    name = name.toLowerCase();
    if (closing) {
      if (stack.at(-1)?.name === name) stack.pop();
      return tag;
    }
    const parent = stack.at(-1) || { background: '#F7F8F8', color: '#000519' };
    const style = /\sstyle="([^"]*)"/i.exec(attributes);
    if (voidTags.has(name)) {
      // Inline brand assets keep their pixels in dark mode, so keep their own backdrop too.
      if (name !== 'img' || !/\ssrc="cid:/i.test(attributes)) return tag;
      const backdrop = 'background-image:linear-gradient(' + parent.background + ',' + parent.background + ');';
      return style ? tag.replace(style[0], () => ' style="' + style[1].replace(/;?$/, ';') + backdrop + '"')
        : '<img' + attributes + ' style="' + backdrop + '">';
    }
    const bgcolor = /\sbgcolor="(#[0-9a-f]{3,6})"/i.exec(attributes);
    const backgroundValue = /(?:^|;)\s*background(?:-color)?\s*:\s*(#[0-9a-f]{3,6})(?=\s*(?:;|$))/i.exec(style?.[1] || '')?.[1];
    const explicitColor = /(?:^|;)\s*color\s*:\s*(#[0-9a-f]{3,6})(?=\s*(?:;|$))/i.exec(style?.[1] || '')?.[1];
    const background = backgroundValue || bgcolor?.[1] || parent.background;
    const color = explicitColor || parent.color;
    stack.push({ name, background, color });
    if (!colored.has(name)) return tag;
    const solid = paint.has(name) || backgroundValue || bgcolor;
    let additions = explicitColor ? '' : 'color:' + color + ';';
    if (solid) {
      additions += 'background-color:' + background + ';';
      if (!bgcolor) attributes += ' bgcolor="' + background + '"';
    }
    if (!additions) return tag;
    attributes = style ? attributes.replace(style[0], () => ' style="' + style[1].replace(/;?$/, ';') + additions + '"')
      : attributes + ' style="' + additions + '"';
    return '<' + name + attributes + '>';
  });
}

function renderMarketsAlertEmail_(events, recipient, feedback) {
  const isTest = marketsAlertIsTest_(events);
  const noSignals = marketsAlertPreviewHasNoSignals_(events);
  const reviewShare = marketsAlertIsReviewShare_(events);
  const critical = (events || []).filter(function (event) { return event.severity === 'CRITICAL'; }).length;
  const warning = (events || []).filter(function (event) { return event.severity === 'WARNING'; }).length;
  const positive = (events || []).filter(function (event) { return event.severity === 'POSITIVE'; }).length;
  const cards = (events || []).map(renderMarketsAlertEmailCard_).join('');
  const loginUrl = marketsWebAppLoginUrl_(feedback?.open ? '' : recipient, feedback?.open);
  const safeLoginUrl = escapeMarketsAlertHtml_(loginUrl);
  const cta = '<table role="presentation" align="center" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0"><tr><td bgcolor="#001391" style="border-radius:8px;"><a href="' + safeLoginUrl + '" target="_blank" style="display:block;padding:13px 22px;border-radius:8px;color:#FFFFFF;text-decoration:none;font-weight:700;">Ir a EDC Market Pulse</a></td></tr></table>';
  const subtitle = noSignals ? 'El último cierre real del ámbito seleccionado no ha superado ninguna de las condiciones configuradas.' :
    marketsAlertPreviewIsBelowThreshold_(events) ?
      'Prueba construida con movimientos reales del ámbito guardado. En producción no se enviaría: ninguno alcanza el límite configurado.' :
    isTest ? 'Vista previa con el último cierre real disponible y la configuración vigente. No genera una alerta operativa.' :
    events.length + ' cambio' + (events.length === 1 ? ' ha' : 's han') + ' superado las condiciones configuradas. Contexto ejecutivo para valorar la situación.';
  const summary = isTest ? renderMarketsAlertTestSummary_(events) :
    '<table role="presentation" width="100%" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0"><tr>' +
    marketsAlertSummaryCell_('Críticas', critical, '#B92A45', '#F9E9ED') +
    marketsAlertSummaryCell_('Advertencias', warning, '#946200', '#FFF4CC') +
    marketsAlertSummaryCell_('Positivas', positive, '#277A49', '#E6F4EA') + '</tr></table>';
  return protectMarketsEmailColors_(marketsLightEmailDocument_() +
    '<table role="presentation" width="100%" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0" bgcolor="#F7F8F8" style="background:#F7F8F8;"><tr><td align="center" style="padding:28px 12px;">' +
    '<table role="presentation" width="100%" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0" bgcolor="#FFFFFF" style="width:100%;max-width:640px;background:#FFFFFF;color:#000519;border-radius:16px;overflow:hidden;">' +
    '<tr><td width="100%" bgcolor="#001391" style="padding:24px 28px;background:#001391;color:#FFFFFF;"><img src="cid:bbvaLogo" width="156" alt="BBVA Banca de Empresas e Instituciones" style="display:block;width:156px;height:auto;"><div style="margin-top:22px;color:#8BE1E9;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:1px;text-transform:uppercase;">EDC MARKET PULSE · ' + (isTest ? 'PRUEBA DE CANAL' : reviewShare ? 'ALERTAS DE RESEÑAS' : 'ALERTAS DE RATINGS') + '</div><h1 style="margin:8px 0 0;color:#FFFFFF;font-size:28px;line-height:34px;">' + (noSignals ? 'Sin alertas activas' : marketsAlertPreviewIsBelowThreshold_(events) ? 'Prueba con datos reales' : reviewShare ? 'Alerta de reseñas' : 'Alerta por cambios en ratings') + '</h1><p style="margin:10px 0 0;color:#85C8FF;font-size:15px;line-height:22px;">' + escapeMarketsAlertHtml_(subtitle) + '</p></td></tr>' +
    '<tr><td width="100%" style="padding:22px 28px 8px;">' + summary + '</td></tr>' +
    '<tr><td width="100%" style="padding:14px 28px 8px;">' + cards + '</td></tr>' +
    '<tr><td width="100%" style="padding:18px 28px 30px;">' + cta + '<p align="center" style="margin:18px 0 0;color:#46536D;font-size:12px;line-height:18px;">Este correo es privado y contiene únicamente señales configuradas para tu cuenta. Las preferencias de otros usuarios nunca son visibles.</p><p align="center" style="margin:7px 0 0;color:#ADB8C2;font-size:10px;line-height:15px;">Datos obtenidos el ' + escapeMarketsAlertHtml_(marketsAlertDataDateLabel_(events)) + ' · backend ' + escapeMarketsAlertHtml_(MARKETS_CONFIG.codeVersion) + ' / web ' + escapeMarketsAlertHtml_(marketsAlertWebVersion_()) + '.</p></td></tr>' +
    '<tr><td style="padding:0 28px 28px;">' + renderMarketsEmailFooter_(feedback) + '</td></tr></table></td></tr></table></body></html>');
}

function marketsAlertIsReviewShare_(events) {
  return Boolean(events?.length) && events.every(event => event.type === 'REVIEW_LOW_SHARE');
}

function marketsAlertIsTest_(events) {
  return Boolean((events || []).length) && (events || []).every(function (event) {
    return event.type === 'TEST' || Boolean(event.isTest);
  });
}

function marketsAlertPreviewHasNoSignals_(events) {
  return Boolean((events || []).length) && (events || []).every(function (event) {
    return event.type === 'TEST_SNAPSHOT';
  });
}

function marketsAlertPreviewIsBelowThreshold_(events) {
  return Boolean((events || []).length) && (events || []).every(function (event) {
    return Boolean(event.isBelowThresholdPreview);
  });
}

function marketsAlertWebVersion_() {
  return typeof MARKETS_WEB !== 'undefined' && trimString_(MARKETS_WEB.version) ?
    trimString_(MARKETS_WEB.version) : 'unknown';
}

      events.length + ' series reales del ámbito guardado y ninguna ha superado los umbrales configurados.</span></div>';

}

function renderMarketsAlertEmailCard_(event) {

  const palette = event.severity === 'CRITICAL' ? ['#B92A45', '#F9E9ED', 'Crítico'] :

    '<div style="font-size:11px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.7px;text-transform:uppercase;color:' + palette[0] + ';">' + palette[2] + ' · ' + escapeMarketsAlertHtml_(marketsAlertRuleLabel_(event.type)) + '</div>' +
    '<div style="margin-top:7px;color:#070E46;font-size:18px;font-weight:700;line-height:24px;">' + escapeMarketsAlertHtml_(title) + '</div>' +
    '<div style="margin-top:3px;color:#46536D;font-size:13px;line-height:19px;">' + escapeMarketsAlertHtml_(market) + '</div>' + metrics +
    '<div style="margin-top:12px;padding-top:11px;border-top:1px solid rgba(0,19,145,.12);color:#46536D;font-size:13px;line-height:19px;"><strong style="color:#070E46;">Qué significa:</strong> ' + escapeMarketsAlertHtml_(marketsAlertReason_(event)) + '<br><strong style="color:#070E46;">Siguiente paso:</strong> ' + escapeMarketsAlertHtml_(marketsAlertRecommendation_(event)) + '</div></div>';

function marketsAlertCardTitle_(event) {
  const app = trimString_(event.appName || 'BBVA Empresas');
  if (event.type === 'REVIEW_LOW_SHARE') {
    return marketsAlertNumberLabel_(event.metricValue) + ' % de reseñas de 1 o 2 estrellas';
  }
  if (event.type === 'COMPETITIVE_CROSSOVER') {
    return event.direction === 'LOST' ? trimString_(event.competitorName) + ' ha superado a ' + app :
      app + ' ha recuperado posición frente a ' + trimString_(event.competitorName);
  }
  return 'BBVA ' + marketsAlertGeographyLabel_(event) + ' cae ' + marketsAlertNumberLabel_(event.metricValue) + ' puntos';
}

function marketsAlertGeographyLabel_(event) {
  return trimString_(event.country || event.countryCode || 'mercado');
}

function marketsAlertMetricsHtml_(event, palette) {
  if (event.type === 'REVIEW_LOW_SHARE') return '';
  if (event.type === 'COMPETITIVE_CROSSOVER') {
    return '<table role="presentation" width="100%" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0" style="margin-top:13px;background:#FFFFFF;border-radius:8px;"><tr>' +
      marketsAlertMetricCell_('BBVA', marketsAlertNumberLabel_(event.bbvaRating), 'rating') +
      marketsAlertMetricCell_(trimString_(event.competitorName || 'Competidor'), marketsAlertNumberLabel_(event.competitorRating), 'rating') +
      marketsAlertMetricCell_('Brecha', marketsAlertSignedNumberLabel_(event.metricValue), 'puntos') + '</tr></table>';
  }
  return '<table role="presentation" width="100%" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0" style="margin-top:13px;background:#FFFFFF;border-radius:8px;"><tr>' +
    marketsAlertMetricCell_('Rating anterior', marketsAlertNumberLabel_(event.baselineRating), marketsAlertDateLabel_(event.baselineDate)) +
    marketsAlertMetricCell_('Rating actual', marketsAlertNumberLabel_(event.currentRating), marketsAlertDateLabel_(event.currentDate)) +
    marketsAlertMetricCell_('Caída / límite', marketsAlertNumberLabel_(event.metricValue), 'límite ' + marketsAlertNumberLabel_(event.threshold)) + '</tr></table>';
}

function marketsAlertMetricCell_(label, value, note) {
  return '<td width="33.33%" style="padding:12px 9px;text-align:center;"><span style="display:block;color:#46536D;font-size:10px;text-transform:uppercase;">' + escapeMarketsAlertHtml_(label) + '</span><strong style="display:block;margin-top:3px;color:#070E46;font-size:18px;line-height:22px;">' + escapeMarketsAlertHtml_(value) + '</strong><small style="display:block;margin-top:2px;color:#46536D;font-size:10px;line-height:14px;">' + escapeMarketsAlertHtml_(note) + '</small></td>';
}

function marketsAlertSeverityLabel_(severity) {
  return severity === 'CRITICAL' ? 'Crítica' : severity === 'WARNING' ? 'Advertencia' : 'Movimiento positivo';
}

function marketsAlertReason_(event) {
  if (event.type === 'REVIEW_LOW_SHARE') return event.detail;
  if (event.type === 'COMPETITIVE_CROSSOVER') {
    return event.direction === 'LOST' ? 'El competidor ha pasado de estar por debajo o empatado a situarse por encima de BBVA.' :
      'BBVA ha pasado de estar por debajo o empatado a situarse por encima del competidor.';
  }
  const limit = event.severity === 'CRITICAL' ? 'rojo' : 'amarillo';
  return 'La caída de ' + marketsAlertNumberLabel_(event.metricValue) +
    ' puntos supera el límite configurado para el nivel ' + limit +
    ' (' + marketsAlertNumberLabel_(event.threshold) + ' puntos).';
}

function marketsAlertRecommendation_(event) {
  if (event.type === 'REVIEW_LOW_SHARE') return 'Consulta las reseñas recientes de BBVA Empresas en EDC Market Pulse.';
  if (event.type === 'COMPETITIVE_CROSSOVER') return 'Abre EDC Market Pulse y compara la evolución de BBVA con el competidor en ese mercado.';
  return 'Abre EDC Market Pulse, revisa la evolución de la aplicación y contrasta el movimiento con las valoraciones recientes.';
}

function marketsAlertNumberLabel_(value) {
  const number = Number(value);
  return isFinite(number) ? number.toFixed(2).replace('.', ',') : '—';
}

function marketsAlertIntegerLabel_(value) {
  const number = toFiniteNumber_(value);
  if (number === null) return 'N/D';
  return Math.round(number).toLocaleString('es-ES');
}

function marketsAlertSignedNumberLabel_(value) {
  const number = Number(value);
  return isFinite(number) ? (number > 0 ? '+' : '') + number.toFixed(2).replace('.', ',') : '—';
}

function marketsAlertDateLabel_(value) {
  if (!value) return 'fecha base';
  const date = value instanceof Date ? value : new Date(value);
  if (isNaN(date.getTime())) return trimString_(value);
  try { return Utilities.formatDate(date, MARKETS_CONFIG.timeZone, 'dd/MM/yyyy'); }
  catch (ignored) { return date.toISOString().slice(0, 10); }
}

function marketsAlertDataDateLabel_(events) {
  const dates = (events || []).map(function (event) {
    return event.currentDate || event.referenceDate || null;
  }).map(function (value) {
    if (!value) return null;
    const date = value instanceof Date ? value : new Date(value);
    return isNaN(date.getTime()) ? null : date;
  }).filter(Boolean).sort(function (a, b) { return b.getTime() - a.getTime(); });
  return dates.length ? marketsAlertDateLabel_(dates[0]) : 'no disponible';
}

function marketsAlertRuleLabel_(type) {
  return type === 'REVIEW_LOW_SHARE' ? 'Proporción de reseñas de 1 y 2 estrellas' :
    type === 'RATING_DROP_DAILY' ? 'Caída diaria del rating' :
    type === 'RATING_DROP_MTD' ? 'Caída del día 15 al día 15' :
    type === 'RATING_DROP_YTD' ? 'Caída desde inicio de año' :
    type === 'COMPETITIVE_CROSSOVER' ? 'Cruce de posición competitiva' :
    type === 'TEST' ? 'Verificación del canal' : type;
}

function buildMarketsAlertInlineImages_() {
  const html = HtmlService.createHtmlOutputFromFile('BrandIdentity').getContent();
  const match = html.match(/--asset-bbva-bei-logo:url\("data:image\/png;base64,([^"\)]+)"\)/);
  if (!match) throw new Error('No se ha encontrado el logotipo oficial de BBVA Banca de Empresas e Instituciones.');
  const images = { bbvaLogo: Utilities.newBlob(Utilities.base64Decode(match[1]), 'image/png', 'bbva-bei.png') };
  for (const [id, data] of Object.entries(marketsEmailFooterImages_(html))) {
    images[id] = Utilities.newBlob(Utilities.base64Decode(data), 'image/png', id + '.png');
  }
  return images;
}

function marketsEmailFooterImages_(html) {
  const entries = html.matchAll(/<template id="mail-(biaLogo|feedbackPositive|feedbackNegative|reviewAndroid)">([A-Za-z0-9+/=]+)<\/template>/g);
  return Object.fromEntries([...entries].map(([, id, data]) => [id, data]));
}

function escapeMarketsAlertHtml_(value) {
  return trimString_(value).replace(/&/g, '&amp;').replace(/</g, '&lt;')
    .replace(/>/g, '&gt;').replace(/"/g, '&quot;').replace(/'/g, '&#39;');
}

function marketsEmailFooterMime_(images, boundary, ids = ['biaLogo', 'feedbackPositive', 'feedbackNegative']) {
  return ids.flatMap(id => images?.[id] ? [
    '--' + boundary, 'Content-Type: image/png; name="' + id + '.png"',
    'Content-Transfer-Encoding: base64', 'Content-ID: <' + id + '>',
    'Content-Disposition: inline; filename="' + id + '.png"', '', marketsAlertMimeBytes_(images[id].getBytes())
  ] : []);
}

function marketsEmailSecret_(key) {
  const properties = PropertiesService.getScriptProperties();
  const existing = properties.getProperty(key);
  if (existing) return existing;
  // Both delivery paths already hold the script lock while composing messages.
  const secret = Utilities.getUuid() + Utilities.getUuid();
  properties.setProperty(key, secret);
  return secret;
}

function marketsAlertFeedbackLinks_(recipient, messageId) {
  const secret = marketsEmailSecret_('MARKETS_ALERT_FEEDBACK_SECRET');
  if (secret.length < 32) return null;
  const expiry = Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000) + 30 * 86400;
  return Object.fromEntries(['open', 'positive', 'negative', 'unsubscribe'].map(vote => {
    const payload = [messageId, expiry, vote].join('.');
    const signature = signMarketsAlertFeedback_(payload, recipient, secret);
    return [vote, marketsWebAppUrl_() + '?alertFeedback=' + encodeURIComponent(payload + '.' + signature)];
  }));
}

function signMarketsAlertFeedback_(payload, recipient, secret) {
  return Utilities.base64EncodeWebSafe(Utilities.computeHmacSha256Signature(payload + '|' + recipient, secret))
    .replace(/=+$/, '');
}

function parseMarketsAlertFeedback_(token) {
  const match = /^([a-f0-9]{32})\.(\d{10})\.(open|positive|negative|unsubscribe)\.([A-Za-z0-9_-]{43})$/.exec(String(token || ''));
  if (!match || Number(match[2]) <= Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000)) return null;
  return { id: match[1], expiry: Number(match[2]), vote: match[3], signature: match[4] };
}

function requireMarketsAlertFeedbackLink_(token, recipient) {
  const request = parseMarketsAlertFeedback_(token);
  const secret = PropertiesService.getScriptProperties().getProperty('MARKETS_ALERT_FEEDBACK_SECRET');
  if (!request || !secret || secret.length < 32) throw new Error('Valoración no válida o caducada.');
  const payload = [request.id, request.expiry, request.vote].join('.');
  const expected = signMarketsAlertFeedback_(payload, recipient, secret);
  let different = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < expected.length; i++) different |= expected.charCodeAt(i) ^ request.signature.charCodeAt(i);
  if (different) throw new Error('La valoración no corresponde a la cuenta conectada.');
  return request;
}

const MARKETS_ALERT_FEEDBACK_BASE = ['message_id', 'vote', 'recorded_at'];
const MARKETS_ALERT_FEEDBACK_HEADERS = [...MARKETS_ALERT_FEEDBACK_BASE, 'observation', 'status', 'user_email'];

function marketsAlertFeedbackSheet_(ss, extend = false) {
  const name = 'ALERT_FEEDBACK';
  const existing = ss.getSheetByName(name);
  if (!existing && !extend) return null;
  const sheet = existing || ss.insertSheet(name);
  return marketsAppendSheetHeaders_(sheet, MARKETS_ALERT_FEEDBACK_HEADERS, [MARKETS_ALERT_FEEDBACK_BASE.length, 5], extend);
}

function findMarketsAlertFeedback_(sheet, id) {
  const last = sheet.getLastRow();
  return last > 1 ? sheet.getRange(2, 1, last - 1, 1).createTextFinder(id).matchEntireCell(true).findNext() : null;
}

function saveMarketsAlertFeedback(token, vote, observation) {
  const recipient = currentMarketsUserEmail_();
  const request = requireMarketsAlertFeedbackLink_(token, recipient);
  if (request.vote === 'open') throw new Error('Valoración no válida.');
  const comment = trimString_(observation);
  if ((vote !== undefined && !['positive', 'negative'].includes(vote)) || comment.length > 1000 ||
      (request.vote === 'unsubscribe' && (vote !== undefined || comment))) throw new Error('Valoración no válida.');
  const lock = LockService.getScriptLock();
  if (!lock.tryLock(5000)) throw new Error('La valoración está ocupada. Inténtalo de nuevo.');
  try {
    const ss = openMarketsSpreadsheet_();
    if (request.vote === 'unsubscribe') return unsubscribeMarketsEmail_(ss, recipient, false);
    const current = marketsAlertFeedbackSheet_(ss);
    const found = current && findMarketsAlertFeedback_(current.sheet, request.id);
    const previous = found && current.sheet.getRange(found.getRow(), 1, 1, current.headers.length).getValues()[0];
    const choice = vote || request.vote;
    const note = observation === undefined ? previous?.[3] || '' : comment;
    const unchanged = previous && previous[1] === choice && (previous[3] || '') === note;
    if (unchanged && previous[5] === recipient) return { recorded: true };
    const { sheet, headers } = marketsAlertFeedbackSheet_(ss, true);
    const row = found ? found.getRow() : sheet.getLastRow() + 1;
    ensureSheetCapacity_(sheet, row, headers.length);
    sheet.getRange(row, 1, 1, headers.length).setValues([[request.id, choice, unchanged ? previous[2] : new Date(), marketsReviewLiteral_(note),
      unchanged ? previous[4] || 'pendiente' : 'pendiente', marketsReviewLiteral_(recipient)]]);
    SpreadsheetApp.flush();
    return { recorded: true };
  } finally {
    lock.releaseLock();
  }
}

function renderMarketsAlertFeedbackPage_(token) {
  const request = parseMarketsAlertFeedback_(token);
  if (!request) return HtmlService.createHtmlOutput('<p>El enlace de valoración ha caducado o no es válido.</p>');
  const page = HtmlService.createTemplateFromFile('AlertFeedback');
  page.token = token;
  page.newsletter = false;
  page.rating = '';
  page.unsubscribe = request.vote === 'unsubscribe';
  page.destination = '';
  page.choice = page.unsubscribe ? 'Dar de baja las alertas' : request.vote === 'positive' ? 'Sí, me resultó útil' : 'No me resultó útil';
  return page.evaluate().setTitle('Valorar alerta de EDC Market Pulse')
    .addMetaTag('viewport', 'width=device-width, initial-scale=1');
}

/** Called only after validating the recipient-bound link and acquiring the script lock. */
function unsubscribeMarketsEmail_(ss, recipient, newsletter) {
  const preferences = readMarketsAlertPreferences_(ss, recipient);
  const key = newsletter ? 'newsletterEnabled' : 'active';
  if (preferences[key]) {
    const updated = normalizeMarketsAlertPreferences_({ ...preferences, [key]: false }, recipient);
    upsertMarketsAlertPreferences_(ss, updated, recipient);
  }
  return { unsubscribed: true };
}
