function classifyMarketsReviewAudience_(original) {
  const rules = MARKETS_REVIEW_AUDIENCE_RULES;
  const evidence = {};
  const clauses = String(original || '').split(/[.!?;\n]+|\b(?:pero|sin embargo|but|however|mas|porem|ama|ancak|fakat)\b/iu);
  const normalized = normalizeReviewEvidence_(original);
  evidence.retail = (rules.retail.exec(normalized) || rules.salaryReceived.exec(normalized) || rules.turkishSalaryCustomer.exec(normalized) ||
    rules.personalUse.exec(normalized) || rules.pension.exec(normalized) || rules.personalContext.exec(normalized))?.[0] || '';
  const salaryCustomer = rules.turkishSalaryCustomer.test(normalized) || /\bmaas (?:hesab\w*|musterisi\w*)\b|\bmaasim\w*\b/u.test(normalized);
  for (const text of clauses) {
    const clause = normalizeReviewEvidence_(text);
    if (!clause) continue;
    const banking = rules.banking.exec(clause)?.[0] || '';
    const feature = rules.operation.exec(clause)?.[0] || banking;
    const issue = rules.issue.exec(clause)?.[0];
    const action = rules.action.exec(clause)?.[0];
    const authorOperation = /\b(?:puedo|pagar|pago|pagamos|pague|envie|recibi|cobre|abri|yapamadim|gonderdim|gonderiyorum|gonderemiyorum|yaptim|al(?:am|in|iyor)\w*)\b/u.test(clause);
    const performance = /\b(?:app|aplicacion|movil|uygulama\w*)\b.*\b(lent[oa]|tarda\w*|cierra|bloque\w*|yavas|donuyor|kapaniyor)\b/u.exec(clause);
    if (!evidence.shared && ((feature && (issue || (authorOperation && banking && action !== banking))) ||
        (issue && /\b(?:entrar|acceder|giremiyorum|giris\w*)\b/u.test(clause)) || performance)) {
      evidence.shared = feature || performance?.[1] || issue;
    }

    if (evidence.business || rules.negatedBusiness.test(clause)) continue;
    const strong = rules.direct.map(pattern => pattern.exec(clause)?.[0]).find(Boolean);
    const personal = rules.retail.test(clause) || rules.salaryReceived.test(clause) || rules.turkishSalaryCustomer.test(clause) || rules.personalUse.test(clause) ||
      rules.pension.test(clause) || rules.personalContext.test(clause);
    const context = !personal && rules.context.exec(clause)?.[0];
    const bankStaff = /\b(?:calisanlariniz\w*|(?:banka|sube) (?:personel|calisan)\w*)\b/u.test(clause);
    const payrollMatch = MARKETS_REVIEW_PAYROLL.exec(clause)?.[0];
    // A generic reference to staff payroll can be the employee's complaint, including in the title.
    const employeePayroll = salaryCustomer && /^(?:personel|calisanlar\w*)\b/.test(payrollMatch || '') &&
      !/\b(?:personelimin|personelimizin|calisanlarimin|calisanlarimizin|oduyorum|oduyoruz|odeyemiyorum|odeyemiyoruz)\b/u.test(clause);
    const payroll = !personal && !bankStaff && !employeePayroll && payrollMatch;
    const fileOperation = issue && /\b(?:ficheros? (?:bancarios?|de remesas)|archivos? de remesas)\b/u.exec(clause)?.[0];
    const business = rules.businessUse.exec(clause)?.[0] || strong || payroll || fileOperation ||
      (context && action && banking && context !== 'ticari' ? context : '');
    if (business) evidence.business = business;
  }
  const sharedOperation = Boolean(evidence.shared);
  const mixedAccounts = evidence.retail && /\bbireysel olarak\b.*\bticari olarak (?:hesa[bp]\w*|ac\w*)\b/u.test(normalized);
  const audience = evidence.retail && (evidence.business || mixedAccounts) ? 'MIXED' : evidence.business ? 'BEI_CONFIRMED'
    : evidence.retail ? 'RETAIL' : 'UNDETERMINED';
  const relevance = evidence.business ? 'BUSINESS' : evidence.retail ? 'NONE'
    : sharedOperation ? 'TRANSVERSAL' : rules.operation.test(normalized) || rules.banking.test(normalized) ? 'UNCERTAIN' : 'NONE';
  const reason = audience === 'MIXED' ? (evidence.business ? 'explicit_business_with_retail' : 'mixed_account_context') : ({
    BUSINESS: 'business', TRANSVERSAL: 'shared_banking', UNCERTAIN: 'insufficient_context',
    NONE: evidence.retail ? 'personal_use' : 'insufficient_evidence'
  })[relevance];
  return { audience, relevance, sharedOperation, reason, evidence };
}

function matchesMarketsReviewAudience_(filter, decision) {
  if (!['BEI', 'BEI_ONLY', 'BEI_EXTENDED'].includes(filter)) return true;
  return decision.relevance === 'BUSINESS' || decision.relevance === 'TRANSVERSAL';
}

function syncMarketsFunctionalCatalog_() {
  const lock = LockService.getUserLock();
  if (!lock.tryLock(1000)) return { deferred: true };
  const properties = PropertiesService.getScriptProperties();
  const started = Date.now();
  const requested = properties.getProperty('MARKETS_FUNCTIONAL_SYNC_REQUEST');
  try {
    const ss = openMarketsSpreadsheet_(), master = SpreadsheetApp.openById(MARKETS_FUNCTIONAL_MASTER);
    const seen = new Set(), rows = [];
    for (const name of MARKETS_FUNCTIONAL_TABS) {
      const source = master.getSheetByName(name);
      if (!source || source.getLastRow() > 1500) throw new Error('Pestaña de catálogo ausente o fuera de límite: ' + name);
      const values = source.getRange(1, 1, source.getLastRow(), 6).getDisplayValues();
      const header = values.findIndex(row => row.includes('ID') && row.includes('Bloque funcional') &&
        row.includes('Funcionalidad/Sub Operativa'));
      if (header < 0) throw new Error('Cabecera de catálogo no válida: ' + name);
      const columns = ['ID', 'Bloque funcional', 'Funcionalidad/Sub Operativa', 'Descripción']
        .map(label => values[header].indexOf(label));
      for (const sourceRow of values.slice(header + 1)) {
        const [id, block, feature, description] = columns.map(column => String(sourceRow[column] || '').trim());
        if (!/^\d{2}\.\d{2}$/.test(id)) continue;
        if (!block || !feature || seen.has(id)) throw new Error('Funcionalidad incompleta o duplicada: ' + id);
        seen.add(id);
        rows.push([id, block, feature, description]);
      }
    }
    if (!rows.length) throw new Error('Catálogo funcional vacío.');
    rows.sort((a, b) => a[0].localeCompare(b[0]));
    const revision = Utilities.base64EncodeWebSafe(Utilities.computeDigest(Utilities.DigestAlgorithm.SHA_256, JSON.stringify(rows)));
    const existing = ss.getSheetByName('FUNCTIONAL_CATALOG');
    const changed = !existing || properties.getProperty('MARKETS_FUNCTIONAL_REVISION') !== revision;
    if (changed) {
      const sheet = existing ? requireCurrentSheetContract_(ss, 'FUNCTIONAL_CATALOG', MARKETS_FUNCTIONAL_HEADERS) : ss.insertSheet('FUNCTIONAL_CATALOG');
      const previous = sheet.getLastRow();
      ensureSheetCapacity_(sheet, rows.length + 1, 4);
      sheet.getRange(1, 1, rows.length + 1, 4).setNumberFormat('@')
        .setValues([MARKETS_FUNCTIONAL_HEADERS, ...rows].map(row => row.map(marketsReviewLiteral_)));
      if (previous > rows.length + 1) sheet.getRange(rows.length + 2, 1, previous - rows.length - 1, 4).clearContent();
      sheet.setFrozenRows(1);
      SpreadsheetApp.flush();
      properties.setProperty('MARKETS_FUNCTIONAL_REVISION', revision);
    }
    properties.setProperties({ MARKETS_FUNCTIONAL_SYNCED: new Date().toISOString(),
      MARKETS_FUNCTIONAL_SYNC_STATUS: JSON.stringify({ status: 'Completado', durationMs: Date.now() - started, functions: rows.length, changed }) });
    if (requested && properties.getProperty('MARKETS_FUNCTIONAL_SYNC_REQUEST') === requested) {
      properties.deleteProperty('MARKETS_FUNCTIONAL_SYNC_REQUEST');
    }
    return { changed, functions: rows.length };
  } catch (error) {
    properties.setProperty('MARKETS_FUNCTIONAL_SYNC_STATUS', JSON.stringify({ status: 'Reintento pendiente',
      durationMs: Date.now() - started, error: errorToString_(error).slice(0, 180), retryAt: Date.now() + 3600000 }));
    throw error;
  } finally {
    lock.releaseLock();
  }
}

// Like News Radar: revision-bound checkpoint, reuse translations by original text,
// short quota-aware batches, and leave the original visible until its label is ready.
function advanceMarketsFunctionalCatalog_(allow = { sync: true, translate: true }) {
  const properties = PropertiesService.getScriptProperties();
  const today = Utilities.formatDate(new Date(), MARKETS_CONFIG.timeZone, 'yyyy-MM-dd');
  const sync = safeJsonParse_(properties.getProperty('MARKETS_FUNCTIONAL_SYNC_STATUS')) || {};
  const last = properties.getProperty('MARKETS_FUNCTIONAL_SYNCED');
  if ((properties.getProperty('MARKETS_FUNCTIONAL_SYNC_REQUEST') || !last ||
      Utilities.formatDate(new Date(last), MARKETS_CONFIG.timeZone, 'yyyy-MM-dd') !== today) &&
      !(sync.retryAt > Date.now())) {
    if (!allow.sync) return false;
    try { syncMarketsFunctionalCatalog_(); }
    catch (error) { console.warn('Catálogo funcional: ' + errorToString_(error)); }
    return true;
  }
  const revision = properties.getProperty('MARKETS_FUNCTIONAL_REVISION');
  const previous = safeJsonParse_(properties.getProperty(MARKETS_FUNCTIONAL_JOB));
  if (!allow.translate || !revision || (previous?.revision === revision && (previous.status === 'Completado' || previous.retryAt > Date.now())) ||
      Number(properties.getProperty(MARKETS_TRANSLATION_QUOTA_RETRY_KEY)) > Date.now()) return;
  const lock = LockService.getUserLock();
  if (!lock.tryLock(1000)) return;
  try {
    const started = Date.now();
    const current = safeJsonParse_(properties.getProperty(MARKETS_FUNCTIONAL_JOB));
    if ((current?.revision === revision && (current.status === 'Completado' || current.retryAt > started)) ||
        Number(properties.getProperty(MARKETS_TRANSLATION_QUOTA_RETRY_KEY)) > started ||
        properties.getProperty('MARKETS_FUNCTIONAL_REVISION') !== revision) {
      return false;
    }
    const job = current?.revision === revision ? current : { revision, done: 0, total: 0, day: current?.day, calls: current?.calls || 0 };
    try {
      const ss = openMarketsSpreadsheet_();
      const catalog = requireCurrentSheetContract_(ss, 'FUNCTIONAL_CATALOG', MARKETS_FUNCTIONAL_HEADERS);
      const sourceCount = catalog.getLastRow() - 1;
      const labels = sourceCount > 0 ? catalog.getRange(2, 2, sourceCount, 2).getDisplayValues().flat() : [];
      const originals = [...new Set(labels.filter(Boolean))].sort();
      const languages = ['en', 'tr'];
      job.total = originals.length * languages.length;
      if (job.day !== today) { job.day = today; job.calls = 0; }
      const existing = ss.getSheetByName(MARKETS_FUNCTIONAL_TRANSLATIONS);
      const sheet = existing ? requireCurrentSheetContract_(ss, MARKETS_FUNCTIONAL_TRANSLATIONS, MARKETS_FUNCTIONAL_TRANSLATION_HEADERS)
        : ss.insertSheet(MARKETS_FUNCTIONAL_TRANSLATIONS);
      if (!existing) sheet.getRange(1, 1, 1, 3).setValues([MARKETS_FUNCTIONAL_TRANSLATION_HEADERS]);
      const lastRow = sheet.getLastRow();
      const rows = lastRow > 1 ? sheet.getRange(2, 1, lastRow - 1, 3).getDisplayValues() : [];
      const known = new Set(rows.map(([lang, original]) => JSON.stringify([lang, original])));
      const batch = [];
      let cursor = Math.max(0, Math.min(job.total, job.done || 0));
      job.done = cursor;
      job.startedAt = new Date(started).toISOString();
      job.runningUntil = started + 6 * 60 * 1000;
      properties.setProperty(MARKETS_FUNCTIONAL_JOB, JSON.stringify(job));
      let failure;
      try {
        while (cursor < job.total && batch.length < 20 && job.calls < 100 && Date.now() - started < 10000) {
          const original = originals[Math.floor(cursor / languages.length)], language = languages[cursor % languages.length];
          if (!known.has(JSON.stringify([language, original]))) {
            job.calls++;
            const translated = String(LanguageApp.translate(original, 'es', language) || '').trim();
            if (!translated) throw new Error('Traducción vacía.');
            batch.push([language, original, translated].map(marketsReviewLiteral_));
          }
          cursor++;
        }
      } catch (error) { failure = error; }
      if (batch.length) {
        ensureSheetCapacity_(sheet, lastRow + batch.length, 3);
        sheet.getRange(lastRow + 1, 1, batch.length, 3).setValues(batch);
        SpreadsheetApp.flush();
        properties.setProperty('MARKETS_FUNCTIONAL_TRANSLATIONS_REVISION', Utilities.getUuid());
      }
      job.done = cursor;
      job.status = cursor === job.total ? 'Completado' : job.calls >= 100 ? 'En pausa por límite diario' : 'Pendiente';
      job.error = '';
      job.retryAt = 0;
      if (failure) throw failure;
    } catch (error) {
      job.status = 'Reintento pendiente';
      job.error = errorToString_(error).slice(0, 180);
      job.retryAt = Date.now() + 3600000;
      if (/quota|cuota|too many times|limit exceeded/i.test(job.error)) {
        properties.setProperty(MARKETS_TRANSLATION_QUOTA_RETRY_KEY, String(job.retryAt));
      }
    } finally {
      delete job.runningUntil;
      job.updatedAt = new Date().toISOString();
      job.durationMs = Date.now() - started;
      properties.setProperty(MARKETS_FUNCTIONAL_JOB, JSON.stringify(job));
    }
  } finally {
    lock.releaseLock();
  }
  return true;
}

function marketsFunctionalJobStatus_() {
  const properties = PropertiesService.getScriptProperties();
  const synced = properties.getProperty('MARKETS_FUNCTIONAL_SYNCED');
  const sync = safeJsonParse_(properties.getProperty('MARKETS_FUNCTIONAL_SYNC_STATUS')) || {};
  const translation = safeJsonParse_(properties.getProperty(MARKETS_FUNCTIONAL_JOB)) || {};
  const requested = properties.getProperty('MARKETS_FUNCTIONAL_SYNC_REQUEST');
  const revision = properties.getProperty('MARKETS_FUNCTIONAL_REVISION');
  const awaitingSync = !revision || Boolean(requested);
  const pendingTranslation = translation.revision !== revision;
  const quotaRetryAt = Number(properties.getProperty(MARKETS_TRANSLATION_QUOTA_RETRY_KEY)) || 0;
  const waitingQuota = quotaRetryAt > Date.now() && translation.status !== 'Completado';
  return [
    { id: 'taxonomy', priority: 6, schedule: 'Comprobación diaria y tras cambios', name: 'Catálogo global de funcionalidades', status: sync.status || (synced ? 'Completado' : 'Sin ejecución registrada'),
      updatedAt: synced, done: sync.functions, total: sync.functions, changed: sync.changed, error: sync.error, retryAt: sync.retryAt, durationMs: sync.durationMs },
    { id: 'taxonomyTranslation', priority: 6, schedule: 'Tras sincronizar el catálogo',
      name: 'Traducción del catálogo funcional', status: awaitingSync ? 'Esperando catálogo' :
        !pendingTranslation && translation.runningUntil > Date.now() ? 'En curso' : waitingQuota ? 'Esperando cuota de traducción' : pendingTranslation ? 'Pendiente' : translation.status || 'Pendiente',
      startedAt: pendingTranslation ? undefined : translation.startedAt,
      updatedAt: pendingTranslation ? undefined : translation.updatedAt, error: pendingTranslation ? undefined : translation.error, retryAt: waitingQuota ? quotaRetryAt : translation.retryAt, durationMs: translation.durationMs,
      done: pendingTranslation ? undefined : translation.done, total: pendingTranslation ? undefined : translation.total }
  ];
}

function marketsFunctionalTranslations_(ss, language) {
  const sheet = language !== 'es' && ss.getSheetByName(MARKETS_FUNCTIONAL_TRANSLATIONS);
  if (!sheet || sheet.getLastRow() < 2) return new Map();
  requireCurrentSheetContract_(ss, MARKETS_FUNCTIONAL_TRANSLATIONS, MARKETS_FUNCTIONAL_TRANSLATION_HEADERS);
  return new Map(sheet.getRange(2, 1, sheet.getLastRow() - 1, 3).getDisplayValues()
    .filter(row => row[0] === language).map(([, original, translated]) => [original, translated]));
}

function localizeMarketsReviewTopics_(ss, data, language) {
  const names = marketsFunctionalTranslations_(ss, language || 'es');
  if (!names.size) return data;
  const topics = Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(data.topics).map(([id, name]) => [id, names.get(name) || name]));
  return { ...data, topics, ...(data.deltas ? { deltas: data.deltas.map(row => ({ ...row, label: topics[row.id] || row.label })) } : {}) };
}

function queueMarketsFunctionalCatalogEdit_(event) {
  const range = event?.range;
  if (!range || !MARKETS_FUNCTIONAL_TABS.includes(range.getSheet().getName()) || range.getColumn() > 6) return;
  PropertiesService.getScriptProperties().setProperty('MARKETS_FUNCTIONAL_SYNC_REQUEST', Utilities.getUuid());
}

function setupMarketsReviewInsights() {
  requireMarketsReviewOwner_();
  const lock = LockService.getScriptLock();
  if (!lock.tryLock(5000)) return { deferred: true };
  try {
    const triggers = ScriptApp.getProjectTriggers();
    if (!triggers.some(trigger => trigger.getHandlerFunction() === 'queueMarketsFunctionalCatalogEdit_' &&
        trigger.getTriggerSourceId() === MARKETS_FUNCTIONAL_MASTER)) {
      ScriptApp.newTrigger('queueMarketsFunctionalCatalogEdit_').forSpreadsheet(MARKETS_FUNCTIONAL_MASTER).onEdit().create();
    }
    PropertiesService.getScriptProperties().setProperty('MARKETS_FUNCTIONAL_SYNC_REQUEST', Utilities.getUuid());
    return { queued: true };
  } finally {
    lock.releaseLock();
  }
}

function getMarketsReviewHeatmap(filters) {
  currentMarketsUserEmail_();
  const ss = openMarketsSpreadsheet_();
  const catalog = ss.getSheetByName('FUNCTIONAL_CATALOG');
  if (!catalog || catalog.getLastRow() < 2) return { configured: false, functions: [] };
  const period = /^\d{4}-\d{2}$/.test(filters?.period) ? filters.period : '';
  const country = /^(UNKNOWN|[A-Z]{2})$/.test(filters?.country) ? filters.country : '';
  const platform = ['Android', 'iOS'].includes(filters?.platform) ? filters.platform : '';
  const appName = String(filters?.app || '').slice(0, 150);
  const { audience } = normalizeMarketsReviewFilters_({ audience: filters?.audience });
  const scope = { audience, period, country: country || 'ALL', platform: platform || 'ALL', app: appName, maxRating: 3, includeTopics: true };
  return readMarketsReviewCache_(ss, 'heatmap', scope, {}, apps => {
    const taxonomy = catalog.getRange(2, 1, catalog.getLastRow() - 1, 4).getDisplayValues();
    const topics = {};
    const groups = { entities: new Map(), markets: new Map() };
    for (const [id, block, name] of taxonomy) {
      topics[id] = name;
      topics[id.slice(0, 2)] = block;
      topics[id.slice(0, 2) + '.xx'] = block + ' · Sin suboperativa identificada';
    }
    const rows = queryMarketsReviews_(ss, scope, null, false, apps);
    let classified = 0;
    for (const row of rows) {
      const ids = row.topicIds.filter(id => topics[id]);
      if (ids.length) classified++;
      const categories = new Set(ids.flatMap(id => [id, id.slice(0, 2)]));
      for (const [axis, labels] of [['entities', row.entities], ['markets', row.countries]]) {
        for (const label of labels) {
          const group = groups[axis].get(label) || { label, total: 0, counts: {} };
          group.total++;
          for (const id of categories) group.counts[id] = (group.counts[id] || 0) + 1;
          groups[axis].set(label, group);
        }
      }
    }
    const complaints = rows.length;
    return { configured: true, complaints, classified, topics,
      groups: Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(groups).map(([axis, values]) => [axis, [...values.values()]
        .sort((a, b) => Number(b.label === 'BBVA Empresas') - Number(a.label === 'BBVA Empresas') ||
          b.total - a.total || a.label.localeCompare(b.label))])) };
  });
}

const MARKETS_REVIEW_ENTITY = 'BBVA Empresas';
const MARKETS_REVIEW_SNAPSHOT_SCHEMA = 15;
const MARKETS_REVIEW_SNAPSHOT_POINTER = 'MARKETS_REVIEW_SNAPSHOT_POINTER';
const MARKETS_REVIEW_HELPFUL_MIN = 5;
const MARKETS_REVIEW_PAGE_SIZE = 25;

function marketsReviewWindow_(filters = {}) {
  const today = Utilities.formatDate(new Date(), MARKETS_CONFIG.timeZone, 'yyyy-MM-dd');
  const earliest = shiftReviewDay_(today, -365);
  const start = filters.start && filters.start > earliest ? filters.start : earliest;
  const end = filters.end && filters.end < today ? filters.end : today;
  const recent = shiftReviewDay_(end, -29);
  return { start, recent: recent < start ? start : recent, end };
}

function marketsAnnualReviewWindow_(window) {
  const annual = marketsReviewWindow_({ end: window.end });
  const start = shiftReviewDay_(annual.end, -364);
  return { start: start > annual.start ? start : annual.start, end: annual.end };
}

function shiftReviewDay_(date, days) {
  return new Date(Date.parse(date + 'T00:00:00Z') + days * 86400000).toISOString().slice(0, 10);
}

function marketsDefaultCommentStart_(end) {
  const [year, month] = end.split('-').map(Number);
  return shiftReviewDay_(end, 1 - new Date(Date.UTC(year, month, 0)).getUTCDate());
}

function marketsReviewDigest_(value) {
  return Utilities.base64EncodeWebSafe(Utilities.computeDigest(Utilities.DigestAlgorithm.SHA_256, JSON.stringify(value)));
}

function marketsReviewCatalogVersion_(catalog) {
  const listings = catalog.filter(app => app.platform === 'Android' || app.platform === 'iOS')
    .map(app => JSON.stringify([app.appKey, app.platform, app.countryCode, app.packageName, app.appId, app.appName, app.isBbva]));
  return marketsReviewDigest_(listings.sort());
}

function marketsFunctionalEngine_(properties) {
  const pointer = typeof properties.getProperty === 'function'
    ? properties.getProperty(MARKETS_REVIEW_SNAPSHOT_POINTER) : properties[MARKETS_REVIEW_SNAPSHOT_POINTER];
  return safeJsonParse_(pointer || 'null')?.engine || null;
}

function marketsReviewVersions_(properties, catalogVersion, engine = marketsFunctionalEngine_(properties)) {
  const revisions = engine ? ['MARKETS_REVIEW_GEOGRAPHY_REVISION']
    : ['MARKETS_FUNCTIONAL_ALIASES_REVISION', 'MARKETS_REVIEW_GEOGRAPHY_REVISION', 'MARKETS_FUNCTIONAL_TRANSLATIONS_REVISION'];
  return [properties.MARKETS_REVIEWS_GENERATION || '', properties.MARKETS_FUNCTIONAL_REVISION || '', catalogVersion,
    ...revisions.flatMap(key =>
      properties[key] ? [[key, properties[key]]] : []), ...(engine ? [['MARKETS_FUNCTIONAL_ENGINE', JSON.stringify(engine)]] : [])];
}

function marketsReviewNpsVersions_(properties, catalogVersion) {
  return [properties.MARKETS_REVIEW_SOURCE_GENERATION || '', properties.MARKETS_REVIEW_GEOGRAPHY_REVISION || '', catalogVersion];
}

function marketsReviewSnapshotScope_(operation, filters, window) {
  if (operation === 'ranking') return filters.analysisMonth && !filters.audience && filters.platform === 'ALL'
    ? ['ranking', filters.country, filters.analysisMonth].join(':') : '';
  const withoutInference = filters.inferGeography === 'NO';
  const comparesGeography = operation === 'nps' || (operation === 'analytics' && (filters.year || filters.analysisMonth));
  if ((withoutInference && !comparesGeography) ||
      filters.audience || filters.platform !== 'ALL' || filters.topic || filters.rating || filters.search || filters.reviewKey ||
      filters.period || filters.sort || Number(filters.page || 0) !== 0) return marketsReviewRequestedScope_(operation, filters, window);
  const language = ['es', 'en', 'tr'].includes(filters.language) ? filters.language : 'es';
  if (operation === 'page') {
    return !filters.year && !filters.analysisMonth && filters.app === 'BBVA Empresas' && !filters.segment && window.start === marketsDefaultCommentStart_(window.end)
      ? ['page', filters.country, language].join(':') : '';
  }
  if (operation === 'nps') return 'nps:' + filters.country + (withoutInference ? ':NO' : '');
  if (operation !== 'analytics') return '';
  if (filters.year || filters.analysisMonth) {
    if ((filters.year && filters.analysisMonth) || filters.start || filters.end || filters.app ||
        (filters.entity && filters.entity !== MARKETS_REVIEW_ENTITY) ||
        (filters.segment !== 'DETRACTOR' && !(filters.analysisMonth && !filters.segment))) return marketsReviewRequestedScope_(operation, filters, window);
    const scope = ['analytics', filters.country, filters.year || filters.analysisMonth, window.start, window.end];
    if (!filters.segment) scope.push('all-stars');
    if (withoutInference) scope.push('NO');
    return scope.join(':');
  }
  return (!filters.entity || filters.entity === MARKETS_REVIEW_ENTITY) && !filters.app && filters.segment === 'DETRACTOR' && window.start === shiftReviewDay_(window.end, -365)
    ? ['analytics', filters.country].join(':') : '';
}

/** Solo filtros analíticos estructurados; nunca persistir búsquedas ni identidades. */
function marketsReviewRequestedScope_(operation, filters, window) {
  if (!['analytics', 'nps'].includes(operation) || !(filters.year || filters.analysisMonth) ||
      filters.year && filters.analysisMonth) return '';
  const allowed = new Set(['country', 'platform', 'year', 'analysisMonth', 'entity', 'segment', 'audience', 'inferGeography', 'page', 'strictFreshness']);
  if (Object.keys(filters).some(key => !allowed.has(key) && filters[key])) return '';
  const selected = Object.keys(filters).filter(key => filters[key] !== undefined && filters[key] !== '' && key !== 'page' && key !== 'strictFreshness')
    .sort().map(key => [key, filters[key]]);
  return [operation, filters.country, 'requested', marketsReviewDigest_([selected, window.start, window.end, window.recent])].join(':');
}

function marketsReviewRequestedScopes_(properties, now = Date.now()) {
  const raw = typeof properties.getProperty === 'function'
    ? properties.getProperty('MARKETS_REVIEW_REQUESTED_SCOPES') : properties.MARKETS_REVIEW_REQUESTED_SCOPES;
  const entries = safeJsonParse_(raw || '[]');
  return Array.isArray(entries) ? entries.filter(entry => now - entry.requestedAt >= 0 && now - entry.requestedAt < 21600000).slice(-8) : [];
}

/** Keep large review payloads outside ScriptProperties. Only their manifest is published there. */
function writeMarketsReviewSnapshot_(properties, manifest, values, isCurrent,
    previousPointer = properties.getProperty(MARKETS_REVIEW_SNAPSHOT_POINTER)) {
  const files = {};
  const shards = new Map();
  for (const [scope, value] of Object.entries(values)) {
    const country = scope.split(':')[1];
    if (!shards.has(country)) shards.set(country, {});
    shards.get(country)[scope] = value;
  }
  let published = false, serializedCharacters = 0, uploadMs = 0, readbackMs = 0;
  const lock = LockService.getUserLock();
  let locked = false;
  try {
    for (const [country, shard] of shards) {
      const text = JSON.stringify(shard);
      serializedCharacters += text.length;
      const blob = Utilities.newBlob(text, 'application/json');
      const filename = 'market-pulse-review-snapshot-' + manifest.end + '-' + country + '.json.gz';
      const uploadStarted = Date.now();
      files[country] = DriveApp.createFile(Utilities.gzip(blob, filename)).getId();
      uploadMs += Date.now() - uploadStarted;
      const readbackStarted = Date.now();
      const readback = readMarketsReviewSnapshotShard_({ files }, country);
      const verified = readback && JSON.stringify(readback) === text;
      readbackMs += Date.now() - readbackStarted;
      if (!verified) {
        throw new Error('No se pudo validar el shard publicado: ' + country);
      }
    }
    locked = lock.tryLock(1000);
    if (!locked) {
      console.log(JSON.stringify({ operation: 'review-publish', reason: 'lock' }));
      return false;
    }
    if (!isCurrent()) {
      console.log(JSON.stringify({ operation: 'review-publish', reason: 'versions-before-commit' }));
      return false;
    }
    // CAS del puntero bajo el mismo lock usado por las escrituras de reseñas.
    if (properties.getProperty(MARKETS_REVIEW_SNAPSHOT_POINTER) !== previousPointer) {
      console.log(JSON.stringify({ operation: 'review-publish', reason: 'pointer-cas' }));
      return false;
    }
    const publishedAt = new Date().toISOString();
    if (previousPointer && !properties.getProperty('MARKETS_REVIEW_SNAPSHOT_REPAIR')) {
      properties.setProperty('MARKETS_REVIEW_SNAPSHOT_PREVIOUS', previousPointer);
    }
    properties.setProperty(MARKETS_REVIEW_SNAPSHOT_POINTER, JSON.stringify({ ...manifest, files, publishedAt }));
    published = true;
    return true;
  } finally {
    if (locked) lock.releaseLock();
    console.log(JSON.stringify({ operation: 'review-publish-drive', published, shards: shards.size,
      serializedCharacters, uploadMs, readbackMs }));
    if (published) {
      try { cleanupMarketsReviewSnapshots_(properties); }
      catch (error) { console.warn('Limpieza diferida de snapshots: ' + errorToString_(error)); }
    }
    // El snapshot anterior sigue disponible para lectores en curso y rollback.
    for (const id of Object.values(published ? {} : files)) {
      try { DriveApp.getFileById(id).setTrashed(true); }
      catch (error) { console.warn('No se pudo retirar una vista anterior de reseñas: ' + errorToString_(error)); }
    }
  }
}

/** GC acotado; 24 horas de gracia protegen builds y lectores en curso. */
function cleanupMarketsReviewSnapshots_(properties, now = Date.now()) {
  const keep = new Set();
  for (const key of [MARKETS_REVIEW_SNAPSHOT_POINTER, 'MARKETS_REVIEW_SNAPSHOT_PREVIOUS']) {
    const manifest = safeJsonParse_(properties.getProperty(key) || 'null');
    for (const id of Object.values(manifest?.files || {})) keep.add(id);
  }
  for (const key of ['MARKETS_FUNCTIONAL_MIGRATION', MARKETS_FUNCTIONAL_MIGRATION_PREVIOUS]) {
    const migration = safeJsonParse_(properties.getProperty(key) || 'null');
    const rollback = safeJsonParse_(migration?.previousSnapshot || 'null');
    for (const id of Object.values(rollback?.files || {})) keep.add(id);
  }
  const before = new Date(now - 86400000).toISOString();
  const files = DriveApp.searchFiles("trashed = false and title contains 'market-pulse-review-snapshot-' and createdDate < '" + before + "'");
  let visited = 0, removed = 0;
  while (visited++ < 100 && removed < 20 && files.hasNext()) {
    const file = files.next();
    if (/^market-pulse-review-snapshot-\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}-(?:ALL|UNKNOWN|[A-Z]{2})\.json\.gz$/.test(file.getName()) && !keep.has(file.getId())) {
      file.setTrashed(true); removed++;
    }
  }
}

function readMarketsReviewSnapshotShard_(manifest, country) {
  const id = manifest?.files?.[country];
  if (!id) return null;
  try { return JSON.parse(Utilities.ungzip(DriveApp.getFileById(id).getBlob()).getDataAsString('UTF-8')); }
  catch (error) {
    console.warn('No se pudo leer la vista publicada de reseñas: ' + errorToString_(error));
    return null;
  }
}

/** Ejecución administrativa desde el editor, con auditoría y reintento existentes. */
function publishMarketsReviewSnapshot() {
  requireMarketsReviewOwner_();
  const properties = PropertiesService.getScriptProperties();
  const complete = runMarketsAuxiliaryTask_(properties, { id: 'publish', run: () => publishMarketsReviewSnapshot_().complete,
    request: properties.getProperty('MARKETS_REVIEW_MANUAL:publish'),
    retry: safeJsonParse_(properties.getProperty('MARKETS_REVIEW_AUX_RETRY:publish') || 'null') });
  const manifest = safeJsonParse_(properties.getProperty(MARKETS_REVIEW_SNAPSHOT_POINTER) || 'null');
  const result = { complete, publishedAt: manifest?.publishedAt, count: manifest?.count,
    engine: manifest?.engine?.engine || 'local', status: safeJsonParse_(properties.getProperty('MARKETS_REVIEW_PUBLISH_STATUS') || 'null') };
  console.log(JSON.stringify(result));
  return result;
}

function publishMarketsReviewSnapshot_(force = false) {
  const ss = openMarketsSpreadsheet_();
  const properties = PropertiesService.getScriptProperties();
  const catalog = readAppCatalog_(ss), catalogVersion = marketsReviewCatalogVersion_(catalog);
  const current = properties.getProperties();
  const migration = safeJsonParse_(current.MARKETS_FUNCTIONAL_MIGRATION || 'null');
  const activeEngine = marketsFunctionalEngine_(current);
  const pending = migration?.ready && !migration.complete && activeEngine?.sheet !== migration.sheet ? migration : null;
  const engine = pending ? { engine: 'EDCCatalogClassifier', libraryVersion: pending.libraryVersion || '1', pins: pending.pins, sheet: pending.sheet,
    ...(pending.indexSpreadsheetId ? { indexSpreadsheetId: pending.indexSpreadsheetId } : {}) } : activeEngine;
  const inputVersions = marketsReviewVersions_(current, catalogVersion);
  const versions = marketsReviewVersions_(current, catalogVersion, engine);
  const npsVersions = marketsReviewNpsVersions_(current, catalogVersion);
  const stillCurrent = (currentCatalog = catalogVersion) => {
    const latest = properties.getProperties();
    return JSON.stringify(marketsReviewVersions_(latest, currentCatalog)) === JSON.stringify(inputVersions) &&
      JSON.stringify(marketsReviewNpsVersions_(latest, currentCatalog)) === JSON.stringify(npsVersions);
  };
  const deferred = reason => {
    console.log(JSON.stringify({ operation: 'review-publish', reason }));
    return { complete: false, published: 0 };
  };
  if (engine?.libraryVersion && engine.libraryVersion !== MARKETS_REVIEW_LIBRARY_VERSION) return deferred('migration-library');
  if (pending && pending.sourceGeneration !== (current.MARKETS_REVIEW_SOURCE_GENERATION || '')) return deferred('migration-source');
  const requestedScopes = marketsReviewRequestedScopes_(current);
  const { end } = marketsReviewWindow_();
  const previousPointer = current[MARKETS_REVIEW_SNAPSHOT_POINTER] ?? null;
  const previous = safeJsonParse_(previousPointer || 'null');
  if (!force && !current.MARKETS_REVIEW_SNAPSHOT_REPAIR && previous?.schema === MARKETS_REVIEW_SNAPSHOT_SCHEMA && previous.hasAnnualNps && previous.hasNpsAttribution && previous.hasAllSentimentGaps && previous.hasReviewRanking && previous.hasFeaturedReviews && previous.audienceVersion === MARKETS_REVIEW_AUDIENCE_VERSION && previous.end === end && JSON.stringify(previous.versions) === JSON.stringify(versions) &&
      JSON.stringify(previous.npsVersions) === JSON.stringify(npsVersions) &&
      requestedScopes.every(entry => previous.requestedScopes?.includes(entry.id))) {
    return { complete: true, published: previous.count };
  }
  const analyticsWindow = marketsReviewWindow_();
  const annualWindow = marketsAnnualReviewWindow_(analyticsWindow);
  const commentWindow = marketsReviewWindow_({ start: marketsDefaultCommentStart_(end) });
  const topics = marketsReviewTopics_(ss);
  const year = end.slice(0, 4), analysisMonth = end.slice(0, 7);
  const previousMonth = shiftReviewDay_(analysisMonth + '-01', -1).slice(0, 7);
  const previousWindow = marketsReviewAnalyticsWindow_({ analysisMonth: previousMonth }, end);
  const earliest = [analyticsWindow.start, marketsAnnualReviewWindow_(previousWindow).start,
    previousWindow.start, (Number(previousMonth.slice(0, 4)) - 1) + '-01-01', (Number(year) - 1) + '-01-01',
    ...requestedScopes.flatMap(entry => [entry.window.start, (Number(entry.window.end.slice(0, 4)) - 1) + '-01-01'])].sort()[0];
  const classification = pending ? { library: engine, knownBlocks: marketsReviewClassification_(ss).knownBlocks,
    version: marketsReviewDigest_([MARKETS_REVIEW_CLASSIFIER_SCHEMA, MARKETS_REVIEW_AUDIENCE_VERSION, engine.pins]) } : null;
  const queryStarted = Date.now();
  const allRows = queryMarketsReviews_(ss, { country: 'ALL', platform: 'ALL', includeAudience: true,
    ...(pending ? { classificationOverride: classification, migrationIndex: engine } : {}) },
    { ...analyticsWindow, start: earliest }, true, catalog);
  const queryMs = Date.now() - queryStarted;
  const rows = allRows.filter(row => row.date >= analyticsWindow.start);
  const byCountry = new Map(), commentRows = new Map(), counts = Object.create(null), reassigned = [];
  for (const row of allRows) {
    if (row.countries.length !== 1) continue;
    const [country] = row.countries;
    if (marketsReviewHasAssignedGeography_(row)) reassigned.push(marketsReviewWithoutAssignedGeography_(row));
    if (!byCountry.has(country)) byCountry.set(country, []);
    byCountry.get(country).push(row);
    if (row.date < commentWindow.start || !row.entities.includes(MARKETS_REVIEW_ENTITY)) continue;
    counts[country] = (counts[country] || 0) + 1;
    if (!commentRows.has(country)) commentRows.set(country, []);
    const firstPage = commentRows.get(country);
    if (firstPage.length < MARKETS_REVIEW_PAGE_SIZE) firstPage.push(row);
  }
  const values = {};
  for (const country of ['ALL', ...MARKETS_WEB.countryCodes, 'UNKNOWN']) {
    const history = country === 'ALL' ? allRows : byCountry.get(country) || [];
    const scoped = country === 'ALL' ? rows : history.filter(row => row.date >= analyticsWindow.start);
    if (country !== 'ALL') {
      for (const period of [analysisMonth, previousMonth, 'history']) {
        values['featured:' + country + ':' + period] = ['Android', 'iOS'].flatMap(platform => history.filter(row =>
          row.platform === platform && row.entities.includes(MARKETS_REVIEW_ENTITY) &&
          Number.isInteger(row.helpful) && row.helpful > 0 && (period === 'history' || row.date.startsWith(period + '-')))
          .sort(compareMarketsHelpfulReviews_).slice(0, 3));
      }
      values['ranking:' + country + ':' + analysisMonth] = { start: analysisMonth + '-01', end,
        rows: ['Android', 'iOS', 'Huawei'].flatMap(platform => summarizeMarketsReviewNps_(history.filter(row =>
          row.platform === platform && row.date.startsWith(analysisMonth + '-'))).map(point => ({ ...point, country, platform }))) };
    }
    const analytics = summarizeMarketsReviewAnalytics_(scoped, topics, { segment: 'DETRACTOR', entity: MARKETS_REVIEW_ENTITY }, analyticsWindow, annualWindow);
    values['analytics:' + country] = analytics;
    if (country === 'ALL') continue;
    for (const language of ['es', 'en', 'tr']) {
      const page = { page: 0, size: MARKETS_REVIEW_PAGE_SIZE, total: counts[country] || 0, counts, topics, window: commentWindow };
      page.rows = (commentRows.get(country) || []).map(({ translations, replyTranslations, relevance, ...row }) => {
        const translated = translations[language];
        return { ...row, reply: replyTranslations?.[language] || row.reply, text: translated || row.original, translated: Boolean(translated && translated !== row.original) };
      });
      values['page:' + country + ':' + language] = page;
    }
  }
  values['ranking:ALL:' + analysisMonth] = { start: analysisMonth + '-01', end,
    rows: MARKETS_WEB.countryCodes.flatMap(country => values['ranking:' + country + ':' + analysisMonth].rows) };
  for (const period of [analysisMonth, previousMonth, 'history']) {
    values['featured:ALL:' + period] = MARKETS_WEB.countryCodes.flatMap(country => values['featured:' + country + ':' + period]);
  }
  if (!stillCurrent()) return deferred('versions-during-build');

  // Materializa los scopes esenciales en Drive. L1 se llena al leer el snapshot;
  // su precalentamiento nunca debe retrasar ni cancelar la publicación.
  for (const country of ['ALL', ...MARKETS_WEB.countryCodes, 'UNKNOWN']) {
    const scoped = country === 'ALL' ? allRows : byCountry.get(country) || [];
    const hasAssigned = country === 'UNKNOWN' ? reassigned.length !== 0 : scoped.some(marketsReviewHasAssignedGeography_);
    const direct = !hasAssigned ? scoped : country === 'ALL' ? scoped.map(marketsReviewWithoutAssignedGeography_)
      : country === 'UNKNOWN' ? scoped.concat(reassigned).sort(compareMarketsReviewRows_)
      : scoped.filter(row => !marketsReviewHasAssignedGeography_(row));
    const inferredNps = { start: earliest, end, monthly: summarizeMarketsReviewNps_(scoped) };
    values['nps:' + country] = inferredNps;
    values['nps:' + country + ':NO'] = hasAssigned
      ? { start: earliest, end, monthly: summarizeMarketsReviewNps_(direct) }
      : inferredNps;
    const sourceRange = { start: (Number(year) - 1) + '-01-01', end };
    for (const dateFilter of [{ year }, { analysisMonth }, { analysisMonth: previousMonth }]) {
      const filters = normalizeMarketsReviewFilters_({ country, ...dateFilter, segment: 'DETRACTOR', entity: MARKETS_REVIEW_ENTITY });
      const window = marketsReviewAnalyticsWindow_(filters, end);
      const sourceStart = filters.year ? sourceRange.start
        : [marketsAnnualReviewWindow_(window).start, window.start].sort()[0];
      const queryStart = [sourceStart, (Number(window.end.slice(0, 4)) - 1) + '-01-01'].sort()[0];
      const inRange = row => row.date >= queryStart && row.date <= window.end;
      const compact = rows => compactMarketsReviewAnalyticsRows_(rows, window.end).filter(row => row.date >= sourceStart);
      const rowsForView = compact(scoped.filter(inRange));
      const directRows = hasAssigned ? compact(direct.filter(inRange)) : rowsForView;
      const variants = [filters];
      if (filters.analysisMonth) {
        const { segment, ...allStars } = filters;
        variants.push(allStars);
      }
      for (const selection of variants) {
        const data = buildMarketsReviewAnalytics_(rowsForView, topics, selection, window);
        values[marketsReviewSnapshotScope_('analytics', selection, window)] = data;
        const directFilters = { ...selection, inferGeography: 'NO' };
        const directData = hasAssigned ? buildMarketsReviewAnalytics_(directRows, topics, directFilters, window) : data;
        values[marketsReviewSnapshotScope_('analytics', directFilters, window)] = directData;
      }
    }
  }
  if (!stillCurrent()) return deferred('versions-during-build');
  for (const entry of requestedScopes) {
    if (Object.hasOwn(values, entry.scope)) continue;
    const filters = entry.filters, window = entry.window;
    const scoped = (filters.inferGeography === 'NO' ? allRows.map(marketsReviewWithoutAssignedGeography_) : allRows)
      .filter(row => (filters.country === 'ALL' || row.countries[0] === filters.country) &&
        (filters.platform === 'ALL' || row.platform === filters.platform) &&
        (!filters.audience || matchesMarketsReviewAudience_(filters.audience, { relevance: row.relevance })));
    if (entry.operation === 'nps') {
      values[entry.scope] = { start: window.start, end: window.end,
        monthly: summarizeMarketsReviewNps_(scoped.filter(row => row.date >= window.start && row.date <= window.end)) };
    } else {
      const start = filters.year ? (Number(filters.year) - 1) + '-01-01' : [marketsAnnualReviewWindow_(window).start, window.start].sort()[0];
      values[entry.scope] = buildMarketsReviewAnalytics_(compactMarketsReviewAnalyticsRows_(
        scoped.filter(row => row.date >= start && row.date <= window.end), window.end), topics, filters, window);
    }
  }
  const count = Object.keys(values).length;
  const buildMs = Date.now() - queryStarted - queryMs;
  const publishStarted = Date.now();
  const complete = writeMarketsReviewSnapshot_(properties, { end, versions, npsVersions, count, ...(engine ? { engine } : {}),
    audienceVersion: MARKETS_REVIEW_AUDIENCE_VERSION, requestedScopes: requestedScopes.map(entry => entry.id),
    hasReviewRanking: true, hasFeaturedReviews: true, hasAnnualNps: true, hasNpsAttribution: true, hasAllSentimentGaps: true, schema: MARKETS_REVIEW_SNAPSHOT_SCHEMA }, values,
    () => end === marketsReviewWindow_().end && stillCurrent(marketsReviewCatalogVersion_(readAppCatalog_(ss))), previousPointer);
  if (complete && current.MARKETS_REVIEW_SNAPSHOT_REPAIR) properties.deleteProperty('MARKETS_REVIEW_SNAPSHOT_REPAIR');
  console.log(JSON.stringify({ operation: 'review-publish', complete, count, end, queryMs, buildMs,
    publishMs: Date.now() - publishStarted }));
  return { complete, published: complete ? count : 0 };
}

function getMarketsReviewPage(filters, snapshotOnly = false) {
  const requestStarted = Date.now();
  currentMarketsUserEmail_();
  filters = normalizeMarketsReviewFilters_(filters);
  if (filters.country === 'ALL') throw new Error('Selecciona una geografía para consultar los comentarios.');
  const ss = openMarketsSpreadsheet_();
  if (!filters.start && !filters.period) {
    const { end } = marketsReviewWindow_(filters);
    filters.start = marketsDefaultCommentStart_(end);
  }
  const window = marketsReviewWindow_(filters);
  if (filters.start && filters.start < window.start) window.start = filters.start;
  const timing = {};
  const page = readMarketsReviewCache_(ss, 'page', filters, window, catalog => {
    // Text search matches original review text. Only the visible page needs block labels.
    const deferBlocks = !filters.topic && !filters.audience;
    const query = { ...filters, country: 'ALL', deferBlocks, interactive: true, timing };
    const paging = { ...filters, topics: marketsReviewTopics_(ss) };
    const page = queryMarketsReviews_(ss, query, window, false, catalog, paging);
    if (deferBlocks && page.rows.length) {
      const started = Date.now();
      const { rules, knownBlocks, library } = marketsReviewClassification_(ss);
      const predictions = library && classifyMarketsFunctionalBatch_(page.rows.map(row => {
        const source = []; source[0] = row.key; source[9] = row.title; source[10] = row.original; return source;
      }), library.pins);
      for (const [index, row] of page.rows.entries()) {
        row.blocks = marketsReviewBlocks_(library ? predictions[index] : classifyReviewEvidence_([row.title, row.original].join(' '), rules), knownBlocks);
      }
      timing.classificationMs = (timing.classificationMs || 0) + Date.now() - started;
      timing.classified = (timing.classified || 0) + page.rows.length;
    }
    return page;
  }, timing, snapshotOnly === true);
  if (!page) return null;
  return { ...localizeMarketsReviewTopics_(ss, page, filters.language), timing: { ...timing, durationMs: Date.now() - requestStarted } };
}

/** Descarga la selección completa con los mismos filtros y permisos que Comentarios. */
function getMarketsReviewExport(filters) {
  currentMarketsUserEmail_();
  filters = normalizeMarketsReviewFilters_(filters);
  if (filters.country === 'ALL') throw new Error('Selecciona una geografía para descargar los comentarios.');
  const ss = openMarketsSpreadsheet_();
  const window = marketsReviewWindow_(filters);
  if (filters.start && filters.start < window.start) window.start = filters.start;
  const rows = queryMarketsReviews_(ss, filters, window);
  return localizeMarketsReviewTopics_(ss, { rows, topics: marketsReviewTopics_(ss), window }, filters.language);
}

function normalizeMarketsReviewFilters_(filters) {
  filters = filters || {};
  const country = filters.country || 'ALL', platform = filters.platform || 'ALL';
  if (!/^(ALL|UNKNOWN|[A-Z]{2})$/.test(country) || !['ALL', 'iOS', 'Android', 'Huawei'].includes(platform)) {
    throw new Error('Geografía o plataforma no válidas.');
  }
  for (const value of [filters.start, filters.end]) {
    if (value && (typeof value !== 'string' || !/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(value) ||
        !Number.isFinite(Date.parse(value)) || new Date(value).toISOString().slice(0, 10) !== value)) {
      throw new Error('Fecha no válida.');
    }
  }
  if (filters.start && filters.end && filters.start > filters.end) throw new Error('Intervalo no válido.');
  if (filters.year && !/^(?:19|20)\d{2}$/.test(filters.year)) throw new Error('Año no válido.');
  if (filters.analysisMonth && !/^(?:19|20)\d{2}-(0[1-9]|1[0-2])$/.test(filters.analysisMonth)) throw new Error('Mes no válido.');
  if (filters.period && !/^\d{4}-(0[1-9]|1[0-2])$/.test(filters.period)) throw new Error('Mes no válido.');
  if (filters.topic && !/^(general|\d{2})$/.test(filters.topic)) throw new Error('Bloque no válido.');
  if (filters.rating !== undefined && filters.rating !== '' && !/^[1-5]$/.test(filters.rating)) {
    throw new Error('Número de estrellas no válido.');
  }
  if (filters.inferGeography && !['YES', 'NO'].includes(filters.inferGeography)) {
    throw new Error('Inferencia geográfica no válida.');
  }
  if (filters.audience && !['ALL', 'BEI', 'BEI_ONLY', 'BEI_EXTENDED'].includes(filters.audience)) {
    throw new Error('Audiencia no válida.');
  }
  if (filters.sort && !['RECENT', 'HELPFUL'].includes(filters.sort)) throw new Error('Orden no válido.');
  const normalized = { country, platform, page: Math.min(10000, Math.max(0, Math.floor(Number(filters.page) || 0))) };
  for (const key of ['start', 'end', 'year', 'analysisMonth', 'period', 'topic', 'segment', 'app', 'entity', 'reviewKey', 'search']) {
    if (typeof filters[key] === 'string' && filters[key]) normalized[key] = filters[key].slice(0, 200);
  }
  if (filters.inferGeography === 'NO') normalized.inferGeography = 'NO';
  if (filters.audience && filters.audience !== 'ALL') normalized.audience = 'BEI';
  if (filters.rating) normalized.rating = String(filters.rating);
  if (filters.sort === 'HELPFUL') normalized.sort = 'HELPFUL';
  if (filters.strictFreshness === true) normalized.strictFreshness = true;
  if (['es', 'en', 'tr'].includes(filters.language)) normalized.language = filters.language;
  return normalized;
}

function paginateMarketsReviews_(rows, filters, window) {
  const counts = Object.create(null);
  const matching = [];
  for (const row of rows) {
    if (row.countries.length !== 1) continue;
    const [country] = row.countries;
    counts[country] = (counts[country] || 0) + 1;
    if (country === filters.country) matching.push(row);
  }
  const size = MARKETS_REVIEW_PAGE_SIZE;
  const page = Math.min(Math.max(0, Math.ceil(matching.length / size) - 1),
    Math.max(0, Math.trunc(Number(filters.page) || 0)));
  return { page, size, total: matching.length, rows: matching.slice(page * size, (page + 1) * size),
    counts, topics: filters.topics, window };
}

/** The annual plot needs counts by month and entity without review text or other panels. */
function getMarketsReviewNps(filters, snapshotOnly = false) {
  const started = Date.now();
  currentMarketsUserEmail_();
  const { country, audience, inferGeography, year, strictFreshness } = normalizeMarketsReviewFilters_(filters);
  if (!year) throw new Error('Selecciona un año para consultar el NPS.');
  const scope = { country, audience, inferGeography, year, strictFreshness, platform: 'ALL' };
  const window = marketsReviewAnalyticsWindow_(scope, marketsReviewWindow_().end);
  const timing = {};
  if (window.end < window.start) return { monthly: [] };
  const ss = openMarketsSpreadsheet_();
  const data = readMarketsReviewCache_(ss, 'nps', scope, window, catalog => {
    const rows = queryMarketsReviews_(ss, { ...scope, npsOnly: true, deferBlocks: true, interactive: true, timing }, window, false, catalog);
    const aggregateStarted = Date.now();
    const monthly = summarizeMarketsReviewNps_(rows);
    timing.aggregateMs = Date.now() - aggregateStarted;
    timing.input = rows.length;
    return { monthly };
  }, timing, snapshotOnly === true);
  if (!data) return null;
  return { monthly: data.monthly.filter(point => point.month.startsWith(year + '-')),
    timing: { ...timing, durationMs: Date.now() - started } };
}

function getMarketsReviewRanking(filters) {
  currentMarketsUserEmail_();
  const normalized = normalizeMarketsReviewFilters_(filters);
  const month = normalized.analysisMonth || marketsReviewWindow_().end.slice(0, 7);
  const scope = { country: normalized.country, platform: 'ALL', analysisMonth: month, strictFreshness: normalized.strictFreshness };
  const window = marketsReviewAnalyticsWindow_(scope, marketsReviewWindow_().end), timing = {};
  const ss = openMarketsSpreadsheet_();
  const value = readMarketsReviewCache_(ss, 'ranking', scope, window, () => {
    queueMarketsReviewSnapshotRefresh_();
    throw new Error('El ranking de NPS se está publicando. Reintenta en unos minutos.');
  }, timing);
  return { ...value, timing };
}

function summarizeMarketsReviewNps_(rows) {
  const monthly = new Map();
  for (const row of rows) {
    const month = row.date.slice(0, 7);
    for (const entity of row.entities) {
      const key = JSON.stringify([entity, month]);
      const point = monthly.get(key) || { entity, month, total: 0, promoters: 0, detractors: 0, assignedGeography: 0 };
      countMarketsReviewNps_(point, row);
      monthly.set(key, point);
    }
  }
  return [...monthly.values()].map(point => ({ ...point, balance: reviewBalancePoints_(point) }));
}

function getMarketsReviewAnalytics(filters, snapshotOnly = false) {
  const requestStarted = Date.now();
  currentMarketsUserEmail_();
  const ss = openMarketsSpreadsheet_();
  filters = normalizeMarketsReviewFilters_(filters);
  const window = marketsReviewAnalyticsWindow_(filters, marketsReviewWindow_().end);
  filters.entity = filters.entity || MARKETS_REVIEW_ENTITY;
  const language = filters.language || 'es';
  delete filters.language;
  const timing = {};
  const data = readMarketsReviewCache_(ss, 'analytics', filters, window, (catalog, versions) => {
    const annual = filters.year ? { start: window.start, end: window.end } : marketsAnnualReviewWindow_(window);
    const start = filters.year ? (Number(filters.year) - 1) + '-01-01' : [annual.start, window.start].sort()[0];
    const sourceStart = [start, (Number(window.end.slice(0, 4)) - 1) + '-01-01'].sort()[0];
    const range = { start: sourceStart, end: window.end };
    const query = { country: filters.country, platform: filters.platform, start: sourceStart };
    if (filters.end && filters.end < range.end) query.end = filters.end;
    for (const field of ['period', 'rating', 'topic', 'reviewKey', 'search', 'audience', 'inferGeography']) {
      if (filters[field]) query[field] = filters[field];
    }
    const key = marketsReviewAnalyticsSourceKey_(ss, query, range, versions);
    const { rows, topics } = readMarketsWebCache_(key, () => {
      timing.source = 'sheet';
      const rows = queryMarketsReviews_(ss, { ...query, interactive: true, timing }, range, true, catalog);
      return { rows: compactMarketsReviewAnalyticsRows_(rows, range.end), topics: marketsReviewTopics_(ss) };
    }, 12);
    timing.source = timing.source || 'cache';
    const aggregateStarted = Date.now();
    const result = buildMarketsReviewAnalytics_(rows.filter(row => row.date >= start), topics, filters, window);
    timing.aggregateMs = Date.now() - aggregateStarted;
    timing.input = rows.length;
    return result;
  }, timing, snapshotOnly === true);
  if (!data) return null;
  function localizeReview({ translations, replyTranslations, relevance, ...review }) {
    const translated = translations?.[language];
    return { ...review, reply: replyTranslations?.[language] || review.reply, text: translated || review.original, translated: Boolean(translated && translated !== review.original) };
  }
  return {
    ...localizeMarketsReviewTopics_(ss, data, language),
    timing: { ...timing, durationMs: Date.now() - requestStarted },
    examples: data.examples.map(({ block, review }) => ({ block, review: localizeReview(review) })),
    annual: { ...data.annual, topHelpful: data.annual.topHelpful.map(localizeReview),
      topAuthors: data.annual.topAuthors.map(({ reviews, ...author }) => ({ ...author, reviews: (reviews || []).map(localizeReview) })) }
  };
}

function marketsReviewAnalyticsWindow_(filters, today) {
  const window = marketsReviewWindow_(filters);
  if (filters.year) {
    window.start = filters.year + '-01-01';
    window.end = [today, filters.year + '-12-31'].sort()[0];
    window.recent = window.start;
  }
  if (filters.analysisMonth) {
    const start = filters.analysisMonth + '-01';
    const [year, month] = filters.analysisMonth.split('-').map(Number);
    window.recent = start;
    window.end = [today, shiftReviewDay_(new Date(Date.UTC(year, month, 1)).toISOString().slice(0, 10), -1)].sort()[0];
    window.start = new Date(Date.UTC(year, month - 6, 1)).toISOString().slice(0, 10);
  }
  return window;
}

function buildMarketsReviewAnalytics_(rows, topics, filters, window) {
  const annual = filters.year ? { start: window.start, end: window.end } : marketsAnnualReviewWindow_(window);
  const result = summarizeMarketsReviewAnalytics_(rows, topics, filters, window, annual);
  if (filters.analysisMonth && filters.country !== 'ALL' && filters.country !== 'UNKNOWN') {
    // Captured comments after query filters, never a denominator for total store ratings.
    result.observedReviewCountByVolumeKey = {};
    for (const row of rows) {
      if (row.platform !== 'Android' || row.countries?.[0] !== filters.country ||
          row.date.slice(0, 7) !== filters.analysisMonth || !row.volumeKey ||
          (filters.entity !== 'ALL' && !row.entities.includes(filters.entity))) continue;
      const counts = result.observedReviewCountByVolumeKey;
      counts[row.volumeKey] = (counts[row.volumeKey] || 0) + 1;
    }
  }
  if (filters.year) {
    const previousYear = String(Number(filters.year) - 1);
    const priorRows = rows.filter(row => row.date.startsWith(previousYear + '-'));
    result.annual.previousTotal = priorRows.length ? priorRows.filter(row => filters.entity === 'ALL' || row.entities.includes(filters.entity)).length : null;
  }
  return result;
}

/** Keep full records for examples, helpful reviews and recent cards of leading authors. */
function compactMarketsReviewAnalyticsRows_(rows, end) {
  const examplesStart = shiftReviewDay_(end, -30);
  const authorGroups = new Map();
  for (const row of rows) {
    if (!row.author?.trim()) continue;
    for (const entity of ['ALL', ...row.entities]) {
      const key = JSON.stringify([row.date.slice(0, 4), entity]);
      if (!authorGroups.has(key)) authorGroups.set(key, new Map());
      countMarketsReviewAuthor_(authorGroups.get(key), row);
    }
  }
  const authorSamples = new Set();
  for (const authors of authorGroups.values()) {
    for (const { reviews } of topMarketsReviewAuthors_(authors)) {
      for (const review of reviews) authorSamples.add(review);
    }
  }
  return rows.map(row => {
    if (authorSamples.has(row) || row.date >= examplesStart || (Number.isInteger(row.helpful) && row.helpful >= MARKETS_REVIEW_HELPFUL_MIN)) return row;
    return { date: row.date, rating: row.rating, entities: row.entities, blocks: row.blocks,
      author: row.author, reply: row.reply?.trim() ? '1' : '', countries: row.countries,
      ...(marketsReviewHasAssignedGeography_(row) ? { attributionMethod: row.attributionMethod } : {}),
      ...(row.platform === 'Android' && row.volumeKey ? { volumeKey: row.volumeKey, platform: row.platform } : {}) };
  });
}

function marketsReviewAnalyticsSourceKey_(ss, query, range, versions) {
  return marketsReviewCacheKey_(ss, 'analytics-source-compact', query, range, versions);
}

function marketsReviewCacheKey_(ss, operation, filters, window, versions) {
  const scope = Object.keys(filters).sort().map(key => [key, filters[key]]);
  const hasAttribution = operation === 'nps' || operation === 'analytics-source-compact' || (operation === 'analytics' && filters.analysisMonth);
  const parts = ['review', MARKETS_REVIEW_SNAPSHOT_SCHEMA, MARKETS_REVIEW_AUDIENCE_VERSION, operation,
    ss.getId(), window.start, window.end, versions, scope];
  if (hasAttribution) parts.push('nps-attribution-v1');
  return 'market-review:' + marketsReviewDigest_(parts);
}

function readMarketsReviewCache_(ss, operation, filters, window, builder, timing = {}, snapshotOnly = false) {
  const started = Date.now();
  const properties = PropertiesService.getScriptProperties().getProperties();
  const catalog = readAppCatalog_(ss);
  const catalogVersion = marketsReviewCatalogVersion_(catalog);
  const isNps = operation === 'nps' || operation === 'ranking';
  const versions = isNps ? marketsReviewNpsVersions_(properties, catalogVersion) : marketsReviewVersions_(properties, catalogVersion);
  const snapshotScope = marketsReviewSnapshotScope_(operation, filters, window);
  const maxParts = operation === 'analytics' || operation === 'page' ? 6 : operation === 'nps' ? 2 : 1;
  const attempts = [];
  const log = () => {
    timing.durationMs = Date.now() - started;
    console.log(JSON.stringify({ operation: 'review-' + operation, ...timing, snapshotScope, attempts }));
  };
  let repair = false;
  if (snapshotScope) for (const pointer of [MARKETS_REVIEW_SNAPSHOT_POINTER, 'MARKETS_REVIEW_SNAPSHOT_PREVIOUS']) {
    const snapshot = safeJsonParse_(properties[pointer] || 'null');
    const diagnostic = { pointer, end: snapshot?.end, publishedAt: snapshot?.publishedAt,
      flags: snapshot && { annualNps: snapshot.hasAnnualNps, attribution: snapshot.hasNpsAttribution,
        allSentimentGaps: snapshot.hasAllSentimentGaps, ranking: snapshot.hasReviewRanking },
      shards: Object.keys(snapshot?.files || {}).length };
    attempts.push(diagnostic);
    const isPrevious = pointer !== MARKETS_REVIEW_SNAPSHOT_POINTER;
    const state = marketsReviewSnapshotState_(snapshot, operation, filters, window, versions, properties, Date.now(), diagnostic, isPrevious);
    if (!state) continue;
    const key = marketsReviewCacheKey_(ss, operation, filters, window,
      [isNps ? snapshot.npsVersions : snapshot.versions, snapshot.end, snapshot.publishedAt, snapshot.files?.[filters.country]]);
    let source = 'L1';
    const value = readMarketsWebCache_(key, () => {
      const readStarted = Date.now();
      const shard = readMarketsReviewSnapshotShard_(snapshot, filters.country);
      diagnostic.driveMs = Date.now() - readStarted;
      const entry = shard?.[snapshotScope];
      const coversWindow = operation === 'nps'
        ? Array.isArray(entry?.monthly) && entry.start <= window.start && entry.end >= window.end
        : operation !== 'analytics' || (entry?.window?.start === window.start && entry?.window?.end === window.end);
      if (!entry || !coversWindow) {
        diagnostic.reason = !shard ? 'shard-unavailable' : !entry ? 'scope-unavailable' : 'scope-coverage';
        const requestId = marketsReviewRequestedScope_(operation, filters, window);
        if (!isPrevious && (!shard || !requestId || snapshot.requestedScopes?.includes(requestId))) repair = true;
        return undefined;
      }
      source = 'snapshot';
      return operation === 'nps' ? { monthly: entry.monthly.filter(point => point.month.startsWith(filters.year + '-')) } : entry;
    }, maxParts, timing);
    if (value === undefined) continue;
    if (!snapshotOnly && (state.refreshDue || isPrevious)) {
      timing.refreshQueued = isPrevious ? queueMarketsReviewSnapshotRefresh_(filters, window, operation, repair)
        : queueMarketsReviewSnapshotRefresh_();
    }
    Object.assign(timing, state, { source: source === 'L1' ? 'cache' : 'snapshot',
      cacheSource: source === 'L1' ? source : 'snapshot ' + state.freshness });
    log();
    return value;
  }
  const key = marketsReviewCacheKey_(ss, operation, filters, window, versions);
  let source = 'cache';
  const value = readMarketsWebCache_(key, () => {
    source = 'sheet';
    if (!snapshotOnly && ['analytics', 'nps', 'ranking'].includes(operation) &&
        (ss.getSheetByName('MARKET_REVIEWS')?.getLastRow() || 0) > 251) {
      timing.refreshQueued = Boolean(snapshotScope && queueMarketsReviewSnapshotRefresh_(filters, window, operation, repair));
      log();
      if (!snapshotScope) throw new Error('La consulta de reseñas supera el límite interactivo. Reduce los filtros.');
      throw new Error('La vista de reseñas se está publicando. Reintenta en unos minutos.');
    }
    if (snapshotOnly) return undefined;
    const built = builder(catalog, versions);
    const after = PropertiesService.getScriptProperties().getProperties();
    const currentCatalog = marketsReviewCatalogVersion_(readAppCatalog_(ss));
    const afterVersions = isNps ? marketsReviewNpsVersions_(after, currentCatalog) : marketsReviewVersions_(after, currentCatalog);
    if (JSON.stringify(afterVersions) !== JSON.stringify(versions)) {
      throw new Error('Las reseñas cambiaron durante la consulta. Reintenta la selección.');
    }
    return built;
  }, maxParts, timing);
  timing.source = timing.source || source;
  log();
  if (value === undefined) return null;
  return value;
}

/** Solicitud deduplicada al supervisor existente: sin triggers ni trabajo en RPC. */
function queueMarketsReviewSnapshotRefresh_(filters, window, operation = 'analytics', repair = false) {
  const properties = PropertiesService.getScriptProperties();
  const key = 'MARKETS_REVIEW_MANUAL:publish';
  const lock = LockService.getScriptLock();
  if (!lock.tryLock(100)) return false;
  try {
    const scope = filters && window && marketsReviewSnapshotScope_(operation, filters, window);
    const id = filters && window && marketsReviewRequestedScope_(operation, filters, window);
    if (scope && id) {
      const requests = marketsReviewRequestedScopes_(properties);
      if (!requests.some(entry => entry.id === id)) {
        requests.push({ id, scope, operation, filters, window, requestedAt: Date.now() });
        properties.setProperty('MARKETS_REVIEW_REQUESTED_SCOPES', JSON.stringify(requests.slice(-8)));
      }
    }
    if (repair) properties.setProperty('MARKETS_REVIEW_SNAPSHOT_REPAIR', '1');
    if (!properties.getProperty(key)) properties.setProperty(key, String(Date.now()));
    return true;
  } finally { lock.releaseLock(); }
}

/** La TTL física de L1 no determina la vigencia de una publicación. */
function marketsReviewSnapshotState_(snapshot, operation, filters, window, versions, properties, now = Date.now(), diagnostic = {}, isPrevious = false) {
  const reject = reason => { diagnostic.reason = reason; return null; };
  const nps = operation === 'nps' || operation === 'ranking';
  if (!snapshot) return reject('missing');
  if (snapshot.schema !== MARKETS_REVIEW_SNAPSHOT_SCHEMA) return reject('schema');
  if ((nps || filters.analysisMonth || filters.inferGeography === 'NO') && !snapshot.hasNpsAttribution) return reject('attribution');
  if (operation === 'nps' && !snapshot.hasAnnualNps) return reject('annual-nps');
  if (operation === 'ranking' && !snapshot.hasReviewRanking) return reject('ranking');
  if ((filters.audience || operation === 'analytics' || operation === 'nps') &&
      snapshot.audienceVersion !== MARKETS_REVIEW_AUDIENCE_VERSION) return reject('audience');
  if (operation === 'analytics' && filters.analysisMonth && !filters.segment &&
      !snapshot.hasAllSentimentGaps) return reject('sentiment');
  if (!/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(snapshot.end) || snapshot.end < window.end) return reject('date-coverage');
  const published = nps ? snapshot.npsVersions : snapshot.versions;
  if (!Array.isArray(published) || JSON.stringify(published.slice(1)) !== JSON.stringify(versions.slice(1))) return reject('versions');
  const today = marketsReviewWindow_().end;
  const sameVersion = JSON.stringify(published) === JSON.stringify(versions);
  const exactWindow = (operation === 'analytics' && (filters.analysisMonth || filters.year)) || operation === 'nps';
  if (!isPrevious && snapshot.end === today && (exactWindow || snapshot.end === window.end) && sameVersion) {
    return { freshness: 'fresh', publishedAt: snapshot.publishedAt || null, asOf: snapshot.end,
      ageSeconds: snapshot.publishedAt ? Math.max(0, (now - Date.parse(snapshot.publishedAt)) / 1000) : null, refreshDue: false };
  }
  // Límite operativo explícito y configurable. Un contrato/revisión diferente
  // nunca es stale compatible; sin publishedAt verificable tampoco se admite.
  const configured = Number(properties.MARKETS_REVIEW_STALE_MAX_SECONDS);
  const maxAge = Number.isFinite(configured) && configured >= 0 ? Math.min(configured, 86400) : 3600;
  const ageSeconds = (now - Date.parse(snapshot.publishedAt)) / 1000;
  if (filters.strictFreshness) return reject('strict-freshness');
  if (!Number.isFinite(ageSeconds) || ageSeconds < 0 || ageSeconds > maxAge) return reject('age');
  // Las ventanas exactas del análisis mensual/anual no cambian al cruzar el día.
  // Las páginas móviles del día anterior se consideran un scope distinto.
  if (snapshot.end !== today && !(exactWindow && window.end <= snapshot.end)) return reject('date');
  return { freshness: 'stale', publishedAt: snapshot.publishedAt, asOf: snapshot.end, ageSeconds, staleMaxSeconds: maxAge, refreshDue: true };
}

function advanceMarketsReviewGeneration_(properties, sourceChanged = false) {
  try {
    const generation = String(Math.max(Date.now(), Number(properties.getProperty('MARKETS_REVIEWS_GENERATION') || 0) + 1));
    properties.setProperty('MARKETS_REVIEWS_GENERATION', generation);
    if (sourceChanged) properties.setProperty('MARKETS_REVIEW_SOURCE_GENERATION', generation);
  }
  catch (error) { console.warn('No se pudo invalidar la caché de reseñas. ' + error.message); }
}

function marketsReviewTopics_(ss) {
  const catalog = ss.getSheetByName('FUNCTIONAL_CATALOG');
  const topics = { general: 'Generalista' };
  if (catalog && catalog.getLastRow() > 1) {
    for (const [id, label] of catalog.getRange(2, 1, catalog.getLastRow() - 1, 2).getDisplayValues()) {
      if (/^\d{2}\./.test(id) && label) topics[id.slice(0, 2)] = label;
    }
  }
  return topics;
}

function marketsReviewNet_(rating) {
  return MARKETS_DEFAULT_REVIEW_SEGMENTS[2].stars.includes(rating) ? 1
    : MARKETS_DEFAULT_REVIEW_SEGMENTS[0].stars.includes(rating) ? -1 : 0;
}

function reviewBalancePoints_(stats) {
  return 100 * (stats.promoters - stats.detractors) / stats.total;
}

function countMarketsReviewNps_(point, row) {
  const score = marketsReviewNet_(row.rating);
  point.total++;
  point.promoters += Number(score === 1);
  point.detractors += Number(score === -1);
  if (point.assignedGeography !== undefined) {
    point.assignedGeography += Number(marketsReviewHasAssignedGeography_(row));
  }
}

function marketsReviewHasAssignedGeography_(row) {
  return row.attributionMethod === 'review_evidence_inferred' || row.attributionMethod === 'review_evidence_validated';
}

function marketsReviewWithoutAssignedGeography_(row) {
  if (!marketsReviewHasAssignedGeography_(row)) return row;
  return { ...row, countries: ['UNKNOWN'], confidence: 'unknown',
    attributionMethod: row.storefronts?.length > 1 ? 'multi_storefront_ambiguous' : 'no_evidence' };
}

function summarizeMarketsReviewAnalytics_(rows, topics, filters, window, annual = window) {
  const segment = MARKETS_DEFAULT_REVIEW_SEGMENTS.find(group => group.id === filters.segment);
  if (filters.segment && !segment) throw new Error('Segmento de comentarios desconocido.');
  const visible = rows.filter(row => row.date >= window.start && row.date <= window.end);
  const selected = visible.filter(row => !segment || segment.stars.includes(row.rating));
  const blocksOf = row => {
    const blocks = row.blocks.filter(id => Object.hasOwn(topics, id));
    return blocks.length ? blocks : ['general'];
  };
  const groups = new Map();
  const monthly = new Map();
  const entity = filters.entity || MARKETS_REVIEW_ENTITY;
  const matchesEntity = row => entity === 'ALL' || row.entities.includes(entity);
  const monthlyRows = filters.analysisMonth ? visible.filter(matchesEntity) : visible;
  const local = (filters.analysisMonth ? monthlyRows : selected).filter(matchesEntity);
  const blockTotals = new Map();
  for (const row of selected) {
    const blocks = blocksOf(row);
    for (const block of blocks) blockTotals.set(block, (blockTotals.get(block) || 0) + 1);
    for (const entity of row.entities) {
      const group = groups.get(entity) || { label: entity, total: 0, counts: {} };
      group.total++;
      for (const block of blocks) group.counts[block] = (group.counts[block] || 0) + 1;
      groups.set(entity, group);
    }
  }
  const geographyMonths = new Map();
  function countMonthly(points, dimensions, row) {
    const key = JSON.stringify(dimensions);
    const point = points.get(key) || { total: 0, promoters: 0, detractors: 0,
      ...(filters.analysisMonth ? { assignedGeography: 0 } : {}) };
    countMarketsReviewNps_(point, row);
    points.set(key, point);
  }
  for (const row of monthlyRows) {
    const month = row.date.slice(0, 7);
    for (const entityName of row.entities) {
      if ((filters.analysisMonth || filters.year) && entity !== 'ALL' && entityName !== entity) continue;
      countMonthly(monthly, [entityName, month], row);
    }
    if (filters.analysisMonth && row.countries?.length === 1) {
      countMonthly(geographyMonths, [row.countries[0], month], row);
    }
  }
  const monthlyPoints = [...monthly].map(([key, point]) => {
    const [entityName, month] = JSON.parse(key);
    return { entity: entityName, month, ...point, balance: reviewBalancePoints_(point) };
  });
  const base = { total: 0, promoters: 0, detractors: 0 };
  const previousEnd = shiftReviewDay_(window.recent, -1);
  const baseStart = filters.analysisMonth ? previousEnd.slice(0, 7) + '-01' : window.start;
  const current = { total: 0, promoters: 0, detractors: 0 };
  const recent = [], recentBlocks = new Map();
  for (const row of filters.year ? [] : local) {
    if (row.date < window.recent) {
      if (row.date >= baseStart) countMarketsReviewNps_(base, row);
      continue;
    }
    if (filters.analysisMonth) countMarketsReviewNps_(current, row);
    if (filters.analysisMonth && segment && !segment.stars.includes(row.rating)) continue;
    recent.push(row);
    for (const id of blocksOf(row)) {
      if (!recentBlocks.has(id)) recentBlocks.set(id, { total: 0, promoters: 0, detractors: 0,
        ...(filters.analysisMonth ? { assignedGeography: 0 } : {}) });
      countMarketsReviewNps_(recentBlocks.get(id), row);
    }
  }
  const baseline = base.total ? { ...base, balance: reviewBalancePoints_(base), start: baseStart,
    end: previousEnd } : null;
  const deltas = [...recentBlocks].map(([id, stats]) => {
    const balance = reviewBalancePoints_(stats);
    return { id, label: topics[id], ...stats, weight: 100 * stats.total / recent.length,
      balance, gap: baseline ? balance - baseline.balance : null };
  }).sort((a, b) => a.gap - b.gap || a.label.localeCompare(b.label));
  const examples = [];
  const used = new Set();
  for (const block of ['general', ...deltas.filter(item => item.id !== 'general').slice(0, 3).map(item => item.id)]) {
    const example = selectMarketsReviewExample_(recent.filter(row => blocksOf(row).includes(block)), used);
    if (!example) continue;
    used.add(normalizeReviewEvidence_([example.title, example.original].join(' ')));
    examples.push({ block, review: example });
  }
  const leading = [...blockTotals].filter(([id]) => id !== 'general')
    .sort(([a, countA], [b, countB]) => countB - countA || a.localeCompare(b))[0];
  return { window, topics, examples, total: selected.length, leadingBlock: leading ? { id: leading[0], count: leading[1] } : null,
    annual: summarizeAnnualMarketsReviews_(rows, entity, annual, Boolean(filters.year)),
    entities: [...groups.values()].sort((a, b) => Number(b.label === 'BBVA Empresas') - Number(a.label === 'BBVA Empresas') ||
      b.total - a.total || a.label.localeCompare(b.label)), entityOptions: [...new Set(visible.flatMap(row => row.entities))].sort(),
    monthlyEntityOptions: [...new Set(monthlyPoints.map(point => point.entity))].sort(),
    monthly: monthlyPoints,
    ...(filters.analysisMonth ? { monthlyByGeography: [...geographyMonths].map(([key, point]) => {
      const [country, month] = JSON.parse(key);
      return { country, month, ...point, balance: reviewBalancePoints_(point) };
    }) } : {}),
    ...(filters.analysisMonth ? { nps: { start: window.recent, end: window.end, current: current.total ? reviewBalancePoints_(current) : null,
      previous: baseline?.balance ?? null, previousStart: baseStart, previousEnd,
      delta: current.total && baseline ? reviewBalancePoints_(current) - baseline.balance : null } } : {}),
    deltas, baseline, recentTotal: recent.length };
}


function summarizeAnnualMarketsReviews_(rows, entity, { start, end }, includeAuthorReviews) {
  const summary = { start, end, total: 0, promoters: 0, detractors: 0, answered: 0 };
  const helpful = [], authors = new Map();
  for (const row of rows) {
    if (row.date < start || row.date > end || (entity !== 'ALL' && !row.entities.includes(entity))) continue;
    countMarketsReviewNps_(summary, row);
    if (Number.isInteger(row.helpful) && row.helpful >= MARKETS_REVIEW_HELPFUL_MIN) helpful.push(row);
    if (row.reply?.trim()) summary.answered++;
    countMarketsReviewAuthor_(authors, row);
  }
  return { ...summary, neutral: summary.total - summary.promoters - summary.detractors, helpful: helpful.length, helpfulMinimum: MARKETS_REVIEW_HELPFUL_MIN,
    topHelpful: helpful.sort((a, b) => b.helpful - a.helpful || b.date.localeCompare(a.date) || a.key.localeCompare(b.key)).slice(0, 3),
    topAuthors: topMarketsReviewAuthors_(authors).map(({ author, count, reviews }) =>
      includeAuthorReviews ? { author, count, reviews } : { author, count }) };
}

const MARKETS_REVIEW_AUTHOR_SAMPLE_SIZE = 3;

function countMarketsReviewAuthor_(authors, row) {
  const author = row.author?.trim();
  if (!author) return;
  const entry = authors.get(author) || { author, count: 0, reviews: [] };
  entry.count++;
  if (row.key) {
    entry.reviews.push(row);
    entry.reviews.sort((a, b) => b.date.localeCompare(a.date) || a.key.localeCompare(b.key));
    if (entry.reviews.length > MARKETS_REVIEW_AUTHOR_SAMPLE_SIZE) entry.reviews.pop();
  }
  authors.set(author, entry);
}

function topMarketsReviewAuthors_(authors) {
  return [...authors.values()].sort((a, b) => b.count - a.count || a.author.localeCompare(b.author))
    .slice(0, 3).map(entry => entry.count > 1 ? entry : { ...entry, reviews: [] });
}

function selectMarketsReviewExample_(rows, used) {
  const documents = new Map();
  const frequency = new Map();
  const stop = new Set('para como este esta esto pero porque desde hasta sobre with this that from have your bir için ama olan'.split(' '));
  for (const row of rows) {
    const text = normalizeReviewEvidence_([row.title, row.original].join(' '));
    if (!text || used.has(text) || documents.has(text)) continue;
    const terms = new Set(text.split(' ').filter(word => word.length > 2 && !stop.has(word) && !/\d/.test(word)));
    if (!terms.size) continue;
    documents.set(text, { row, terms });
    for (const term of terms) frequency.set(term, (frequency.get(term) || 0) + 1);
  }
  const count = documents.size;
  const centroid = new Map();
  const vectors = [];
  for (const { row, terms } of documents.values()) {
    const vector = [...terms].map(term => [term, Math.log((count + 1) / (frequency.get(term) + 1)) + 1]);
    const length = Math.sqrt(vector.reduce((sum, [, value]) => sum + value * value, 0));
    const unit = vector.map(([term, value]) => [term, value / length]);
    for (const [term, value] of unit) centroid.set(term, (centroid.get(term) || 0) + value / count);
    vectors.push({ row, unit });
  }
  return vectors.map(({ row, unit }) => ({ row, score: unit.reduce((sum, [term, value]) => sum + value * centroid.get(term), 0) }))
    .sort((a, b) => b.score - a.score || a.row.key.localeCompare(b.row.key))[0]?.row;
}

ARCHIVO: 53_PlayReviews.gs
