/** Public Google Play web results. The requested storefront does not establish reviewer location. */
function fetchPlayReviewPage_(listing, token) {
  const locale = /^[a-z]{2}(?:-[a-z]{2})?$/i.test(listing.locale) ? listing.locale : 'en';
  const url = 'https://play.google.com/_/PlayStoreUi/data/batchexecute?rpcids=oCPfdb&hl=' +
    encodeURIComponent(locale) + '&gl=' + listing.countryCode.toLowerCase();
  const paging = token ? [150, null, token] : [150];
  const body = [null, [2, 2, paging, null, Array(9).fill(null)], [listing.packageName, 7]];
  const response = UrlFetchApp.fetch(url, {
    method: 'post', contentType: 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded;charset=UTF-8',
    payload: 'f.req=' + encodeURIComponent(JSON.stringify([[['oCPfdb', JSON.stringify(body), null, 'generic']]])),
    muteHttpExceptions: true, followRedirects: false
  });
  const status = response.getResponseCode();
  if (status !== 200) {
    const error = new Error('Google Play HTTP ' + status);
    error.rateLimited = status === 429 || status === 503;
    throw error;
  }
  return parsePlayReviewPage_(response.getContentText());
}

function playReviewTimestamp_(value) {
  const [seconds, nanos = 0] = Array.isArray(value) ? value : [];
  if (!Number.isFinite(seconds) || seconds <= 0 || !Number.isFinite(nanos)) return '';
  const date = new Date(seconds * 1000 + nanos / 1000000);
  return Number.isFinite(date.getTime()) ? date.toISOString() : '';
}

function parsePlayReviewPage_(body) {
  if (!body.startsWith(")]}'")) throw new Error('Respuesta inesperada de Google Play.');
  const envelope = JSON.parse(body.slice(4));
  const frame = envelope.find(item => item[0] === 'wrb.fr' && item[1] === 'oCPfdb');
  if (!frame || typeof frame[2] !== 'string') throw new Error('Google Play no devolvió un bloque de reseñas.');
  const data = JSON.parse(frame[2]);
  if (!Array.isArray(data) || (data[0] != null && !Array.isArray(data[0]))) {
    throw new Error('El formato de reseñas de Google Play ha cambiado.');
  }
  const rows = (data[0] || []).flatMap(item => {
    const id = trimString_(item[0]), text = trimString_(item[4]), rating = item[2];
    const date = playReviewTimestamp_(item[5]);
    if (!/^[a-z0-9_-]{8,128}$/i.test(id) || !text || !Number.isInteger(rating) ||
        rating < 1 || rating > 5 || !date) return [];
    const developer = Array.isArray(item[7]) ? item[7] : [];
    const metadata = {
      author: Array.isArray(item[1]) && typeof item[1][0] === 'string' ? trimString_(item[1][0]) : '',
      helpful: item[6],
      replyAuthor: typeof developer[0] === 'string' ? trimString_(developer[0]) : '',
      reply: typeof developer[1] === 'string' ? trimString_(developer[1]) : '',
      replyDate: playReviewTimestamp_(developer[2])
    };
    return [{ id, text, rating, date, version: trimString_(item[10]), metadata }];
  });
  if (data[0]?.length && !rows.length) throw new Error('Google Play devolvió reseñas sin los campos esperados.');
  const next = data[1]?.[1];
  return { rows, next: typeof next === 'string' && next.length <= 8000 ? next : '' };
}

function runMarketsPlayReviewBackfill() {
  requireMarketsReviewOwner_();
  return collectMarketsPlayReviews_();
}

/** Reinicia sólo los cursores de Google Play para recuperar metadatos de reseñas visibles. */
function resetMarketsPlayReviewHistory() {
  const { ss } = requireMarketsReviewOwner_();
  const lock = LockService.getUserLock();
  lock.waitLock(5000);
  try {
    if (marketsReviewWidth_(marketsReviewSheet_(ss)) !== MARKETS_REVIEW_METADATA_COLUMN) {
      throw new Error('Aplica primero migrateMarketsReviewMetadata.');
    }
    const properties = PropertiesService.getScriptProperties();
    const keys = properties.getKeys().filter(key => key.startsWith('MARKETS_PLAY_REVIEW|'));
    keys.forEach(key => properties.deleteProperty(key));
    return { reset: keys.length };
  } finally {
    lock.releaseLock();
  }
}

function collectMarketsPlayReviews_(limit = Infinity) {
  const lock = LockService.getUserLock();
  if (!lock.tryLock(1000)) return { deferred: true };
  try {
    const ss = openMarketsSpreadsheet_(), sheet = marketsReviewSheet_(ss);
    const properties = PropertiesService.getScriptProperties();
    const indexKey = 'MARKETS_PLAY_REVIEW_INDEX';
    const pauseKey = 'MARKETS_PLAY_REVIEW_PAUSE';
    if (Number(properties.getProperty(pauseKey)) > Date.now()) return { deferred: true };
    const listings = new Map();
    readAppCatalog_(ss).forEach(app => {
      if (app.platform === 'Android' && /^[A-Z]{2}$/.test(app.countryCode) &&
          /^[a-z][a-z0-9_]*(\.[a-z0-9_]+)+$/i.test(app.packageName)) {
        listings.set(app.packageName + '|' + app.countryCode, app);
      }
    });
    const keys = [...listings.keys()].sort();
    if (!keys.length) return { added: 0, processed: 0, eligible: 0 };
    const width = marketsReviewWidth_(sheet), last = sheet.getLastRow();
    const stored = last > 1 ? sheet.getRange(2, 1, last - 1, width).getValues() : [];
    const known = new Map();
    stored.forEach((row, index) => {
      if (row[3] === 'Android') known.set(row[0], { row, index: index + 2 });
    });
    const deadline = Date.now() + 235000;
    const start = Math.max(0, keys.indexOf(properties.getProperty(indexKey)));
    const summary = { added: 0, updated: 0, failures: 0, pages: 0, processed: 0, eligible: keys.length };
    // Reserva una página por escaparate para el histórico y limita el turno reciente.
    const recentPagesPerListing = 8;
    for (let step = 0; step < Math.min(keys.length, limit) && Date.now() < deadline && summary.pages < 100; step++) {
      const index = (start + step) % keys.length, key = keys[index], listing = listings.get(key);
      const stateKey = 'MARKETS_PLAY_REVIEW|' + key;
      const history = properties.getProperty(stateKey);
      const refreshKey = 'MARKETS_PLAY_REFRESH|' + key;
      let activeKey = refreshKey;
      try {
        let token = properties.getProperty(refreshKey) || '';
        const visited = new Set();
        for (let pageNumber = 0; pageNumber < recentPagesPerListing && summary.pages < 99 && Date.now() < deadline; pageNumber++) {
          const page = fetchPlayReviewPage_(listing, token);
          const overlap = page.rows.length > 0 && page.rows.every(review => {
            const stored = known.get(JSON.stringify(['Android', listing.packageName, review.id]))?.row;
            return stored && String(stored[2]).split(',').includes(listing.countryCode) && Date.parse(stored[6]) >= Date.parse(review.date);
          });
          storePlayReviews_(sheet, properties, known, listing, page.rows, summary, width);
          if (history === null && pageNumber === 0 && !token) properties.setProperty(stateKey, page.next || 'DONE');
          summary.pages++;
          visited.add(token);
          if (!page.next || overlap || visited.has(page.next)) {
            if (token) properties.deleteProperty(refreshKey);
            if (page.next && visited.has(page.next)) summary.failures++;
            break;
          }
          token = page.next;
          properties.setProperty(refreshKey, token);
        }
        if (history && history !== 'DONE' && Date.now() < deadline) {
          activeKey = stateKey;
          const page = fetchPlayReviewPage_(listing, history);
          storePlayReviews_(sheet, properties, known, listing, page.rows, summary, width);
          if (page.next === history) summary.failures++;
          else properties.setProperty(stateKey, page.next || 'DONE');
          summary.pages++;
        }
      } catch (error) {
        summary.failures++;
        console.warn(key + ': ' + error.message);
        if (error.rateLimited) {
          properties.setProperty(pauseKey, String(Date.now() + 60 * 60 * 1000));
          summary.deferred = true;
          summary.rateLimited = true;
          break;
        }
        if (/HTTP (400|404)$/.test(error.message)) properties.deleteProperty(activeKey);
      }
      properties.setProperty(indexKey, keys[(index + 1) % keys.length]);
      summary.processed++;
    }
    console.log(JSON.stringify(summary));
    return summary;
  } finally {
    lock.releaseLock();
  }
}

function storePlayReviews_(sheet, properties, known, listing, reviews, summary, width = 15) {
  const changes = new Map();
  const captured = new Date().toISOString();
  let firstEdit = Infinity;
  let geographyChanged = false;
  let nextIndex = sheet.getLastRow() + 1;
  for (const review of reviews) {
    const key = JSON.stringify(['Android', listing.packageName, review.id]);
    const previous = changes.get(key) || known.get(key);
    const markets = new Set(previous ? String(previous.row[2]).split(',') : []);
    const newMarket = !markets.has(listing.countryCode);
    markets.add(listing.countryCode);
    const newer = !previous || Date.parse(review.date) > Date.parse(previous.row[6]);
    const metadata = width === MARKETS_REVIEW_METADATA_COLUMN ? mergeMarketsReviewMetadata_(
      previous ? marketsReviewMetadata_(previous.row) : {}, review.metadata || {}) : '';
    if (!newer && !newMarket && (!metadata || metadata === previous.row[15])) continue;
    const row = newer ? [key, listing.appKey, '', 'Android', listing.packageName, review.id, review.date,
      review.rating, review.version, '', review.text, '', '', '', captured] : previous.row.slice();
    const index = previous ? previous.index : nextIndex++;
    if (previous && newer && previous.row[10] !== row[10]) firstEdit = Math.min(firstEdit, index);
    if (previous && newer && previous.row[10] === review.text) {
      row.splice(11, 3, ...previous.row.slice(11, 14));
    }
    row[2] = [...markets].sort().join(',');
    row[14] = captured;
    if (width === MARKETS_REVIEW_METADATA_COLUMN) row[15] = metadata;
    if (previous && (row[2] !== previous.row[2] || row[10] !== previous.row[10] ||
        (width === MARKETS_REVIEW_METADATA_COLUMN && marketsReviewMetadata_(row).reply !== marketsReviewMetadata_(previous.row).reply))) {
      geographyChanged = true;
    }
    changes.set(key, { row, index });
  }
  if (!changes.size) return;
  if (Number.isFinite(firstEdit) && typeof invalidateMarketsReviewIndexFrom_ === 'function') {
    invalidateMarketsReviewIndexFrom_(properties, firstEdit);
  }
  ensureSheetCapacity_(sheet, nextIndex - 1, width);
  const ordered = [...changes.values()].sort((a, b) => a.index - b.index);
  for (let start = 0; start < ordered.length;) {
    let end = start + 1;
    while (end < ordered.length && ordered[end].index === ordered[end - 1].index + 1) end++;
    const rows = ordered.slice(start, end).map(item => item.row.map(marketsReviewLiteral_));
    sheet.getRange(ordered[start].index, 1, rows.length, width).setValues(rows);
    start = end;
  }
  SpreadsheetApp.flush();
  if (geographyChanged) properties.setProperty('MARKETS_ANDROID_GEO_SOURCE_REVISION', captured);
  advanceMarketsReviewGeneration_(properties, true);
  changes.forEach((item, key) => {
    if (known.has(key)) summary.updated++;
    else summary.added++;
    known.set(key, item);
  });
}

const MARKETS_PLAY_METADATA_REFRESH = 'MARKETS_PLAY_METADATA_REFRESH';

/** Revisit the newest pages independently of the ordinary ingestion overlap cutoff. */
function advanceMarketsAndroidMetadata_(now = new Date()) {
  const properties = PropertiesService.getScriptProperties();
  if (Number(properties.getProperty('MARKETS_PLAY_REVIEW_PAUSE')) > now.getTime()) return null;
  const day = Utilities.formatDate(now, MARKETS_CONFIG.timeZone, 'yyyy-MM-dd');
  const previous = safeJsonParse_(properties.getProperty(MARKETS_PLAY_METADATA_REFRESH) || 'null');
  if (previous?.completedDay === day && previous.complete) return false;
  const lock = LockService.getUserLock();
  if (!lock.tryLock(1000)) return null;
  try {
    const ss = openMarketsSpreadsheet_(), sheet = marketsReviewSheet_(ss);
    if (marketsReviewWidth_(sheet) !== MARKETS_REVIEW_METADATA_COLUMN) throw new Error('Falta la columna store_metadata.');
    const listings = marketsReviewRecoveryListings_(ss).filter(app => app.platform === 'Android')
      .sort((a, b) => (a.packageName + '|' + a.countryCode).localeCompare(b.packageName + '|' + b.countryCode));
    const windowPages = Number(properties.getProperty('MARKETS_PLAY_METADATA_WINDOW_PAGES')) || 3;
    const limit = Math.max(1, Math.min(10, Math.floor(windowPages)));
    const state = previous && !previous.complete ? previous : { day, listing: 0, pages: 0, done: 0, updated: 0 };
    const signature = marketsReviewDigest_(listings.map(app => [app.packageName, app.countryCode]));
    if (state.signature !== signature) Object.assign(state, { signature, listing: 0, page: 0, done: 0, token: '' });
    state.total = listings.length;
    if (state.listing < listings.length) {
      const listing = listings[state.listing];
      state.runningUntil = Date.now() + 7 * 60 * 1000;
      properties.setProperty(MARKETS_PLAY_METADATA_REFRESH, JSON.stringify(state));
      try {
        const result = fetchPlayReviewPage_(listing, state.token || '');
        state.updated += refreshMarketsAndroidMetadataPage_(sheet, properties, listing.packageName, result.rows);
        state.pages++;
        state.page = (state.page || 0) + 1;
        if (!result.next || result.next === state.token || state.page >= limit) {
          state.listing++;
          state.page = 0;
          state.token = '';
        } else {
          state.token = result.next;
        }
      } catch (error) {
        if (error.rateLimited) properties.setProperty('MARKETS_PLAY_REVIEW_PAUSE', String(Date.now() + 60 * 60 * 1000));
        else if (state.token && /HTTP (400|404)$/.test(error.message)) {
          state.page = 0;
          state.token = '';
        }
        throw error;
      } finally {
        delete state.runningUntil;
        state.done = state.listing;
        state.complete = state.done >= state.total;
        if (state.complete) state.completedDay = day;
        state.updatedAt = new Date().toISOString();
        properties.setProperty(MARKETS_PLAY_METADATA_REFRESH, JSON.stringify(state));
      }
    } else {
      state.complete = true;
      state.completedDay = day;
      properties.setProperty(MARKETS_PLAY_METADATA_REFRESH, JSON.stringify(state));
    }
    return true;
  } finally {
    lock.releaseLock();
  }
}

function refreshMarketsAndroidMetadataPage_(sheet, properties, packageName, reviews) {
  const last = sheet.getLastRow();
  if (last < 2 || !reviews.length) return 0;
  const byKey = new Map(reviews.map(review => [JSON.stringify(['Android', packageName, review.id]), review.metadata]));
  const candidates = sheet.getRange(2, 1, last - 1, 1).getValues().flatMap(([key], offset) =>
    byKey.has(key) ? [{ row: [key], rowNumber: offset + 2 }] : []);
  if (!candidates.length) return 0;
  if (!hydrateMarketsReviewPage_(sheet, MARKETS_REVIEW_METADATA_COLUMN, candidates)) throw new Error('Las reseñas cambiaron durante la lectura.');
  const edits = [];
  let replyChanged = false;
  for (const { row, rowNumber } of candidates) {
    const previous = marketsReviewMetadata_(row);
    const merged = mergeMarketsReviewMetadata_(previous, byKey.get(row[0]) || {});
    if (!merged || merged === row[15]) continue;
    replyChanged = replyChanged || parseMarketsReviewMetadata_(merged).reply !== previous.reply;
    edits.push([rowNumber, merged]);
  }
  if (!edits.length) return 0;
  // Only the metadata cell changes. Keep original IDs, timestamps and main translations.
  advanceMarketsReviewGeneration_(properties);
  if (replyChanged) properties.setProperty('MARKETS_ANDROID_GEO_SOURCE_REVISION', Utilities.getUuid());
  try {
    for (let start = 0; start < edits.length;) {
      let end = start + 1;
      while (end < edits.length && edits[end][0] === edits[end - 1][0] + 1) end++;
      sheet.getRange(edits[start][0], MARKETS_REVIEW_METADATA_COLUMN, end - start, 1)
        .setValues(edits.slice(start, end).map(([, metadata]) => [marketsReviewLiteral_(metadata)]));
      start = end;
    }
    SpreadsheetApp.flush();
  } finally {
    // Una escritura parcial también debe retirar cualquier build concurrente.
    advanceMarketsReviewGeneration_(properties);
  }
  return edits.length;
}

/** Reseñas de escaparates de App Store, con almacenamiento y activadores propios. */
var MARKETS_REVIEW_HEADERS = Object.freeze([
  'review_key', 'app_key', 'country_code', 'platform', 'store_id', 'review_id',
  'updated_at', 'rating', 'version', 'title', 'original', 'es', 'en', 'tr'
]);

const MARKETS_REVIEW_METADATA_COLUMN = 16;
const MARKETS_REVIEW_METADATA_HEADER = 'store_metadata';

function setupMarketsReviews() {
  const access = requireMarketsReviewOwner_();
  if (!access.ss.getSheetByName('MARKET_REVIEWS')) {
    const sheet = access.ss.insertSheet('MARKET_REVIEWS');
    const headers = [...MARKETS_REVIEW_HEADERS, 'captured_at', MARKETS_REVIEW_METADATA_HEADER];
    sheet.getRange(1, 1, 1, headers.length).setValues([headers]);
    sheet.setFrozenRows(1);
  }
  const sheet = marketsReviewSheet_(access.ss);
  ensureSheetCapacity_(sheet, 2, 15);
  const captured = sheet.getRange(1, 15);
  if (!captured.getValue()) captured.setValue('captured_at');
  installMarketsReviewSupervisor_();
}

function requireMarketsReviewOwner_() {
  const access = requireMarketsAdministrator_();
  if (access.email !== normalizeEmailForComparison_(Session.getEffectiveUser().getEmail())) {
    throw new Error('Esta operación está reservada al propietario de los activadores.');
  }
  return access;
}

/** Migración explícita y aditiva para instalaciones con el contrato anterior. */
function migrateMarketsReviewMetadata() {
  const { ss } = requireMarketsReviewOwner_();
  const lock = LockService.getUserLock();
  lock.waitLock(5000);
  try {
    const sheet = marketsReviewSheet_(ss);
    if (sheet.getRange(1, 15).getValue() !== 'captured_at') {
      throw new Error('MARKET_REVIEWS no tiene la cabecera esperada captured_at.');
    }
    if (marketsReviewWidth_(sheet) === MARKETS_REVIEW_METADATA_COLUMN) return { changed: false };
    if (sheet.getLastColumn() >= MARKETS_REVIEW_METADATA_COLUMN) {
      throw new Error('La columna de metadatos ya contiene datos con otro contrato.');
    }
    ensureSheetCapacity_(sheet, 2, MARKETS_REVIEW_METADATA_COLUMN);
    sheet.getRange(1, MARKETS_REVIEW_METADATA_COLUMN).setValue(MARKETS_REVIEW_METADATA_HEADER);
    SpreadsheetApp.flush();
    return { changed: true };
  } finally {
    lock.releaseLock();
  }
}

function marketsReviewWidth_(sheet) {
  return sheet.getLastColumn() >= MARKETS_REVIEW_METADATA_COLUMN &&
    sheet.getRange(1, MARKETS_REVIEW_METADATA_COLUMN).getValue() === MARKETS_REVIEW_METADATA_HEADER
    ? MARKETS_REVIEW_METADATA_COLUMN : 15;
}

function marketsReviewMetadata_(row) {
  return parseMarketsReviewMetadata_(row[MARKETS_REVIEW_METADATA_COLUMN - 1]);
}

function parseMarketsReviewMetadata_(value) {
  try { return JSON.parse(value) || {}; }
  catch (ignored) { return {}; }
}

function mergeMarketsReviewMetadata_(previous, source) {
  const out = { ...previous };
  if (source.author) out.author = source.author;
  if (Number.isInteger(source.helpful) && source.helpful >= 0) out.helpful = source.helpful;
  if (source.reply && (!out.replyDate || (source.replyDate && source.replyDate >= out.replyDate))) {
    if (out.reply !== source.reply) delete out.replyTranslations;
    out.reply = source.reply;
    if (source.replyDate) out.replyDate = source.replyDate;
    if (source.replyAuthor) out.replyAuthor = source.replyAuthor;
  }
  return Object.keys(out).length ? JSON.stringify(out) : '';
}

function runMarketsReviewBackfill() {
  requireMarketsReviewOwner_();
  return collectMarketsReviews_();
}

function runMarketsReviewTranslation() {
  requireMarketsReviewOwner_();
  const result = translateMarketsReviews_();
  console.log(JSON.stringify(result));
  return result;
}

function marketsReviewSheet_(ss) {
  const sheet = ss.getSheetByName('MARKET_REVIEWS');
  if (!sheet) throw new Error('La colección de reseñas todavía no está configurada.');
  assertCurrentSheetContract_(sheet, MARKETS_REVIEW_HEADERS,
    sheet.getRange(1, 1, 1, MARKETS_REVIEW_HEADERS.length).getValues()[0]);
  return sheet;
}

function marketsReviewFeedUrl_(app, page) {
  return 'https://itunes.apple.com/' + app.countryCode.toLowerCase() + '/rss/customerreviews/page=' +
    page + '/id=' + app.appId + '/sortby=mostrecent/json';
}

function parseMarketsReviewFeed_(app, page, payload) {
  const feed = JSON.parse(payload).feed;
  const links = feed && Array.isArray(feed.link) ? feed.link.map(link => link.attributes || {}) : [];
  if (!links.some(link => link.rel === 'self' && link.href === marketsReviewFeedUrl_(app, page))) {
    throw new Error('El escaparate devuelto no coincide con el solicitado.');
  }
  const entries = Array.isArray(feed.entry) ? feed.entry : feed.entry ? [feed.entry] : [];
  const rows = entries.flatMap(entry => {
    const id = trimString_(entry.id?.label), original = trimString_(entry.content?.label);
    const rating = Number(entry['im:rating']?.label), updatedAt = trimString_(entry.updated?.label);
    if (!/^\d+$/.test(id) || !original || !Number.isInteger(rating) || rating < 1 || rating > 5 ||
        !Number.isFinite(Date.parse(updatedAt))) return [];
    const metadata = mergeMarketsReviewMetadata_({}, { author: trimString_(entry.author?.name?.label) });
    return [[JSON.stringify([app.platform, app.countryCode, app.appId, id]), app.appKey, app.countryCode,
      app.platform, app.appId, id, updatedAt, rating, trimString_(entry['im:version']?.label),
      trimString_(entry.title?.label), original, '', '', '', '', metadata]];
  });
  return { rows, more: links.some(link => link.rel === 'next' && String(link.href).split('?')[0].replace(/\/xml$/, '/json') === marketsReviewFeedUrl_(app, page + 1)) };
}

function marketsReviewLiteral_(value) {
  return typeof value === 'string' && /^[=+\-@']/.test(value) ? "'" + value : value;
}

function collectMarketsReviews_(limit = Infinity) {
  // User lock keeps ingestion and translation mutually exclusive for the trigger owner.
  const lock = LockService.getUserLock();
  if (!lock.tryLock(1000)) return { deferred: true };
  try {
    const ss = openMarketsSpreadsheet_(), sheet = marketsReviewSheet_(ss);
    const width = marketsReviewWidth_(sheet);
    const apps = marketsIosReviewListings_(readAppCatalog_(ss));
    const lastRow = sheet.getLastRow();
    const stored = lastRow > 1 ? sheet.getRange(2, 1, lastRow - 1, width).getValues() : [];
    const known = new Map(stored.map((row, index) => [row[0], {
      index: index + 2, row
    }]));
    const properties = PropertiesService.getScriptProperties(), cursorKey = 'MARKETS_REVIEWS_CURSOR';
    const [cursor, cursorPage] = JSON.parse(properties.getProperty(cursorKey) || '["",1]');
    const start = Math.max(0, apps.findIndex(app => app.appKey === cursor));
    const deadline = Date.now() + 240000;
    let added = 0, updated = 0, failures = 0, processed = 0;
    const retryPrefix = 'MARKETS_IOS_REVIEW_RETRY|';
    const scheduled = new Map(apps.map(app => [app.appKey,
      JSON.parse(properties.getProperty(retryPrefix + app.appKey) || 'null')]));
    const priority = cursorPage === 1 && limit > 0 ? apps.filter(app => {
      const retry = scheduled.get(app.appKey);
      return app !== apps[start] && retry?.page > 1 && retry.after <= Date.now();
    }).sort((a, b) => scheduled.get(a.appKey).after - scheduled.get(b.appKey).after)[0] : null;
    let priorityPending = Boolean(priority);
    while (processed < Math.min(apps.length, limit) && Date.now() < deadline) {
      const bonus = priorityPending;
      priorityPending = false;
      const app = bonus ? priority : apps[(start + processed) % apps.length];
      const retryKey = retryPrefix + app.appKey;
      const retry = scheduled.get(app.appKey);
      let page = retry?.page || (app.appKey === cursor ? cursorPage : 1);
      try {
        for (; page <= 10 && !(retry?.after > Date.now()); page++) {
          if (Date.now() >= deadline) {
            if (bonus) break;
            if (retry) properties.setProperty(retryKey, JSON.stringify({ ...retry, page }));
            properties.setProperty(cursorKey, JSON.stringify([app.appKey, page]));
            const summary = { added, updated, failures, processed, eligible: apps.length, deferred: true };
            console.log(JSON.stringify(summary));
            return summary;
          }
          const result = fetchMarketsIosReviewPage_(app, page);
          const summary = { added: 0, updated: 0 };
          storeMarketsIosReviews_(sheet, properties, known, result.rows, summary, width);
          added += summary.added;
          updated += summary.updated;
          if (bonus) {
            const next = result.more && page < 10 ? { ...retry, page: page + 1 } : null;
            if (next) properties.setProperty(retryKey, JSON.stringify(next));
            else properties.deleteProperty(retryKey);
            // Regular rotation will count the listing on its own turn.
            scheduled.set(app.appKey, next || { after: Infinity });
            break;
          }
          if (!result.more) break;
        }
        if (!bonus && retry && !(retry.after > Date.now())) properties.deleteProperty(retryKey);
      } catch (error) {
        const attempts = Math.min((retry?.attempts || 0) + 1, 6);
        const next = { page, attempts, after: Date.now() + 60000 * 2 ** attempts };
        properties.setProperty(retryKey, JSON.stringify(next));
        scheduled.set(app.appKey, next);
        failures++;
        console.warn(app.appKey + ': ' + error.message);
      }
      if (bonus) continue;
      processed++;
      properties.setProperty(cursorKey, JSON.stringify([apps[(start + processed) % apps.length].appKey, 1]));
    }
    const summary = { added, updated, failures, processed, eligible: apps.length };
    console.log(JSON.stringify(summary));
    return summary;
  } finally {
    lock.releaseLock();
  }
}

function marketsIosReviewListings_(catalog) {
  const listings = new Map();
  catalog.filter(app => app.platform === 'iOS' && /^[A-Z]{2}$/.test(app.countryCode) &&
    /^\d+$/.test(app.appId)).forEach(app => {
    const listing = app.countryCode + '|' + app.appId;
    if (!listings.has(listing)) listings.set(listing, []);
    listings.get(listing).push(app);
  });
  const ambiguous = [...listings.values()].filter(group => group.length > 1).length;
  if (ambiguous) console.warn('Escaparates iOS ambiguos excluidos: ' + ambiguous);
  return [...listings.values()].filter(group => group.length === 1).map(group => group[0])
    .sort((a, b) => a.appKey.localeCompare(b.appKey));
}

function fetchMarketsIosReviewPage_(app, page) {
  const response = UrlFetchApp.fetch(marketsReviewFeedUrl_(app, page), {
    muteHttpExceptions: true, followRedirects: false
  });
  if (response.getResponseCode() !== 200) throw new Error('HTTP ' + response.getResponseCode());
  return parseMarketsReviewFeed_(app, page, response.getContentText());
}

function storeMarketsIosReviews_(sheet, properties, known, reviews, summary, width) {
  const previousUpdates = summary.updated;
  const pending = new Map();
  const captured = new Date().toISOString();
  for (const row of reviews) {
    row[14] = captured;
    const previous = known.get(row[0]);
    if (!previous) {
      if (!pending.has(row[0]) || Date.parse(row[6]) > Date.parse(pending.get(row[0])[6])) {
        pending.set(row[0], row.slice(0, width));
      }
      continue;
    }
    const newer = Date.parse(row[6]) > Date.parse(previous.row[6]);
    const textChanged = newer && row[10] !== previous.row[10];
    const merged = width === MARKETS_REVIEW_METADATA_COLUMN ? mergeMarketsReviewMetadata_(
      marketsReviewMetadata_(previous.row), marketsReviewMetadata_(row)) : '';
    if (!newer && (!merged || merged === previous.row[15])) continue;
    const updatedRow = newer ? row.slice(0, width) : previous.row.slice();
    if (newer && !textChanged) updatedRow.splice(11, 3, ...previous.row.slice(11, 14));
    updatedRow[14] = captured;
    if (width === MARKETS_REVIEW_METADATA_COLUMN) updatedRow[15] = merged;
    if (newer && (textChanged || row[9] !== previous.row[9]) && typeof invalidateMarketsReviewIndexFrom_ === 'function') {
      invalidateMarketsReviewIndexFrom_(properties, previous.index);
    }
    const update = updatedRow.slice(6);
    sheet.getRange(previous.index, 7, 1, update.length).setValues([update.map(marketsReviewLiteral_)]);
    known.set(row[0], { index: previous.index, row: updatedRow });
    summary.updated++;
  }
  if (pending.size) {
    const nextRow = sheet.getLastRow() + 1;
    const rows = [...pending.values()];
    ensureSheetCapacity_(sheet, nextRow + rows.length - 1, width);
    sheet.getRange(nextRow, 1, rows.length, width)
      .setValues(rows.map(row => row.map(marketsReviewLiteral_)));
    rows.forEach((row, i) => known.set(row[0], { index: nextRow + i, row }));
    summary.added += rows.length;
  }
  if (pending.size || summary.updated > previousUpdates) {
    SpreadsheetApp.flush();
    advanceMarketsReviewGeneration_(properties, true);
  }
}

/** Auditoría de sólo lectura: devuelve recuentos, nunca textos ni autores. */
function auditMarketsReviewTranslations() {
  const { ss } = requireMarketsReviewOwner_();
  const lock = LockService.getUserLock();
  if (!lock.tryLock(1000)) return { deferred: true };
  try {
    const sheet = marketsReviewSheet_(ss), height = sheet.getLastRow() - 1;
    const rows = height > 0 ? sheet.getRange(2, 2, height, 13).getValues() : [];
    const groups = new Map(), totals = new Map();
    const increment = (map, scope, original, values) => {
      const key = JSON.stringify(scope);
      if (!map.has(key)) map.set(key, { scope, total: 0, emptyOriginal: 0, pending: 0, missing: [0,0,0], identical: [0,0,0] });
      const group = map.get(key);
      group.total++;
      group.emptyOriginal += Number(!original);
      group.pending += Number(Boolean(original) && values.some(value => !value));
      values.forEach((value, i) => { group.missing[i] += Number(!value); group.identical[i] += Number(Boolean(original) && value === original); });
    };
    for (const row of rows) {
      const [app, markets, platform, , , date, , , , original, ...values] = row;
      const turkey = String(markets).split(',').includes('TR');
      increment(totals, [turkey ? 'TR' : 'otros', platform], original, values);
      if (turkey) increment(groups, ['TR', platform, marketsReviewRecoveryMonth_(date), app], original, values);
    }
    const summary = [...totals.values()];
    const result = { checked: rows.length, pending: summary.reduce((sum, group) => sum + group.pending, 0),
      languages: ['es', 'en', 'tr'], totals: summary, groups: [...groups.values()] };
    console.log(JSON.stringify({ checked: result.checked, pending: result.pending, languages: result.languages, totals: summary }));
    return result;
  } finally {
    lock.releaseLock();
  }
}

function repairMarketsReviewTranslations() {
  const result = processMarketsReviewTranslations_(true);
  console.log(JSON.stringify(result));
  return result;
}

function translateMarketsReviews_() {
  return processMarketsReviewTranslations_(false);
}

const MARKETS_TRANSLATION_QUOTA_RETRY_KEY = 'MARKETS_TRANSLATION_QUOTA_RETRY_AT';
const MARKETS_TRANSLATION_QUOTA_RETRY_MS = 60 * 60 * 1000;

function processMarketsReviewTranslations_(historical) {
  const ss = historical ? requireMarketsReviewOwner_().ss : openMarketsSpreadsheet_();
  const lock = LockService.getUserLock();
  if (!lock.tryLock(1000)) return { deferred: true };
  try {
    const properties = PropertiesService.getScriptProperties();
    const retryAt = Number(properties.getProperty(MARKETS_TRANSLATION_QUOTA_RETRY_KEY)) || 0;
    if (retryAt > Date.now()) return { quotaLimited: true, retryAt };
    const sheet = marketsReviewSheet_(ss), eligible = Math.max(0, sheet.getLastRow() - 1);
    // La fecha de la reseña (no su posición) define la prioridad, incluso tras una recuperación histórica.
    const metadataEnabled = typeof sheet.getLastColumn === 'function' && marketsReviewWidth_(sheet) === MARKETS_REVIEW_METADATA_COLUMN;
    const rows = eligible ? sheet.getRange(2, 7, eligible, metadataEnabled ? 10 : 8).getValues() : [];
    const queue = [];
    rows.forEach(([date, , , , original, es, en, tr, , rawMetadata], offset) => {
      const index = offset + 2, time = Date.parse(date) || 0;
      const values = [es, en, tr];
      if (original && values.some(value => !value)) queue.push({ index, time, original, values });
      if (!metadataEnabled || !rawMetadata) return;
      const metadata = parseMarketsReviewMetadata_(rawMetadata);
      const replyValues = ['es', 'en', 'tr'].map(lang => metadata.replyTranslations?.[lang] || '');
      if (metadata.reply && replyValues.some(value => !value)) {
        queue.push({ index, time: Date.parse(metadata.replyDate) || time, original: metadata.reply,
          values: replyValues, metadata });
      }
    });
    queue.sort((a, b) => b.time - a.time || b.index - a.index);
    const deadline = Date.now() + 235000;
    const languages = ['es', 'en', 'tr'];
    let translated = 0, translatedReplies = 0, failed = 0, pending = queue.length, nextRetry = 0;
    const replyTotal = queue.filter(item => item.metadata).length;
    const workTotal = eligible + replyTotal;
    let replyPending = replyTotal;
    const translatedText = new Map();
    try {
      for (const {index, original, values, metadata} of queue.slice(0, 100)) {
        if (Date.now() >= deadline) break;
        const result = values.slice();
        for (let i = 0; i < languages.length; i++) {
          if (result[i]) continue;
          try {
            const key = JSON.stringify([original, languages[i]]);
            result[i] = translatedText.get(key) || LanguageApp.translate(String(original), '', languages[i]) || '';
            if (result[i]) translatedText.set(key, result[i]);
          } catch (error) {
            // LanguageApp no ofrece una consulta de saldo: la siguiente llamada actúa como sonda.
            if (/quota|cuota|too many times|limit exceeded/i.test(errorToString_(error))) {
              nextRetry = Date.now() + MARKETS_TRANSLATION_QUOTA_RETRY_MS;
              properties.setProperty(MARKETS_TRANSLATION_QUOTA_RETRY_KEY, String(nextRetry));
              break;
            }
          }
        }
        if (result.some((value,i) => value !== values[i])) {
          if (metadata) {
            metadata.replyTranslations = Object.fromEntries(languages.map((lang, i) => [lang, result[i]]));
            sheet.getRange(index, MARKETS_REVIEW_METADATA_COLUMN, 1, 1).setValues([[JSON.stringify(metadata)]]);
            translatedReplies++;
          } else {
            sheet.getRange(index, 12, 1, 3).setValues([result.map(marketsReviewLiteral_)]);
            translated++;
          }
        }
        if (result.every(Boolean)) {
          pending--;
          if (metadata) replyPending--;
        }
        else if (!nextRetry) failed++;
        if (nextRetry) break;
      }
    } finally {
      if (translated || translatedReplies) {
        SpreadsheetApp.flush();
        advanceMarketsReviewGeneration_(properties);
      }
    }
    if (failed) console.warn('Filas de traducción pendientes de reintento: ' + failed);
    return { translated, translatedReplies, replyPending, checked: workTotal - pending, eligible: workTotal, failed, pending,
      quotaLimited: Boolean(nextRetry), retryAt: nextRetry, complete: pending === 0 };
  } finally {
    lock.releaseLock();
  }
}

const MARKETS_DEFAULT_REVIEW_SEGMENTS = [
  { id: 'DETRACTOR', label: 'Detractores', stars: [1, 2, 3] },
  { id: 'NEUTRAL', label: 'Neutros', stars: [4] },
  { id: 'PROMOTER', label: 'Promotores', stars: [5] }
];

function getMarketsReviewSegments() {
  currentMarketsUserEmail_();
  return MARKETS_DEFAULT_REVIEW_SEGMENTS;
}

function readMarketsReviewsForWeb_(filters) {
  currentMarketsUserEmail_();
  return queryMarketsReviews_(openMarketsSpreadsheet_(), filters).slice(0, 100);
}

const MARKETS_REVIEW_CLASSIFIER_SCHEMA = 13;

function marketsReviewClassification_(ss) {
  const taxonomy = ss.getSheetByName('FUNCTIONAL_CATALOG');
  const entries = taxonomy && taxonomy.getLastRow() > 1
    ? taxonomy.getRange(2, 1, taxonomy.getLastRow() - 1, 4).getDisplayValues() : [];
  const knownBlocks = new Set(entries.filter(([id, label]) => /^\d{2}\./.test(id) && label).map(([id]) => id.slice(0, 2)));
  const active = typeof PropertiesService === 'object' && marketsFunctionalEngine_(PropertiesService.getScriptProperties());
  if (active?.engine === 'EDCCatalogClassifier') return { library: active, knownBlocks,
    version: marketsReviewDigest_([MARKETS_REVIEW_CLASSIFIER_SCHEMA, MARKETS_REVIEW_AUDIENCE_VERSION, active.pins]) };
  const aliases = marketsBusinessAliases_(ss);
  const translations = ['en', 'tr'].map(language => marketsFunctionalTranslations_(ss, language));
  for (const [id, , name] of entries) {
    const localized = translations.map(names => names.get(name)).filter(Boolean);
    if (localized.length) aliases[id] = [...(aliases[id] || []), ...localized];
  }
  return { rules: compileReviewRules_(entries, aliases), knownBlocks,
    version: typeof Utilities === 'object' && Utilities.computeDigest ?
      marketsReviewDigest_([MARKETS_REVIEW_CLASSIFIER_SCHEMA, MARKETS_REVIEW_AUDIENCE_VERSION, entries, aliases]) : '' };
}

function marketsReviewBlocks_(ids, knownBlocks) {
  return [...new Set(ids.map(id => id.slice(0, 2)).filter(id => !knownBlocks || knownBlocks.has(id)))];
}

function queryMarketsReviews_(ss, filters, window, includeTranslations = false, apps = readAppCatalog_(ss), paging = null) {
  filters = filters || {};
  const segment = MARKETS_DEFAULT_REVIEW_SEGMENTS.find(group => group.id === filters.segment);
  if (filters.segment && !segment) throw new Error('Segmento de comentarios desconocido.');
  const catalog = new Map(apps.map(app => [app.appKey, app]));
  const sheet = ss.getSheetByName('MARKET_REVIEWS');
  const lastRow = sheet?.getLastRow() || 0;
  if (lastRow < 2) return paging ? paginateMarketsReviews_([], paging, window) : [];
  marketsReviewSheet_(ss);
  const topic = /^(?:\d{2})(?:\.(?:\d{2}|xx))?$/.test(filters.topic) ? filters.topic : "";
  const classification = filters.classificationOverride || (((window && !filters.deferBlocks) || filters.includeTopics || filters.audience || topic)
    ? marketsReviewClassification_(ss) : null);
  const rules = classification?.rules;
  const knownBlocks = window ? classification?.knownBlocks : null;
  const languageColumn = { es: 11, en: 12, tr: 13 }[filters.language] || 11;
  const androidListings = new Map(apps.filter(app => app.platform === 'Android')
    .map(app => [app.packageName + '|' + app.countryCode, app]));
  const iosListings = new Map();
  for (const app of apps.filter(item => item.platform === 'iOS')) {
    const key = app.appId + '|' + app.countryCode;
    iosListings.set(key, iosListings.has(key) ? null : app);
  }
  const readStarted = Date.now();
  const width = marketsReviewWidth_(sheet);
  const indexOnly = !filters.fullRead && !paging?.fullRead;
  const search = normalizeReviewEvidence_(String(filters.search || "").slice(0, 200));
  const approvedGeo = filters.inferGeography !== 'NO' && typeof readMarketsAndroidGeography_ === 'function'
    ? readMarketsAndroidGeography_(ss) : new Map();
  const filterText = Boolean(search || filters.audience || filters.topic);
  const indexWidth = MARKETS_REVIEW_HEADERS.indexOf(filterText ? 'original' : 'rating') + 1;
  const stored = sheet.getRange(2, 1, lastRow - 1, indexOnly ? indexWidth : width).getValues();
  if (indexOnly && filters.sort === 'HELPFUL' && width > 15) {
    const metadata = sheet.getRange(2, 16, lastRow - 1, 1).getValues();
    stored.forEach((row, index) => { row[15] = metadata[index][0]; });
  }
  if (indexOnly && approvedGeo.size) {
    const geographicRows = stored.flatMap((row, offset) => approvedGeo.get(row[0])?.country
      ? [{ row, rowNumber: offset + 2 }] : []);
    if (geographicRows.length && !hydrateMarketsReviewPage_(sheet, width, geographicRows)) {
      return queryMarketsReviews_(ss, { ...filters, fullRead: true }, window, includeTranslations, apps, paging && { ...paging, fullRead: true });
    }
    for (const { row, rowNumber } of geographicRows) stored[rowNumber - 2] = row;
  }
  let readMs = Date.now() - readStarted;
  const byPackage = new Map();
  for (const app of androidListings.values()) {
    if (!byPackage.has(app.packageName)) byPackage.set(app.packageName, []);
    byPackage.get(app.packageName).push(app);
  }
  const derived = Boolean(classification?.version) && (filters.migrationIndex ? marketsFunctionalIndexSheet_(ss, filters.migrationIndex)
    : typeof marketsReviewIndexSheet_ === 'function' && marketsReviewIndexSheet_(ss));
  const derivedCount = derived ? Math.max(0, Math.min(stored.length, derived.getLastRow() - 1)) : 0;
  const derivedRows = derivedCount ? derived.getRange(2, 1, derivedCount, derived.getLastColumn()).getValues() : [];
  let classified = 0, classificationMs = 0;
  const started = Date.now();
  const identities = new Map();
  for (const [offset, row] of stored.entries()) {
    if (!row[0]) continue;
    const identity = row[4] && row[5] ? JSON.stringify([row[3], row[4], row[5]]) : String(row[0]);
    const previous = identities.get(identity);
    if (!previous) {
      identities.set(identity, { row, rowNumber: offset + 2, markets: String(row[2]), key: row[0], matches: row[0] === filters.reviewKey });
    } else {
      previous.markets += ',' + row[2];
      previous.matches = previous.matches || row[0] === filters.reviewKey;
      if (String(row[0]) < String(previous.key)) previous.key = row[0];
      if (Date.parse(row[6]) > Date.parse(previous.row[6])) {
        previous.row = row;
        previous.rowNumber = offset + 2;
      }
    }
  }
  const localDate = typeof Intl === 'object' && new Intl.DateTimeFormat('sv-SE', {
    timeZone: MARKETS_CONFIG.timeZone, year: 'numeric', month: '2-digit', day: '2-digit'
  });
  let candidates = Array.from(identities.values())
    .flatMap(({ row, rowNumber, markets, key, matches }) => {
      if (filters.reviewKey && !matches) return [];
      if (filters.platform !== 'ALL' && row[3] !== filters.platform) return [];
      if (!Number.isInteger(row[7]) || row[7] < 1 || row[7] > 5) return [];
      const date = row[6] instanceof Date
        ? (Number.isFinite(row[6].getTime()) ? (localDate ? localDate.format(row[6]) : webDateKey_(row[6])) : '')
        : String(row[6]).slice(0, 10);
      if (window && ((filters.start && date < filters.start) || (filters.end && date > filters.end) || !/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(date) || date < window.start || date > window.end)) return [];
      if (window && filters.rating !== undefined && filters.rating !== '' && row[7] !== Number(filters.rating)) return [];
      if (segment && (typeof row[7] !== 'number' || !segment.stars.includes(row[7]))) return [];
      const android = row[3] === 'Android';
      if (filters.period && !date.startsWith(filters.period)) return [];
      if (filters.maxRating && row[7] > filters.maxRating) return [];
      const storefronts = [...new Set(markets.split(',').map(code => code.trim()).filter(code => /^[A-Z]{2}$/.test(code)))].sort();
      let country = storefronts.length === 1 && MARKETS_WEB.countryCodes.includes(storefronts[0]) ? storefronts[0] : 'UNKNOWN';
      let attributionMethod = country !== 'UNKNOWN' ? 'single_storefront' :
        storefronts.length > 1 ? 'multi_storefront_ambiguous' : 'no_evidence';
      const approval = country === 'UNKNOWN' && android && approvedGeo.get(row[0]);
      const eligible = approval && (byPackage.get(row[4]) || []).map(app => app.countryCode);
      if (approval && approval.packageName === row[4] && new Set(eligible).size > 1 &&
          eligible.includes(approval.country) && approval.digest === marketsAndroidGeographyDigest_(row, approval.automatic)) {
        const evidence = marketsAndroidGeographyApprovalEvidence_(row, eligible, approval);
        if (evidence?.status === 'VALIDAR' && evidence.candidate === approval.country) {
          country = approval.country;
          attributionMethod = approval.automatic ? 'review_evidence_inferred' : 'review_evidence_validated';
        }
      }
      if (filters.country !== 'ALL' && filters.country !== country) return [];
      const sharedListing = android && storefronts.length > 1;
      const direct = catalog.get(row[1]);
      const candidates = storefronts.map(code => (android ? androidListings : iosListings).get(row[4] + '|' + code)).filter(Boolean);
      if (!android && !storefronts.length && direct?.platform === 'iOS' && String(row[4]) === direct.appId) candidates.push(direct);
      if (android && !candidates.length) {
        if (direct?.platform === 'Android' && direct.packageName === row[4]) candidates.push(direct);
        else if (byPackage.get(row[4])?.length === 1) candidates.push(byPackage.get(row[4])[0]);
      }
      const apps = candidates.filter(app => !filters.app || (app.isBbva ? 'BBVA Empresas' : app.appName) === filters.app);
      if (!apps.length && (filters.app || candidates.length || !['Android', 'iOS'].includes(row[3]) || !row[4])) return [];
      return [{ row, rowNumber, key, date, countries: [country], android, storefronts, attributionMethod, sharedListing, apps,
        ...(filters.sort === 'HELPFUL' ? { helpful: marketsReviewMetadata_(row).helpful } : {}) }];
    });
  if (filters.helpfulLimit) {
    const counts = new Map(), limit = Math.min(3, Math.max(1, filters.helpfulLimit));
    candidates = candidates.filter(row => row.helpful > 0).sort(compareMarketsHelpfulReviews_).filter(row => {
      const key = JSON.stringify([row.countries[0], row.row[3]]), count = counts.get(key) || 0;
      counts.set(key, count + 1); return count < limit;
    });
  }
  if (filters.interactive && !paging && !filters.npsOnly && candidates.length > 250) {
    throw new Error('La selección de reseñas requiere una vista publicada. Reintenta cuando termine la actualización.');
  }
  if (indexOnly && !paging && !filters.npsOnly && candidates.length) {
    if (!hydrateMarketsReviewPage_(sheet, width, candidates)) {
      return queryMarketsReviews_(ss, { ...filters, fullRead: true }, window, includeTranslations, apps,
        paging && { ...paging, fullRead: true });
    }
  }
  const compare = filters.sort === 'HELPFUL' ? compareMarketsHelpfulReviews_ : compareMarketsReviewRows_;
  const libraryIds = new Map();
  if (classification?.library && !filters.npsOnly) {
    const missing = candidates.filter(candidate => {
      const saved = derivedRows[candidate.rowNumber - 2];
      return !saved || saved[0] !== candidate.row[0] || saved[2] !== classification.version ||
        saved[1] !== marketsReviewTextDigest_(candidate.row);
    });
    if (missing.length > (filters.interactive ? 250 : MARKETS_REVIEW_INDEX_BATCH)) {
      throw new Error('La clasificación de reseñas se está actualizando. Vuelve a consultar en unos minutos.');
    }
    if (missing.length) {
      const ids = classifyMarketsFunctionalBatch_(missing.map(({ row }) => row), classification.library.pins);
      missing.forEach((candidate, index) => libraryIds.set(candidate.row[0], ids[index]));
    }
  }
  function matchingEvidence(candidate) {
    const { row } = candidate;
    const original = marketsReviewOriginalText_(row);
    if (search && !normalizeReviewEvidence_(original).includes(search)) return false;
    const saved = derivedRows[candidate.rowNumber - 2];
    const indexed = saved && saved[0] === row[0] && saved[2] === classification.version &&
      saved[1] === marketsReviewTextDigest_(row) && Boolean(saved[7]);
    if (filters.includeAudience) candidate.relevance = indexed ? saved[7] : classifyMarketsReviewAudience_(original).relevance;
    if (!indexed && (rules || filters.audience)) {
      classified++;
      if (filters.interactive && classified > 250) {
        throw new Error('La clasificación de reseñas se está actualizando. Vuelve a consultar en unos minutos.');
      }
    }
    const classifyStarted = filters.timing && !indexed ? Date.now() : 0;
    const indexedEvidence = filters.audience && indexed && safeJsonParse_(saved[8]);
    const decision = filters.audience && (indexedEvidence ? { audience: saved[4], sharedOperation: saved[5] === true, reason: saved[6],
      relevance: saved[7], evidence: indexedEvidence }
      : classifyMarketsReviewAudience_(original));
    if (decision && !matchesMarketsReviewAudience_(filters.audience, decision)) {
      if (classifyStarted) classificationMs += Date.now() - classifyStarted;
      return false;
    }
    if (filters.npsOnly) {
      if (classifyStarted) classificationMs += Date.now() - classifyStarted;
      return true;
    }
    const ids = indexed ? JSON.parse(saved[3]) : libraryIds.get(row[0]) || (rules ? classifyReviewEvidence_(original, rules) : []);
    if (classifyStarted) classificationMs += Date.now() - classifyStarted;
    if (window && filters.topic === 'general' && marketsReviewBlocks_(ids, knownBlocks).length) return false;
    if (topic && ((!window && !(row[7] >= 1 && row[7] <= 3)) ||
        !ids.some(id => id === topic || id.slice(0, 2) === topic))) return false;
    candidate.ids = ids;
    return true;
  }
  const matching = filterText ? candidates.filter(matchingEvidence) : candidates;
  let page;
  if (paging) {
    matching.sort(compare);
    page = paginateMarketsReviews_(matching, paging, window);
    if (indexOnly && page.rows.length) {
      const startedTextRead = Date.now();
      if (!hydrateMarketsReviewPage_(sheet, width, page.rows)) {
        return queryMarketsReviews_(ss, filters, window, includeTranslations, apps, { ...paging, fullRead: true });
      }
      readMs += Date.now() - startedTextRead;
    }
  }
  const results = filters.npsOnly
    ? matching.map(({ row, date, apps, attributionMethod }) => ({
      date, rating: row[7], entities: marketsReviewEntities_(apps, row[4]), attributionMethod
    }))
    : (page?.rows || matching).map(candidate => {
      if (!filterText) matchingEvidence(candidate);
      const { row, key, date, countries, android, storefronts, attributionMethod, sharedListing, apps, ids } = candidate;
      const [country] = countries;
      const url = android ? 'https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=' + encodeURIComponent(row[4]) +
        '&reviewId=' + encodeURIComponent(row[5]) : row[3] === 'iOS' && storefronts.length === 1 && /^\d+$/.test(row[4])
          ? 'https://apps.apple.com/' + storefronts[0].toLowerCase() + '/app/' + row[4] + '?see-all=reviews&platform=iphone' : '';
      const { author, helpful, reply, replyDate, replyAuthor, replyTranslations } = marketsReviewMetadata_(row);
      return { key, listings: apps.map(app => ({ country: app.countryCode, app: app.appName, entity: app.isBbva ? 'BBVA Empresas' : app.appName })),
        entities: marketsReviewEntities_(apps, row[4]),
        ...(filters.includeAudience ? { relevance: candidate.relevance } : {}),
        blocks: marketsReviewBlocks_(ids, knownBlocks), app: apps[0]?.appName || String(row[4]), countries: [country], storefronts,
        attributionMethod, confidence: country === 'UNKNOWN' ? 'unknown' : 'inferred',
        platform: row[3], ...(android ? { volumeKey: 'ANDROID|' + String(row[4]).toLowerCase() } : {}), date, rating: row[7], version: String(row[8]),
        title: row[9], original: row[10], text: row[languageColumn] || row[10], url,
        author, helpful, reply: replyTranslations?.[filters.language || 'es'] || reply, replyDate, replyAuthor,
        ...(includeTranslations && replyTranslations ? { replyTranslations } : {}),
        sharedListing,
        ...(filters.includeTopics ? { topicIds: ids } : {}),
        updatedAt: row[6] instanceof Date ? row[6].toISOString() : String(row[6]),
        ...(includeTranslations ? { translations: { es: row[11], en: row[12], tr: row[13] } } : {}),
        capturedAt: row[14] ? String(row[14]).slice(0, 10) : '',
        translated: Boolean(row[languageColumn] && row[languageColumn] !== row[10]) };
    })
    .sort(compare);
  const stats = { readMs, classificationMs, queryMs: Date.now() - started,
    read: stored.length, indexOnly, classified, returned: results.length };
  if (filters.timing) Object.assign(filters.timing, stats);
  console.log(JSON.stringify({ operation: 'review-query', ...stats }));
  return page ? { ...page, rows: results } : results;
}

function marketsReviewEntities_(apps, storeId) {
  return apps.length ? [...new Set(apps.map(app => app.isBbva ? 'BBVA Empresas' : app.appName))] : [String(storeId)];
}

function compareMarketsReviewRows_(a, b) {
  return b.date.localeCompare(a.date) || a.key.localeCompare(b.key);
}

function compareMarketsHelpfulReviews_(a, b) {
  const votes = item => {
    const helpful = item.helpful;
    return Number.isInteger(helpful) && helpful > 0 ? helpful : 0;
  };
  return votes(b) - votes(a) || compareMarketsReviewRows_(a, b);
}

/** Recupera como máximo cuatro intervalos, separados por los huecos más grandes. */
function hydrateMarketsReviewPage_(sheet, width, rows) {
  const ordered = rows.slice().sort((a, b) => a.rowNumber - b.rowNumber);
  const splits = new Set(ordered.slice(1).map((row, index) => ({ index: index + 1, gap: row.rowNumber - ordered[index].rowNumber }))
    .filter(item => item.gap > 16).sort((a, b) => b.gap - a.gap).slice(0, 3).map(item => item.index));
  let first = 0;
  for (let end = 1; end <= ordered.length; end++) {
    if (end < ordered.length && !splits.has(end)) continue;
    const startRow = ordered[first].rowNumber;
    const values = sheet.getRange(startRow, 1, ordered[end - 1].rowNumber - startRow + 1, width).getValues();
    for (const candidate of ordered.slice(first, end)) {
      const current = values[candidate.rowNumber - startRow];
      // A capture can update a row while the page is being read.
      if (!current || candidate.row.some((value, index) => String(value) !== String(current[index]))) return false;
      candidate.row = current;
    }
    first = end;
  }
  return true;
}

/** Preferencias privadas y autoservicio de alertas. */

    lastDeliveryAt: '', status: 'NOT_CONFIGURED', persisted: false
  };

function normalizeMarketsAlertPreferences_(source, email) {
  const input = source || {};
  const defaults = defaultMarketsAlertPreferences_(email || input.email);
  const countries = normalizeMarketsAlertScope_(input.countries, MARKETS_CONFIG.countryCodes);
  const platforms = normalizeMarketsAlertScope_(input.platforms, ['Android', 'iOS', 'Huawei']);
  const reviewWarning = marketsAlertNumber_(input.reviewWarningPct, defaults.reviewWarningPct, 0, 100);
  const reviewCritical = marketsAlertNumber_(input.reviewCriticalPct, defaults.reviewCriticalPct, 0, 100);
  const dailyWarning = marketsAlertNumber_(input.dailyWarningDrop, defaults.dailyWarningDrop, 0.01, 5);
  const dailyCritical = marketsAlertNumber_(input.dailyCriticalDrop, defaults.dailyCriticalDrop, 0.01, 5);
  const mtdWarning = marketsAlertNumber_(input.mtdWarningDrop, defaults.mtdWarningDrop, 0.01, 5);
  const mtdCritical = marketsAlertNumber_(input.mtdCriticalDrop, defaults.mtdCriticalDrop, 0.01, 5);
  const ytdWarning = marketsAlertNumber_(input.ytdWarningDrop, defaults.ytdWarningDrop, 0.01, 5);
  const ytdCritical = marketsAlertNumber_(input.ytdCriticalDrop, defaults.ytdCriticalDrop, 0.01, 5);
  if (reviewCritical <= reviewWarning) throw new Error('El umbral critico de resenas debe ser mayor que el de advertencia.');
  validateMarketsAlertThresholds_('diaria', dailyWarning, dailyCritical);
  validateMarketsAlertThresholds_('mensual', mtdWarning, mtdCritical);
  validateMarketsAlertThresholds_('anual', ytdWarning, ytdCritical);
  const direction = trimString_(input.crossoverDirection || defaults.crossoverDirection).toUpperCase();
  if (['BOTH', 'LOST', 'GAINED'].indexOf(direction) < 0) throw new Error('Direccion de cruce competitivo no valida.');
  const storedDeliveryMode = trimString_(input.deliveryMode || defaults.deliveryMode).toUpperCase();
  const storedConfigVersion = trimString_(input.configVersion);
  const newsletterEnabled = input.newsletterEnabled === undefined ?
    (storedConfigVersion && Number(storedConfigVersion) < 4 ?
      parseBoolean_(input.active, false) : storedDeliveryMode !== 'ALERTS_ONLY') :
    parseBoolean_(input.newsletterEnabled, defaults.newsletterEnabled);
  const normalized = {
    email: defaults.email,
    active: parseBoolean_(input.active, defaults.active),
    countries: countries,
    platforms: platforms,
    reviewShareEnabled: parseBoolean_(input.reviewShareEnabled, defaults.reviewShareEnabled),
    reviewWarningPct: reviewWarning,
    reviewCriticalPct: reviewCritical,
    dailyDropEnabled: parseBoolean_(input.dailyDropEnabled, defaults.dailyDropEnabled),
    dailyWarningDrop: dailyWarning,
    dailyCriticalDrop: dailyCritical,
    mtdDropEnabled: parseBoolean_(input.mtdDropEnabled, defaults.mtdDropEnabled),
    mtdWarningDrop: mtdWarning,
    mtdCriticalDrop: mtdCritical,
    ytdDropEnabled: parseBoolean_(input.ytdDropEnabled, defaults.ytdDropEnabled),
    ytdWarningDrop: ytdWarning,
    ytdCriticalDrop: ytdCritical,
    repeatWhileBreached: parseBoolean_(input.repeatWhileBreached, defaults.repeatWhileBreached),
    crossoverEnabled: parseBoolean_(input.crossoverEnabled, defaults.crossoverEnabled),
    crossoverDirection: direction,
    newsletterEnabled: newsletterEnabled,
    deliveryMode: newsletterEnabled ? 'DAILY_DIGEST' : 'ALERTS_ONLY',
    configVersion: MARKETS_ALERT_DEFAULTS.configVersion,
    updatedAt: input.updatedAt || '',
    updatedBy: trimString_(input.updatedBy),
    registeredAt: input.registeredAt || '',
    lastSeenAt: input.lastSeenAt || '',
    lastTestAt: input.lastTestAt || '',
    lastDeliveryAt: input.lastDeliveryAt || '',
    persisted: Boolean(input.persisted)
  };
  normalized.status = normalized.active && normalized.newsletterEnabled ? 'ACTIVE' :
    normalized.active ? 'ALERTS_ONLY' :
      normalized.newsletterEnabled ? 'NEWSLETTER_ONLY' : 'PAUSED';
  return normalized;
}

function validateMarketsAlertThresholds_(label, warning, critical) {
  if (critical <= warning) throw new Error('El umbral critico de caida ' + label + ' debe ser mayor que el de advertencia.');
}

function normalizeMarketsAlertScope_(value, allowed) {
  const items = Array.isArray(value) ? value : trimString_(value).split(/[;,]/);
  const normalized = uniqueStrings_(items.map(function (item) { return trimString_(item); }));
  if (!normalized.length || normalized.indexOf('ALL') >= 0) return ['ALL'];
  const invalid = normalized.filter(function (item) { return allowed.indexOf(item) < 0; });
  if (invalid.length) throw new Error('Ambito de alerta no valido: ' + invalid.join(', '));
  return normalized;
}

function marketsAlertNumber_(value, fallback, minimum, maximum) {
  const parsed = toFiniteNumber_(value);
  const normalized = parsed === null ? fallback : Math.round(parsed * 100) / 100;
  if (normalized < minimum || normalized > maximum) {
    throw new Error('Umbral fuera de rango: ' + normalized);
  }
  return normalized;
}

function normalizeMarketsAlertEmail_(email) {
  const normalized = trimString_(email).toLowerCase();
  if (!/^[^\s@]+@(?:bbva\.com|garantibbva\.com\.tr)$/.test(normalized)) throw new Error('Las alertas requieren una cuenta corporativa @bbva.com o @garantibbva.com.tr.');
  return normalized;
}

function currentMarketsUserEmail_() {
  const email = Session.getActiveUser().getEmail();
  if (!trimString_(email)) {
    throw new Error('No se ha podido identificar al usuario conectado. Revisa el modo de despliegue de la aplicacion web.');
  }
  return normalizeMarketsAlertEmail_(email);
}

function readMarketsAlertPreferences_(ss, email) {
  const normalizedEmail = normalizeMarketsAlertEmail_(email);
  const sheet = ss.getSheetByName(MARKETS_CONFIG.sheets.alertPreferences);
  if (!sheet || sheet.getLastRow() <= 1) return defaultMarketsAlertPreferences_(normalizedEmail);
  const headers = MARKETS_CONFIG.headers.alertPreferences;
  const indexes = indexHeaders_(headers);
  const rows = sheet.getRange(2, 1, sheet.getLastRow() - 1, headers.length).getValues();
  const row = rows.find(function (item) { return normalizeEmailForComparison_(item[indexes.user_email]) === normalizedEmail; });
  return row ? alertPreferencesFromRow_(row, indexes) : defaultMarketsAlertPreferences_(normalizedEmail);
}

function readAllMarketsAlertPreferences_(ss) {
  const sheet = ss.getSheetByName(MARKETS_CONFIG.sheets.alertPreferences);
  if (!sheet || sheet.getLastRow() <= 1) return [];
  const headers = MARKETS_CONFIG.headers.alertPreferences;
  const indexes = indexHeaders_(headers);
  return sheet.getRange(2, 1, sheet.getLastRow() - 1, headers.length).getValues()
    .filter(function (row) { return trimString_(row[indexes.user_email]); })
    .map(function (row) { return alertPreferencesFromRow_(row, indexes); });
}

function alertPreferencesFromRow_(row, indexes) {
  return normalizeMarketsAlertPreferences_({
    email: row[indexes.user_email], active: row[indexes.active],
    countries: row[indexes.countries], platforms: row[indexes.platforms],
    reviewShareEnabled: row[indexes.review_share_enabled],
    reviewWarningPct: row[indexes.review_warning_pct], reviewCriticalPct: row[indexes.review_critical_pct],
    dailyDropEnabled: row[indexes.daily_drop_enabled],
    dailyWarningDrop: row[indexes.daily_warning_drop], dailyCriticalDrop: row[indexes.daily_critical_drop],
    mtdDropEnabled: row[indexes.mtd_drop_enabled],
    mtdWarningDrop: row[indexes.mtd_warning_drop], mtdCriticalDrop: row[indexes.mtd_critical_drop],
    ytdDropEnabled: row[indexes.ytd_drop_enabled],
    ytdWarningDrop: row[indexes.ytd_warning_drop], ytdCriticalDrop: row[indexes.ytd_critical_drop],
    repeatWhileBreached: row[indexes.repeat_while_breached],
    crossoverEnabled: row[indexes.crossover_enabled], crossoverDirection: row[indexes.crossover_direction],
    deliveryMode: row[indexes.delivery_mode], updatedAt: row[indexes.updated_at],
    updatedBy: row[indexes.updated_by], registeredAt: row[indexes.registered_at],
    lastSeenAt: row[indexes.last_seen_at], lastTestAt: row[indexes.last_test_at],
    lastDeliveryAt: row[indexes.last_delivery_at], configVersion: row[indexes.config_version],
    persisted: true
  }, row[indexes.user_email]);
}

function marketsAlertPreferencesRow_(preferences, updatedBy) {
  const now = preferences.updatedAt instanceof Date ? preferences.updatedAt : new Date();
  return [
    preferences.email, preferences.active, preferences.countries.join(','), preferences.platforms.join(','),
    preferences.reviewShareEnabled, preferences.reviewWarningPct, preferences.reviewCriticalPct,
    false, 0.30, 0.50,
    preferences.crossoverEnabled, preferences.crossoverDirection, preferences.deliveryMode,
    now, updatedBy || preferences.email, preferences.configVersion, preferences.status,
    preferences.dailyDropEnabled, preferences.dailyWarningDrop, preferences.dailyCriticalDrop,
    preferences.mtdDropEnabled, preferences.mtdWarningDrop, preferences.mtdCriticalDrop,
    preferences.ytdDropEnabled, preferences.ytdWarningDrop, preferences.ytdCriticalDrop,
    preferences.repeatWhileBreached, preferences.registeredAt || now, preferences.lastSeenAt || '',
    preferences.lastTestAt || '', preferences.lastDeliveryAt || ''
  ];
}

function upsertMarketsAlertPreferences_(ss, preferences, updatedBy) {
  const sheet = ss.getSheetByName(MARKETS_CONFIG.sheets.alertPreferences);
  const previous = readMarketsAlertPreferences_(ss, preferences.email);
  const normalized = normalizeMarketsAlertPreferences_(preferences, preferences.email);
  normalized.updatedAt = new Date();
  normalized.updatedBy = updatedBy || normalized.email;
  normalized.registeredAt = preferences.registeredAt || previous.registeredAt || normalized.updatedAt;
  normalized.lastSeenAt = preferences.lastSeenAt || previous.lastSeenAt || '';
  normalized.lastTestAt = preferences.lastTestAt || previous.lastTestAt || '';
  normalized.lastDeliveryAt = preferences.lastDeliveryAt || previous.lastDeliveryAt || '';
  normalized.persisted = true;
  const existing = sheet.getLastRow() > 1 ? sheet.getRange(2, 1, sheet.getLastRow() - 1, 1).getValues() : [];
  const index = existing.findIndex(function (row) { return normalizeEmailForComparison_(row[0]) === normalized.email; });
  const row = marketsAlertPreferencesRow_(normalized, normalized.updatedBy);
  ensureSheetCapacity_(sheet, Math.max(2, sheet.getLastRow() + (index < 0 ? 1 : 0)), row.length);
  sheet.getRange(index < 0 ? sheet.getLastRow() + 1 : index + 2, 1, 1, row.length).setValues([row]);
  refreshFilter_(sheet, row.length);
  return normalized;
}

function registerOrTouchMarketsAlertUser_(ss, email) {
  const lock = LockService.getScriptLock();
  if (!lock.tryLock(MARKETS_CONFIG.lockTimeoutMs)) {
    throw new Error('El registro de alertas esta siendo actualizado. Intentalo de nuevo.');
  }
  try {
    const preferences = readMarketsAlertPreferences_(ss, email);
    const now = new Date();
    if (!preferences.persisted) {
      preferences.registeredAt = now;
      preferences.lastSeenAt = now;
      return upsertMarketsAlertPreferences_(ss, preferences, 'SELF_SERVICE_REGISTRATION');
    }
    touchMarketsAlertTimestamp_(ss, email, 'LAST_SEEN_AT', now);
    preferences.lastSeenAt = now;
    return preferences;
  } finally {
    lock.releaseLock();
  }
}

function touchMarketsAlertTimestamp_(ss, email, header, value) {
  const sheet = ss.getSheetByName(MARKETS_CONFIG.sheets.alertPreferences);
  if (!sheet || sheet.getLastRow() <= 1) return;
  const emailColumn = sheet.getRange(2, 1, sheet.getLastRow() - 1, 1).getValues();
  const index = emailColumn.findIndex(function (row) {
    return normalizeEmailForComparison_(row[0]) === normalizeEmailForComparison_(email);
  });
  const column = indexHeaders_(MARKETS_CONFIG.headers.alertPreferences)[normalizeHeader_(header)];
  if (index >= 0 && column !== undefined) sheet.getRange(index + 2, column + 1).setValue(value || new Date());
}

function normalizeEmailForComparison_(email) {
  return trimString_(email).toLowerCase();
}

function getMarketsAlertPreferences() {
  const email = currentMarketsUserEmail_();
  const ss = openMarketsSpreadsheet_();
  requireCurrentSheetContract_(ss, MARKETS_CONFIG.sheets.control, MARKETS_CONFIG.headers.control);
  requireCurrentSheetContract_(ss, MARKETS_CONFIG.sheets.alertPreferences, MARKETS_CONFIG.headers.alertPreferences);
  requireCurrentSheetContract_(ss, MARKETS_CONFIG.sheets.alerts, MARKETS_CONFIG.headers.alerts);
  const control = readControl_(ss);
  const preferences = registerOrTouchMarketsAlertUser_(ss, email);
  return {
    user: { email: email }, preferences: alertPreferencesForClient_(preferences),
    defaults: alertPreferencesForClient_(defaultMarketsAlertPreferences_(email)),
    system: {
      emailDeliveryEnabled: parseBoolean_(control.SEND_ALERT_EMAILS, false),
      reviewDataAvailable: Boolean(ss.getSheetByName('MARKET_REVIEWS')),
      configWarning: trimString_(control.ALERT_CONFIG_WARNING),
      schedule: 'Resumen diario tras la actualización de las 07:05',
      privacy: 'Puedes modificar esta configuración desde Alertas aunque el alta la haya realizado un administrador. Administración conserva la gestión y la auditoría.',
      deliveryScope: 'Todos los usuarios activos · sin sesión',
      adminVisibility: 'Los administradores auditan altas y actividad en ALERT_SUBSCRIPTIONS.'
    },
    recentEvents: readRecentMarketsAlertEventsForUser_(ss, email, 6)
  };
}

function saveMarketsAlertPreferences(payload) {
  const email = currentMarketsUserEmail_();
  const lock = LockService.getScriptLock();
  if (!lock.tryLock(MARKETS_CONFIG.lockTimeoutMs)) throw new Error('La configuracion de alertas esta siendo actualizada. Intentalo de nuevo.');
  try {
    const ss = openMarketsSpreadsheet_();
    requireCurrentSheetContract_(ss, MARKETS_CONFIG.sheets.alertPreferences, MARKETS_CONFIG.headers.alertPreferences);
    if (typeof payload?.expectedUpdatedAt === 'string' &&
        String(alertPreferencesForClient_(readMarketsAlertPreferences_(ss, email)).updatedAt || '') !== payload.expectedUpdatedAt) {
      throw new Error('Tus alertas cambiaron en otra sesión. Recarga la pantalla antes de guardar.');
    }
    return alertPreferencesForClient_(upsertMarketsAlertPreferences_(ss,
      normalizeMarketsAlertPreferences_(payload, email), email));
  } finally {
    lock.releaseLock();
  }
}

function resetMarketsAlertPreferences(expectedUpdatedAt) {
  return saveMarketsAlertPreferences({ ...defaultMarketsAlertPreferences_(currentMarketsUserEmail_()), expectedUpdatedAt });
}

function sendMarketsAlertTestEmail() {
  const email = currentMarketsUserEmail_();
  const ss = openMarketsSpreadsheet_();
  requireCurrentSheetContract_(ss, MARKETS_CONFIG.sheets.control, MARKETS_CONFIG.headers.control);
  requireCurrentSheetContract_(ss, MARKETS_CONFIG.sheets.alertPreferences, MARKETS_CONFIG.headers.alertPreferences);
  requireCurrentSheetContract_(ss, MARKETS_CONFIG.sheets.alerts, MARKETS_CONFIG.headers.alerts);
  const control = readControl_(ss);
  if (!parseBoolean_(control.SEND_ALERT_EMAILS, false)) {
    throw new Error('El envio global esta desactivado. Activa SEND_ALERT_EMAILS en CONTROL antes de probar.');
  }
  const sentAt = new Date();
  const deliveryId = 'COM-' + Utilities.formatDate(sentAt, MARKETS_CONFIG.timeZone, 'yyyyMMdd-HHmmss') + '-' +
    Utilities.getUuid().slice(0, 8).toUpperCase();
  return sendMarketsAlertPreview_(ss, email, readMarketsAlertPreferences_(ss, email), deliveryId);
}

function sendMarketsAlertPreview_(ss, email, preferences, deliveryId, reviewOnly = false, onAccepted) {
  const eventKey = 'TEST|' + deliveryId + '|' + email;
  if (deliveryId.startsWith('COM-NEWS-REQ-') && readExistingAlertKeys_(ss)[eventKey]) return { sent: true, accepted: true, alreadyAccepted: true, recipient: email, deliveryId };
  const sentAt = new Date();
  const ratings = readRatingObjects_(ss);
  const catalog = readAppCatalog_(ss);
  let sourceEvents;
  if (reviewOnly) {
    const day = Utilities.formatDate(sentAt, MARKETS_CONFIG.timeZone, 'yyyy-MM-dd');
    const rows = queryMarketsReviews_(ss, { country: 'ALL', platform: 'ALL', app: 'BBVA Empresas', deferBlocks: true },
      { start: shiftReviewDay_(day, -2), end: shiftReviewDay_(day, 1) });
    sourceEvents = buildMarketsReviewAlertEvents_(summarizeMarketsReviewAlerts_(rows, sentAt),
      { ...preferences, active: true, reviewShareEnabled: true }, {}, sentAt, day, true).map(event => ({ ...event,
        isTest: true, testId: deliveryId, eventKey: 'TEST_PREVIEW|' + deliveryId + '|' + event.eventKey,
        source: 'SELF_SERVICE_TEST_REAL_DATA' }));
  } else sourceEvents = buildMarketsRealAlertPreviewEvents_(ratings, catalog, preferences, deliveryId);
  const events = validateMarketsRealAlertPreviewEvents_(sourceEvents, preferences);
  const delivered = sendAlertEmails_(events, ss);
  if (delivered !== 1) throw new Error('Google no ha aceptado la prueba para el destinatario esperado.');
  onAccepted?.({ sent: true, accepted: true, recipient: email, deliveryId, realData: true, auditLogged: false,
    messageId: events.deliveryResults?.[0]?.messageId || '' });
  let auditLogged = true;
  try {
    appendAlertEvents_(ss, [{
      timestamp: sentAt, eventKey,
      referenceDate: events[0].referenceDate || sentAt, platform: 'Configurada',
      countryCode: preferences.countries.join(','), type: 'TEST', severity: 'POSITIVE',
      detail: 'Vista previa con ' + events.length + ' señal(es) o cierre(s) reales según la configuración vigente.',
      recipients: email, userEmail: email, ruleId: deliveryId, metricValue: events.length,
      threshold: '', appKey: '', direction: 'TEST', runId: deliveryId,
      source: 'SELF_SERVICE_TEST_REAL_DATA'
    }]);
    touchMarketsAlertTimestamp_(ss, email, 'LAST_TEST_AT', sentAt);
  } catch (auditError) {
    auditLogged = false;
    console.error('Correo aceptado, pero no se pudo completar la auditoria ' + deliveryId + ': ' + errorToString_(auditError));
  }
  let effectiveSender = '';
  try { effectiveSender = normalizeEmailForComparison_(Session.getEffectiveUser().getEmail()); } catch (ignored) {}
  const delivery = events.deliveryResults && events.deliveryResults[0] || {};
  return {
    sent: true, accepted: true, recipient: email, sentAt: sentAt.toISOString(), deliveryId: deliveryId,
    effectiveSender: effectiveSender, senderName: delivery.senderName || MARKETS_ALERT_EMAIL.senderName,
    senderAddress: delivery.senderAddress || MARKETS_ALERT_EMAIL.senderAddress,
    senderMode: MARKETS_ALERT_EMAIL.senderMode,
    senderVerificationStatus: delivery.verificationStatus || '',
    messageId: delivery.messageId || '', threadId: delivery.threadId || '', auditLogged: auditLogged,
    realData: true, previewItems: events.length,
    scopeCountries: preferences.countries.slice(), scopePlatforms: preferences.platforms.slice(),
    previewCountries: uniqueStrings_(events.map(function (event) { return event.countryCode; })),
    codeVersion: MARKETS_CONFIG.codeVersion, webVersion: MARKETS_WEB.version
  };
}

function alertPreferencesForClient_(preferences) {
  const output = Object.assign({}, preferences);
  ['updatedAt', 'registeredAt', 'lastSeenAt', 'lastTestAt', 'lastDeliveryAt'].forEach(function (field) {
    if (output[field] instanceof Date) output[field] = output[field].toISOString();
  });
  return output;
}

function readRecentMarketsAlertEventsForUser_(ss, email, limit) {
  const sheet = ss.getSheetByName(MARKETS_CONFIG.sheets.alerts);
  if (!sheet || sheet.getLastRow() <= 1) return [];
  const headers = MARKETS_CONFIG.headers.alerts;
  const indexes = indexHeaders_(headers);
  const count = Math.min(500, sheet.getLastRow() - 1);
  const rows = sheet.getRange(sheet.getLastRow() - count + 1, 1, count, headers.length).getValues();
  return rows.reverse().filter(function (row) {
    return normalizeEmailForComparison_(row[indexes.user_email] || row[indexes.recipients]) === email;
  }).slice(0, limit).map(function (row) {
    const timestamp = row[indexes.timestamp];
    return {
      timestamp: timestamp instanceof Date ? timestamp.toISOString() : trimString_(timestamp),
      type: trimString_(row[indexes.type]), severity: trimString_(row[indexes.severity]),
      platform: trimString_(row[indexes.platform]), countryCode: trimString_(row[indexes.country_code]),
      detail: trimString_(row[indexes.detail]), direction: trimString_(row[indexes.direction])
    };
  });
}

ARCHIVO: 55_ReviewIndex.gs
