      platform: app.platform, monthStartRating: monthStart ? monthStart.rating : null, endRating: end.rating,
      yearStartRating: yearStart ? yearStart.rating : null,
      monthDelta: monthStart ? round2_(end.rating - monthStart.rating) : null,
      yearDelta: yearStart ? round2_(end.rating - yearStart.rating) : null,
      newReviews: volumeAvailable ? newReviews : null,
      volumeAvailable: volumeAvailable, volumeKey: metadata.key,
      sharedMarkets: metadata.markets, startCount: monthStart ? monthStart.ratingCount : null,
      endCount: end.ratingCount, startDate: monthStart ? monthStart.observedDate : null,
      endDate: end.observedDate, position: position,
      effect: volumeAvailable && monthStart ? marketsNewsletterReviewEffect_(monthStart, end) : null
    };
  }).filter(Boolean);
  if (!items.length) throw new Error('No hay cierres BBVA reales para ' + period + ' en el ámbito configurado.');
  const criticalCatalog = marketsCriticalItems_(scopedCatalog);
  const observedKeys = items.reduce(function (out, item) { out[item.appKey] = true; return out; }, {});
  const missing = criticalCatalog.filter(function (app) { return !observedKeys[app.appKey]; })
    .map(function (app) {
      return { appKey: app.appKey, country: app.country, countryCode: app.countryCode, platform: app.platform };
    });
  const countries = uniqueStrings_(items.map(function (item) { return item.countryCode; }));
  const allCountries = preferences.countries.indexOf('ALL') >= 0;
  const scopeType = allCountries ? 'ALL' : preferences.countries.length === 1 ? 'SINGLE' : 'MULTI';
  const reviewEffects = marketsNewsletterReviewEffects_(items, scopeType);
  const totals = marketsNewsletterTotals_(items, scopeType);
  totals.effects = reviewEffects.length;
  const movements = items.filter(function (item) { return item.monthDelta !== null; })
    .sort(function (a, b) { return b.monthDelta - a.monthDelta; });
  return {
    period: period, periodLabel: marketsNewsletterPeriodLabel_(period),
    language: options?.language || "es",
    generatedAt: new Date(), isTest: Boolean(options && options.isTest),
    configuredFor: trimString_(options && options.configuredFor) || preferences.email,
    scope: {
      type: scopeType, countries: countries,
      countryLabel: countries.length === 1 ? items[0].country : '',
      platformLabel: preferences.platforms.indexOf('ALL') >= 0 ?
        'Todas las plataformas' : preferences.platforms.join(', ')
    },
    items: items, reviewEffects: reviewEffects, totals: totals,
    coverage: {
      observed: criticalCatalog.filter(function (app) { return observedKeys[app.appKey]; }).length,
      expected: criticalCatalog.length,
      complete: missing.length === 0, missing: missing
    },
    strongest: movements.length ? movements[0] : null,
    weakest: movements.length ? movements[movements.length - 1] : null
  };
}

function marketsNewsletterVolumeMetadata_(catalog) {
  const marketsByKey = {};
  (catalog || []).filter(function (app) { return app.platform === 'Android' && app.isBbva; })
    .forEach(function (app) {
      const key = 'ANDROID|' + (trimString_(app.packageName).toLowerCase() || app.appKey);
      (marketsByKey[key] || (marketsByKey[key] = {}))[app.countryCode] = true;
    });
  return (catalog || []).reduce(function (out, app) {
    const key = app.platform === 'Android' ?
      'ANDROID|' + (trimString_(app.packageName).toLowerCase() || app.appKey) :
      [app.platform.toUpperCase(), app.countryCode, app.appId || app.appKey].join('|');
    const markets = app.platform === 'Android' ? Object.keys(marketsByKey[key] || {}).length : 1;
    out[app.appKey] = { key: key, shared: app.platform === 'Android' && markets > 1, markets: Math.max(1, markets) };
    return out;
  }, {});
}

function marketsNewsletterPosition_(ratings, catalog, app, period) {
  const expected = (catalog || []).filter(function (candidate) {
    return candidate.enabled !== false && (candidate.marketSegment || 'BANK') === 'BANK' &&
      candidate.countryCode === app.countryCode && candidate.platform === app.platform;
  });
  const latestByApp = {};
  (ratings || []).filter(function (item) {
    return item.countryCode === app.countryCode && item.platform === app.platform &&
      (item.marketSegment || 'BANK') === 'BANK' &&
      dateKey_(item.observedDate).slice(0, 7) === period;
  }).forEach(function (item) {
    const current = latestByApp[item.appKey];
    if (!current || item.observedDate.getTime() > current.observedDate.getTime()) latestByApp[item.appKey] = item;
  });
  const rows = expected.map(function (candidate) { return latestByApp[candidate.appKey] || null; })
    .filter(function (item) { return item && item.rating !== null; });
  const bbva = latestByApp[app.appKey];
  if (!bbva || rows.length !== expected.length) {
    return { available: false, observed: rows.length, expected: expected.length };
  }
  const rank = 1 + rows.filter(function (item) { return item.rating > bbva.rating; }).length;
  const leader = rows.slice().sort(function (a, b) { return b.rating - a.rating; })[0];
  return {
    available: true, rank: rank, total: rows.length,
    leader: leader ? leader.appName : '', gapToLeader: leader ? round2_(bbva.rating - leader.rating) : null
  };
}

function marketsNewsletterCountDelta_(start, end) {
  const first = toFiniteNumber_(start && start.ratingCount);
  const last = toFiniteNumber_(end && end.ratingCount);
  if (first === null || last === null || last < first) return null;
  return Math.round(last - first);
}

function marketsNewsletterReviewEffect_(start, end) {
  const startRating = toFiniteNumber_(start && start.rating);
  const endRating = toFiniteNumber_(end && end.rating);
  const startCount = toFiniteNumber_(start && start.ratingCount);
  const endCount = toFiniteNumber_(end && end.ratingCount);
  if ([startRating, endRating, startCount, endCount].some(function (value) { return value === null; })) return null;
  const newReviews = endCount - startCount;
  if (newReviews <= 0) return null;
  const rating = (endCount * endRating - startCount * startRating) / newReviews;
  const uncertainty = (endCount * marketsNewsletterRatingHalfStep_(endRating) +
    startCount * marketsNewsletterRatingHalfStep_(startRating)) / newReviews;
  if (rating < 1 || rating > 5 || uncertainty > 0.5) return null;
  return {
    newReviewRating: Math.round(rating * 100) / 100,
    gapToPreviousRating: round2_(rating - startRating),
    accumulatedRatingChange: round2_(endRating - startRating),
    uncertainty: Math.round(uncertainty * 100) / 100
  };
}

function marketsNewsletterRatingHalfStep_(rating) {
  return Math.abs(rating * 10 - Math.round(rating * 10)) < 0.000001 ? 0.05 : 0.005;
}

function marketsNewsletterTotals_(items, scopeType) {
  const comparable = (items || []).filter(function (item) {
    return toFiniteNumber_(item.monthDelta) !== null;
  });
  const sharedGroups = (items || []).filter(function (item) {
    return !item.volumeAvailable;
  }).reduce(function (out, item) {
    (out[item.volumeKey] || (out[item.volumeKey] = [])).push(item);
    return out;
  }, {});
  const uniqueVolumes = {};
  (items || []).forEach(function (item) {
    let reviews = item.newReviews;
    if (!item.volumeAvailable) {
      const group = sharedGroups[item.volumeKey] || [];
      const expectedMarkets = group.reduce(function (maximum, candidate) {
        return Math.max(maximum, Number(candidate.sharedMarkets) || 1);
      }, 1);
      if (scopeType === 'ALL' || group.length >= expectedMarkets) {
        reviews = marketsNewsletterRawCountDelta_(item.startCount, item.endCount);
      }
    }
    reviews = toFiniteNumber_(reviews);
    if (reviews === null) return;
    const current = uniqueVolumes[item.volumeKey];
    if (!current || reviews > current.value) {
      uniqueVolumes[item.volumeKey] = { value: reviews, platform: item.platform };
    }
  });
  const byPlatform = Object.keys(uniqueVolumes).reduce(function (out, key) {
    const item = uniqueVolumes[key];
    out[item.platform] = (out[item.platform] || 0) + item.value;
    return out;
  }, {});
  return {
    series: comparable.length,
    improving: comparable.filter(function (item) { return item.monthDelta > 0; }).length,
    declining: comparable.filter(function (item) { return item.monthDelta < 0; }).length,
    stable: comparable.filter(function (item) { return item.monthDelta === 0; }).length,
    reviewsByPlatform: byPlatform
  };
}

function marketsNewsletterReviewEffects_(items, scopeType) {
  const effects = (items || []).filter(function (item) {
    return item.volumeAvailable && Boolean(item.effect);
  }).map(function (item) {
    return {
      appKey: item.appKey, country: item.country, platform: item.platform,
      volumeKey: item.volumeKey, effect: item.effect, shared: false
    };
  });
  const shared = (items || []).filter(function (item) {
    return !item.volumeAvailable && item.platform === 'Android';
  }).reduce(function (out, item) {
    (out[item.volumeKey] || (out[item.volumeKey] = [])).push(item);
    return out;
  }, {});
  Object.keys(shared).forEach(function (volumeKey) {
    const group = shared[volumeKey];
    const expectedMarkets = group.reduce(function (maximum, item) {
      return Math.max(maximum, Number(item.sharedMarkets) || 1);
    }, 1);
    if (scopeType !== 'ALL' && group.length < expectedMarkets) return;
    const signatures = uniqueStrings_(group.map(function (item) {
      return [item.monthStartRating, item.startCount, item.endRating, item.endCount].join('|');
    }));
    if (signatures.length !== 1) return;
    const first = group[0];
    const effect = marketsNewsletterReviewEffect_(
      { rating: first.monthStartRating, ratingCount: first.startCount },
      { rating: first.endRating, ratingCount: first.endCount });
    if (!effect) return;
    effects.push({
      appKey: volumeKey, country: 'Ficha Android compartida',
      platform: 'Android', volumeKey: volumeKey, effect: effect, shared: true,
      markets: uniqueStrings_(group.map(function (item) { return item.country; })).sort()
    });
  });
  return effects.sort(function (a, b) {
    return compareMarketsPlatforms_(a, b) || trimString_(a.country).localeCompare(trimString_(b.country));
  });
}

function marketsNewsletterRawCountDelta_(startCount, endCount) {
  const first = toFiniteNumber_(startCount);
  const last = toFiniteNumber_(endCount);
  return first === null || last === null || last < first ? null : Math.round(last - first);
}

const MARKETS_NEWSLETTER_SUBJECT_PREFIX = '[bIA]🚀🚀🚀 [EDC Market Pulse] · ';

/** Una selección compartida por edición/generación, nunca por destinatario. */
function loadMarketsNewsletterFeatured_(ss, catalog, period, historical = false) {
  if (!ss.getSheetByName('MARKET_REVIEWS')) return [];
  const properties = PropertiesService.getScriptProperties(), captured = properties.getProperties();
  const catalogVersion = marketsReviewCatalogVersion_(catalog), versions = marketsReviewVersions_(captured, catalogVersion);
  const scope = { period: historical ? 'history' : period };
  const key = marketsReviewCacheKey_(ss, 'newsletter-featured', scope, {}, versions);
  return readMarketsWebCache_(key, () => {
    const snapshot = safeJsonParse_(captured[MARKETS_REVIEW_SNAPSHOT_POINTER] || 'null');
    if (snapshot?.schema === MARKETS_REVIEW_SNAPSHOT_SCHEMA && JSON.stringify(snapshot.versions) === JSON.stringify(versions)) {
      const rows = readMarketsReviewSnapshotShard_(snapshot, 'ALL')?.['featured:ALL:' + scope.period];
      if (rows && (!historical || rows.length)) return rows;
    }
    const [year, month] = period.split('-').map(Number);
    const window = historical ? null : { start: period + '-01', end: new Date(Date.UTC(year, month, 0)).toISOString().slice(0, 10) };
    const rows = queryMarketsReviews_(ss, { country: 'ALL', platform: 'ALL', app: 'BBVA Empresas',
      deferBlocks: true, sort: 'HELPFUL', helpfulLimit: 3 }, window, true, catalog);
    if (JSON.stringify(marketsReviewVersions_(properties.getProperties(), catalogVersion)) !== JSON.stringify(versions)) {
      throw new Error('Las reseñas cambiaron mientras se preparaba la edición. Reintenta la publicación.');
    }
    return rows;
  }, 6);
}

function selectMarketsNewsletterFeatured_(rows, preferences) {
  const groups = {}, seen = new Set();
  for (const row of rows.slice().sort(compareMarketsHelpfulReviews_)) {
    const country = row.countries?.length === 1 && row.countries[0];
    if (!country || seen.has(row.key) || !Number.isInteger(row.helpful) || row.helpful <= 0 ||
        !marketsAlertScopeMatches_(preferences, { countryCode: country, platform: row.platform })) continue;
    const group = groups[country] || (groups[country] = []);
    if (group.length < 3) { group.push(row); seen.add(row.key); }
  }
  return groups;
}

function renderMarketsNewsletterFeatured_(model, country) {
  const rows = model.featuredReviews?.[country] || [];
  if (!rows.length) return '';
  const language = model.language || 'es', esc = escapeMarketsAlertHtml_;
  const title = { es: 'Reseñas destacadas por nuestros clientes', en: 'Reviews highlighted by our customers', tr: 'Müşterilerimizin öne çıkardığı yorumlar' }[language];
  return '<div style="padding:16px;color:#070E46;background:#FFFFFF;"><h3 style="font-size:16px;line-height:22px;">' + esc(title) + '</h3>' +
    (model.featuredHistorical ? '<p>Ejemplos históricos de prueba · cada reseña indica su fecha de origen.</p>' : '') + rows.map(row => {
      const text = row.translations?.[language] || row.original, reply = row.replyTranslations?.[language] || row.reply;
      const link = /^https:\/\//.test(row.url || '') ? '<a href="' + esc(row.url) + '">' + esc(row.platform) + '</a>' : esc(row.platform);
      return '<div style="padding:14px 0;border-top:1px solid #CAD1D8;overflow-wrap:anywhere;">' +
        '<strong>' + esc(row.app) + '</strong> · ' + (row.platform === 'Android' ? '<img src="cid:reviewAndroid" width="20" height="20" alt="Android" style="vertical-align:middle;"> ' : '') + link +
        '<p>' + esc(row.rating) + '/5 · ' + esc(row.date) + ' · ' + esc(row.helpful) + ' votos útiles</p>' +
        (row.title ? '<strong>' + esc(row.title) + '</strong>' : '') + '<p style="white-space:pre-line;">' + esc(text) + '</p>' +
        (reply ? '<blockquote style="margin:12px 0;padding-left:12px;border-left:3px solid #CAD1D8;"><strong>' + esc(row.replyAuthor || row.platform) + '</strong><p style="white-space:pre-line;">' + esc(reply) + '</p></blockquote>' : '') + '</div>';
    }).join('') + '</div>';
}

function marketsNewsletterFeaturedPlain_(model) {
  return Object.entries(model.featuredReviews || {}).filter(([, rows]) => rows.length).map(([country, rows]) =>
    country + ' · Reseñas destacadas por nuestros clientes' + (model.featuredHistorical ? ' · Ejemplos históricos de prueba' : '') + '\n' +
    rows.map(row => [row.app, row.platform, row.date, row.rating + '/5', row.helpful + ' votos útiles',
      row.translations?.[model.language] || row.original, row.replyTranslations?.[model.language] || row.reply].filter(Boolean).join(' · ')).join('\n')).join('\n\n');
}

function marketsNewsletterSpanishSubject_(model) {
  return (model.isTest ? '[PRUEBA] ' : '') + MARKETS_NEWSLETTER_SUBJECT_PREFIX + 'Cierre ' +
    model.periodLabel + ' · ' + marketsNewsletterScopeTitle_(model);
}

function marketsNewsletterEmailMessage_(recipient, model, inlineImages, sender) {
  const localized = model.language && model.language !== "es" ? localizedMarketsNewsletter_(model) : null;
  const subject = localized?.subject || marketsNewsletterSpanishSubject_(model);
  const plain = localized?.plain || renderMarketsNewsletterPlainText_(model);
  const html = localized?.html || renderMarketsNewsletterHtml_(model);
  const image = inlineImages && inlineImages.bbvaLogo;
  if (!image || typeof image.getBytes !== 'function') throw new Error('No se ha podido incorporar el logotipo oficial.');
  const token = Utilities.getUuid().replace(/-/g, '');
  const related = 'market_pulse_news_related_' + token;
  const alternative = 'market_pulse_news_alt_' + token;
  const crlf = '\r\n';
  const mime = [
    'From: ' + marketsAlertEncodedHeader_(sender.name) + ' <' + sender.address + '>',
    'To: ' + normalizeMarketsAlertEmail_(recipient),
    'Subject: ' + marketsAlertEncodedHeader_(subject),
    'Date: ' + new Date().toUTCString(),
    'Message-ID: <' + token + '@voc-commercial.bbva.com>',
    'MIME-Version: 1.0',
    'Content-Type: multipart/related; boundary="' + related + '"', '',
    '--' + related, 'Content-Type: multipart/alternative; boundary="' + alternative + '"', '',
    '--' + alternative, 'Content-Type: text/plain; charset="UTF-8"',
    'Content-Transfer-Encoding: base64', '', marketsAlertMimeText_(plain),
    '--' + alternative, 'Content-Type: text/html; charset="UTF-8"',
    'Content-Transfer-Encoding: base64', '', marketsAlertMimeText_(html),
    '--' + alternative + '--', '',
    '--' + related, 'Content-Type: image/png; name="bbva-bei.png"',
    'Content-Transfer-Encoding: base64', 'Content-ID: <bbvaLogo>',
    'Content-Disposition: inline; filename="bbva-bei.png"', '',
    marketsAlertMimeBytes_(image.getBytes()), ...marketsEmailFooterMime_(inlineImages, related, ['biaLogo', 'feedbackPositive', 'feedbackNegative', 'reviewAndroid']), '--' + related + '--', ''
  ].join(crlf);
  return { raw: Utilities.base64EncodeWebSafe(mime, Utilities.Charset.UTF_8).replace(/=+$/g, ''),
    subject: subject, recipient: recipient };
}

function renderMarketsNewsletterPlainText_(model) {
  const brief = marketsNewsletterExecutiveBrief_(model);
  const lines = model.items.map(function (item) {
    const volume = item.newReviews === null ? 'actividad N/D' :
      marketsAlertIntegerLabel_(item.newReviews) + ' nuevas valoraciones';
    const story = item.effect ?
      marketsNewsletterRatingLabel_(item.monthStartRating) + ' → voz nueva ' +
      marketsNewsletterRatingLabel_(item.effect.newReviewRating) + '/5 (' + volume +
      ') → cierre ' + marketsNewsletterRatingLabel_(item.endRating) + ' (' +
      marketsNewsletterSigned_(item.monthDelta) + ')' :
      marketsNewsletterRatingLabel_(item.monthStartRating) + ' → cierre ' +
      marketsNewsletterRatingLabel_(item.endRating) + ' (' +
      marketsNewsletterSigned_(item.monthDelta) + ') · ' + volume;
    return [item.country, item.platform].join(' · ') + ': ' + story +
      ' · año ' + marketsNewsletterSigned_(item.yearDelta) +
      ' · ' + marketsNewsletterPositionLabel_(item.position);
  });
  const effects = (model.reviewEffects || []).filter(function (item) {
    return item.shared;
  }).map(function (item) {
    return item.country + ' · ' + item.platform + ': ' +
      marketsNewsletterRatingLabel_(item.effect.newReviewRating) +
      '/5 en las nuevas valoraciones · ' +
      marketsNewsletterSigned_(item.effect.gapToPreviousRating) +
      ' frente al rating acumulado anterior · el acumulado se mueve ' +
      marketsNewsletterSigned_(item.effect.accumulatedRatingChange) + ' puntos' +
      (item.shared ? ' sobre la ficha completa, sin atribución geográfica' : '');
  });
  return 'EDC MARKET PULSE\nBBVA Banca de Empresas e Instituciones\n\n' +
    (model.isTest ? 'VISTA PREVIA CON DATOS REALES — NO ES UN ENVÍO MENSUAL\n' : '') +
    'Cierre ejecutivo · ' + model.periodLabel + '\n' + marketsNewsletterScopeTitle_(model) + '\n\n' +
    brief.headline + '\n' + brief.summary +
    (model.coverage && !model.coverage.complete ? '\nCobertura de cierre: ' +
      model.coverage.observed + ' de ' + model.coverage.expected +
      ' series; se omiten las series sin dato real.' : '') +
    '\n\n' + lines.join('\n') +
    (effects.length ? '\n\nVOZ NUEVA DEL MES · POR FICHA Y PLATAFORMA\n' +
      effects.join('\n') : '') +
    '\n\n' + marketsNewsletterFeaturedPlain_(model) + '\n\n' + marketsNewsletterInteractionText_(model);
}

function renderMarketsNewsletterHtml_(model) {
  const groups = marketsNewsletterGroups_(model.items);
  const scopeTitle = marketsNewsletterScopeTitle_(model);
  const brief = marketsNewsletterExecutiveBrief_(model);
  const appUrl = escapeMarketsAlertHtml_(marketsWebAppLoginUrl_('', model.interactions?.open));
  const preview = model.isTest ?
    '<tr><td style="padding:12px 24px;background:#FFE761;color:#070E46;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;text-align:center;">VISTA PREVIA · DATOS REALES · NO ES UN ENVÍO MENSUAL</td></tr>' : '';
  const groupHtml = groups.map(function (group) {
    const rows = group.items.map(marketsNewsletterRowHtml_).join('');
    const geographyBrief = model.scope.type === 'SINGLE' ? '' :
      '<span style="display:block;margin-top:4px;color:#85C8FF;font-size:10px;line-height:14px;">' +
      escapeMarketsAlertHtml_(marketsNewsletterGeographyBrief_(group.items)) + '</span>';
    return '<tr><td style="padding:8px 26px 20px;"><table role="presentation" width="100%" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0" style="border:1px solid #CAD1D8;border-radius:10px;overflow:hidden;">' +
      '<tr><td colspan="2" style="padding:13px 16px;background:#070E46;color:#FFFFFF;">' +
      '<strong style="display:block;font-size:15px;">' + escapeMarketsAlertHtml_(group.country) +
      '</strong>' + geographyBrief + '</td></tr>' + rows + '<tr><td colspan="2">' +
      renderMarketsNewsletterFeatured_(model, group.items[0].countryCode) +
      '<p align="center"><a href="' + appUrl + '" style="display:inline-block;padding:13px 22px;border-radius:8px;background:#001391;color:#FFFFFF;text-decoration:none;font-weight:700;">Abrir Market Pulse</a></p></td></tr></table></td></tr>';
  }).join('');
  const platformVolumes = Object.keys(model.totals.reviewsByPlatform || {})
    .sort(compareMarketsPlatforms_).map(function (platform) {
    return '<span style="display:inline-block;margin:0 6px 6px 0;padding:7px 10px;border-radius:999px;background:#EAFBFA;color:#070E46;font-size:11px;"><strong>' +
      escapeMarketsAlertHtml_(platform) + '</strong> · ' +
      escapeMarketsAlertHtml_(marketsAlertIntegerLabel_(model.totals.reviewsByPlatform[platform])) +
      '</span>';
  }).join('');
  const coverage = model.coverage && !model.coverage.complete ?
    '<tr><td style="padding:0 26px 18px;"><div style="padding:12px 14px;border-radius:8px;background:#FFF4CC;color:#6B4F00;font-size:12px;line-height:18px;"><strong>Cobertura de cierre: ' +
    escapeMarketsAlertHtml_(model.coverage.observed + ' de ' + model.coverage.expected) +
    ' series.</strong> Las series sin dato real se han omitido; no se han estimado.</div></td></tr>' : '';
  const effectItems = (model.reviewEffects || []).filter(function (item) { return item.shared; });
  const effects = effectItems.length ? '<tr><td style="padding:4px 26px 22px;"><div style="padding:18px;border-radius:10px;background:#EAFBFA;">' +
    '<div style="color:#001391;font-size:11px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.7px;text-transform:uppercase;">FICHA ANDROID COMPARTIDA · SIN ATRIBUCIÓN GEOGRÁFICA</div>' +
    effectItems.slice(0, 5).map(function (item) {
      return '<div style="padding-top:11px;color:#46536D;font-size:13px;line-height:19px;"><strong style="color:#070E46;">' +
        escapeMarketsAlertHtml_(item.country + ' · ' + item.platform) + ':</strong> ' +
        marketsNewsletterRatingLabel_(item.effect.newReviewRating) + '/5 en las nuevas valoraciones · ' +
        escapeMarketsAlertHtml_(marketsNewsletterSigned_(item.effect.gapToPreviousRating)) +
        ' frente al rating acumulado anterior · el acumulado se mueve ' +
        escapeMarketsAlertHtml_(marketsNewsletterSigned_(item.effect.accumulatedRatingChange)) + ' puntos' +
        (item.shared ? ' sobre la ficha compartida completa, sin atribución geográfica.' : '.') + '</div>';
    }).join('') + '</div></td></tr>' : '';
  return protectMarketsEmailColors_(marketsLightEmailDocument_() +
    '<table role="presentation" width="100%" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0" bgcolor="#F7F8F8" style="background:#F7F8F8;"><tr><td align="center" style="padding:28px 10px;">' +
    '<table role="presentation" width="100%" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0" bgcolor="#FFFFFF" style="width:100%;max-width:720px;background:#FFFFFF;color:#000519;border-radius:16px;overflow:hidden;">' +
    preview +
    '<tr><td bgcolor="#001391" style="padding:26px 30px;background:#001391;color:#FFFFFF;"><img src="cid:bbvaLogo" width="168" alt="BBVA Banca de Empresas e Instituciones" style="display:block;width:168px;height:auto;">' +
    '<div style="margin-top:24px;color:#8BE1E9;font-size:11px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:1px;">EDC MARKET PULSE · CIERRE MENSUAL</div>' +
    '<h1 style="margin:8px 0 0;font-family:Georgia,serif;font-size:31px;line-height:37px;">' +
    escapeMarketsAlertHtml_(model.periodLabel) + '</h1><p style="margin:9px 0 0;color:#85C8FF;font-size:15px;line-height:22px;">' +
    escapeMarketsAlertHtml_(scopeTitle) + '</p></td></tr>' +
    '<tr><td style="padding:24px 30px 12px;"><div style="color:#001391;font-size:10px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.8px;text-transform:uppercase;">LECTURA EJECUTIVA</div>' +
    '<div style="margin-top:7px;font-family:Georgia,serif;color:#070E46;font-size:24px;line-height:31px;">' +
    escapeMarketsAlertHtml_(brief.headline) + '</div><div style="margin-top:10px;color:#46536D;font-size:14px;line-height:21px;">' +
    escapeMarketsAlertHtml_(brief.summary) + '</div></td></tr>' +
    '<tr><td style="padding:10px 26px 22px;"><table role="presentation" width="100%" cellspacing="8" cellpadding="0"><tr>' +
    marketsNewsletterKpiHtml_('Mejoran', model.totals.improving, 'de ' + model.totals.series + ' series') +
    marketsNewsletterKpiHtml_('Retroceden', model.totals.declining, model.totals.stable + ' estables') +
    marketsNewsletterKpiHtml_('Voz nueva', model.totals.effects,
      'fichas con lectura') +
    '</tr></table>' + (model.scope.type !== 'SINGLE' && platformVolumes ? '<div style="padding:4px 8px 0;color:#46536D;font-size:10px;text-transform:uppercase;">Valoraciones por plataforma</div><div style="padding:8px 8px 0;">' +
      platformVolumes + '</div>' : '') + '</td></tr>' + coverage + groupHtml + effects +
    '<tr><td style="padding:4px 30px 28px;">' +
    '<p align="center" style="margin:16px 0 0;color:#ADB8C2;font-size:10px;line-height:15px;">La lectura ejecutiva se genera exclusivamente a partir de las cifras mostradas. Ratings y volúmenes de Android, iOS y Huawei nunca se combinan. Solo se publican posiciones con cobertura competitiva completa; los volúmenes no atribuibles y los efectos no fiables se presentan como N/D o se omiten.</p></td></tr>' +
    '<tr><td style="padding:0 30px 28px;">' + renderMarketsEmailFooter_(model.interactions, model.language) + '</td></tr>' +
    '</table></td></tr></table></body></html>');
}

function marketsNewsletterGroups_(items) {
  const groups = {};
  (items || []).forEach(function (item) {
    const group = groups[item.countryCode] || (groups[item.countryCode] = { country: item.country, items: [] });
    group.items.push(item);
  });
  return Object.keys(groups).sort().map(function (key) {
    groups[key].items.sort(compareMarketsPlatforms_);
    return groups[key];
  });
}

function marketsNewsletterGeographyBrief_(items) {
  const comparable = (items || []).filter(function (item) {
    return toFiniteNumber_(item.monthDelta) !== null;
  });
  if (!comparable.length) return 'Sin cierre anterior comparable';
  if (comparable.length === 1) {
    return comparable[0].platform + ' · ' +
      marketsNewsletterSigned_(comparable[0].monthDelta) + ' en el mes';
  }
  const improving = comparable.filter(function (item) { return item.monthDelta > 0; }).length;
  const declining = comparable.filter(function (item) { return item.monthDelta < 0; }).length;
  const stable = comparable.length - improving - declining;
  const parts = [];
  if (improving) parts.push(improving + (improving === 1 ? ' mejora' : ' mejoran'));
  if (declining) parts.push(declining + (declining === 1 ? ' retrocede' : ' retroceden'));
  if (stable) parts.push(stable + (stable === 1 ? ' estable' : ' estables'));
  return marketsNewsletterJoinFacts_(parts) + ' · ' + comparable.length + ' plataformas';
}

function marketsNewsletterRowHtml_(item) {
  const movementColor = item.monthDelta > 0 ? '#277A3E' : item.monthDelta < 0 ? '#B92A45' : '#46536D';
  const volume = item.newReviews === null ? (item.volumeAvailable ? 'N/D' : 'No atribuible') :
    marketsAlertIntegerLabel_(item.newReviews);
  const voice = item.effect || null;
  const voiceColor = !voice ? '#001391' : voice.gapToPreviousRating > 0.005 ?
    '#277A3E' : voice.gapToPreviousRating < -0.005 ? '#B92A45' : '#46536D';
  const middleLabel = voice ? 'Voz nueva' : 'Actividad del mes';
  const middleValue = voice ? marketsNewsletterRatingLabel_(voice.newReviewRating) + '/5' : volume;
  const middleNote = voice ? volume + ' nuevas valoraciones' :
    item.volumeAvailable ? 'nuevas valoraciones' : 'ficha compartida';
  const annual = item.yearStartRating === null || item.yearDelta === null ? '' :
    'Desde inicio de año: ' + marketsNewsletterSigned_(item.yearDelta) +
    ' (partía de ' + marketsNewsletterRatingLabel_(item.yearStartRating) + ').';
  const voiceGap = voice ? ' La voz nueva queda ' +
    marketsNewsletterSigned_(voice.gapToPreviousRating) +
    ' frente al rating acumulado anterior.' : '';
  return '<tr><td style="width:27%;padding:16px;border-top:1px solid #E2E6EA;vertical-align:top;"><strong style="display:block;color:#070E46;font-size:15px;">' +
    escapeMarketsAlertHtml_(item.platform) + '</strong><span style="display:block;margin-top:10px;color:#46536D;font-size:9px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.4px;text-transform:uppercase;">Posición competitiva</span>' +
    '<span style="display:block;margin-top:3px;color:#070E46;font-size:12px;line-height:17px;">' +
    escapeMarketsAlertHtml_(marketsNewsletterPositionLabel_(item.position)) + '</span></td>' +
    '<td style="padding:16px;border-top:1px solid #E2E6EA;"><table role="presentation" width="100%" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0" style="border-radius:8px;background:#F7F8F8;"><tr>' +
    marketsNewsletterStoryCell_('Cierre anterior',
      marketsNewsletterRatingLabel_(item.monthStartRating), 'punto de partida', '#46536D') +
    marketsNewsletterStoryCell_(middleLabel, middleValue, middleNote, voiceColor) +
    marketsNewsletterStoryCell_('Cierre',
      marketsNewsletterRatingLabel_(item.endRating),
      marketsNewsletterSigned_(item.monthDelta) + ' en el mes', movementColor) +
    '</tr></table><div style="padding:8px 4px 0;color:#46536D;font-size:9px;line-height:14px;">' +
    escapeMarketsAlertHtml_(annual + voiceGap) + '</div></td></tr>';
}

function marketsNewsletterStoryCell_(label, value, note, color) {
  return '<td style="width:33.33%;padding:11px 10px;vertical-align:top;">' +
    '<span style="display:block;color:#46536D;font-size:8px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.25px;text-transform:uppercase;">' +
    escapeMarketsAlertHtml_(label) + '</span><strong style="display:block;margin-top:4px;color:' +
    color + ';font-size:16px;">' + escapeMarketsAlertHtml_(value) +
    '</strong><small style="display:block;margin-top:2px;color:#6B7280;font-size:8px;line-height:11px;">' +
    escapeMarketsAlertHtml_(note) + '</small></td>';
}

function marketsNewsletterKpiHtml_(label, value, note) {
  return '<td style="width:33.33%;padding:14px;border-radius:8px;background:#F7F8F8;text-align:center;"><span style="display:block;color:#46536D;font-size:10px;text-transform:uppercase;">' +
    escapeMarketsAlertHtml_(label) + '</span><strong style="display:block;margin-top:5px;color:#070E46;font-size:23px;">' +
    escapeMarketsAlertHtml_(value) + '</strong><small style="display:block;margin-top:3px;color:#46536D;font-size:10px;">' +
    escapeMarketsAlertHtml_(note) + '</small></td>';
}

function marketsNewsletterScopeTitle_(model) {
  if (model.scope.type === 'SINGLE') return model.scope.countryLabel + ' · ' + model.scope.platformLabel;
  if (model.scope.type === 'MULTI') return model.scope.countries.length + ' geografías seleccionadas · ' +
    model.scope.platformLabel;
  return 'Visión global · ' + model.scope.platformLabel;
}

function marketsNewsletterExecutiveNarrative_(model) {
  const brief = marketsNewsletterExecutiveBrief_(model);
  return [brief.headline, brief.summary].filter(Boolean).join(' ');
}

function marketsNewsletterExecutiveBrief_(model) {
  const totals = model.totals;
  const single = model.scope.type === 'SINGLE';
  const subject = single ? model.scope.countryLabel :
    model.scope.type === 'MULTI' ? 'El perímetro seleccionado' : 'La visión global de BBVA Empresas';
  if (!totals.series) {
    return {
      headline: subject + ' no dispone de un cierre anterior comparable.',
      summary: 'El cierre actual se muestra con datos reales, pero no se calculan variaciones ni la nota de las nuevas valoraciones sin dos cierres mensuales consecutivos.'
    };
  }
  let headline = '';
  if (totals.series === 1 && model.items.length === 1) {
    const only = model.items[0];
    headline = only.platform + (only.monthDelta > 0 ? ' cierra el mes al alza en ' :
      only.monthDelta < 0 ? ' cierra el mes a la baja en ' : ' cierra el mes sin cambios en ') +
      only.country + '.';
  } else if (totals.declining === totals.series && totals.series > 0) {
    headline = single ? subject + ' cierra el mes con presión en todas las plataformas.' :
      'El mes cierra con presión en todo el perímetro analizado.';
  } else if (totals.improving === totals.series && totals.series > 0) {
    headline = single ? subject + ' avanza en todas las plataformas analizadas.' :
      'El mes cierra con avances en todo el perímetro analizado.';
  } else if (totals.stable === totals.series && totals.series > 0) {
    headline = single ? subject + ' cierra sin movimientos en sus ratings.' :
      'El mes cierra estable, sin movimientos en los ratings analizados.';
  } else if (totals.stable >= totals.improving && totals.stable >= totals.declining) {
    headline = totals.improving > totals.declining ?
      'La estabilidad marca el tono del mes, con un ligero sesgo positivo.' :
      totals.declining > totals.improving ?
        'La estabilidad marca el tono del mes, aunque aparecen señales de presión.' :
        'La estabilidad marca el tono de un mes equilibrado.';
  } else if (totals.declining > totals.improving) {
    headline = single ? subject + ' cierra con un balance de cautela.' :
      'El balance mensual exige atención, aunque la presión no es generalizada.';
  } else if (totals.improving > totals.declining) {
    headline = single ? subject + ' cierra con un balance favorable.' :
      'El balance mensual es favorable, aunque no homogéneo.';
  } else {
    headline = single ? subject + ' presenta un cierre mixto.' :
      'El mes deja un balance equilibrado, con movimientos en ambas direcciones.';
  }

  const facts = [];
  if (totals.series === 1 && model.items.length === 1) {
    // El titular ya resume la dirección; el detalle numérico vive una sola vez
    // en la secuencia Cierre anterior → Voz nueva → Cierre.
  } else {
    const strongest = model.strongest && model.strongest.monthDelta > 0 ? model.strongest : null;
    const weakest = model.weakest && model.weakest.monthDelta < 0 ? model.weakest : null;
    if (weakest) facts.push('El principal foco de atención está en ' +
      marketsNewsletterItemLabel_(weakest, model) + ' (' +
      marketsNewsletterSigned_(weakest.monthDelta) + ').');
    else if (strongest) facts.push('El avance más destacado se registra en ' +
      marketsNewsletterItemLabel_(strongest, model) + ' (' +
      marketsNewsletterSigned_(strongest.monthDelta) + ').');
  }

  const voiceContext = marketsNewsletterVoiceContext_(model);
  if (voiceContext) facts.push(voiceContext);
  const yearContext = marketsNewsletterYearContext_(model);
  if (yearContext) facts.push(yearContext);
  const positionContext = marketsNewsletterPositionContext_(model);
  if (positionContext) facts.push(positionContext);
  const volumeContext = marketsNewsletterVolumeContext_(model);
  if (!single && volumeContext) facts.push(volumeContext);
  return { headline: headline, summary: facts.slice(0, single ? 3 : 2).join(' ') };
}

function marketsNewsletterItemLabel_(item, model) {
  return model.scope.type === 'SINGLE' ? item.platform : item.country + ' · ' + item.platform;
}

function marketsNewsletterCountLabel_(count) {
  return ({ 2: 'dos', 3: 'tres', 4: 'cuatro', 5: 'cinco', 6: 'seis',
    7: 'siete', 8: 'ocho', 9: 'nueve', 10: 'diez' })[count] || String(count);
}

function marketsNewsletterJoinFacts_(parts) {
  if (parts.length < 2) return parts[0] || '';
  if (parts.length === 2) return parts[0] + ' y ' + parts[1].toLowerCase();
  return parts.slice(0, -1).join(', ') + ' y ' + parts[parts.length - 1].toLowerCase();
}

function marketsNewsletterYearContext_(model) {
  const item = (model.items || []).find(function (candidate) {
    return candidate.monthDelta < 0 && candidate.yearDelta > 0;
  });
  if (item) {
    return 'Pese al ajuste mensual, ' + marketsNewsletterItemLabel_(item, model) +
      ' se mantiene ' + marketsNewsletterSigned_(item.yearDelta) + ' sobre el inicio de año.';
  }
  const rebound = (model.items || []).find(function (candidate) {
    return candidate.monthDelta > 0 && candidate.yearDelta < 0;
  });
  return rebound ? 'El avance mensual de ' + marketsNewsletterItemLabel_(rebound, model) +
    ' todavía deja el rating ' + marketsNewsletterSigned_(rebound.yearDelta) +
    ' frente al inicio de año.' : '';
}

function marketsNewsletterPositionContext_(model) {
  const comparable = (model.items || []).filter(function (item) {
    return item.position && item.position.available;
  });
  if (!comparable.length) return '';
  const leaders = comparable.filter(function (item) { return item.position.rank === 1; });
  if (leaders.length) {
    if (comparable.length === 1) {
      return 'BBVA mantiene el liderazgo frente a la banca comparable.';
    }
    return 'BBVA lidera en ' + leaders.length + ' de ' + comparable.length +
      ' ' + (model.scope.type === 'SINGLE' ? 'plataformas comparables.' : 'series comparables.');
  }
  const best = comparable.slice().sort(function (a, b) {
    return a.position.rank - b.position.rank || b.endRating - a.endRating;
  })[0];
  return 'En ' + marketsNewsletterItemLabel_(best, model) + ', BBVA ocupa la ' +
    best.position.rank + '.ª posición entre ' + best.position.total + ' bancos comparados.';
}

function marketsNewsletterVolumeContext_(model) {
  const byPlatform = model.totals && model.totals.reviewsByPlatform || {};
  const platforms = Object.keys(byPlatform).filter(function (platform) {
    return toFiniteNumber_(byPlatform[platform]) !== null && byPlatform[platform] > 0;
  }).sort(compareMarketsPlatforms_);
  if (!platforms.length) return '';
  const facts = platforms.map(function (platform) {
    return platform + ' registra ' + marketsAlertIntegerLabel_(byPlatform[platform]) +
      ' nuevas valoraciones';
  });
  const joined = facts.length < 2 ? facts[0] :
    facts.length === 2 ? facts[0] + ' y ' + facts[1] :
      facts.slice(0, -1).join(', ') + ' y ' + facts[facts.length - 1];
  return 'Volumen separado por plataforma: ' + joined + '.';
}

function marketsNewsletterVoiceContext_(model) {
  const effects = (model.reviewEffects || []).filter(function (item) {
    return item.effect && toFiniteNumber_(item.effect.newReviewRating) !== null;
  });
  if (!effects.length) return '';
  if (effects.length === 1) {
    const item = effects[0];
    const label = model.scope.type === 'SINGLE' && !item.shared ?
      item.platform : item.country + ' · ' + item.platform;
    const gap = item.effect.gapToPreviousRating;
    const change = item.effect.accumulatedRatingChange;
    const quality = gap > 0.005 ? 'se sitúan por encima del rating previo' :
      gap < -0.005 ? 'quedan por debajo del rating previo' :
        'se mantienen alineadas con el rating previo';
    const consequence = change > 0.005 ? 'refuerzan el cierre' :
      change < -0.005 ? 'presionan el cierre' :
        'no alteran de forma visible el acumulado';
    return (model.scope.type === 'SINGLE' ? 'Las nuevas valoraciones ' :
      'En ' + label + ', las nuevas valoraciones ') + quality + ' y ' + consequence + '.';
  }
  const positive = effects.filter(function (item) {
    return item.effect.gapToPreviousRating > 0.005;
  }).length;
  const negative = effects.filter(function (item) {
    return item.effect.gapToPreviousRating < -0.005;
  }).length;
  const stable = effects.length - positive - negative;
  const notable = effects.slice().sort(function (a, b) {
    return Math.abs(b.effect.accumulatedRatingChange) -
      Math.abs(a.effect.accumulatedRatingChange);
  })[0];
  const notableLabel = model.scope.type === 'SINGLE' && !notable.shared ?
    notable.platform : notable.shared ? notable.country :
      notable.country + ' · ' + notable.platform;
  const count = marketsNewsletterCountLabel_(effects.length);
  const measurableScope = model.scope.type === 'SINGLE' ?
    'las ' + count + ' plataformas donde puede medirse' :
    'los ' + count + ' casos donde es posible medir su efecto';
  let reading = '';
  if (positive === effects.length) {
    reading = 'Las nuevas valoraciones aportan una señal favorable en ' +
      measurableScope + '.';
  } else if (negative === effects.length) {
    reading = 'Las nuevas valoraciones añaden presión en ' +
      measurableScope + '.';
  } else if (positive > negative) {
    reading = 'La voz del cliente ofrece un balance favorable en ' +
      measurableScope + '.';
  } else if (negative > positive) {
    reading = 'La voz del cliente aconseja cautela en ' +
      measurableScope + '.';
  } else if (stable === effects.length) {
    reading = 'Las nuevas valoraciones se mantienen alineadas con los ratings previos.';
  } else {
    reading = 'La voz del cliente presenta señales mixtas en ' +
      measurableScope + '.';
  }
  const change = notable.effect.accumulatedRatingChange;
  return reading + (Math.abs(change) < 0.005 ?
    ' No se observa un efecto relevante en los ratings acumulados.' :
    ' El mayor efecto en el cierre corresponde a ' + notableLabel +
      ' (' + marketsNewsletterSigned_(change) + ').');
}

function marketsNewsletterPositionLabel_(position) {
  if (!position || !position.available) return 'No disponible';
  if (position.rank === 1) return 'Líder entre ' + position.total +
    (position.total === 1 ? ' banco' : ' bancos');
  return position.rank + '.ª posición entre ' + position.total +
    (position.total === 1 ? ' banco' : ' bancos');
}

function marketsNewsletterRatingLabel_(value) {
  const number = toFiniteNumber_(value);
  return number === null ? 'N/D' : number.toFixed(2).replace('.', ',');
}

function marketsNewsletterSigned_(value) {
  const number = toFiniteNumber_(value);
  if (number === null) return 'N/D';
  if (Math.abs(number) < 0.005) return '0,00';
  return (number > 0 ? '+' : '') + number.toFixed(2).replace('.', ',');
}

function marketsNewsletterPeriodLabel_(period) {
  const months = ['enero', 'febrero', 'marzo', 'abril', 'mayo', 'junio',
    'julio', 'agosto', 'septiembre', 'octubre', 'noviembre', 'diciembre'];
  const parts = period.split('-');
  return months[Number(parts[1]) - 1] + ' ' + parts[0];
}

function marketsNewsletterAuditEvent_(recipient, model, eventKey, source) {
  return {
    timestamp: new Date(), eventKey: eventKey,
    referenceDate: dateFromKey_(model.period + '-01'),
    platform: model.scope.platformLabel, countryCode: model.scope.countries.join(','),
    type: source === 'NEWSLETTER_TEST' ? 'NEWSLETTER_TEST' : 'NEWSLETTER_MONTHLY',
    severity: 'POSITIVE', detail: marketsNewsletterExecutiveNarrative_(model),
    recipients: recipient, runId: (source === 'NEWSLETTER_TEST' ? 'NEWS-TEST-' : 'NEWS-') + model.period,
    source: source, userEmail: recipient, ruleId: 'MONTHLY_NEWSLETTER:' + model.language,
    metricValue: model.totals.series, threshold: '', appKey: '', direction: 'SUMMARY'
  };
}

function marketsNewsletterLanguageKey_(email) {
  return 'MARKETS_NEWSLETTER_LANGUAGE:' + String(email).trim().toLowerCase();
}

function marketsNewsletterLanguageFor_(email) {
  const language = typeof PropertiesService === 'undefined' ? '' :
    PropertiesService.getScriptProperties().getProperty(marketsNewsletterLanguageKey_(email));
  const code = String(language || '').trim().toLowerCase().split('-')[0];
  return code === 'en' || code === 'tr' ? code : 'es';
}

function localizedMarketsNewsletter_(model) {
  const language = model.language;
  const copy = {
    en: { title: 'Monthly review', preview: 'PREVIEW · REAL DATA', country: 'Market', platform: 'Platform',
      rating: 'Closing rating', monthly: 'Monthly change', annual: 'Year to date', volume: 'New ratings',
      position: 'Position', coverage: 'Coverage', link: 'Open EDC Market Pulse' },
    tr: { title: 'Aylık değerlendirme', preview: 'ÖN İZLEME · GERÇEK VERİLER', country: 'Pazar', platform: 'Platform',
      rating: 'Kapanış puanı', monthly: 'Aylık değişim', annual: 'Yılbaşından bu yana', volume: 'Yeni puanlamalar',
      position: 'Sıralama', coverage: 'Kapsam', link: 'EDC Market Pulse’u aç' }
  }[language];
  if (!copy) return null;
  const months = language === 'tr'
    ? ['Ocak','Şubat','Mart','Nisan','Mayıs','Haziran','Temmuz','Ağustos','Eylül','Ekim','Kasım','Aralık']
    : ['January','February','March','April','May','June','July','August','September','October','November','December'];
  const [year, month] = model.period.split('-');
  const period = months[Number(month) - 1] + ' ' + year;
  const names = language === 'tr'
    ? { AR:'Arjantin', CO:'Kolombiya', ES:'İspanya', MX:'Meksika', PE:'Peru', TR:'Türkiye', UY:'Uruguay', VE:'Venezuela' }
    : { AR:'Argentina', CO:'Colombia', ES:'Spain', MX:'Mexico', PE:'Peru', TR:'Türkiye', UY:'Uruguay', VE:'Venezuela' };
  const number = (value, digits = 0) => {
    if (typeof value !== 'number' || !Number.isFinite(value)) return '—';
    const formatted = value.toFixed(digits);
    return language === 'tr' ? formatted.replace('.', ',') : formatted;
  };
  const headers = [copy.country, copy.platform, copy.rating, copy.monthly, copy.annual, copy.volume, copy.position];
  const rows = model.items.map(item => [
    names[item.countryCode] || item.country, item.platform, number(item.endRating, 2),
    number(item.monthDelta, 2), number(item.yearDelta, 2), number(item.newReviews),
    item.position?.rank ? item.position.rank + ' / ' + (item.position.apps || item.position.total || '—') : '—'
  ]);
  const subject = (model.isTest ? '[' + copy.preview + '] ' : '') + MARKETS_NEWSLETTER_SUBJECT_PREFIX + copy.title + ' · ' + period;
  const coverage = model.coverage ? copy.coverage + ' ' + model.coverage.observed + '/' + model.coverage.expected : '';
  const url = marketsWebAppLoginUrl_('', model.interactions?.open), esc = escapeMarketsAlertHtml_;
  const plain = [subject, coverage, headers.join(' | '), ...rows.map(row => row.join(' | ')), marketsNewsletterFeaturedPlain_(model), marketsNewsletterInteractionText_(model)].filter(Boolean).join('\n');
  const html = protectMarketsEmailColors_(marketsLightEmailDocument_(language) +
    '<table role="presentation" width="100%" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0" bgcolor="#FFFFFF" style="background-color:#FFFFFF;color:#070E46;"><tr><td>' +
    '<header style="background:#070e46;padding:20px;color:#fff"><img src="cid:bbvaLogo" alt="BBVA" width="112"><h1>' +
    esc(subject) + '</h1></header><p>' + esc(coverage) + '</p><table cellpadding="8"><thead><tr>' +
    headers.map(value => '<th scope="col">' + esc(value) + '</th>').join('') + '</tr></thead><tbody>' +
    rows.map(row => '<tr>' + row.map(value => '<td>' + esc(value) + '</td>').join('') + '</tr>').join('') +
    '</tbody></table>' + Object.entries(model.featuredReviews || {}).filter(([, reviews]) => reviews.length).map(([country]) =>
      '<h3>' + esc(names[country] || country) + '</h3>' + renderMarketsNewsletterFeatured_(model, country) +
      '<p align="center"><a href="' + esc(url) + '">' + esc(copy.link) + '</a></p>').join('') +
    '<p align="center"><a style="display:inline-block;padding:13px 22px;border-radius:8px;background:#001391;color:#FFFFFF;text-decoration:none;font-weight:700;" href="' +
    esc(url) + '">' + esc(copy.link) + '</a></p>' + renderMarketsEmailFooter_(model.interactions, language) + '</td></tr></table></body></html>');
  return { subject, plain, html };
}

const MARKETS_NEWSLETTER_INTERACTIONS = 'NEWSLETTER_INTERACTIONS';
const MARKETS_NEWSLETTER_INTERACTION_HEADERS = ['id', 'period', 'action', 'recorded_at', 'state', 'observation', 'user_email'];
const MARKETS_NEWSLETTER_SECRET = 'MARKETS_NEWSLETTER_INTERACTION_SECRET';

function marketsNewsletterInteractionLinks_(recipient, period, secret, preview = false) {
  if (!secret) return null;
  const expiry = Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000) + 30 * 86400;
  return Object.fromEntries(['open', 'positive', 'negative', 'unsubscribe'].map(action => {
    const payload = [preview ? 'newsletter-preview' : 'newsletter', period, expiry, action].join('.');
    const signature = signMarketsAlertFeedback_(payload, recipient, secret);
    const url = marketsWebAppUrl_() + '?newsletterInteraction=' + encodeURIComponent(payload + '.' + signature);
    return [action, url];
  }));
}

function parseMarketsNewsletterInteraction_(token) {
  const match = /^(newsletter(?:-preview)?\.(\d{4}-(?:0[1-9]|1[0-2]))\.(\d{10})\.(open|positive|negative|unsubscribe))\.([A-Za-z0-9_-]{43})$/.exec(String(token || ''));
  if (!match || Number(match[3]) <= Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000)) return null;
  return { payload: match[1], period: match[2], action: match[4], signature: match[5], preview: match[1].startsWith('newsletter-preview.') };
}

function renderMarketsNewsletterInteractionPage_(token) {
  const interaction = parseMarketsNewsletterInteraction_(token);
  if (interaction?.action !== 'unsubscribe') return HtmlService.createHtmlOutput('<p>Este enlace de la newsletter ha caducado o no es válido.</p>');
  const page = HtmlService.createTemplateFromFile('AlertFeedback');
  page.token = token;
  page.newsletter = true;
  page.unsubscribe = true;
  page.rating = '';
  page.destination = marketsWebAppUrl_();
  page.choice = 'Dar de baja la newsletter';
  return page.evaluate().setTitle('Newsletter de EDC Market Pulse').addMetaTag('viewport', 'width=device-width, initial-scale=1');
}

function marketsNewsletterInteractionSheet_(ss, extend = false) {
  const name = MARKETS_NEWSLETTER_INTERACTIONS;
  const sheet = ss.getSheetByName(name) || (extend ? ss.insertSheet(name) : null);
  return sheet && marketsAppendSheetHeaders_(sheet, MARKETS_NEWSLETTER_INTERACTION_HEADERS, [5, 6], extend);
}

function requireMarketsNewsletterInteractionLink_(token, email) {
  const interaction = parseMarketsNewsletterInteraction_(token);
  const secret = PropertiesService.getScriptProperties().getProperty(MARKETS_NEWSLETTER_SECRET);
  if (!interaction || !secret) throw new Error('Enlace no válido o caducado.');
  const expected = signMarketsAlertFeedback_(interaction.payload, email, secret);
  let diff = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < expected.length; i++) diff |= expected.charCodeAt(i) ^ interaction.signature.charCodeAt(i);
  if (diff) throw new Error('El enlace no corresponde a la cuenta conectada.');
  return { interaction, secret };
}

function recordMarketsNewsletterOpen(token) {
  if (parseMarketsNewsletterInteraction_(token)?.action === 'open') return saveMarketsNewsletterInteraction(token);
  if (parseMarketsAlertFeedback_(token)?.vote !== 'open') throw new Error('Enlace de acceso no válido.');
  const email = currentMarketsUserEmail_();
  const request = requireMarketsAlertFeedbackLink_(token, email);
  const lock = LockService.getScriptLock();
  if (!lock.tryLock(5000)) throw new Error('No se pudo guardar. Inténtalo de nuevo.');
  try {
    const { sheet, headers } = marketsNewsletterInteractionSheet_(openMarketsSpreadsheet_(), true);
    const id = 'a_' + request.id;
    const last = sheet.getLastRow();
    if (last > 1 && sheet.getRange(2, 1, last - 1, 1).createTextFinder(id).matchEntireCell(true).findNext()) return { open: true };
    ensureSheetCapacity_(sheet, last + 1, headers.length);
    sheet.getRange(last + 1, 1, 1, headers.length).setValues([[id, '', 'open', new Date(), '', '', marketsReviewLiteral_(email)]]);
    SpreadsheetApp.flush();
    return { open: true };
  } finally {
    lock.releaseLock();
  }
}

function saveMarketsNewsletterInteraction(token, vote, observation) {
  const email = currentMarketsUserEmail_();
  const { interaction, secret } = requireMarketsNewsletterInteractionLink_(token, email);
  const period = interaction.period;
  const rating = ['positive', 'negative'].includes(interaction.action);
  if (vote && (!rating || !['positive', 'negative'].includes(vote))) throw new Error('Valoración no válida.');
  const comment = trimString_(observation);
  if (comment && (!rating || comment.length > 1000)) throw new Error('Observaciones no válidas.');
  const action = vote || interaction.action;
  if (interaction.preview && action === 'unsubscribe') return { open: false, preview: true };
  const id = marketsNewsletterInteractionId_(period, action === 'open' ? 'open' : 'vote', email, secret, interaction.preview);
  const lock = LockService.getScriptLock();
  if (!lock.tryLock(5000)) throw new Error('No se pudo guardar. Inténtalo de nuevo.');
  try {
    const ss = openMarketsSpreadsheet_();
    if (action === 'unsubscribe') return unsubscribeMarketsEmail_(ss, email, true);
    const { sheet, headers } = marketsNewsletterInteractionSheet_(ss, true);
    const last = sheet.getLastRow();
    const found = last > 1 ? sheet.getRange(2, 1, last - 1, 1).createTextFinder(id).matchEntireCell(true).findNext() : null;
    const before = found && sheet.getRange(found.getRow(), 1, 1, headers.length).getValues()[0];
    const note = observation === undefined ? before?.[5] || '' : comment;
    const changed = before && rating && (before[2] !== action || (before[5] || '') !== note);
    if (!before || changed || before[6] !== email) {
      const row = found ? found.getRow() : last + 1;
      const values = [id, period, action, before && !changed ? before[3] : new Date(),
        action === 'open' ? '' : changed ? 'pendiente' : before?.[4] || 'pendiente', marketsReviewLiteral_(note), marketsReviewLiteral_(email)];
      ensureSheetCapacity_(sheet, row, headers.length);
      sheet.getRange(row, 1, 1, headers.length).setValues([values]);
      SpreadsheetApp.flush();
    }
    return { open: action === 'open', preview: interaction.preview };
  } finally {
    lock.releaseLock();
  }
}

function marketsNewsletterInteractionId_(period, kind, email, secret, preview = false) {
  const scope = preview ? 'newsletter-preview' : 'newsletter';
  return (preview ? 'np_' : 'n_') + signMarketsAlertFeedback_([scope, period, kind].join('.'), email, secret);
}

/** Match the recipient-bound interaction identifier against accepted newsletter deliveries. */
function marketsNewsletterInteractionEditions_(ss, interactions, kind) {
  const newsletterRows = interactions.filter(row => row[1]);
  const recordedAt = new Map(newsletterRows.map(row => [row[0], new Date(row[3]).getTime()]));
  const periods = new Set(newsletterRows.map(row => row[1]));
  const matched = new Map();
  if (!recordedAt.size) return matched;
  const secret = PropertiesService.getScriptProperties().getProperty(MARKETS_NEWSLETTER_SECRET);
  const sheet = ss.getSheetByName(MARKETS_CONFIG.sheets.alerts);
  if (!secret || !sheet || sheet.getLastRow() < 2) return matched;
  const headers = MARKETS_CONFIG.headers.alerts, indexes = indexHeaders_(headers);
  requireCurrentSheetContract_(ss, MARKETS_CONFIG.sheets.alerts, headers);
  const last = sheet.getLastRow();
  const sources = new Set(newsletterRows.map(row => row[0].startsWith('np_') ? 'NEWSLETTER_TEST' : 'MONTHLY_NEWSLETTER'));
  const sourceColumn = sheet.getRange(2, indexes.source + 1, last - 1, 1);
  const matches = [...sources].flatMap(source => sourceColumn.createTextFinder(source).matchEntireCell(true)
    .findAll().map(cell => cell.getRow())).sort((a, b) => a - b);
  const windowSize = 250;
  for (let start = 0; start < matches.length;) {
    const first = matches[start];
    let end = start + 1;
    while (end < matches.length && matches[end] - first < windowSize) end++;
    const values = sheet.getRange(first, 1, matches[end - 1] - first + 1, headers.length).getValues();
    for (; start < end; start++) {
      const row = values[matches[start] - first];
      const preview = row[indexes.source] === 'NEWSLETTER_TEST';
      if (row[indexes.type] !== (preview ? 'NEWSLETTER_TEST' : 'NEWSLETTER_MONTHLY')) continue;
      const period = /^NEWS-(?:TEST-)?(\d{4}-(?:0[1-9]|1[0-2]))$/.exec(row[indexes.run_id])?.[1];
      const email = normalizeEmailForComparison_(row[indexes.user_email] || row[indexes.recipients]);
      const sentAt = adminDateTime_(row[indexes.timestamp]);
      const time = Date.parse(sentAt);
      if (!periods.has(period) || !email || !Number.isFinite(time)) continue;
      const id = marketsNewsletterInteractionId_(period, kind, email, secret, preview);
      if (!recordedAt.has(id) || time > recordedAt.get(id) || (matched.has(id) && time <= Date.parse(matched.get(id).sentAt))) continue;
      matched.set(id, kind === 'open' ? { email, sentAt } : {
        email, sentAt, countries: trimString_(row[indexes.country_code]), summary: trimString_(row[indexes.detail]),
        language: /^MONTHLY_NEWSLETTER:(es|en|tr)$/.exec(row[indexes.rule_id])?.[1]
      });
    }
  }
  return matched;
}

function marketsNewsletterAccessUsers_(rows, editions, asOf) {
  const users = new Map(), seen = new Set();
  const recentStart = asOf.getTime() - 30 * 86400000;
  let identified = 0;
  for (const [id, , , date, , , storedEmail] of rows) {
    const email = normalizeEmailForComparison_(storedEmail) || editions.get(id)?.email;
    if (!email || seen.has(id)) continue;
    const time = new Date(date).getTime();
    if (!Number.isFinite(time) || time > asOf.getTime()) continue;
    seen.add(id);
    const iso = new Date(time).toISOString();
    if (!users.has(email)) users.set(email, { email, events: 0, recentEvents: 0, firstSeenAt: iso, lastSeenAt: iso });
    const user = users.get(email);
    user.events++;
    if (time >= recentStart) user.recentEvents++;
    if (iso < user.firstSeenAt) user.firstSeenAt = iso;
    if (iso > user.lastSeenAt) user.lastSeenAt = iso;
    identified++;
  }
  return { identified, asOf: asOf.toISOString(), users: [...users.values()].sort((a, b) =>
    b.lastSeenAt.localeCompare(a.lastSeenAt) || a.email.localeCompare(b.email)) };
}

function getMarketsNewsletterInteractions(kind, period, vote, status, start = '', end = '') {
  const { ss } = requireMarketsAdministrator_();
  if (!['access', 'feedback'].includes(kind) || (period && !/^\d{4}-(?:0[1-9]|1[0-2])$/.test(period))) throw new Error('Filtro no válido.');
  if ((vote && !['positive', 'negative'].includes(vote)) || (status && !['pendiente', 'atendido'].includes(status))) throw new Error('Filtro no válido.');
  if ([start, end].some(value => value && (!/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(value) || !Number.isFinite(Date.parse(value)) ||
      new Date(value).toISOString().slice(0, 10) !== value)) || (start && end && start > end)) throw new Error('Intervalo no válido.');
  const sheet = ss.getSheetByName(MARKETS_NEWSLETTER_INTERACTIONS);
  const last = sheet?.getLastRow() || 0;
  const rows = last > 1 ? sheet.getRange(2, 1, last - 1, marketsNewsletterInteractionSheet_(ss).headers.length).getValues() : [];
  if (kind === 'feedback' && !period) {
    const alert = marketsAlertFeedbackSheet_(ss);
    const count = alert ? alert.sheet.getLastRow() - 1 : 0;
    if (count > 0) {
      for (const [id, action, date, comment, state, email] of alert.sheet.getRange(2, 1, count, alert.headers.length).getValues()) {
        if (/^[a-f0-9]{32}$/.test(id) && ['positive', 'negative'].includes(action)) {
          rows.push([id, '', action, date, state || 'pendiente', comment, email]);
        }
      }
    }
  }
  const dates = new Map();
  const zone = MARKETS_CONFIG.timeZone;
  const selected = rows.filter(row => {
    if (!(kind === 'access' ? ['open'] : ['positive', 'negative']).includes(row[2]) || (period && row[1] !== period) ||
        (vote && row[2] !== vote) || (status && row[4] !== status)) return false;
    const date = new Date(row[3]);
    if (!Number.isFinite(date.getTime())) return false;
    const day = Utilities.formatDate(date, zone, 'yyyy-MM-dd');
    if ((start && day < start) || (end && day > end)) return false;
    dates.set(day, (dates.get(day) || 0) + 1);
    return true;
  });
  const now = new Date();
  const today = Utilities.formatDate(now, zone, 'yyyy-MM-dd'), through = end || today;
  const daily = kind === 'access' ? Array.from({ length: 30 }, (_, offset) => {
    const date = usageOffsetDateKey_(through, offset - 29);
    return { date, count: dates.get(date) || 0 };
  }).filter(row => !start || row.date >= start) : [];
  const editions = marketsNewsletterInteractionEditions_(ss, selected, kind === 'access' ? 'open' : 'vote');
  const access = kind === 'access' ? marketsNewsletterAccessUsers_(selected, editions, now) : undefined;
  return { total: selected.length, daily, access, editions: new Set(selected.map(row => row[1])).size, positive: selected.filter(row => row[2] === 'positive').length,
    negative: selected.filter(row => row[2] === 'negative').length,
    pending: selected.filter(row => row[4] === 'pendiente').length,
    resolved: selected.filter(row => row[4] === 'atendido').length,
    rows: selected.sort((a, b) => new Date(b[3]) - new Date(a[3])).map(([id, edition, action, date, state, comment, storedEmail]) => {
      const preview = id.startsWith('np_');
      const delivery = editions.get(id);
      const metadata = kind === 'feedback' ? {
        ...delivery, ...(edition ? {} : { language: 'es' }), email: normalizeEmailForComparison_(storedEmail) || delivery?.email || 'desconocido', preview
      } : id.startsWith('a_') ? { alert: true } : preview ? { preview: true } : null;
      return [edition, action, adminDateTime_(date), state, kind === 'feedback' ? id : '', comment || '', metadata];
    }) };
}

function setMarketsNewsletterFeedbackState(id, state) {
  const { ss } = requireMarketsAdministrator_();
  const isAlert = /^[a-f0-9]{32}$/.test(String(id));
  if (!(isAlert || /^np?_[A-Za-z0-9_-]{43}$/.test(String(id))) || !['pendiente', 'atendido'].includes(state)) throw new Error('Seguimiento no válido.');
  const lock = LockService.getScriptLock();
  if (!lock.tryLock(5000)) throw new Error('Feedback ocupado. Inténtalo de nuevo.');
  try {
    if (isAlert) {
      const current = marketsAlertFeedbackSheet_(ss);
      const found = current && findMarketsAlertFeedback_(current.sheet, id);
      if (!found || !['positive', 'negative'].includes(current.sheet.getRange(found.getRow(), 2).getValue())) {
        throw new Error('Valoración no disponible.');
      }
      const { sheet, headers } = marketsAlertFeedbackSheet_(ss, true);
      sheet.getRange(found.getRow(), headers.indexOf('status') + 1).setValue(state);
      SpreadsheetApp.flush();
      return { saved: true };
    }
    if (!ss.getSheetByName(MARKETS_NEWSLETTER_INTERACTIONS)) throw new Error('Valoración no disponible.');
    const { sheet } = marketsNewsletterInteractionSheet_(ss);
    const last = sheet.getLastRow();
    const found = last > 1 ? sheet.getRange(2, 1, last - 1, 1).createTextFinder(id).matchEntireCell(true).findNext() : null;
    if (!found || !['positive', 'negative'].includes(sheet.getRange(found.getRow(), 3).getValue())) throw new Error('Valoración no disponible.');
    sheet.getRange(found.getRow(), 5).setValue(state);
    SpreadsheetApp.flush();
    return { saved: true };
  } finally {
    lock.releaseLock();
  }
}

function marketsNewsletterInteractionLabels_(language) {
  const labels = { es: ['¿Te ha resultado útil?', 'Útil', 'Mejorable'],
    en: ['Was this helpful?', 'Helpful', 'Could be better'], tr: ['Faydalı oldu mu?', 'Faydalı', 'Geliştirilebilir'] };
  return labels[language] || labels.es;
}

function marketsNewsletterInteractionText_(model) {
  const links = model.interactions;
  if (!links) return marketsWebAppUrl_();
  const [question, positive, negative] = marketsNewsletterInteractionLabels_(model.language);
  return [links.open, question, positive + ': ' + links.positive, negative + ': ' + links.negative].join('\n');
}

/** Verifica que el proceso diario termino con datos utilizables y un canal de alertas operativo. */
function checkDailyRatingMonitorHealth() {
  return measureMarketsScheduledJob_('health', checkDailyRatingMonitorHealth_);
}

function checkDailyRatingMonitorHealth_() {
  const ss = openMarketsSpreadsheet_();
  ensureWorkbookSchema_(ss);
  const control = readControl_(ss);
  if (!parseBoolean_(control.MONITOR_HEALTH_ENABLED, true)) {
    return { healthy: true, status: 'DISABLED', notified: false };
  }
  const now = new Date();
  const dateKey = Utilities.formatDate(now, trimString_(control.TIME_ZONE) || MARKETS_CONFIG.timeZone, 'yyyy-MM-dd');
  const latest = readLatestRunForHealth_(ss, dateKey);
  const health = evaluateMarketsMonitorHealth_(latest, dateKey);
  health.notified = false;
  if (health.healthy) return health;
  const properties = PropertiesService.getScriptProperties();
  const notificationKey = 'MARKETS_MONITOR_HEALTH_ALERT_' + dateKey;
  if (properties.getProperty(notificationKey)) {
    health.notificationStatus = 'ALREADY_SENT';
    return health;
  }
  const recipient = normalizeMarketsAlertEmail_(trimString_(control.MONITOR_ADMIN_EMAIL) || MARKETS_ALERT_EMAIL.senderAddress);
  const delivery = sendMarketsMonitorHealthEmail_(recipient, health, now);
  properties.setProperty(notificationKey, JSON.stringify({
    sentAt: now.toISOString(), messageId: delivery.messageId, status: health.status
  }));
  health.notified = true;
  health.notificationStatus = 'SENT';
  health.recipient = recipient;
  health.messageId = delivery.messageId;
  return health;
}

function readLatestRunForHealth_(ss, expectedDateKey) {
  const sheet = ss.getSheetByName(MARKETS_CONFIG.sheets.runs);
  if (!sheet || sheet.getLastRow() <= 1) return null;
  const width = Math.min(sheet.getLastColumn(), MARKETS_CONFIG.headers.runs.length);
  const headers = sheet.getRange(1, 1, 1, width).getValues()[0];
  const indexes = indexHeaders_(headers);
  const count = Math.min(20, sheet.getLastRow() - 1);
  const rows = sheet.getRange(sheet.getLastRow() - count + 1, 1, count, width).getValues();
  for (let index = rows.length - 1; index >= 0; index -= 1) {
    const row = rows[index];
    const startedAt = row[indexes.started_at];
    if (!(startedAt instanceof Date)) continue;
    const dateKey = Utilities.formatDate(startedAt, MARKETS_CONFIG.timeZone, 'yyyy-MM-dd');
    if (dateKey !== expectedDateKey) continue;
    return {
      startedAt: startedAt,
      runId: trimString_(row[indexes.run_id]),
      status: trimString_(row[indexes.status]).toUpperCase(),
      appsTotal: toNonNegativeInteger_(row[indexes.apps_total]) || 0,
      appsOk: toNonNegativeInteger_(row[indexes.apps_ok]) || 0,
      rowsUpserted: toNonNegativeInteger_(row[indexes.rows_upserted]) || 0,
      detail: trimString_(row[indexes.detail]),
      alertDeliveryStatus: indexes.alert_delivery_status === undefined ? '' :
        trimString_(row[indexes.alert_delivery_status]).toUpperCase(),
      alertDeliveryDetail: indexes.alert_delivery_detail === undefined ? '' :
        trimString_(row[indexes.alert_delivery_detail])
    };
  }
  return null;
}

function evaluateMarketsMonitorHealth_(run, expectedDateKey) {
  if (!run) {
    return {
      healthy: false, status: 'MISSING', dateKey: expectedDateKey, runId: '',
      reason: 'No existe ninguna ejecucion registrada para la fecha esperada.'
    };
  }
  const dataHealthy = ['OK', 'PARTIAL'].indexOf(run.status) >= 0 &&
    run.appsTotal > 0 && run.appsOk > 0 && run.rowsUpserted > 0;
  const deliveryFailed = ['ERROR', 'PARTIAL'].indexOf(run.alertDeliveryStatus) >= 0;
  if (dataHealthy && !deliveryFailed) {
    return {
      healthy: true, status: 'HEALTHY', dateKey: expectedDateKey, runId: run.runId,
      runStatus: run.status, alertDeliveryStatus: run.alertDeliveryStatus || 'LEGACY'
    };
  }
  const reasons = [];
  if (!dataHealthy) {
    reasons.push('El proceso termino en ' + (run.status || 'estado desconocido') +
      ' con ' + run.appsOk + '/' + run.appsTotal + ' aplicaciones correctas y ' +
      run.rowsUpserted + ' filas actualizadas.');
  }
  if (deliveryFailed) {
    reasons.push('El canal de alertas termino en ' + run.alertDeliveryStatus +
      (run.alertDeliveryDetail ? ': ' + run.alertDeliveryDetail : '.'));
  }
  return {
    healthy: false, status: dataHealthy ? 'ALERT_DELIVERY_FAILED' : 'RUN_FAILED',
    dateKey: expectedDateKey, runId: run.runId, runStatus: run.status,
    alertDeliveryStatus: run.alertDeliveryStatus || 'UNKNOWN', reason: reasons.join(' '),
    detail: run.detail
  };
}

/** Autorizacion y observabilidad privada para responsables de Market Pulse. */
function marketsAdministratorEmails_(control) {
  return uniqueStrings_(trimString_(control && control.ADMIN_EMAILS).split(/[;,\s]+/)
    .map(normalizeEmailForComparison_))
    .filter(function (email) { return /^[^\s@]+@bbva\.com$/.test(email); });
}

function isMarketsAdministrator_(email, control) {
  return marketsAdministratorEmails_(control).indexOf(normalizeEmailForComparison_(email)) >= 0;
}

function seedInitialMarketsAdministrator_(ss) {
  const control = readControl_(ss);
  if (marketsAdministratorEmails_(control).length) return control.ADMIN_EMAILS;
  const owner = normalizeEmailForComparison_(Session.getEffectiveUser().getEmail());
  if (!owner) throw new Error('No se ha podido identificar al propietario inicial para ADMIN_EMAILS.');
  const sheet = ss.getSheetByName(MARKETS_CONFIG.sheets.control);
  const rows = sheet.getRange(2, 1, Math.max(1, sheet.getLastRow() - 1), 1).getValues();
  const index = rows.findIndex(function (row) { return trimString_(row[0]) === 'ADMIN_EMAILS'; });
  if (index < 0) throw new Error('Falta ADMIN_EMAILS en CONTROL. Ejecuta setupProject() con el contrato vigente.');
  sheet.getRange(index + 2, 2).setValue(owner);
  return owner;
}

function getMarketsUserContext() {
  const email = normalizeEmailForComparison_(currentMarketsUserEmail_());
  const cache = CacheService.getScriptCache();
  const cacheKey = 'markets-web:administrator-emails:' + MARKETS_CONFIG.codeVersion;
  let administrators = null;
  try {
    const cached = cache.get(cacheKey);
    administrators = cached ? JSON.parse(cached) : null;
  } catch (ignored) {}
  if (!Array.isArray(administrators)) {
    const ss = openMarketsSpreadsheet_();
    requireCurrentSheetContract_(ss, MARKETS_CONFIG.sheets.control, MARKETS_CONFIG.headers.control);
    administrators = marketsAdministratorEmails_(readControl_(ss));
    try { cache.put(cacheKey, JSON.stringify(administrators), 300); } catch (ignored) {}
  }
  return { email: email, isAdmin: administrators.indexOf(email) >= 0 };
}

function requireMarketsAdministrator_() {
  const email = currentMarketsUserEmail_();
  const ss = openMarketsSpreadsheet_();
  requireCurrentSheetContract_(ss, MARKETS_CONFIG.sheets.control, MARKETS_CONFIG.headers.control);
  const control = readControl_(ss);
  if (!isMarketsAdministrator_(email, control)) {
    throw new Error('Acceso denegado. Esta cuenta no esta autorizada como administradora.');
  }
  return { email: email, ss: ss, control: control };
}

}

  const access = requireMarketsAdministrator_();
  const ss = access.ss;
  [
    [MARKETS_CONFIG.sheets.runs, MARKETS_CONFIG.headers.runs],
    [MARKETS_CONFIG.sheets.fetchLog, MARKETS_CONFIG.headers.fetchLog],
    [MARKETS_CONFIG.sheets.alerts, MARKETS_CONFIG.headers.alerts],
    [MARKETS_CONFIG.sheets.alertPreferences, MARKETS_CONFIG.headers.alertPreferences]
  ].forEach(function (definition) {
    requireCurrentSheetContract_(ss, definition[0], definition[1]);
  });
  let sender = { available: false, address: trimString_(access.control.ALERT_SENDER_ALIAS), verificationStatus: 'UNKNOWN' };
  try { sender = marketsAlertSenderStatus_(ss); } catch (error) { sender.error = errorToString_(error); }
  const runs = readRecentMarketsAdminRuns_(ss, 14);
  const subscribers = readAllMarketsAlertPreferences_(ss);
  const issues = readRecentMarketsAdminFetchIssues_(ss, 40);
  const alerts = readRecentMarketsAdminAlertEvents_(ss, 30);

  const usage = includeUsage ? readMarketsUsageAnalytics_(ss,
    trimString_(access.control.TIME_ZONE) || MARKETS_CONFIG.timeZone) : null;
  return {
    generatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
    administrator: access.email,
    system: {
      deliveries,
      codeVersion: MARKETS_CONFIG.codeVersion,
      webVersion: MARKETS_WEB.version,
      webAppUrl: marketsWebAppUrl_(),
      timeZone: trimString_(access.control.TIME_ZONE) || MARKETS_CONFIG.timeZone,
      reviewPipeline: marketsAdminReviewPipeline_(access.email),
      functionalJobs: typeof marketsFunctionalJobStatus_ === 'function' ? marketsFunctionalJobStatus_() : [],
      operations: typeof marketsAdminReviewOperations_ === 'function' ? marketsAdminReviewOperations_(access.email) : null,
      dailySchedule: String(MARKETS_CONFIG.runHour).padStart(2, '0') + ':' + String(MARKETS_CONFIG.runMinute).padStart(2, '0'),
      healthSchedule: String(MARKETS_CONFIG.healthCheckHour).padStart(2, '0') + ':' + String(MARKETS_CONFIG.healthCheckMinute).padStart(2, '0'),
      newsletterSchedule: 'Día 1 · ' + String(MARKETS_CONFIG.newsletterHour).padStart(2, '0') + ':' +
        String(MARKETS_CONFIG.newsletterMinute).padStart(2, '0'),
      emailDeliveryEnabled: parseBoolean_(access.control.SEND_ALERT_EMAILS, false),
      newsletterDeliveryEnabled: marketsNewsletterDeliveryEnabled_(access.control),
      healthMonitorEnabled: parseBoolean_(access.control.MONITOR_HEALTH_ENABLED, true),
      healthRecipient: trimString_(access.control.MONITOR_ADMIN_EMAIL),
      administratorEmails: marketsAdministratorEmails_(access.control),
      senderName: sender.name,
      senderAddress: sender.address,
      senderAvailable: Boolean(sender.available),
      senderVerificationStatus: trimString_(sender.verificationStatus),
      senderError: trimString_(sender.error)
    },
    summary: {
      activeSubscribers: subscribers.filter(function (item) {
        return item.active || item.newsletterEnabled;
      }).length,
      pausedSubscribers: subscribers.filter(function (item) {
        return !item.active && !item.newsletterEnabled;
      }).length,
      recentRuns: runs.length,
      recentIssues: issues.length,
      recentAlertEvents: alerts.length,
      usersThisMonth: usage?.kpis.usersMonth ?? null
    },
    recentRuns: runs,
    fetchIssues: issues,
    subscribers: subscribers.map(function (item) {

      client.lastTestAt = adminDateTime_(item.lastTestAt);
