function trimString_(value) {
  return value === null || value === undefined ? '' : String(value).trim();
}

/** URL corporativa unica para web, correos y diagnostico. */
function marketsWebAppUrl_() {
  const url = trimString_(MARKETS_CONFIG.webAppUrl);
  const type = marketsDeploymentUrlType_(url);
  if (type !== 'WEB_APP') {
    const detail = type === 'LIBRARY' ?
      'La URL pertenece a una biblioteca de Apps Script, no a una aplicacion web.' :
      'La URL debe ser la direccion corporativa /s/.../exec completa.';
    throw new Error('MARKETS_CONFIG.webAppUrl no es una aplicacion web valida. ' + detail);
  }
  return url;
}

function marketsDeploymentUrlType_(value) {
  const url = trimString_(value);
  if (/^https:\/\/script\.google\.com\/macros\/library\/d\/[A-Za-z0-9_-]+\/\d+(?:[/?#]|$)/.test(url)) {
    return 'LIBRARY';
  }
  if (/^https:\/\/script\.google\.com\/a\/macros\/bbva\.com\/s\/[A-Za-z0-9_-]+\/exec(?:[?#].*)?$/.test(url) ||
      /^https:\/\/script\.google\.com\/macros\/s\/[A-Za-z0-9_-]+\/exec(?:[?#].*)?$/.test(url)) {
    return 'WEB_APP';
  }
  if (/\/dev(?:[?#].*)?$/.test(url)) return 'DEVELOPMENT';
  return url ? 'UNKNOWN' : 'MISSING';
}

/** Fuerza la seleccion de la cuenta Workspace antes de entrar desde un correo. */
function marketsWebAppLoginUrl_(email, destination = marketsWebAppUrl_()) {
  const account = trimString_(email).toLowerCase();
  const query = [];
  if (/^[^\s@]+@bbva\.com$/.test(account)) query.push('Email=' + encodeURIComponent(account));
  query.push('continue=' + encodeURIComponent(destination));
  return 'https://accounts.google.com/AccountChooser?' + query.join('&');
}

function normalizeHeader_(value) {
  return trimString_(value).toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, '_').replace(/^_|_$/g, '');
}

function indexHeaders_(headers) {
  return (headers || []).reduce(function (out, header, index) {
    out[normalizeHeader_(header)] = index;
    return out;
  }, {});
}

function parseBoolean_(value, defaultValue) {
  if (typeof value === 'boolean') return value;
  const normalized = trimString_(value).toLowerCase();
  if (['true', '1', 'si', 'sí', 'yes'].indexOf(normalized) >= 0) return true;
  if (['false', '0', 'no'].indexOf(normalized) >= 0) return false;
  return Boolean(defaultValue);
}

function toFiniteNumber_(value) {
  if (typeof value === 'number') return isFinite(value) ? value : null;
  const normalized = trimString_(value).replace(/\s/g, '').replace(',', '.');
  if (!normalized) return null;
  const parsed = Number(normalized);
  return isFinite(parsed) ? parsed : null;
}

function toNonNegativeInteger_(value) {
  const parsed = toFiniteNumber_(value);
  return parsed !== null && parsed >= 0 ? Math.round(parsed) : null;
}

function nonNegativeNumberOrZero_(value) {
  const parsed = toFiniteNumber_(value);
  return parsed !== null && parsed >= 0 ? parsed : 0;
}

function normalizeRating_(value) {
  const parsed = toFiniteNumber_(value);
  // Conserva la precision publicada por la fuente. La interfaz decide cuantos
  // decimales mostrar; redondear aqui destruye informacion necesaria para
  // inferir la nota de las reseñas nuevas a partir de acumulados grandes.
  return parsed !== null && parsed >= 1 && parsed <= 5 ? Math.round(parsed * 1000000) / 1000000 : null;
}

function dateKey_(value) {
  if (!(value instanceof Date) || isNaN(value.getTime())) return '';
  const year = value.getFullYear();
  const month = String(value.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0');
  const day = String(value.getDate()).padStart(2, '0');
  return year + '-' + month + '-' + day;
}

function dateFromKey_(key) {
  const parts = trimString_(key).split('-').map(Number);
  if (parts.length !== 3 || parts.some(function (part) { return !isFinite(part); })) return null;
  return new Date(parts[0], parts[1] - 1, parts[2], 12, 0, 0, 0);
}

function round2_(value) {
  return Math.round(Number(value) * 100) / 100;
}

function makeRatingKey_(date, appKey) {
  return dateKey_(date) + '|' + trimString_(appKey);
}

/** Ranking de competicion: 5, 5, 4 produce 1, 1, 3. */
function rankSnapshot_(items) {
  const ratings = (items || []).map(function (item) { return normalizeRating_(item.rating); });
  return ratings.map(function (rating) {
    if (rating === null) return null;
    return 1 + ratings.filter(function (other) { return other !== null && other > rating; }).length;
  });
}

/** Devuelve el valor de la ultima observacion anterior al corte. */
function findPreviousValue_(series, targetMillis, field) {
  let low = 0;
  let high = (series || []).length - 1;
  let found = null;
  while (low <= high) {
    const middle = Math.floor((low + high) / 2);
    if (series[middle].dateMillis <= targetMillis) {
      found = series[middle][field];
      low = middle + 1;
    } else {
      high = middle - 1;
    }
  }
  return found;
}

function findPreviousRating_(series, targetMillis) {
  return findPreviousValue_(series, targetMillis, 'rating');
}

function retryableStatus_(status) {
  return status === 408 || status === 429 || status >= 500;
}

function errorToString_(error) {
  if (!error) return 'Error desconocido';
  return trimString_(error.message || error.stack || error);
}

function safeJsonParse_(text) {
  try { return JSON.parse(text); } catch (ignored) { return null; }
}

function uniqueStrings_(values) {
  const seen = {};
  return (values || []).map(trimString_).filter(function (value) {
    if (!value || seen[value]) return false;
    seen[value] = true;
    return true;
  });
}

/**
 * Android e iOS sostienen la cobertura operativa. Huawei se conserva como
 * fuente complementaria: se captura y publica cuando existe, pero su ausencia
 * nunca degrada una ejecución, un agregado ni una alerta técnica.
 */
function isMarketsCriticalPlatform_(platform) {
  return ['Android', 'iOS'].indexOf(trimString_(platform)) >= 0;
}

function marketsPlatformRank_(value) {
  const platform = trimString_(value && typeof value === 'object' ? value.platform : value);
  const index = ['Android', 'iOS', 'Huawei'].indexOf(platform);
  return index < 0 ? 3 : index;
}

function compareMarketsPlatforms_(a, b) {
  const first = trimString_(a && typeof a === 'object' ? a.platform : a);
  const second = trimString_(b && typeof b === 'object' ? b.platform : b);
  return marketsPlatformRank_(first) - marketsPlatformRank_(second) ||
    first.localeCompare(second);
}

function marketsCriticalItems_(items) {
  return (items || []).filter(function (item) {
    const source = item && item.app ? item.app : item;
    const explicit = trimString_(source && source.platform);
    const prefix = trimString_(source && source.appKey).split('|')[0].toUpperCase();
    const platform = explicit || (prefix === 'ANDROID' ? 'Android' : prefix === 'IOS' ? 'iOS' : prefix === 'HUAWEI' ? 'Huawei' : '');
    return isMarketsCriticalPlatform_(platform);
  });
}

    const supportedLanguage=value=>["es","en","tr"].includes(value)?value:"es";
    const browserLanguages=navigator.languages?.length?navigator.languages:[navigator.language];
    let appLanguage=browserLanguages.map(tag=>tag?.split("-")[0].toLowerCase()).find(value=>["es","en","tr"].includes(value))||"es";
    const locale=()=>({es:"es-ES",en:"en-GB",tr:"tr-TR"}[appLanguage]);
    const translate=(key,values={})=>{
      const variants=Object.hasOwn(interfaceCopy,key)?interfaceCopy[key]:null;
      const text=appLanguage==="es"||!variants?key:variants[appLanguage==="en"?0:1];
      return text.replace(/\{(\w+)\}/g,(match,name)=>values[name]??match);
    };
    const originalCopy=new WeakMap(), originalAttributes=new WeakMap();
    const localizedAttributes=["aria-label","title","placeholder"];
    function translateInterface(root){
      if(!root)return;
      const attributeSelector=localizedAttributes.map(name=>`[${name}]`).join(",");
      for(const element of [root,...root.querySelectorAll(attributeSelector)]){
        if(element.closest("[data-review-content],[data-detail]"))continue;
        for(const name of localizedAttributes){
          const value=element.getAttribute(name);
          if(!value)continue;
          const attributes=originalAttributes.get(element)||{};
          const previous=attributes[name];
          const original=previous?.rendered===value?previous.original:value;
          const rendered=translate(original);
          if(!previous&&original===rendered&&!Object.hasOwn(interfaceCopy,original))continue;
          attributes[name]={original,rendered};
          originalAttributes.set(element,attributes);
          if(value!==rendered)element.setAttribute(name,rendered);
        }
      }
      const walker=document.createTreeWalker(root,NodeFilter.SHOW_TEXT);
      for(let node=walker.nextNode();node;node=walker.nextNode()){
        if(node.parentElement.closest("script,style,textarea,[data-review-content],[data-detail]"))continue;
        const previous=originalCopy.get(node);
        const original=previous?.rendered===node.data?previous.original:node.data;
        const word=original.trim(), variants=Object.hasOwn(interfaceCopy,word)?interfaceCopy[word]:null;
        if(!variants)continue;
        const rendered=original.replace(word,()=>translate(word));
        originalCopy.set(node,{original,rendered});
        if(node.data!==rendered)node.data=rendered;
      }
    }
    function initializeLanguage(){
      document.documentElement.lang=appLanguage;
      const selector=$("admin-app-language");
      selector.value=appLanguage;
      selector.addEventListener("change",()=>{
        appLanguage=supportedLanguage(selector.value);
        document.documentElement.lang=appLanguage;
        if(state.meta){renderRunStatus();renderDashboard();renderAdmin();if(state.view==="analytics")loadAnalytics();if(state.view==="reviews")loadReviews();if(state.view==="evolution")renderEvolution()}
        translateInterface(document.body);
      });
      translateInterface(document.body);
      new MutationObserver(records=>{
        for(const record of records){
          if(record.type==="characterData")translateInterface(record.target.parentElement);
          else for(const node of record.addedNodes){
            if(node.nodeType===Node.ELEMENT_NODE)translateInterface(node);
            else if(node.nodeType===Node.TEXT_NODE)translateInterface(node.parentElement);
          }
        }
      }).observe(document.body,{childList:true,characterData:true,subtree:true});
    }
    const fmt=(value,digits=1)=>D.finite(value)?value.toLocaleString(locale(),{minimumFractionDigits:digits,maximumFractionDigits:digits}):"—";
    const integer=value=>D.finite(value)?Math.round(value).toLocaleString(locale()):"—";
    const compactInteger=value=>{if(!D.finite(value))return"—";const absolute=Math.abs(value);if(absolute<1000)return integer(value);if(absolute<1000000)return`${fmt(value/1000,absolute<10000?1:0)} mil`;return`${fmt(value/1000000,absolute<10000000?1:0)} M`};
    const signed=(value,digits=2)=>{if(!D.finite(value))return"—";const normalized=Math.abs(value)<.005?0:value;return`${normalized>0?"+":""}${fmt(normalized,digits)}`};
    const initials=value=>String(value||"?").split(/\s+/).slice(0,2).map(part=>part[0]).join("").toUpperCase();
    const dateLabel=value=>value?new Intl.DateTimeFormat(locale(),{day:"2-digit",month:"short",year:"numeric"}).format(new Date(`${value}T12:00:00`)):"—";
    const dateTimeLabel=value=>value?new Intl.DateTimeFormat(locale(),{day:"2-digit",month:"short",year:"numeric",hour:"2-digit",minute:"2-digit",second:"2-digit"}).format(new Date(value)):"—";
    const monthLabel=value=>value?new Intl.DateTimeFormat(locale(),{month:"short",year:"2-digit"}).format(new Date(`${value}-15T12:00:00`)):"—";
    const monthName=value=>value?new Intl.DateTimeFormat(locale(),{month:"long"}).format(new Date(`2024-${String(value).padStart(2,"0")}-15T12:00:00`)):"—";
    const countryLabel=code=>{
      if(code==="UNKNOWN")return translate("No atribuible");

      return configured&&appLanguage!=="es"?new Intl.DisplayNames([appLanguage],{type:"region"}).of(code):configured||code;
    };

    function recordNewsletterOpen(){
      const token=document.body.dataset.newsletterOpen;
      if(!token||document.visibilityState!=="visible"||document.prerendering)return;
      document.removeEventListener("visibilitychange",recordNewsletterOpen);
      document.removeEventListener("prerenderingchange",recordNewsletterOpen);
      const send=attempt=>{
        const retry=()=>{
          if(attempt<3)setTimeout(()=>send(attempt+1),500*2**(attempt-1));
          else showToast("No se pudo registrar el acceso desde el correo. Recarga la página para reintentar.",false);
        };
        google.script.run.withSuccessHandler(result=>{
          if(result?.open)delete document.body.dataset.newsletterOpen;
          else retry();
        }).withFailureHandler(retry).recordMarketsNewsletterOpen(token);
      };
      send(1);
    }

    function openEmailFeedback(){
      const dialog=$("feedback-dialog");
      if(!dialog)return;
      const form=$("edition-feedback"), close=$("close-feedback"), error=$("feedback-error");
      const token=form.dataset.token, newsletter=form.dataset.newsletter==="true";
      close.innerHTML=U.icon("close");
      close.addEventListener("click",()=>dialog.close());
      form.addEventListener("submit",event=>{
        event.preventDefault();
        const button=form.querySelector('[type="submit"]');
        button.disabled=true;
        error.classList.add("hidden");
        const failure=()=>{
          button.disabled=false;
          error.textContent=translate("No se pudo guardar la valoración. Inténtalo de nuevo.");
          error.classList.remove("hidden");
        };
        const run=google.script.run.withSuccessHandler(result=>{
          delete form.dataset.token;
          dialog.close();
          showToast(result?.preview?"Valoración de prueba guardada.":"Valoración guardada.",true);
        }).withFailureHandler(failure);
        const args=[token,form.elements.rating.value,form.elements.comment.value];
        if(newsletter)run.saveMarketsNewsletterInteraction(...args);
        else run.saveMarketsAlertFeedback(...args);
      });
      dialog.showModal();
    }

    function serverTimeoutMs(method){return method==="admin:newsletter:test"?120000:method==="bootstrap"?60000:(method.startsWith("review:")||method==="trends")?60000:method==="admin:get"?30000:20000}
    let activeRpc=0;
    const adminLoadingActivity=new Map(),adminPanelsLoaded=new WeakSet();
    // Estructura y ciclo de News Radar, limitados a las secciones de Administración.
    function beginAdminLoading(method){
      if(state.view!=="admin"||!method.startsWith("admin:")||method==="admin:jobs:status")return()=>{};
      const panel=document.querySelector('#view-admin .admin-tab-panel:not(.hidden)');
      if(!panel)return()=>{};
      let activity=adminLoadingActivity.get(panel);
      if(!activity){
        const indicator=document.createElement("div"),skeleton=document.createElement("div");
        indicator.className="admin-radar-loading";indicator.setAttribute("role","status");indicator.setAttribute("aria-live","polite");
        indicator.innerHTML='<span class="admin-radar-spinner" aria-hidden="true"></span><span>'+U.esc(translate("Cargando contenido…"))+'</span>';
        skeleton.className="admin-radar-skeleton";skeleton.setAttribute("aria-hidden","true");
        skeleton.innerHTML='<span class="admin-radar-skeleton-heading"></span>'+Array(3).fill('<div class="admin-radar-skeleton-card"><span></span><span></span><span></span></div>').join("");
        activity={pending:0,replace:0,indicator,skeleton};adminLoadingActivity.set(panel,activity);panel.prepend(indicator,skeleton);
      }
      const replace=!adminPanelsLoaded.has(panel);
      const update=delta=>{
        activity.pending+=delta;if(replace)activity.replace+=delta;
        panel.dataset.loading=activity.replace?"replace":activity.pending?"refresh":"";
        panel.setAttribute("aria-busy",String(activity.pending>0));
        activity.indicator.hidden=!activity.pending;activity.skeleton.hidden=!activity.replace;
      };
      update(1);let finished=false;
      return()=>{if(finished)return;finished=true;adminPanelsLoaded.add(panel);update(-1)};
    }
    function callServer(method,argument,snapshotOnly=false){
      const started=performance.now(), view=state.view, operation=snapshotOnly?method+":prefetch":method;
      return new Promise((resolve,reject)=>{
        if(!window.google?.script?.run)return reject(new Error("El dashboard debe abrirse desde el despliegue de Apps Script."));
        activeRpc++;
        const finishLoading=beginAdminLoading(method);
        let settled=false;
        const finish=outcome=>value=>{
          if(settled)return;
          settled=true;
          activeRpc--;
          finishLoading();
          window.clearTimeout(timer);
          trackUsage("PERFORMANCE",view,operation,`RPC ${Math.round(performance.now()-started)} ${outcome}`);
          if(outcome==="OK"){
            const timing=value?.timing;
            if(["cache","snapshot","sheet"].includes(timing?.source)&&Number.isFinite(timing.durationMs)){
              trackUsage("PERFORMANCE",view,operation,`SERVER_${timing.source.toUpperCase()} ${Math.round(timing.durationMs)} OK`);
              const phases=["readMs","classificationMs","aggregateMs","cacheMs","serializationMs","read","classified","returned","input","payloadCharacters"];
              const metrics=phases.filter(key=>Number.isFinite(timing[key])).map(key=>key+"="+Math.round(timing[key]));
              if(metrics.length)trackUsage("PERFORMANCE",view,operation,"PHASES "+metrics.join(" "));
            }
            resolve(value);
          }
          else reject(new Error(value?.message||value));
        };
        const timer=window.setTimeout(()=>finish("TIMEOUT")(translate("EDC Market Pulse no ha respondido a tiempo. Reintenta la carga.")),serverTimeoutMs(method));
        try{
          const runner=google.script.run.withSuccessHandler(finish("OK")).withFailureHandler(finish("ERROR"));
          if(method==="bootstrap")runner.getMarketsDashboardBootstrap();else if(method==="user:context")runner.getMarketsUserContext();else if(method==="admin:get")runner.getMarketsAdminDashboard(false);else if(method==="admin:jobs:status")runner.getMarketsAdminPanelJobs();else if(method==="admin:business:refresh")runner.refreshMarketsAdminFunctionalCatalog();else if(method==="admin:business")runner.getMarketsBusinessCatalog(argument,appLanguage);else if(method==="admin:business:save")runner.saveMarketsBusinessCatalogEntry(argument);else if(method==="admin:newsletter:feedback-state")runner.setMarketsNewsletterFeedbackState(argument.id,argument.state);else if(method==="admin:newsletter:interactions")runner.getMarketsNewsletterInteractions(argument.kind,argument.period,argument.vote,argument.status,argument.start,argument.end);else if(method==="admin:subscriber:save")runner.saveMarketsAdminSubscriber(argument.email,argument.preferences);else if(method==="admin:newsletter:test")runner.sendMarketsAdminNewsletterTestEmail(argument);else if(method==="admin:jobs:run")runner.runMarketsPanelJob(argument);else if(method==="admin:jobs:interval")runner.configureMarketsReviewSupervisor(argument);else if(method==="admin:jobs:settings")runner.saveMarketsReviewJobSettings(argument.id,argument.config);else if(method==="admin:jobs:folder")runner.saveMarketsStorageFolder(argument.kind,argument.id);else if(method==="admin:reviews:restart")runner.requestMarketsReviewPipeline();else if(method==="admin:ratings:recover")runner.requestMarketsAdminRatingRecovery();else if(method==="reviews:segments")runner.getMarketsReviewSegments();else if(method==="reviews")runner.getMarketsReviews(argument);else if(method==="review:page")runner.getMarketsReviewPage(argument,snapshotOnly);else if(method==="review:export")runner.getMarketsReviewExport(argument);else if(method==="review:analytics")runner.getMarketsReviewAnalytics(argument,snapshotOnly);else if(method==="review:ranking")runner.getMarketsReviewRanking(argument);else if(method==="review:nps")runner.getMarketsReviewNps(argument,snapshotOnly);else if(method==="admin:usage")runner.getMarketsAdminUsage();else if(method==="performance")runner.getMarketsPerformance();else if(method==="trends")runner.getMarketsDashboardTrends(argument,snapshotOnly);else if(method==="alerts:get")runner.getMarketsAlertPreferences();else if(method==="alerts:save")runner.saveMarketsAlertPreferences(argument);else if(method==="alerts:reset")runner.resetMarketsAlertPreferences(argument);else finish("ERROR")(new Error("Operación no soportada: "+method));
        }catch(error){finish("ERROR")(error)}
      });
    }

    const reviewRequests=new Map(), reviewResponses=new Map();
    const reviewResponseTtl=120000;
    let monthlyReviewLoadedAt=0;
    const reviewResponseKey=(method,scope)=>JSON.stringify([method,Object.keys(scope).sort().map(field=>[field,scope[field]])]);
    const hasReviewResponse=(method,scope)=>reviewResponses.get(reviewResponseKey(method,scope))?.expires>Date.now();
    function fetchReviewData(method,scope,snapshotOnly=false){
      const key=reviewResponseKey(method,scope);
      const hit=reviewResponses.get(key);
      if(hit&&hit.expires>Date.now()){
        reviewResponses.delete(key);
        reviewResponses.set(key,hit);
        trackUsage("PERFORMANCE",state.view,method,"CACHE 0 OK");
        return Promise.resolve(hit.value);
      }
      reviewResponses.delete(key);
      if(reviewRequests.has(key)){
        trackUsage("PERFORMANCE",state.view,method,"SHARED 0 OK");
        const {promise,prefetch}=reviewRequests.get(key);
        return snapshotOnly||!prefetch?promise:promise.then(value=>value??fetchReviewData(method,scope),()=>fetchReviewData(method,scope));
      }
      const request=callServer(method,scope,snapshotOnly).then(value=>{
        if(value==null)return null;
        const stale=value.timing?.freshness==="stale"?Math.max(0,(value.timing.staleMaxSeconds-value.timing.ageSeconds)*1000):reviewResponseTtl;
        reviewResponses.set(key,{value,expires:Date.now()+Math.min(reviewResponseTtl,stale)});
        if(reviewResponses.size>32)reviewResponses.delete(reviewResponses.keys().next().value);
        return value;
      }).finally(()=>reviewRequests.delete(key));
      reviewRequests.set(key,{promise:request,prefetch:snapshotOnly});
      return request;
    }
    function trackReady(view,operation,started){
      window.requestAnimationFrame(()=>window.requestAnimationFrame(()=>{
        if(state.view===view&&document.visibilityState==="visible"){
          trackUsage("PERFORMANCE",view,operation,`UI ${Math.round(performance.now()-started)} OK`);
        }
      }));
    }
    function validateBootstrap(data){if(!data||!data.meta||!Array.isArray(data.snapshot)||!Array.isArray(data.trends))throw new Error(translate("El servidor ha devuelto una respuesta incompleta. Actualiza el despliegue de EDC Market Pulse."));return data}

    let usageSession="";
    function usageSessionId(){
      if(usageSession)return usageSession;
      const key="markets-usage-session-v1";
      try{
        const saved=sessionStorage.getItem(key);
        if(/^(?:[0-9a-f]{32}|[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-4[0-9a-f]{3}-[89ab][0-9a-f]{3}-[0-9a-f]{12})$/i.test(saved||""))return usageSession=saved;
      }catch(ignored){}
      try{
        const random=window.crypto?.getRandomValues(new Uint8Array(16));
        if(!random)return "";
        usageSession=Array.from(random,byte=>byte.toString(16).padStart(2,"0")).join("");
      }catch(ignored){return ""}
      try{sessionStorage.setItem(key,usageSession)}catch(ignored){}
      return usageSession;
    }
    function usageDevice(){const width=Math.min(window.innerWidth||9999,window.screen?.width||9999);return width<=780?"MOBILE":width<=1180?"TABLET":"DESKTOP"}
    function startUsageTracking(){if(state.usageStarted)return;state.usageStarted=true;trackUsage("SESSION_START",state.view,"APP_OPEN");trackUsage("VIEW",state.view,"OPEN_VIEW")}
    function trackUsage(eventType,view=state.view,action="",detail=""){
      const sessionId=usageSessionId();
      if(!sessionId)return;
      state.usageQueue.push({eventType,view,action,detail:String(detail||"").slice(0,240),sessionId,webVersion:state.meta?.webVersion||"",device:usageDevice()});
      if(state.usageQueue.length>100)state.usageQueue.shift();
      if(!state.usageTimer)scheduleUsage(8000);
    }
    let usageInFlight=false;
    function scheduleUsage(delay){
      window.clearTimeout(state.usageTimer);
      state.usageTimer=window.setTimeout(flushUsage,delay);
    }
    function flushUsage(){
      window.clearTimeout(state.usageTimer);
      state.usageTimer=0;
      if(!state.usageQueue.length||!window.google?.script?.run||usageInFlight)return;
      if(activeRpc){scheduleUsage(8000);return}
      usageInFlight=true;
      const batch=state.usageQueue.splice(0,25);
      const finish=retry=>{
        usageInFlight=false;
        if(retry)state.usageQueue=batch.concat(state.usageQueue).slice(0,100);
        if(state.usageQueue.length)scheduleUsage(retry?15000:8000);
      };
      google.script.run.withSuccessHandler(result=>finish(Boolean(result?.deferred))).withFailureHandler(()=>finish(true)).recordMarketsUsageEvents(batch);
    }

    const annualTrendRequest=({country})=>({countryCode:country==="ALL"?"":country,platform:"",segment:"ALL",months:36,bbvaOnly:false});
    function trendRequest(){return annualTrendRequest(state)}
    function trendKey(request){return[request.countryCode||"ALL",request.platform||"ALL",request.segment,request.bbvaOnly?"BBVA":"ALL",request.months].join("|")}
    const trendRequests=new Map();
    function cachedTrendRows(request){
      const key=trendKey(request);
      if(state.trendCache.has(key))return state.trendCache.get(key);
      if(!request.countryCode)return undefined;
      const broadKey=trendKey({...request,countryCode:""});
      const broad=state.trendCache.get(broadKey);
      return broad?.filter(row=>row.countryCode===request.countryCode);
    }
    function fetchTrends(request,snapshotOnly=false){
      const key=trendKey(request), cached=cachedTrendRows(request);
      if(cached)return Promise.resolve(cached);
      const broad=request.countryCode&&trendRequests.get(trendKey({...request,countryCode:""}));
      if(broad)return broad.promise.then(rows=>rows?rows.filter(row=>row.countryCode===request.countryCode)
        :snapshotOnly?null:fetchTrends(request),()=>snapshotOnly?null:fetchTrends(request));
      const existing=trendRequests.get(key);
      if(existing)return snapshotOnly||!existing.prefetch?existing.promise:
        existing.promise.then(rows=>rows??fetchTrends(request),()=>fetchTrends(request));
      const promise=callServer("trends",request,snapshotOnly).then(rows=>{
        if(rows==null)return null;
        state.trendCache.set(key,rows);
        if(state.trendCache.size>24)state.trendCache.delete(state.trendCache.keys().next().value);
        return rows;
      }).finally(()=>trendRequests.delete(key));
      trendRequests.set(key,{promise,prefetch:snapshotOnly});
      return promise;
    }
    async function loadTrends(){
      const started=performance.now();
      const request=trendRequest(),token=++state.trendToken;
      const cached=cachedTrendRows(request);
      if(cached){
        trackUsage("PERFORMANCE",state.view,"trends","CACHE 0 OK");
        state.trends=cached;state.trendsLoading=false;renderDashboard();
        trackReady("evolution","Mostrar pulso mensual",started);
        return;
      }
      state.trendsLoading=true;renderEvolution();
      try{
        const rows=await fetchTrends(request);
        if(token===state.trendToken)state.trends=rows;
      }catch(error){
        if(token===state.trendToken){state.trends=[];showError(error)}
      }finally{
        if(token===state.trendToken){state.trendsLoading=false;renderDashboard();if(cachedTrendRows(request))trackReady("evolution","Mostrar pulso mensual",started)}
      }
    }

    function renderMonthlyMatrix(period,trends){
      if(state.trendsLoading){

      const points=new Map((npsReady?monthlyPulse.points:[]).map(row=>[row.country+"|"+row.month,row]));
      for(const row of model.rows)for(const cell of row.cells){
        const point=points.get(row.countryCode+"|"+cell.month);
        cell.nps=point?.balance??null;
        if(point)cell.npsSample=reviewNpsSample(point);
        const previous=points.get(row.countryCode+"|"+D.previousCalendarMonth(cell.month))?.balance;
        cell.npsDelta=D.finite(cell.nps)&&D.finite(previous)?cell.nps-previous:null;
      }

        showScopes:state.country==="ALL"});
      const columns=["Mes","Rating consolidado","Variación","NPS de reseñas (pp)","Variación NPS (pp)",
        ...model.platforms.flatMap(platform=>[`Rating ${platform}`,`Valoraciones ${platform}`])];
      setExportSheet("evolution","Pulso mensual",state.country,
        [["Mes de cierre",period],["Aplicación",state.evolutionApp],["Comentarios",reviewFilterLabel("audience",monthlyFilters.audience)],
          ["Inferir datos",reviewFilterLabel("inferGeography",monthlyFilters.inferGeography)]],

        model.rows.flatMap(row=>row.cells.map(cell=>[...(state.country==="ALL"?[row.country]:[]),cell.month,cell.rating,cell.delta,
          cell.nps,cell.npsDelta,...cell.platforms.flatMap(item=>[item.rating,item.value])])));

    function renderBenchmark(){
      const started=performance.now();
      radarFilters.benchmark.render();

      if(benchmarkNps){renderNpsBenchmark();return}
      benchmarkNpsRequest++;

      if(!benchmarkModels.has(key)){
        const rows=D.selectionRows(state.snapshot,selection(),state.benchmarkSegment,true).filter(row=>D.finite(row.rating));
        const groups=D.groupBy(rows,row=>row.countryCode);
        const boards=Object.keys(groups).sort().map(code=>{
          const group=groups[code], weighted=state.benchmarkWeighted;
          const platforms=D.config.platforms.filter(platform=>group.some(row=>row.platform===platform));
          const content=weighted?renderPlatformBoard("Ponderado",D.benchmarkWeightedRows(group),platforms)
            :platforms.map(platform=>renderPlatformBoard(platform,group.filter(row=>row.platform===platform),[platform])).join("");

        }).join("");
        benchmarkModels.set(key,{boards:boards||U.empty("Benchmark sin datos","Selecciona otra geografía o benchmark."),groups});
      }
      $("benchmark-context").textContent=translate("Comparativa de ratings a {date}",{date:state.meta.dataDate?.split("-").reverse().join("-")||"—"});
      const {boards,groups}=benchmarkModels.get(key);
      $("benchmark-grid").innerHTML=boards;
      trackReady("benchmark","Mostrar ranking",started);
      const group=groups[state.country]||[];
      const filters=[["Fecha",state.meta.dataDate],["Tipo de entidad",D.config.segmentLabels[state.benchmarkSegment]],
        ["Ranking",state.benchmarkWeighted?"Ponderado":"Por market"]];
      exportSheets.benchmark.clear();
      const boardsForExport=state.benchmarkWeighted?[["Ponderado",D.benchmarkWeightedRows(group)]]:
        D.config.platforms.map(platform=>[platform,group.filter(row=>row.platform===platform)]);
      for(const [name,rows] of boardsForExport)setExportSheet("benchmark",name,state.country,filters,
        ["Posición","Aplicación","Rating","Variación a 30 días","Market"],
        D.rankRows(rows).map(row=>[row.computedRank,D.appName(row),row.rating,row.delta30d,row.storeUrl]));

    async function renderNpsBenchmark(){
      const token=++benchmarkNpsRequest, country=state.country, segment=state.benchmarkSegment;
      const scope={country,analysisMonth:state.meta.dataDate.slice(0,7)};
      const target=$("benchmark-grid");
      exportSheets.benchmark.clear();
      target.innerHTML=U.loading(translate("Cargando NPS de reseñas"));
      try{
        const data=await fetchReviewData("review:ranking",scope);
        if(token!==benchmarkNpsRequest||!benchmarkNps)return;
        const rows=D.selectionRows(state.snapshot,selection(),segment,true);
        const groups=D.groupBy(rows,row=>row.countryCode);
        target.innerHTML=Object.entries(groups).map(([code,apps])=>{
          const boards=D.config.platforms.map(platform=>{
            const unique=new Map(apps.filter(row=>row.platform===platform).map(row=>[D.appName(row),row]));
            const ranked=D.rankReviewNpsRows([...unique].map(([entity,row])=>{
              const point=data.rows.find(point=>point.country===code&&point.platform===platform&&point.entity===entity);
              return {...row,rating:point?.balance??null,total:point?.total||0,promoters:point?.promoters||0,detractors:point?.detractors||0,nps:true};
            }));
            setExportSheet("benchmark",countryLabel(code)+" · "+platform,code,
              [["Ranking","NPS de reseñas"],["Mes",scope.analysisMonth],["Tipo de entidad",D.config.segmentLabels[segment]]],
              ["Posición","Aplicación","NPS (pp)","Reseñas","Promotoras","Detractoras","Market"],
              ranked.map(row=>[row.computedRank,D.appName(row),row.rating,row.total,row.promoters,row.detractors,row.storeUrl]));
            return `<section class="platform-board"><header class="platform-head"><strong>${platformIcon(platform)}${U.esc(platform)}</strong></header><ol class="rank-list">${ranked.map(renderRankRow).join("")}</ol></section>`;
          }).join("");
          return `<article class="benchmark-country" aria-label="${U.esc(countryLabel(code))}">${country==="ALL"?`<h3>${U.esc(countryLabel(code))}</h3>`:""}<div class="platform-boards">${boards}</div></article>`;
        }).join("");
        $("benchmark-context").textContent=translate("NPS de reseñas")+" · "+monthLabel(scope.analysisMonth);
        appendReviewFreshness(target,data.timing);
      }catch(error){if(token===benchmarkNpsRequest)renderReviewRetry(target,error,renderBenchmark)}
    }
    const renderPlatformBoard=(platform,rows,icons)=>`<section class="platform-board"><header class="platform-head"><strong>${icons.map(platformIcon).join("")}${U.esc(translate(platform))}</strong><span>${rows.length} apps</span></header><ol class="rank-list">${D.rankRows(rows).map(renderRankRow).join("")}</ol></section>`;

    let reviewsRequest=0, reviewTotals, reviewPage=0, renderedReviewKey="", pendingReviewKey="";
    const radarFilters={};
    const reviewDay=(day,offset)=>new Date(Date.parse(day+"T00:00:00Z")+offset*86400000).toISOString().slice(0,10);
    function reviewDates(){
      const parts=Object.fromEntries(new Intl.DateTimeFormat("en-GB",{timeZone:"Europe/Madrid",year:"numeric",month:"2-digit",day:"2-digit"})
        .formatToParts(new Date()).map(({type,value})=>[type,value]));
      const end=`${parts.year}-${parts.month}-${parts.day}`;
      return {start:reviewDay(end,-365),end};
    }
    function reviewCountries(){
      const configured=state.meta?.countries.map(item=>item.code);
      const countries=configured?.length?configured:Object.keys(D.config.countries);
      return [...countries].sort((a,b)=>countryLabel(a).localeCompare(countryLabel(b),locale())).concat("UNKNOWN");
    }
    function defaultCommentCountry(){
      const countries=reviewCountries(), market=browserMarket();
      return countries.includes(market)?market:countries.includes("ES")?"ES":countries[0];
    }
    function initialComments(){
      const {end}=reviewDates();
      const [year,month]=end.split("-").map(Number);
      const days=new Date(Date.UTC(year,month,0)).getUTCDate();
      return {country:defaultCommentCountry(),platform:"ALL",start:reviewDay(end,1-days),end,segment:"",audience:"",sort:"",app:"BBVA Empresas"};
    }

    function annualDates(year){
      const today=reviewDates().end;
      return {start:year+"-01-01",end:year===today.slice(0,4)?today:year+"-12-31"};
    }

    // Preload the default scopes one at a time, without falling back to a historical Sheet scan.
    function warmViewsAfterBootstrap(){
      if(navigator.connection?.saveData)return;
      const steps=[
        ()=>fetchTrends(trendRequest(),true),
        ()=>fetchReviewData("review:page",{...reviewScope(),language:appLanguage,page:reviewPage},true),
        ()=>fetchReviewData("review:nps",annualNpsScope(annualScope()),true),
        ()=>{
          const rows=cachedTrendRows(trendRequest());
          if(!rows)return;
          const app=state.evolutionApp;
          if(!app)return;
          const period=D.periodModel(D.trendRows(withPublishedRatings(rows,selection()),{...selection(),app}),state.periodYear,state.periodMonth);
          const analysisMonth=period.period||reviewDates().end.slice(0,7);
          return fetchReviewData("review:analytics",{...monthlyReviewScope(analysisMonth),segment:$("monthly-review-segment").value},true);
        },
        ()=>fetchReviewData("review:analytics",annualReviewRequest(annualScope()),true)
      ];
      function schedule(){
        if(!steps.length)return;
        window.setTimeout(()=>{
          if(document.visibilityState!=="visible"){
            document.addEventListener("visibilitychange",schedule,{once:true});
            return;
          }
          if(activeRpc){schedule();return}
          const run=()=>{
            if(document.visibilityState!=="visible"||activeRpc){schedule();return}
            Promise.resolve().then(steps.shift()).catch(()=>{}).finally(schedule);
          };
          if(window.requestIdleCallback)window.requestIdleCallback(run,{timeout:2000});
          else run();
        },1200);
      }
      schedule();
    }

    function validateReviewDates({start,end}){
      $("review-end").setCustomValidity(start&&end&&start>end?"La fecha final debe ser posterior o igual a la inicial.":"");
    }
    function bindRadarFilters(){
      const create=(root,options)=>window.MarketRadarFilters.create(root,{translate,...options});
      const benchmarkDefaults=()=>({segment:"BANK",ranking:"MARKET"});
      radarFilters.benchmark=create($("benchmark-filters"),{
        initial:benchmarkDefaults,all:()=>({segment:"ALL",ranking:"MARKET"}),
        applied:()=>({segment:state.benchmarkSegment,ranking:benchmarkNps?"NPS":state.benchmarkWeighted?"WEIGHTED":"MARKET"}),
        alwaysChips:["segment","ranking"],
        commit:({segment,ranking})=>{
          state.benchmarkSegment=segment;state.benchmarkWeighted=ranking==="WEIGHTED";benchmarkNps=ranking==="NPS";
          renderDashboard();
        }
      });
      const common={labelValue:reviewFilterLabel,fixedChips:["start","end"]};
      radarFilters.analytics=create($("analytics-filters"),{
        initial:analyticsInitial,all:()=>({...analyticsInitial(),country:"ALL"}),applied:annualScope,
        alwaysChips:["country","year","audience","inferGeography"],fixedChips:["year"],
        labelValue:(key,value)=>{
          if(key!=="year")return reviewFilterLabel(key,value);
          const {start,end}=annualDates(value);
          const date=day=>day.split("-").reverse().join("/");
          return `${date(start)} – ${date(end)}`;
        },
        prepare:()=>{
          $("analytics-country").innerHTML=U.option("ALL","Todas")+reviewCountries().map(code=>U.option(code,countryLabel(code))).join("");
          const current=analyticsInitial().year;
          $("analytics-year").innerHTML=[current,...annualYears.filter(year=>year!==current)]
            .map(year=>U.option(year,year===current?"Año en curso":year)).join("");
        },
        commit:next=>{
          if(next.country!==annualScope().country||next.year!==annualScope().year)analyticsEntity=defaultAnalyticsEntity;
          analyticsSelection=next;
          loadAnalytics();
        }
      });
      radarFilters.reviews=create($("review-filters"),{
        ...common, initial:initialComments, all:allComments, applied:reviewScope, prepare:prepareReviewFilterOptions,
        alwaysChips:["platform","app","segment","topic","audience","inferGeography"], omitChips:["country"],
        validate:validateReviewDates,
        draftChanged:(field,values)=>{
          if(field==="country"||field==="platform"){
            prepareReviewApps(values,false);
            $("review-app").dispatchEvent(new Event("change",{bubbles:true}));
          }
        },
        commit:(next,action)=>{
          const current=reviewScope();
          updateReviewScope({...next,reviewKey:action?"":current.reviewKey||""},action==="restore"||action==="all");
        }
      });
      annualAppControl=window.MarketRadarFilters.searchable($("analytics-entity"));
      $("analytics-entity").addEventListener("change",event=>{
        analyticsEntity=event.target.value;
        loadAnalytics(true);
      });
      for(const [kind,id] of [["country","admin-filter-countries"],["platform","admin-filter-platforms"]]){
        $(id).innerHTML=adminFilterScopeOptions(kind).map(item=>U.option(item.value,item.label,false)).join("");
      }
      for(const tab of ["newsletter-access","feedback"]){
        const defaults=()=>tab==="feedback"?{period:"",vote:"",status:"",start:"",end:""}:{period:"",start:"",end:""};
        radarFilters[tab]=create($("admin-"+tab+"-filters"),{initial:defaults,all:defaults,
          applied:()=>newsletterFilters[tab]||defaults(),
          commit:filters=>{newsletterFilters[tab]=filters;loadAdminNewsletterInteractions(tab)}});
      }
      for(const [name,defaults,applied,commit] of [
        ["business",()=>({query:""}),()=>businessFilters,filters=>{businessFilters=filters;renderBusinessCatalog()}],
        ["log",()=>({query:"",start:"",end:""}),()=>logFilters,filters=>{logFilters=filters;logPage=0;renderAdminLog(false)}]
      ])radarFilters[name]=create($("admin-"+name+"-filters"),{initial:defaults,all:defaults,applied,commit});
      const adoptionDefaults=()=>({query:""});
      radarFilters.adoption=create($("admin-adoption-filters"),{initial:adoptionDefaults,all:adoptionDefaults,
        applied:()=>adoptionFilters,commit:filters=>{
          adoptionFilters=filters;adoptionPage=0;renderAdminAdoption(state.adminCenter?.usage);
        }});
      radarFilters.admin=create($("subscriber-filters"),{
        applied:()=>state.adminSubscriberFilters, initial:initialSubscribers, all:initialSubscribers,
        choose:(_,current,value)=>nextAdminScopeSelection(current,value),
        commit:next=>{
          state.adminSubscriberFilters=next;subscriberPage=0;
          radarFilters.admin.render();
          renderAdminSubscribers(state.adminCenter?.subscribers||[]);
        }
      });
    }
    function reviewFilterLabel(key,value){
      if(key==="sort")return translate(value==="HELPFUL"?"Más útiles":"Más recientes");
      if(key==="inferGeography")return translate(value==="NO"?"No":"Sí");
      if(key==="audience")return translate(["BEI","BEI_ONLY","BEI_EXTENDED"].includes(value)?"BEI":"Todos");
      if(key==="country")return value==="ALL"?"Todas":countryLabel(value);
      if(key==="segment")return translate(value?(state.reviewSegments?.find(group=>group.id===value)?.label||value):"Todas las reseñas");
      if(!value&&["app","topic"].includes(key))return "Todos";
      if(key==="platform")return D.config.platformLabels[value];
      if(key==="start"||key==="end")return dateLabel(value);
      if(key==="topic")return reviewTopics[value];
    }
    function updateReviewScope(next,resetCohort=false){
      const current=reviewScope();
      if(!reviewCountries().includes(next.country))next={...next,country:current.country};
      if(next.country!==current.country&&next.reviewKey)next={...next,reviewKey:""};
      if(next.app&&next.app!=="BBVA Empresas"&&(next.country!==current.country||next.platform!==current.platform)
          &&!reviewApps(next).includes(next.app))next={...next,app:""};
      reviewDrilldown=!resetCohort&&reviewDrilldown?{scope:next,label:"Filtros ajustados"}:null;
      reviewSelection=next;
      loadReviews();
    }
    function reviewApps(scope){
      return [...new Set(D.selectionRows(state.snapshot,{...scope,country:scope.country==="UNKNOWN"?"ALL":scope.country},"ALL").filter(row=>row.platform!=="Huawei").map(D.appName))];
    }
    function prepareReviewApps(scope,keepHistorical){
      const apps=reviewApps(scope);
      // A drill-down can point to a historical app no longer present in today's snapshot.
      if(keepHistorical&&scope.app&&!apps.includes(scope.app))apps.push(scope.app);
      $("review-app").innerHTML=U.option("","Todas",!apps.includes(scope.app))+apps.sort()
        .map(name=>U.option(name,name,name===scope.app)).join("");
    }
    function prepareReviewFilterOptions(){
      $("review-country").innerHTML=reviewCountries().map(code=>U.option(code,countryLabel(code))).join("");
      $("review-platform").innerHTML=["ALL",...D.config.platforms].map(key=>U.option(key,D.config.platformLabels[key])).join("");
      const {end}=reviewDates();
      for(const name of ["start","end"])$(`review-${name}`).max=end;
      prepareReviewApps(reviewScope(),true);
      $("review-topic").innerHTML=U.option("","Todos",false)+Object.entries(reviewTopics)
        .map(([id,label])=>U.option(id,label,false)).join("");
    }
    async function prepareReviewSegments(control){
      if(control.options.length)return;
      reviewSegments ||= callServer("reviews:segments").catch(error=>{reviewSegments=null;throw error});
      const groups=await reviewSegments;
      if(!control.options.length){
        control.innerHTML=U.option("","Ver todo",false)+groups.map(group=>U.option(group.id,group.label,false)).join("");
        control.value=reviewScope().segment||"";
        radarFilters.reviews.refresh();
      }
    }
    function openReviewCohort(scope,label){
      const territorial=reviewCountries().includes(scope.country);
      reviewDrilldown=territorial?{scope:{...scope},label}:{
        scope:{...scope,country:reviewScope().country,reviewKey:""},
        label:translate("Detalle por geografía")
      };
      reviewPage=0;
      activateView("reviews");
    }
    async function loadReviews(page=0){
      const started=performance.now(), scope=reviewScope(), request={...scope,language:appLanguage,page};
      const label=reviewDrilldown?.label||"", key=JSON.stringify([reviewResponseKey("review:page",request),label]);
      if(pendingReviewKey===key)return;
      const sameView=renderedReviewKey===key, cached=hasReviewResponse("review:page",request);
      if(sameView&&cached){trackReady("reviews","Mostrar comentarios",started);return}
      const token=++reviewsRequest, results=$("review-results"), pagination=$("review-pagination");
      const countKey=JSON.stringify(Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(scope).filter(([field])=>field!=="country")));
      reviewPage=page;
      pendingReviewKey=key;
      if(!sameView){
        renderedReviewKey="";
        reviewsReady=false;
        renderReviewMarkets({counts:reviewTotals?.key===countKey?reviewTotals.counts:null},scope);
        radarFilters.reviews.render();
        if(!cached){
          results.setAttribute("aria-busy","true");
          results.innerHTML=U.loading(translate("Cargando comentarios"));
          pagination.replaceChildren();
        }
      }
      try{
        await prepareReviewSegments($("review-segment"));
        if(token!==reviewsRequest)return;
        const data=await fetchReviewData("review:page",request);
        if(token!==reviewsRequest)return;
        $("review-filter-status").textContent=label;
        reviewTopics=data.topics||{};
        reviewTotals={key:countKey,counts:data.counts};
        renderReviewMarkets(data,scope);
        reviewsReady=data.total>0;
        radarFilters.reviews.render();
        results.innerHTML=data.rows.map(row=>renderReviewCard(row,reviewTopics)).join("")||U.empty("Sin comentarios","No hay reseñas para esta selección.");
        appendReviewFreshness(results,data.timing);
        renderedReviewKey=key;
        trackReady("reviews","Mostrar comentarios",started);
        if(data.total<=data.size){pagination.replaceChildren();return}
        pagination.innerHTML=`${data.page>0?'<button class="alert-button secondary" type="button" data-step="-1">Anterior</button>':""}
          <span>${U.esc(translate("{count} reseñas · Página {page} de {pages}",{count:integer(data.total),page:data.page+1,pages:Math.ceil(data.total/data.size)}))}</span>
          ${(data.page+1)*data.size<data.total?'<button class="alert-button secondary" type="button" data-step="1">Siguiente</button>':""}`;
        pagination.onclick=event=>{const step=event.target.closest("[data-step]")?.dataset.step;if(step)loadReviews(data.page+Number(step))};
      }catch(error){
        if(token!==reviewsRequest||sameView||state.view!=="reviews")return;
        const retry=document.createElement("button");
        retry.type="button";
        retry.className="alert-button secondary";
        retry.textContent=translate("Reintentar");
        retry.onclick=()=>loadReviews(page);
        results.replaceChildren(error.message,retry);
      }
      finally{if(token===reviewsRequest){pendingReviewKey="";results.setAttribute("aria-busy","false")}}
    }
    function renderReviewMarkets(data,scope){
      const android = state.snapshot.filter(row=>row.platform==="Android"&&(!scope.app||D.appName(row)===scope.app));
      const shared = scope.platform!=="iOS" && android.some(row=>row.countryCode===scope.country&&row.volumeScope==="SHARED_LISTING");
      const markets=reviewCountries().filter(code=>code!=="UNKNOWN"||scope.country==="UNKNOWN"||shared);
      renderGeographyTabs($("review-markets"),markets,scope.country,
        code=>{if(code!==scope.country)updateReviewScope({...scope,country:code,audience:""})},data.counts);
    }
    function renderGeographyTabs(target,codes,country,onSelect,counts){
      const focusedMarket=document.activeElement?.dataset.market;
      const previousScroll=target.scrollLeft;
      target.innerHTML=codes.map(code=>{
        const label=code==="ALL"?translate("Todas"):countryLabel(code);
        return `<button type="button" class="geography-tab" data-market="${U.esc(code)}" aria-pressed="${country===code}">${code==="UNKNOWN"?platformIcon("Android"):geographyFlag(code)}${U.esc(label)}${counts?`<span class="geography-count">${integer(counts[code]||0)}</span>`:""}</button>`;
      }).join("");
      target.onclick=event=>{
        const code=event.target.closest("[data-market]")?.dataset.market;
        if(code)onSelect(code);
      };
      if(focusedMarket)[...target.children].find(button=>button.dataset.market===focusedMarket)?.focus({preventScroll:true});
      target.scrollLeft=previousScroll;
      const selected=target.querySelector('[aria-pressed="true"]');
      if(selected){
        const bounds=target.getBoundingClientRect(), item=selected.getBoundingClientRect();
        if(item.right>bounds.right)target.scrollLeft+=item.right-bounds.right;
        if(item.left<bounds.left)target.scrollLeft+=item.left-bounds.left;
      }
    }
    function platformIcon(platform){

    }
    function geographyFlag(code,label=""){
