    }
    function entityLogo(name,country,platform){
      const candidates=state.snapshot.filter(row=>D.appName(row)===name);
      const row=candidates.find(row=>row.countryCode===country&&row.platform===platform)
        ||candidates.find(row=>row.countryCode===country)||candidates[0];
      return appLogo(row||{appName:name});
    }
    function renderReviewCard(row,topics={}){
      const [country]=row.countries, entity=row.entities?.[0]||row.app;
      const platformIcon=window.MarketPlatformIcons[row.platform];
      const stars="★".repeat(row.rating)+"☆".repeat(5-row.rating);
      const sentiment=state.reviewSegments?.find(group=>group.stars.includes(row.rating))?.id.toLowerCase()||"";
      const author=U.esc(row.author||translate("Autor no disponible"));
      const link=row.url?`<a href="${U.esc(row.url)}" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">${author}</a>`:author;
      const blocks=(row.blocks.length?row.blocks:["general"]).map(id=>topics[id]||(id==="general"?"Generalista":"")).filter(Boolean);
      return `<article class="review-card review-${sentiment}">
        <header class="review-card-head"><span class="review-stars" aria-label="${U.esc(translate("{rating} de 5 estrellas",{rating:row.rating}))}">${stars}</span>
          <div class="review-identity">${platformIcon?`<img src="${platformIcon}" alt="${U.esc(row.platform)}">`:""}${entityLogo(entity,country,row.platform)}
          ${country==="UNKNOWN"?`<small>${U.esc(countryLabel(country))}</small>`:country?geographyFlag(country,countryLabel(country)):row.sharedListing?"<small>Ficha compartida</small>":""}</div></header>
        <div><span data-review-content>${link}</span> · <strong data-review-content>${U.esc(entity)}</strong> <time datetime="${U.esc(row.date)}">${U.esc(dateLabel(row.date))}</time></div>
        ${row.title?`<h4 data-review-content>${U.esc(row.title)}</h4>`:""}<p data-review-content>${U.esc(row.text)}</p>
        ${row.translated?`<details><summary>Ver original</summary><p data-review-content>${U.esc(row.original)}</p></details>`:""}
        ${Number.isInteger(row.helpful)?`<small>${U.esc(translate("{count} personas han encontrado útil esta reseña",{count:integer(row.helpful)}))}</small>`:""}
        <div class="review-blocks radar-filters">${row.attributionMethod?.startsWith("review_evidence_")?'<span class="filter-chip">Inferido</span>':""}${blocks.map(block=>`<span class="filter-chip">Bloque funcional · ${U.esc(block)}</span>`).join("")}</div>
        ${row.reply?`<blockquote><strong>${U.esc(row.replyAuthor||entity)}</strong> ${row.replyDate?`<time datetime="${U.esc(row.replyDate)}">${U.esc(dateLabel(row.replyDate.slice(0,10)))}</time>`:""}<p>${U.esc(row.reply)}</p></blockquote>`:""}</article>`;
    }
    const annualReviewRequest=(scope,entity=analyticsEntity)=>({...scope,segment:heatmapSegment,entity,language:appLanguage});
    const annualNpsScope=scope=>({country:scope.country,year:scope.year,audience:scope.audience,inferGeography:scope.inferGeography});
    let pendingAnalyticsKey="",renderedAnalyticsKey="";
    async function loadAnalytics(localOnly=false, heatmapOnly=false){
      hideChartTooltip();
      const started=performance.now(), scope=annualScope(), dates=annualDates(scope.year);
      const key=JSON.stringify([annualReviewRequest(scope),dates.end]);
      if(pendingAnalyticsKey===key)return;
      const sameView=renderedAnalyticsKey===key;
      if(!localOnly&&!heatmapOnly&&sameView&&hasReviewResponse("review:analytics",annualReviewRequest(scope))){
        trackReady("analytics","Mostrar análisis anual",started);return;
      }
      // A changed scope must replace all panels still waiting for a superseded request.
      if(analyticsLoading){localOnly=false;heatmapOnly=false}
      const request=annualReviewRequest(scope,heatmapOnly?defaultAnalyticsEntity:analyticsEntity);
      const cached=hasReviewResponse("review:analytics",request);
      const showLoading=!sameView&&!cached;
      if(!sameView)renderedAnalyticsKey="";
      pendingAnalyticsKey=key;
      analyticsLoading=true;
      const sheets=exportSheets.analytics;
      if(!sameView&&!localOnly)sheets.delete("Mapa de calor");
      if(!sameView&&!heatmapOnly){sheets.delete("Rating al cierre del mes");sheets.delete("Indicadores del periodo");sheets.delete("Reseñas más útiles");sheets.delete("Personas con más reseñas")}
      const token=++analyticsRequest, target=$("review-heatmap"), entityControl=$("analytics-entity");
      const period=annualPeriodLabel(scope.year);
      $("annual-rating-title").textContent=translate("Evolución del rating {period}",{period});
      $("annual-nps-title").textContent=translate("Evolución del NPS de reseñas {period}",{period});
      $("annual-indicators-title").textContent=scope.year===reviewDates().end.slice(0,4)
        ?translate("Indicadores del acumulado del año hasta la fecha"):translate("Indicadores de {year}",{year:scope.year});
      radarFilters.analytics.render();
      if(!localOnly&&showLoading){
        target.setAttribute("aria-busy","true");
        const matrix=target.querySelector("[data-matrix]");
        if(matrix){matrix.innerHTML=U.loading(translate("Cargando el mapa de calor"));target.querySelector("[data-pages]").replaceChildren()}
        else target.innerHTML=U.loading(translate("Cargando el mapa de calor"));
      }
      if(!heatmapOnly){
        const trends=annualTrendRequest(scope);
        if(!sameView&&scope.country!=="UNKNOWN"&&!cachedTrendRows(trends)){
          $("annual-chart").innerHTML=U.loading(translate("Cargando el histórico de ratings"));
          $("annual-series").replaceChildren();
        }
        if(showLoading)$("review-annual").innerHTML=U.loading(translate("Cargando indicadores de reseñas"));
        loadAnnualNps(scope,dates);
      }
      try{
        const trends=heatmapOnly||scope.country==="UNKNOWN"?[]:fetchTrends(annualTrendRequest(scope));
        const chartReady=Promise.resolve(trends).then(rows=>{
          if(token!==analyticsRequest||heatmapOnly)return;
          annualTrends=scope.country==="UNKNOWN"?[]:withPublishedRatings(rows,{country:scope.country,platform:"ALL"});
          renderAnnualChart(scope,dates,analyticsEntity);
          trackReady("analytics","Mostrar histórico de ratings",started);
        });
        const [data]=await Promise.all([
          fetchReviewData("review:analytics",request),
          chartReady
        ]);
        if(token!==analyticsRequest)return;
        if(!localOnly)renderReviewMatrix(target,data,{...dates,country:scope.country,platform:"ALL",segment:heatmapSegment,audience:scope.audience,inferGeography:scope.inferGeography});
        if(!localOnly)appendReviewFreshness(target,data.timing);
        if(!heatmapOnly){
          if(scope.country!=="UNKNOWN")annualYears=[...new Set(annualTrends.filter(row=>D.finite(row.ratingEom)).map(row=>row.month.slice(0,4)))].sort().reverse();
          const apps=new Set(data.entityOptions);
          for(const row of annualTrends)if(row.month.startsWith(scope.year)&&D.finite(row.ratingEom))apps.add(D.appName(row));
          apps.delete(defaultAnalyticsEntity);
          const compareCountry=isAnnualCountry(scope.country);
          const options=[...(compareCountry?["ALL"]:[]),defaultAnalyticsEntity,...[...apps].sort((a,b)=>a.localeCompare(b,locale()))];
          if(!options.includes(analyticsEntity)){
            analyticsEntity=defaultAnalyticsEntity;
            analyticsLoading=false;
            pendingAnalyticsKey="";
            return loadAnalytics(true);
          }
          entityControl.innerHTML=options.map(name=>U.option(name,name===defaultAnalyticsEntity?"BBVA":annualEntityLabel(name),name===analyticsEntity)).join("");
          annualAppControl.refresh();
          renderAnnualReviews($("review-annual"),data,scope);
          appendReviewFreshness($("review-annual"),data.timing);
        }
        renderedAnalyticsKey=key;
        trackReady("analytics",heatmapOnly?"Mostrar mapa de calor":"Mostrar análisis anual",started);
      }catch(error){
        if(token!==analyticsRequest)return;
        renderedAnalyticsKey="";
        if(!localOnly)renderReviewRetry(target.querySelector("[data-matrix]")||target,error,()=>loadAnalytics());
        if(!heatmapOnly&&$("annual-chart").querySelector(".loading-state"))$("annual-chart").textContent=error.message;
        if(!heatmapOnly)renderReviewRetry($("review-annual"),error,()=>loadAnalytics())
      }finally{
        if(token===analyticsRequest){
          target.setAttribute("aria-busy","false");
          analyticsLoading=false;
          pendingAnalyticsKey="";
          annualAppControl.enable(Boolean(entityControl.options.length));
        }
      }
    }
    function withPublishedRatings(rows,scope){
      const month=state.meta.dataDate?.slice(0,7);
      if(!month)return rows;
      const published=D.selectionRows(state.snapshot,scope,"ALL").filter(row=>D.finite(row.rating));
      const keys=new Set(published.map(row=>row.appKey));
      return [...rows.filter(row=>row.month!==month||!keys.has(row.appKey)),...published.map(row=>({...row,month,ratingEom:row.rating,ratingCountEom:row.ratingCount}))];
    }
    const isAnnualCountry=country=>country!=="ALL"&&country!=="UNKNOWN";
    const annualEntityLabel=app=>app==="ALL"?"Todas las aplicaciones del país":app;
    function renderAnnualChart(scope,dates,app){
      hideChartTooltip();
      if(scope.country==="UNKNOWN"){
        $("annual-chart").textContent=translate("Sin datos de ratings para esta geografía");
        $("annual-series").replaceChildren();
        return;
      }
      const months=Array.from({length:Number(dates.end.slice(5,7))},(_,index)=>`${scope.year}-${String(index+1).padStart(2,"0")}`);
      const compareCountry=app==="ALL"&&isAnnualCountry(scope.country);
      const rows=D.trendRows(annualTrends,{country:scope.country,platform:"ALL",app:compareCountry?"":app})
        .filter(row=>row.month.startsWith(scope.year)&&D.finite(row.ratingEom));
      const series=D.prepareSeries(rows,{country:scope.country,platform:"ALL"});
      const chart=C.lineChart(series,{...chartOptions(months.at(-1),"annual"),months,maxSeries:compareCountry?series.length:undefined,context:countryLabel(scope.country)});
      $("annual-chart").innerHTML=chart.svg;
      renderSeriesSummary(chart.series,months.at(-1));
      if(chart.series.length){
        const points=chart.series.map(item=>new Map(item.points.map(point=>[point.month,point.value])));
        setExportSheet("analytics","Rating al cierre del mes",scope.country,[...exportDates(dates),["Aplicación",annualEntityLabel(app)]],
          ["Mes",...chart.series.map(item=>item.label)],months.map(month=>[month,...points.map(values=>values.get(month))]),true);
      }
    }
    function annualPeriodLabel(year){
      return year===reviewDates().end.slice(0,4)?translate("en el acumulado del año hasta la fecha"):translate("en {year}",{year});
    }
    async function loadAnnualNps(scope,dates){
      const request=annualNpsScope(scope);
      const key=JSON.stringify(request), token=++annualNpsRequest, started=performance.now();
      const target=$("annual-nps-chart");
      $("review-balance-period").textContent=`${dateLabel(dates.start)} – ${dateLabel(dates.end)}`;
      const reusable=key===annualNpsKey&&annualNpsData&&hasReviewResponse("review:nps",request);
      if(!reusable){
        resizeReviewBalance=null;
        exportSheets.analytics.delete("Evolución del NPS de reseñas");
        if(!hasReviewResponse("review:nps",request))target.innerHTML=U.loading(translate("Cargando NPS de reseñas"));
        target.setAttribute("aria-busy","true");
      }else renderAnnualNps(scope,dates,annualNpsData,analyticsEntity);
      try{
        const data=await fetchReviewData("review:nps",request);
        if(token!==annualNpsRequest)return;
        if(!reusable||data!==annualNpsData)renderAnnualNps(scope,dates,data,analyticsEntity);
        annualNpsKey=key;
        annualNpsData=data;
        trackReady("analytics","Mostrar gráfico anual de NPS",started);
      }catch(error){
        if(token!==annualNpsRequest)return;
        if(!reusable)renderReviewRetry(target,error,()=>loadAnnualNps(scope,dates));
      }finally{
        if(token===annualNpsRequest)target.setAttribute("aria-busy","false");
      }
    }
    function renderAnnualNps(scope,dates,data,app){
      const compare=app==="ALL"&&isAnnualCountry(scope.country);
      const target=$("annual-nps-chart");
      const filtered=data.monthly.filter(point=>compare||point.entity===app);
      const monthlyEntityOptions=[...new Set(filtered.map(point=>point.entity))]
        .sort((a,b)=>Number(b===defaultAnalyticsEntity)-Number(a===defaultAnalyticsEntity)||a.localeCompare(b,locale()));
      resizeReviewBalance=renderReviewBalance(target,{monthly:filtered,monthlyEntityOptions},dates,compare);
      appendReviewFreshness(target,data.timing);
      const name="Evolución del NPS de reseñas";
      exportSheets.analytics.delete(name);
      if(!monthlyEntityOptions.length)return;
      const months=Array.from({length:Number(dates.end.slice(5,7))},(_,i)=>`${scope.year}-${String(i+1).padStart(2,"0")}`);
      const points=new Map(filtered.map(row=>[JSON.stringify([row.entity,row.month]),row.balance]));
      setExportSheet("analytics",name,scope.country,
        [...exportDates(dates),["Aplicación",annualEntityLabel(app)],["Comentarios",reviewFilterLabel("audience",scope.audience)],
          ["Inferir datos",reviewFilterLabel("inferGeography",scope.inferGeography)]],
        ["Mes",...monthlyEntityOptions.map(entity=>entity+" (pp)")],
        months.map(month=>[month,...monthlyEntityOptions.map(entity=>points.get(JSON.stringify([entity,month])))]),true);
    }
    async function loadMonthlyReviews(period){
      const started=performance.now(), current=reviewDates().end.slice(0,7);
      const analysisMonth=period||current;
      const balanceScope=monthlyReviewScope(analysisMonth);
      const balanceKey=JSON.stringify(balanceScope);
      const scope={...balanceScope,segment:$("monthly-review-segment").value};
      const key=JSON.stringify(scope);
      if(key===monthlyReviewKey&&(monthlyReviewsLoading||Date.now()-monthlyReviewLoadedAt<reviewResponseTtl))return;
      monthlyReviewKey=key;
      monthlyReviewsLoading=true;
      for(const name of ["Brechas","Ejemplos del mes"])exportSheets.evolution.delete(name);
      const token=++monthlyRequest, gaps=$("review-deltas"), examples=$("review-examples");
      const gapPanel=$("review-gap-panel");
      if(balanceKey!==monthlyBalanceKey){
        monthlyBalanceKey="";
        exportSheets.evolution.delete("NPS de reseñas");
        exportSheets.evolution.delete("Comparativa NPS");
      }
      gapPanel.classList.remove("hidden");
      gapPanel.setAttribute("aria-busy","true");
      if(!hasReviewResponse("review:analytics",scope)){
        gaps.innerHTML=U.loading(translate("Cargando brechas y ejemplos"),"");
        examples.replaceChildren();
        $("review-examples-panel").classList.add("hidden");
      }
      try{
        const data=await fetchReviewData("review:analytics",scope);
        if(token!==monthlyRequest)return;
        const applied={country:scope.country,platform:scope.platform,start:data.window.start,end:data.window.end,segment:"",audience:scope.audience,inferGeography:scope.inferGeography};
        if(balanceKey!==monthlyBalanceKey){
          const {nps}=data;
          monthlyPulse={key:balanceKey,points:data.monthlyByGeography||[]};
          renderMonthlyMatrix(analysisMonth,withPublishedRatings(state.trends,selection()));
          const filters=[...exportDates(applied),["Mes",analysisMonth],["Aplicación",scope.entity],["Comentarios",reviewFilterLabel("audience",scope.audience)],["Inferir datos",scope.inferGeography==="NO"?"No":"Sí"]];
          setExportSheet("evolution","Comparativa NPS",scope.country,filters,
            ["Desde","Hasta","NPS de reseñas","Desde (mes anterior)","Hasta (mes anterior)","NPS anterior","Variación (pp)"],
            [[nps.start,nps.end,nps.current,nps.previousStart,nps.previousEnd,nps.previous,nps.delta]]);
          setExportSheet("evolution","NPS de reseñas",scope.country,filters,
            ["Mes","Entidad","NPS (pp)","Promotoras","Detractoras","Reseñas","Geografía inferida o validada"],
            data.monthly.map(row=>[row.month,row.entity,row.balance,row.promoters,row.detractors,row.total,row.assignedGeography]));
          monthlyBalanceKey=balanceKey;
        }
        if(data.deltas.length)renderReviewGaps(gaps,data,{...applied,app:scope.entity,segment:scope.segment});
        else gaps.innerHTML=U.empty(translate("Sin reseñas para este sentimiento"),translate("Elige otro sentimiento para consultar las brechas y los ejemplos del mes."));
        appendReviewFreshness(gaps,data.timing);
        $("review-examples-title").textContent=analysisMonth===current?"Ejemplos del mes en curso":"Ejemplos del mes seleccionado";
        $("review-examples-panel").classList.toggle("hidden",!data.examples.length);
        examples.innerHTML=data.examples.map(({review})=>renderReviewCard(review,data.topics)).join("");
        const recentFilters=[...exportDates({start:data.window.recent,end:applied.end}),["Mes",analysisMonth],
          ["Aplicación",scope.entity],["Comentarios",reviewFilterLabel("audience",scope.audience)],["Inferir datos",scope.inferGeography==="NO"?"No":"Sí"],["Sentimiento",reviewFilterLabel("segment",scope.segment)]];
        setExportSheet("evolution","Brechas",scope.country,recentFilters,
          reviewGapColumns.map(column=>column.label),data.deltas.map(row=>reviewGapColumns.map(column=>column.value(row))));
        setExportSheet("evolution","Ejemplos del mes",scope.country,recentFilters,reviewExportHeader,
          data.examples.map(({review})=>reviewExportRow(review,data.topics)));
        monthlyReviewLoadedAt=Date.now();
        trackReady("evolution","Mostrar reseñas mensuales",started);
      }catch(error){
        if(token!==monthlyRequest)return;
        monthlyReviewKey="";
        if(balanceKey!==monthlyBalanceKey){
          monthlyPulse={key:balanceKey,points:[]};
          renderMonthlyMatrix(analysisMonth,withPublishedRatings(state.trends,selection()));
        }
        renderReviewRetry(gaps,error,()=>loadMonthlyReviews(analysisMonth));
      }finally{
        if(token===monthlyRequest){
          monthlyReviewsLoading=false;
          gapPanel.setAttribute("aria-busy","false");
        }
      }
    }
    function renderAnnualReviews(target,{annual,topics},scope){
      const showRatings=scope.country!=="UNKNOWN"&&analyticsEntity!=="ALL";
      const rows=showRatings?D.trendRows(annualTrends,{country:scope.country,platform:"ALL",app:analyticsEntity}):[];
      const months=D.availablePeriods(rows.filter(row=>D.finite(row.ratingEom)));
      const selected=months.filter(month=>month.startsWith(scope.year));
      const priorClose=(Number(scope.year)-1)+"-12";
      const opening=selected.length&&(months.includes(priorClose)?priorClose:selected[0]);
      const closing=selected.at(-1);
      const openingRating=D.ratingAt(rows,opening,scope.country==="ALL");
      const closingRating=D.ratingAt(rows,closing,scope.country==="ALL");
      const difference=(a,b)=>D.finite(a)&&D.finite(b)?a-b:null;
      const share=count=>annual.total?fmt(100*count/annual.total,1)+" %":"";
      const groups=[
        {title:"Volumen de reseñas",stats:[
          {label:"Reseñas del año seleccionado",number:annual.total,delta:difference(annual.total,annual.previousTotal)},
          {label:"Reseñas del año anterior",number:annual.previousTotal}
        ]},
        ...(showRatings?[{title:"Evolución del rating",stats:[
          {label:"Rating al inicio del periodo",number:openingRating,rating:true,foot:opening?monthLabel(opening):""},
          {label:"Último rating publicado del periodo",number:closingRating,rating:true,foot:closing?monthLabel(closing):"",delta:difference(closingRating,openingRating)}
        ]}]:[]),
        {title:"Distribución por sentimiento",stats:[
          {label:"Promotoras",number:annual.promoters,valueClass:"delta-up",foot:share(annual.promoters)},
          {label:"Neutras",number:annual.neutral,valueClass:"review-neutral-value",foot:share(annual.neutral)},
          {label:"Detractoras",number:annual.detractors,valueClass:"delta-down",foot:share(annual.detractors)}
        ]},
        {title:"Interacción con las reseñas",stats:[
          {label:"Reseñas contestadas",number:annual.answered,foot:share(annual.answered)},
          {label:"Reseñas útiles",number:annual.helpful,foot:share(annual.helpful)}
        ]}
      ];
      const authors=annual.topAuthors.filter(row=>row.count>1);
      const currentYear=scope.year===reviewDates().end.slice(0,4);
      const helpfulTitle=currentYear
        ?translate("Reseñas más útiles del acumulado del año hasta la fecha")
        :translate("Reseñas más útiles del {year}",{year:scope.year});
      const authorsTitle=currentYear
        ?translate("Personas con más reseñas del acumulado del año hasta la fecha")
        :translate("Personas con más reseñas de {year}",{year:scope.year});
      const filters=[...exportDates(annual),["Aplicación",annualEntityLabel(analyticsEntity)],["Comentarios",reviewFilterLabel("audience",scope.audience)],["Inferir datos",scope.inferGeography==="NO"?"No":"Sí"]];
      setExportSheet("analytics","Indicadores del periodo",scope.country,filters,["Indicador","Valor","Variación","Cierre"],
        annual.total||annual.previousTotal||D.finite(openingRating)||D.finite(closingRating)?
          groups.flatMap(({stats})=>stats.map(({label,number,delta,rating,foot})=>[label,number,delta,rating?foot:""])):[]);
      setExportSheet("analytics","Reseñas más útiles",scope.country,[...filters,["Votos útiles mínimos",annual.helpfulMinimum]],
        reviewExportHeader,annual.topHelpful.map(review=>reviewExportRow(review,topics)));
      setExportSheet("analytics","Personas con más reseñas",scope.country,filters,["Persona","Reseñas"],
        authors.map(({author,count})=>[author,count]));
      const metrics=groups.map(({title,stats})=>`<section class="annual-metric-group"><h4>${U.esc(translate(title))}</h4>
        <div class="annual-metric-grid">${U.metrics(stats.map(({number,rating,delta,foot,...item})=>{
          const change=D.finite(delta)?signed(delta,rating?2:0):"";
          return {...item,value:rating?fmt(number,2):integer(number),
            foot:[foot,change].filter(Boolean).join(" · "),footClass:item.accent?"":delta>0?"delta-up":delta<0?"delta-down":""};
        }))}</div></section>`).join("");
      target.innerHTML=`<p class="review-chart-note">${U.esc(dateLabel(annual.start))} – ${U.esc(dateLabel(annual.end))} · <span>Todas las estrellas</span></p>
        <div class="annual-kpis">${metrics}</div>
        ${annual.topHelpful.length?`<section class="annual-review-section"><h4>${U.esc(helpfulTitle)}</h4><p>${U.esc(translate("Al menos {count} votos útiles",{count:integer(annual.helpfulMinimum)}))}</p>
          ${annual.topHelpful.map(review=>renderReviewCard(review,topics)).join("")}</section>`:""}
        ${authors.length?`<section class="annual-review-section"><h4>${U.esc(authorsTitle)}</h4><div class="annual-author-list">
          ${authors.map(({author,count,reviews=[]})=>`<details class="annual-author">
            <summary><span data-review-content>${U.esc(author)}</span><strong>${U.esc(translate("{count} reseñas",{count:integer(count)}))}</strong></summary>
            <div class="annual-author-reviews">
              ${count>reviews.length?`<p>${U.esc(translate("Últimas {count} reseñas del periodo",{count:integer(reviews.length)}))}</p>`:""}
              ${reviews.map(review=>renderReviewCard(review,topics)).join("")}
            </div></details>`).join("")}</div></section>`:""}`;
    }
    const reviewGapPercent=value=>`${fmt(value,1)} %`;
    const reviewGapColumns=[
      {label:"Bloque",value:row=>row.label},
      {label:"Peso en la muestra",value:row=>row.weight,format:reviewGapPercent},
      {label:"Reseñas del bloque",value:row=>row.total,format:integer},
      {label:"Geografía inferida o validada",value:row=>row.assignedGeography,format:integer},
      {label:"Reseñas detractoras",value:row=>row.detractors,format:integer},
      {label:"% Promotoras",value:row=>100*row.promoters/row.total,format:reviewGapPercent},
      {label:"% Detractoras",value:row=>100*row.detractors/row.total,format:reviewGapPercent},
      {label:"NPS (pp)",value:row=>row.balance,format:value=>fmt(value,1)},
      {label:"Brecha vs. base (pp)",value:row=>row.gap,format:value=>value===null?"—":signed(value)}
    ];
    function renderReviewGaps(target,data,scope){
      const {baseline,deltas,recentTotal,window:dates}=data;
      const recent=`${dateLabel(dates.recent)} – ${dateLabel(dates.end)}`;
      target.replaceChildren();
      const note=document.createElement("p");
      note.textContent=translate("Periodo reciente: {dates} · {sentiment} · {count} reseñas. Una reseña puede pertenecer a varios bloques; sus pesos pueden sumar más del 100 %.",{
        dates:recent,sentiment:reviewFilterLabel("segment",scope.segment),count:integer(recentTotal)
      });
      target.append(note);
      if(baseline){
        const reference=document.createElement("p");
        reference.className="review-chart-note";
        reference.textContent=translate("Base del mes anterior: {dates} · {total} reseñas · NPS {nps} pp.",{
          dates:`${dateLabel(baseline.start)} – ${dateLabel(baseline.end)}`,total:integer(baseline.total),nps:fmt(baseline.balance,2)
        });
        target.append(reference);
        appendReviewCohort(target,"Ver reseñas del mes anterior",{...scope,start:baseline.start,end:baseline.end,segment:""});
      }
      target.insertAdjacentHTML("beforeend",C.reviewGaps(deltas,fmt,translate));
      const table=document.createElement("div");
      table.className="admin-table-wrap review-gap-table";
      const headers=reviewGapColumns.map(column=>`<th scope="col">${U.esc(translate(column.label))}</th>`).join("");
      const metrics=reviewGapColumns.slice(1);
      table.innerHTML=`<table class="admin-table"><caption>${U.esc(translate("Detalle del periodo reciente · {dates}",{dates:recent}))}</caption><thead><tr>${headers}</tr></thead><tbody>${deltas.map(row=>`<tr><th scope="row"></th>${metrics.map(column=>`<td>${U.esc(column.format(column.value(row)))}</td>`).join("")}</tr>`).join("")}</tbody></table>`;
      table.querySelectorAll("tbody th").forEach((cell,index)=>{
        const row=deltas[index];
        appendReviewCohort(cell,row.label,{...scope,start:dates.recent,topic:row.id});
      });
      target.append(table);
    }

    const reviewNpsSample=point=>translate("{total} reseñas ({assigned} con geografía inferida o validada)",
      {total:integer(point.total),assigned:integer(point.assignedGeography)});
    function renderReviewRetry(target,error,retry){
      const button=document.createElement("button");
      button.type="button";button.className="alert-button secondary";button.textContent=translate("Reintentar");
      button.onclick=retry;target.replaceChildren(error.message,button);
    }
    function appendReviewFreshness(target,timing){
      if(timing?.freshness!=="stale")return;
      const note=document.createElement("p");note.className="data-freshness";
      note.textContent=translate("Actualización en curso")+" · "+dateTimeLabel(timing.publishedAt);
      target.prepend(note);
    }
    function renderReviewBalance(target,data,scope,compare){
      target.innerHTML='<p class="review-chart-note">NPS en puntos sobre todas las reseñas válidas del mes. Una línea interrumpida indica un mes sin datos.</p>';
      if(!data.monthly.length){target.append("Sin observaciones para este intervalo.");return null}
      const plot=document.createElement("div");
      plot.className="trend-chart";
      const layout=document.createElement("div"), legend=document.createElement("aside");
      layout.className="map-layout";
      legend.className="geo-list";
      layout.append(plot,legend);
      const months=[];
      const cursor=new Date(scope.start.slice(0,7)+"-01T00:00:00Z");
      while(cursor.toISOString().slice(0,7)<=scope.end.slice(0,7)){
        months.push(cursor.toISOString().slice(0,7));
        cursor.setUTCMonth(cursor.getUTCMonth()+1);
      }
      const points=new Map();
      for(const point of data.monthly){
        points.set(JSON.stringify([point.entity,point.month]),point);
      }
      const entities=data.monthlyEntityOptions;
      target.append(layout);

      const series=entities.map(entity=>{
        const samples=months.map(month=>points.get(JSON.stringify([entity,month])));
        return {entity,values:samples.map(point=>point?.balance??null),samples};
      });
      const render=()=>{
        hideChartTooltip();
        plot.innerHTML=C.reviewBalance(months,series,{fmt,monthLabel,width:plot.clientWidth,shade:!compare});
      };
      render();
      legend.innerHTML=series.map(({entity,samples})=>{
        const index=samples.findLastIndex(point=>D.finite(point?.balance)),current=samples[index],previous=samples[index-1];
        const change=current&&D.finite(previous?.balance)?current.balance-previous.balance:null;
        return `<article class="series-card"><i class="series-dot" style="background:${C.reviewSeriesColor(entity)}"></i><div><strong>${U.esc(entity)}</strong><span>${fmt(current?.balance,1)} pp · ${current?monthLabel(current.month):translate("Sin datos")}</span></div><b class="${change>0?"delta-up":change<0?"delta-down":""}">${signed(change)}${change===null?"":" pp"}</b></article>`;
      }).join("");
      return render;
    }
    function appendReviewCohort(target,label,scope){
      const button=document.createElement("button");
      button.type="button";
      button.className="alert-button secondary";
      button.textContent=label;
      button.onclick=()=>openReviewCohort(scope,label);
      target.append(button);
    }
    const heatmapColumns=8;
    function renderReviewMatrix(target,data,scope){
      const totals=new Map();
      for(const group of data.entities)for(const [id,count] of Object.entries(group.counts)){
        totals.set(id,(totals.get(id)||0)+count);
      }
      const ids=[...totals.keys()].sort((a,b)=>totals.get(b)-totals.get(a)||a.localeCompare(b));
      const max=Math.max(1,...data.entities.flatMap(group=>Object.values(group.counts)));
      const leading=data.leadingBlock;
      target.innerHTML=`${leading?`<p class="heatmap-focus">${U.esc(translate("Bloque funcional más frecuente {period}: {block} · {count} reseñas",{period:annualPeriodLabel(scope.start.slice(0,4)),block:data.topics[leading.id],count:integer(leading.count)}))}</p>`:""}<div class="heatmap-controls"><label>Sentimiento <select data-heatmap-segment class="select-control"><option value="DETRACTOR">Detractores</option><option value="PROMOTER">Promotores</option><option value="NEUTRAL">Neutros</option></select></label><label>Medida <select data-measure class="select-control"><option value="share">% de reseñas</option><option value="count">N.º de reseñas</option></select></label></div>
        <div data-matrix class="heatmap-scroll"></div><div data-pages class="heatmap-pagination"></div>`;
      const table=target.querySelector("[data-matrix]"), pages=target.querySelector("[data-pages]"), measure=target.querySelector("[data-measure]");
      const sentiment=target.querySelector("[data-heatmap-segment]");
      sentiment.value=heatmapSegment;
      sentiment.onchange=()=>{heatmapSegment=sentiment.value;loadAnalytics(false,true)};
      measure.value=heatmapMeasure;
      let columnPage=0;
      function render(){
        const rows=data.entities, columns=ids.slice(columnPage*heatmapColumns,(columnPage+1)*heatmapColumns);
        table.innerHTML=columns.length?`<table class="review-matrix">
          <thead><tr><th scope="col">Entidad</th>${columns.map(id=>`<th scope="col">${U.esc(data.topics[id])}</th>`).join("")}</tr></thead>
          <tbody>${rows.map((group,index)=>`<tr><th scope="row"><span class="heatmap-identity">${entityLogo(group.label,scope.country,scope.platform)}${U.esc(group.label)}</span><small>${U.esc(translate("{count} reseñas",{count:integer(group.total)}))}</small></th>${columns.map(id=>{
            const count=group.counts[id]||0, share=Math.round(100*count/group.total);
            const percent=measure.value==="share", shown=percent?`${share} %`:integer(count);
            const heat=Math.ceil(4*count/(percent?group.total:max));
            const label=`${group.label} · ${data.topics[id]} · ${count} reseñas · ${share} %`;
            const content=`<span class="heat-cell-topic">${U.esc(data.topics[id])}</span><span>${shown}</span>`;
            return `<td>${count?`<button class="heat-cell heat-${heat}" type="button" data-cell="${index}|${id}" title="${U.esc(label)}" aria-label="${U.esc(label)}">${content}</button>`:`<span class="heat-cell heat-0">${content}</span>`}</td>`;
          }).join("")}</tr>`).join("")}</tbody></table>`:U.empty("Sin reseñas","No hay reseñas para este ámbito.");
        setExportSheet("analytics","Mapa de calor",scope.country,
          [...exportDates(scope),["Comentarios",reviewFilterLabel("audience",scope.audience)],["Inferir datos",scope.inferGeography==="NO"?"No":"Sí"],["Sentimiento",sentiment.selectedOptions[0]?.textContent],["Medida",measure.selectedOptions[0]?.textContent]],
          ["Entidad","Reseñas",...ids.map(id=>data.topics[id])],ids.length?rows.map(group=>[group.label,group.total,...ids.map(id=>{
            const count=group.counts[id]||0;
            return measure.value==="share"?Math.round(100*count/group.total):count;
          })]):[]);
        table.onclick=event=>{
          const cell=event.target.closest("[data-cell]");
          if(!cell)return;
          const [index,id]=cell.dataset.cell.split("|");
          openReviewCohort({...scope,app:rows[index].label,topic:id},cell.getAttribute("aria-label"));
        };
        const pageCount=Math.ceil(ids.length/heatmapColumns);
        pages.innerHTML=pageCount>1?`<button type="button" data-page="-1" aria-label="${U.esc(translate("Bloques funcionales: anterior"))}" ${columnPage===0?"disabled":""}>‹</button><span><span>Bloques funcionales</span> ${columnPage+1}/${pageCount}</span><button type="button" data-page="1" aria-label="${U.esc(translate("Bloques funcionales: siguiente"))}" ${columnPage+1===pageCount?"disabled":""}>›</button>`:"";
      }
      pages.onclick=event=>{
        const button=event.target.closest("[data-page]");
        if(!button)return;
        columnPage+=Number(button.dataset.page);
        render();
        const next=pages.querySelector(`[data-page="${button.dataset.page}"]:not(:disabled)`);
        (next||pages.querySelector("[data-page]:not(:disabled)"))?.focus();
      };
      measure.onchange=()=>{heatmapMeasure=measure.value;render()};
      render();
    }
    let performancePending=false;
    async function loadPerformance(){
      if(performancePending)return;
      performancePending=true;
      const target=$("admin-performance");
      if(!target.textContent.trim())target.innerHTML=U.loading(translate("Cargando rendimiento"));
      try{
        const data=await callServer("performance");
        const ms=value=>value==null?"—":integer(value)+" ms";
        const table=(head,rows)=>`<div class="admin-table-wrap"><table class="admin-table"><thead><tr>${head.map(value=>`<th scope="col">${value}</th>`).join("")}</tr></thead><tbody>${rows.map(([label,...cells])=>`<tr><th scope="row">${U.esc(label)}</th>${cells.map(value=>`<td>${U.esc(value)}</td>`).join("")}</tr>`).join("")}</tbody></table></div>`;
        target.innerHTML=data.operations.length?table(["Vista y operación","Versión","RPC OK","Mediana RPC","P95 RPC","P95 servidor","Caché servidor","P95 pantalla","Muestras pantalla","Caché local","Reutilizadas","Errores","Timeouts"],
          data.operations.map(row=>[`${usageViewLabel(row.view)} · ${row.operation}`,row.version||"—",integer(row.calls),ms(row.p50),ms(row.p95),ms(row.serverP95),row.serverSamples?`${row.serverHits}/${row.serverSamples}`:"—",ms(row.uiP95),integer(row.uiSamples),integer(row.hits),integer(row.shared),integer(row.errors),integer(row.timeouts)])):
          U.empty("Sin muestras de rendimiento","Los tiempos aparecen al usar la aplicación.");
        $("admin-performance-sample").textContent=`${integer(data.rowsAnalyzed)} eventos recientes · RPC medida desde el navegador`;
        $("admin-performance-jobs").innerHTML=table(["Proceso","Estado","Último lote","Tiempo acumulado","Lotes medidos"],
          data.jobs.map(job=>[job.label,job.status,ms(job.lastBatchMs),ms(job.totalBatchMs),job.measuredBatches??"—"]));
        $("admin-performance-ratings").innerHTML=table(["Inicio de captura","Estado","Duración"],
          data.ratings.map(run=>[dateTimeLabel(run.startedAt),run.status,ms(run.durationMs)]));
        $("admin-performance-scheduled").innerHTML=table(["Tarea","Última ejecución","Estado","Duración"],
          data.scheduled.map(job=>[job.label,job.startedAt?dateTimeLabel(job.startedAt):"—",job.status||"Pendiente de medición",ms(job.durationMs)]));
      }catch(error){target.textContent=error.message}
      finally{performancePending=false}
    }

    let adminUsagePending=false;
    async function loadAdminUsage(){
      const center=state.adminCenter;
      if(!center||adminUsagePending)return;
      if(center.usage){renderActiveAdminUsage(center.usage);return}
      adminUsagePending=true;
      $("admin-usage-kpis").innerHTML=U.loading(translate("Cargando la adopción"));

        const usage=await callServer("admin:usage");
        if(center===state.adminCenter){center.usage=usage;renderActiveAdminUsage(usage)}
      }catch(error){$("admin-usage-kpis").textContent=error.message}
      finally{
        adminUsagePending=false;
        if(center!==state.adminCenter&&["usage","usage-analysis"].includes(state.adminTab))loadAdminUsage();
      }
    }

    function chartOptions(period="",idPrefix="markets"){return{period,idPrefix,format:fmt,monthLabel,context:evolutionContext()}}
    function evolutionApps(){
      return [...new Set([...D.selectionRows(state.snapshot,selection(),"ALL"),...D.trendRows(state.trends,{...selection(),app:""})].map(D.appName))].sort((a,b)=>a.localeCompare(b,"es"));
    }
    function preferredEvolutionApp(apps){
      return apps.includes(defaultAnalyticsEntity)?defaultAnalyticsEntity:apps[0]||"";
    }
    function evolutionPeriod(app,year,month){
      return D.periodModel(D.trendRows(withPublishedRatings(state.trends,selection()),{...selection(),app}),year,month);
    }
    function fillEvolutionPeriods(model){
      $("year-filter").innerHTML=model.years.map(year=>U.option(year,year,year===model.year)).join("");
      $("month-filter").innerHTML=model.months.map(month=>U.option(month,monthName(month),month===model.month)).join("");
    }
    function bindEvolutionFilters(){
      window.MarketRadarFilters.searchable($("monthly-review-segment")).refresh();
      $("monthly-review-segment").addEventListener("change",()=>{
        if(state.evolutionApp)loadMonthlyReviews(evolutionPeriod(state.evolutionApp,state.periodYear,state.periodMonth).period);
      });
      const current=()=>({app:state.evolutionApp,year:state.periodYear,month:state.periodMonth,...monthlyFilters});
      const reset=()=>({app:state.evolutionApp,year:"",month:"",...monthlyFilterDefaults});
      radarFilters.evolution=window.MarketRadarFilters.create($("evolution-filters"),{translate,
        applied:current,initial:()=>({...reset(),app:preferredEvolutionApp(evolutionApps())}),all:reset,fixedChips:["app"],alwaysChips:["app","year","month","audience","inferGeography"],
        labelValue:(key,value)=>["audience","inferGeography","segment"].includes(key)?reviewFilterLabel(key,value):value?(key==="month"?monthName(value):value):key==="app"?"Sin aplicaciones":"Sin cierre",
        prepare:()=>{
          $("evolution-app").innerHTML=evolutionApps().map(app=>U.option(app,app,app===state.evolutionApp)).join("");
          fillEvolutionPeriods(evolutionPeriod(state.evolutionApp,state.periodYear,state.periodMonth));
        },
        draftChanged:(field,values)=>{
          if(field!=="year"&&field!=="app")return;
          fillEvolutionPeriods(evolutionPeriod(values.app,values.year,values.month));
          radarFilters.evolution.refresh();
        },
        commit:({app,year,month,...filters})=>{
          monthlyFilters=filters;
          state.evolutionApp=app;state.periodYear=year;state.periodMonth=month;
          renderEvolution();
        }
      });
    }
    function syncPeriodControls(rows){
      const model=D.periodModel(rows,state.periodYear,state.periodMonth);
      state.periodYear=model.year;state.periodMonth=model.month;
      return model;
    }
    let evolutionRender;
    function renderEvolution(){
      renderDashboardMarkets("evolution");
      if(state.trendsLoading){evolutionRender=null;renderChartsLoading();return}
      const apps=evolutionApps();
      if(!apps.includes(state.evolutionApp))state.evolutionApp=preferredEvolutionApp(apps);
      const renderKey=JSON.stringify([state.country,state.evolutionApp,state.periodYear,state.periodMonth,monthlyFilters,mobileViewport.matches,appLanguage]);
      if(evolutionRender?.trends===state.trends&&evolutionRender.key===renderKey){
        radarFilters.evolution.render();
        return;
      }
      const publishedTrends=withPublishedRatings(state.trends,selection());
      const period=syncPeriodControls(activeTrendRows(publishedTrends));
      evolutionRender={trends:state.trends,key:JSON.stringify([state.country,state.evolutionApp,state.periodYear,state.periodMonth,monthlyFilters,mobileViewport.matches,appLanguage])};
      radarFilters.evolution.render();
      const month=period.period||reviewDates().end.slice(0,7);
      if(state.evolutionApp)loadMonthlyReviews(month);
      else resetMonthlyReviews();
      $("monthly-pulse-title").textContent=state.evolutionApp?translate("Pulso mensual de {app}",{app:state.evolutionApp}):translate("Pulso mensual");
      renderMonthlyMatrix(month,publishedTrends);
      renderNewReviewImpact(month,publishedTrends);
    }
    function renderSeriesSummary(series,period){$("annual-series").innerHTML=series.map((item,index)=>{const points=[...item.points].filter(point=>D.finite(point.value)&&point.month<=period).sort((a,b)=>a.month.localeCompare(b.month)),current=points.at(-1),previous=points.at(-2),change=current&&previous?current.value-previous.value:null,color=T.chart.palette[index%T.chart.palette.length];return`<article class="series-card"><i class="series-dot" style="background:${color}"></i><div><strong>${U.esc(item.label)}</strong><span>${fmt(current?.value,2)} · ${current?monthLabel(current.month):"sin dato"}</span></div><b class="${change>0?"delta-up":change<0?"delta-down":""}">${signed(change)}</b></article>`}).join("")}

    let alertActionsBusy=false;
    function syncAlertSaveState(){
      const draft=alertDraftFromForm(), saved=state.alertCenter?.preferences;
      const dirty=saved&&Object.entries(draft).some(([key,value])=>Array.isArray(value)
        ? JSON.stringify([...value].sort())!==JSON.stringify([...(saved[key]||["ALL"])].sort())
        : value!==saved[key]);
      $("alert-reset-button").hidden=!dirty;
      $("alert-reset-button").disabled=alertActionsBusy;
      const valid=$("alert-form").checkValidity()&&
        [["review-warning","review-critical"],...["daily","mtd","ytd"].map(period=>[period+"-warning",period+"-critical"])]
          .every(([warning,critical])=>$(warning).value!==""&&$(critical).value!==""&&Number($(critical).value)>Number($(warning).value));
      $("alert-save-button").disabled=alertActionsBusy||!dirty||!valid;
      $("alert-save-state").textContent=dirty?(valid?"Tienes cambios sin guardar":"Revisa los umbrales antes de guardar"):saved?.persisted
        ? `Guardado ${saved.updatedAt?dateTimeLabel(saved.updatedAt):"para tu cuenta"}`
        : "Valores recomendados";
    }
    function markAlertsDirty(){$("alert-master-copy").textContent=$("alert-active").checked?"Tus alertas estarán activas":"Las alertas quedarán en pausa";$("newsletter-master-copy").textContent=$("newsletter-enabled").checked?"Recibirás el resumen ejecutivo el día 1":"La newsletter mensual quedará desactivada";syncAlertSaveState()}
    function setAlertActionsBusy(busy){alertActionsBusy=busy;$("alert-form").inert=busy;syncAlertSaveState()}

    async function resetAlerts(){setAlertActionsBusy(true);try{const saved=await callServer("alerts:reset",state.alertCenter.preferences.updatedAt||"");state.alertCenter.preferences=saved;state.alertDraft=JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(saved));trackUsage("ACTION","alerts","ALERTS_RESET");renderAlerts();showToast("Valores recomendados restaurados.",true)}catch(error){showError(error)}finally{setAlertActionsBusy(false)}}

        {label:"Registros disponibles",value:integer(source.length)},{label:"Días con actividad",value:integer(dayCount)},
        {label:"Último registro",value:rows.length?dateTimeLabel(fields(rows[0])[0]):"—"}]);
      logPage=renderAdminPagination("admin-log-pagination",rows.length,logPage,page=>{logPage=page;renderAdminLog(false)});
      render(rows.slice(logPage*adminPageSize,(logPage+1)*adminPageSize));
      const button=$("admin-log-export");
      button.disabled=!rows.length;
      button.onclick=()=>exportAdminRows(name,header,rows.map(fields));
    }

    function adminDataTable(columns,rows,action,renderCell){

      if(section==="system"){target.replaceChildren();return;}
      target.innerHTML=U.loading(translate("Cargando el catálogo"));
      try{
        const data=await callServer("admin:business",section);
        if(token!==businessRequest||state.adminTab!=="business")return;
        businessCatalog={section,data};
        renderBusinessCatalog();
        target.onclick=async event=>{
          const sync=event.target.closest("[data-sync]");
          if(sync){
            sync.disabled=true;
            try{await callServer("admin:business:refresh");if(token===businessRequest)loadAdminBusiness()}
            catch(error){showError(error);sync.disabled=false}
            return;
          }
          const entry=event.target.closest("[data-entry]");
          if(!entry||!data.edit)return;
          const row=businessCatalog.visibleRows[Number(entry.dataset.entry)]||["",""];
          businessDraft={section,expected:String(row[1])};
          $("admin-business-key").value=row[0];
          $("admin-business-key").readOnly=Boolean(row[0]);
          $("admin-business-value").value=row[1];
          $("admin-business-value").required=section!=="aliases";
          $("admin-business-error").textContent="";
          $("admin-business-dialog").showModal();
        };
      }catch(error){if(token===businessRequest)target.textContent=error.message}
    }
    async function saveAdminBusiness(event){
      event.preventDefault();
      if(!businessDraft)return;
      const button=event.submitter;
      if(button)button.disabled=true;
      try{
        await callServer("admin:business:save",{...businessDraft,key:$("admin-business-key").value.trim(),value:$("admin-business-value").value});
        $("admin-business-dialog").close();
        if(state.adminTab==="business")loadAdminBusiness();
      }catch(error){$("admin-business-error").textContent=error.message}
      finally{if(button)button.disabled=false}
    }
    const adminPageSize=20;
    function renderAdminPagination(id,count,page,onPage){
      const target=$(id), pages=Math.max(1,Math.ceil(count/adminPageSize));
      const current=Math.min(page,pages-1);
      target.innerHTML=pages>1?`<button class="button" type="button" data-step="-1" ${current?"":"disabled"}>Anterior</button>
        <span>${current+1} / ${pages}</span><button class="button" type="button" data-step="1" ${current+1<pages?"":"disabled"}>Siguiente</button>`:"";
      target.onclick=event=>{
        const step=event.target.dataset.step;
        if(!step)return;
        onPage(current+Number(step));
        (target.querySelector(`[data-step="${step}"]:not(:disabled)`)||target.querySelector("button:not(:disabled)"))?.focus();
      };
      return current;
    }
