    function exportAdminRows(name,header,rows){
      const file=window.MarketsWorkbook.build([{name,filters:[],header,rows}]);
      const url=URL.createObjectURL(file), link=document.createElement("a");
      link.href=url;link.download="EDC Market Pulse - "+name+".xlsx";link.click();
      window.setTimeout(()=>URL.revokeObjectURL(url),1000);
    }
    // Adapted from News Radar activity-chart.js (859e609).
    function renderAdminActivity(target,days,label,primary,heading="Actividad diaria"){
      const root=$(target);
      if(!days.length){root.innerHTML=U.empty("Sin actividad diaria","");return}
      const max=Math.max(1,...days.map(primary));
      const months=new Map();
      for(const day of days){const key=day.date.slice(0,7);months.set(key,(months.get(key)||0)+1)}
      const monthFormat=new Intl.DateTimeFormat(locale(),{month:"long",year:"numeric",timeZone:"UTC"});
      const control=(step,caption)=>`<button type="button" class="button activity-control" data-step="${step}" aria-label="${caption}">${step<0?"‹":"›"}</button>`;
      root.innerHTML=`<section class="activity-timeline"><div class="activity-heading"><div><strong>${U.esc(translate(heading))}</strong>
        <p class="activity-range small muted" aria-live="polite"></p></div><button type="button" class="button" data-step="end">Últimos días</button></div>
        <div class="activity-navigation">${control(-1,"Ver días anteriores")}<ul class="activity-chart" tabindex="0" aria-label="${U.esc(label)}">${days.map((day,i)=>{
          const month=day.date.slice(0,7), value=primary(day);
          const description=`${dateLabel(day.date)} · ${integer(value)} ${translate(label).toLocaleLowerCase(locale())}`;
          return `<li class="activity-column" data-date="${day.date}" aria-label="${U.esc(description)}" title="${U.esc(description)}"><span>${integer(value)}</span>
            <div class="activity-bars"><i style="height:${100*value/max}%"></i></div>
            <time datetime="${day.date}">${day.date.slice(8)}</time>${days[i-1]?.date.slice(0,7)!==month?`<span class="activity-month" style="--days:${months.get(month)}">${U.esc(monthFormat.format(new Date(month+"-01T00:00:00Z")))}</span>`:""}</li>`;
        }).join("")}</ul>${control(1,"Ver días siguientes")}</div></section>`;
      const chart=root.querySelector(".activity-chart"), range=root.querySelector(".activity-range");
      const earlier=root.querySelector('[data-step="-1"]'), later=root.querySelector('[data-step="1"]'), latest=root.querySelector('[data-step="end"]');
      const step=()=>chart.children[1]?.offsetLeft-chart.children[0].offsetLeft||chart.children[0].offsetWidth||1;
      const update=()=>{
        const left=chart.scrollLeft, width=step();
        earlier.disabled=left<=1;later.disabled=latest.disabled=left+chart.clientWidth>=chart.scrollWidth-1;
        const first=Math.min(days.length-1,Math.floor((left+1)/width));
        const last=Math.min(days.length-1,Math.max(first,Math.ceil((left+chart.clientWidth-1)/width)-1));
        const text=`${dateLabel(days[first].date)} – ${dateLabel(days[last].date)}`;
        if(range.textContent!==text)range.textContent=text;
      };
      const navigate=direction=>{
        const page=step()*Math.max(1,Math.floor(chart.clientWidth/step())-1);
        chart.scrollLeft=direction==="end"?chart.scrollWidth:direction==="start"?0:chart.scrollLeft+direction*page;
        update();
      };
      [earlier,later,latest].forEach(button=>button.onclick=()=>navigate(button===latest?"end":Number(button.dataset.step)));
      chart.onkeydown=event=>{
        const direction={ArrowLeft:-1,ArrowRight:1,PageUp:-1,PageDown:1,Home:"start",End:"end"}[event.key];
        if(direction!==undefined){event.preventDefault();navigate(direction)}
      };
      chart.addEventListener("scroll",update,{passive:true});
      navigate("end");
    }

    let newsletterAccessCohort="dau", newsletterAccessPage=0;
    function renderNewsletterAccessUsers(access,total){
      const users=access?.users||[], asOf=Date.parse(access?.asOf);
      const within=(row,days)=>Date.parse(row.lastSeenAt)>=asOf-days*86400000;
      const cohorts=[
        ["dau","DAU","24 horas",users.filter(row=>within(row,1))],
        ["wau","WAU","7 días",users.filter(row=>within(row,7))],
        ["mau","MAU","30 días",users.filter(row=>within(row,30))],
        ["total","Total usuarios","Selección",users]
      ];
      const selected=cohorts.find(row=>row[0]===newsletterAccessCohort), matched=selected[3];
      const metrics=$("admin-newsletter-access-cohorts");
      metrics.innerHTML=cohorts.map(([key,label,hint,rows])=>`<button type="button" class="metric" data-cohort="${key}" aria-pressed="${key===selected[0]}"><span>${label}</span><strong>${integer(rows.length)}</strong><small>${hint}</small></button>`).join("");
      metrics.onclick=event=>{
        const key=event.target.closest("[data-cohort]")?.dataset.cohort;
        if(!key||key===newsletterAccessCohort)return;
        newsletterAccessCohort=key;
        newsletterAccessPage=0;
        renderNewsletterAccessUsers(access,total);
        metrics.querySelector(`[data-cohort="${key}"]`)?.focus();
      };
      $("admin-newsletter-access-coverage").textContent=`${integer(access?.identified||0)} de ${integer(total)} accesos vinculados a un envío. Los enlaces registran un acceso por destinatario y edición.`;
      newsletterAccessPage=renderAdminPagination("admin-newsletter-access-users-pagination",matched.length,newsletterAccessPage,page=>{
        newsletterAccessPage=page;
        renderNewsletterAccessUsers(access,total);
      });
      const visible=matched.slice(newsletterAccessPage*adminPageSize,(newsletterAccessPage+1)*adminPageSize);
      $("admin-newsletter-access-users").innerHTML=visible.length?adminDataTable(["Usuario","Último acceso","Accesos","Primer acceso"],
        visible.map(row=>[row.email,dateTimeLabel(row.lastSeenAt),selected[0]==="total"?row.events:row.recentEvents,dateTimeLabel(row.firstSeenAt)])):
        U.empty("Sin usuarios verificados","Los accesos sin vínculo con un envío están incluidos en el total de aperturas.");
    }

    function renderAdminAdoption(usage){
      if(!usage)return;
      radarFilters.adoption.render();
      const trend=usage.adoptionTrend||usage.dailyTrend||[], asOf=Date.parse(usage.generatedAt);
      const query=adoptionFilters.query.trim().toLowerCase();
      const candidates=(usage.adoptionUsers||[]).filter(row=>row.email.includes(query));
      const since=(row,days)=>Date.parse(row.lastSeenAt)>=asOf-days*86400000;
      const recent=candidates.filter(row=>since(row,30)).map(row=>({...row,sessions:row.recentSessions,events:row.recentEvents}));
      const cohorts=[
        {key:"dau",label:"DAU",hint:"Usuarios · 24 horas",rows:recent.filter(row=>since(row,1))},
        {key:"wau",label:"WAU",hint:"Usuarios · 7 días",rows:recent.filter(row=>since(row,7))},
        {key:"mau",label:"MAU",hint:"Usuarios · 30 días",rows:recent},
        {key:"returning",label:"Recurrentes",hint:"Más de una sesión · 30 días",rows:recent.filter(row=>row.sessions>1)},
        {key:"total",label:"Total usuarios",hint:"Usuarios · registros retenidos",rows:candidates}
      ];
      const selected=cohorts.find(item=>item.key===adoptionCohort), matched=selected.rows;
      if(trend!==renderedAdoptionTrend){
        renderAdminActivity("admin-adoption-chart",trend,"Usuarios",day=>day.users||0,"Usuarios por día");
        renderedAdoptionTrend=trend;
      }
      const metrics=$("admin-adoption-metrics");
      metrics.innerHTML=cohorts.map(item=>`<button type="button" class="metric" data-cohort="${item.key}" aria-pressed="${item===selected}"><span>${item.label}</span><strong>${integer(item.rows.length)}</strong><small>${item.hint}</small></button>`).join("");
      metrics.onclick=event=>{
        const key=event.target.closest("[data-cohort]")?.dataset.cohort;
        if(key&&key!==adoptionCohort){adoptionCohort=key;adoptionPage=0;renderAdminAdoption(usage);metrics.querySelector(`[data-cohort="${key}"]`)?.focus()}
      };
      const coverage=usage.tracking||{};
      const sessions=matched.reduce((sum,row)=>sum+row.sessions,0),events=matched.reduce((sum,row)=>sum+row.events,0);
      const scoped=["dau","wau"].includes(selected.key)?" · sesiones y eventos de 30 días":"";
      $("admin-adoption-summary").textContent=`${selected.label} · ${integer(matched.length)} usuarios · ${integer(sessions)} sesiones · ${integer(events)} eventos${scoped}${coverage.truncated?` · Cobertura parcial desde ${dateTimeLabel(coverage.coverageStart)}`:""}`;
      adoptionPage=renderAdminPagination("admin-adoption-pagination",matched.length,adoptionPage,page=>{adoptionPage=page;renderAdminAdoption(usage)});
      $("admin-adoption-rows").innerHTML=adminDataTable(["Usuario","Último acceso","Sesiones registradas","Eventos registrados","Primer acceso"],
        matched.slice(adoptionPage*adminPageSize,(adoptionPage+1)*adminPageSize).map(row=>[row.email,dateTimeLabel(row.lastSeenAt),row.sessions,row.events,dateTimeLabel(row.firstSeenAt)]));

    }
    async function loadAdminNewsletterInteractions(tab,initialPage=0){
      const token=new Object();
      newsletterRequests[tab]=token;
      const target=$("admin-"+tab+"-results"), filters=newsletterFilters[tab]||{}, feedback=tab==="feedback";
      radarFilters[tab].render();
      const download=$("admin-"+tab+"-export");
      download.disabled=true;
      $("admin-"+tab+"-pagination").replaceChildren();
      if(!feedback){
        for(const section of ["chart","cohorts","coverage","users","users-pagination"]){
          $("admin-newsletter-access-"+section).replaceChildren();
        }
      }
      target.innerHTML=U.loading(translate(feedback?"Cargando valoraciones":"Cargando accesos desde newsletters"));
      try{
        const data=await callServer("admin:newsletter:interactions",{kind:feedback?"feedback":"access",...filters});
        if(newsletterRequests[tab]!==token)return;
        if(!feedback){
          newsletterAccessPage=0;
          renderNewsletterAccessUsers(data.access,data.total);
          renderAdminActivity("admin-newsletter-access-chart",data.daily||[],"Accesos",day=>day.count);
        }
        const labels={open:"Acceso confirmado",positive:"Útil",negative:"Mejorable"};
        const columns=feedback?["Fecha","Correo","Edición","País","Idioma","Valoración","Observaciones","Estado"]:
          ["Fecha","Edición","Interacción"];
        const rows=data.rows.map(([edition,action,date,status,,comment,metadata])=>feedback?
          [dateTimeLabel(date),metadata?.email||"desconocido",metadata?.preview?edition+" · Prueba":edition||"Alerta",metadata?.countries||"—",metadata?.language||"—",labels[action],comment,status]:
          [dateTimeLabel(date),metadata?.alert?"Alerta":metadata?.preview?edition+" · Prueba":edition,labels[action]]);
        const cards=`<div class="metrics${feedback?" feedback-metrics":""}">`+adminMetricCards(feedback?[
          {label:"Total",value:integer(data.total)},{label:"Útil",value:integer(data.positive)},{label:"Mejorable",value:integer(data.negative)},
          {label:"% útil",value:data.total?fmt(100*data.positive/data.total,0)+"%":"—"},
          {label:"Pendientes",value:integer(data.pending||0)},{label:"Atendidos",value:integer(data.resolved||0)}]:
          [{label:"Accesos confirmados",value:integer(data.total)},{label:"Ediciones",value:integer(data.editions||0)}])+'</div>';
        const render=page=>{
          const renderCell=(value,column,index)=>{
            const entry=data.rows[page*adminPageSize+index];
            if(feedback&&column===9) {
              return `<select class="select-control" data-feedback-entry="${index}" aria-label="Estado de la valoración">
                ${U.option("pendiente","Pendiente",entry[3]!=="atendido")}${U.option("atendido","Atendido",entry[3]==="atendido")}</select>`;
            }
            const summary=feedback&&column===2&&entry[6]?.summary;
            return summary?`<details><summary>${U.esc(value)}</summary><p>${U.esc(summary)}</p></details>`:undefined;
          };
          target.innerHTML=cards+(data.rows.length?adminDataTable(columns,rows.slice(page*adminPageSize,(page+1)*adminPageSize),false,renderCell):
            U.empty("Sin registros","Las interacciones aparecerán después de los próximos envíos."));
          renderAdminPagination("admin-"+tab+"-pagination",rows.length,page,render);
          bindFeedbackActions(page);
        };
        download.disabled=!data.rows.length;
        download.onclick=()=>exportAdminRows(feedback?"Feedback":"Accesos desde newsletters",
          feedback?[...columns,"Resumen"]:columns,
          feedback?rows.map((row,index)=>[...row,data.rows[index][6]?.summary||""]):rows);
        const bindFeedbackActions=page=>target.querySelectorAll("[data-feedback-entry]").forEach(select=>{
          const row=data.rows[page*adminPageSize+Number(select.dataset.feedbackEntry)];
          select.onchange=async()=>{
            const next=select.value;
            select.disabled=true;
            try{
              await callServer("admin:newsletter:feedback-state",{id:row[4],state:next});
              if(newsletterRequests[tab]===token)loadAdminNewsletterInteractions(tab,page);
            }catch(error){
              select.value=row[3];
              showError(error);
              select.disabled=false;
            }
          };
        });
        render(Math.min(initialPage,Math.max(0,Math.ceil(rows.length/adminPageSize)-1)));
      }catch(error){if(newsletterRequests[tab]===token)target.textContent=error.message}
    }
    function activateAdminTab(name,focus=false){const tabs=[...document.querySelectorAll(".admin-tab")],selected=tabs.find(tab=>tab.dataset.adminTab===name)||tabs[0];if(!selected||!state.userContext?.isAdmin)return;if(focus&&state.adminTab===name)return;state.adminTab=selected.dataset.adminTab;tabs.forEach(tab=>{const active=tab===selected;tab.classList.toggle("active",active);tab.setAttribute("aria-selected",String(active));tab.tabIndex=active?0:-1});document.querySelectorAll(".admin-tab-panel").forEach(panel=>panel.classList.toggle("hidden",panel.dataset.adminPanel!==state.adminTab));selected.scrollIntoView?.({block:"nearest",inline:"nearest"});renderAdminLog();if(state.adminTab==="business")loadAdminBusiness();if(state.adminTab==="subscribers")renderAdminSubscriptionTab();if(["newsletter-access","feedback"].includes(state.adminTab))loadAdminNewsletterInteractions(state.adminTab);if(["usage","usage-analysis"].includes(state.adminTab))loadAdminUsage();if(focus){trackUsage("ACTION","admin","ADMIN_TAB",state.adminTab);selected.focus()}}
    function handleAdminTabKeydown(event){if(!["ArrowLeft","ArrowRight","ArrowUp","ArrowDown","Home","End"].includes(event.key))return;const tabs=[...document.querySelectorAll(".admin-tab")],current=Math.max(0,tabs.indexOf(document.activeElement));let next=event.key==="Home"?0:event.key==="End"?tabs.length-1:["ArrowRight","ArrowDown"].includes(event.key)?(current+1)%tabs.length:(current-1+tabs.length)%tabs.length;event.preventDefault();activateAdminTab(tabs[next].dataset.adminTab,true);tabs[next].focus()}
    async function loadAdmin(force=false){
      if(!state.userContext?.isAdmin||state.adminLoading||state.adminLoaded&&!force)return;
      const started=performance.now(), refresh=state.adminLoaded, loading=$("admin-loading");
      state.adminLoading=true;
      if(!refresh){loading.classList.add("hidden");$("admin-content").classList.remove("hidden")}
      try{
        state.adminCenter=await callServer("admin:get");
        if(refresh&&state.adminTab==="health") {
          renderAdminJobs(state.adminCenter.system,state.adminCenter.recentRuns||[]);
        }else renderAdmin();
        state.adminLoaded=true;
        if(!refresh)trackReady("admin","Mostrar administración",started);
      }catch(error){
        if(!refresh){loading.classList.remove("hidden");renderReviewRetry(loading,error,()=>loadAdmin(true))}
        showError(error);
      }finally{state.adminLoading=false}
    }
    function statusBadge(value){const text=String(value||"—"),tone=/^(OK|ACTIVE|VERIFIED|SENT)$/i.test(text)?"ok":/PARTIAL|WARN|PENDING/i.test(text)?"warn":/ERROR|FAIL|DENIED|DISABLED/i.test(text)?"bad":"";return`<span class="admin-status ${tone}">${U.esc(text)}</span>`}
    function renderAdmin(){
      const center=state.adminCenter;
      if(!center)return;
      $("admin-loading").classList.add("hidden");
      $("admin-content").classList.remove("hidden");
      $("admin-generated-at").textContent=`Generado ${dateTimeLabel(center.generatedAt)} · ${center.administrator}`;
      renderAdminSystem(center.system);
      renderAdminJobs(center.system,center.recentRuns||[]);
      if(state.adminTab==="subscribers")renderAdminSubscriptionTab();
      if(["usage","usage-analysis"].includes(state.adminTab))loadAdminUsage();
      if(state.adminTab==="logs")renderAdminLog();
      if(state.adminTab==="business")loadAdminBusiness();
    }
    let runningPanelJob = false;
    window.setInterval?.(()=>{
      if(state.view==="admin"&&state.adminTab==="health"&&!document.hidden&&!runningPanelJob&&!$("admin-jobs").contains(document.activeElement)) refreshAdminJobs();
    },30000);
    let adminJobsPolling=false;
    async function refreshAdminJobs(){
      if(adminJobsPolling||state.adminLoading||!state.adminCenter)return;
      adminJobsPolling=true;
      try{
        const jobs=await callServer("admin:jobs:status");
        if(state.view!=="admin"||state.adminTab!=="health")return;
        Object.assign(state.adminCenter.system,jobs);
        renderAdminJobs(state.adminCenter.system,state.adminCenter.recentRuns||[]);
      }catch(error){
        if(state.view==="admin"&&state.adminTab==="health")$("admin-jobs-result").textContent=error.message;
      }finally{adminJobsPolling=false}
    }
    function renderAdminJobs(system,runs){
      const pipeline=system.reviewPipeline, operations=system.operations;
      renderAdminJobSettings(operations, pipeline, system);
      const latest=runs[0], config=operations?.config||{};
      const index=operations?.index, geo=operations?.geography, maintenance=operations?.maintenance, backup=operations?.backup, androidMetadata=operations?.androidMetadata;
      const waiting=job=>job?.runningUntil>Date.now()?"En curso":job?.error?"Reintento pendiente":job?.complete?"Completado":
        operations?.activeReviewStage?"Esperando "+operations.activeReviewStage:"Pendiente del supervisor";
      const delivery=(id,fallback)=>{
        const timing=system.deliveryTiming?.[id], audit=system.deliveries?.[id];
        const data=Date.parse(timing?.startedAt)>=Date.parse(audit?.startedAt||0)?{...audit,...timing}:audit||{};
        const running=data.status==="RUNNING"&&Date.now()-Date.parse(data.startedAt)<7*60000;
        const known=Number.isInteger(data.sent)&&Number.isInteger(data.total)&&data.sent>=0&&data.sent<=data.total;
        const details=[
          Number.isInteger(data.attempted)?`${integer(data.attempted)} intentadas`:"",
          Number.isInteger(data.sent)?`${integer(data.sent)} confirmadas`:"",
          Number.isInteger(data.failed)?`${integer(data.failed)} fallidas`:"",
          !known&&data.lastAuditedEdition?`Edición ${data.lastAuditedEdition.period} · al menos ${integer(data.lastAuditedEdition.minimumConfirmed)} confirmadas`:""
        ].filter(Boolean);
        return {updatedAt:data.startedAt||fallback,deliveredAt:data.lastDeliveryAt,
          done:known?(running?data.attempted:data.sent):undefined,total:known?data.total:undefined,
          status:running?"En curso":data.status==="RUNNING"?"Revisar":known&&data.status==="DELIVERED"&&data.sent===data.total?"Completado":
            data.status==="NOT_REQUIRED"?"Sin envíos pendientes":!known&&data.status!=="ERROR"?"No verificable":data.status||"Pendiente",
          detail:details.join(" · ")};
      };
      const ratingSchedule=operations?.ratingSchedule;
      const runningRatings=ratingSchedule?.status==="En curso"&&Date.now()-Date.parse(ratingSchedule.startedAt)<7*60000;
      const jobs=[
        {id:"ratings",priority:1,group:"Ratings",name:"Carga diaria de ratings",detail:latest?`${latest.appsError} con error · ${latest.appsNoRating} sin rating · ${latest.rowsUpserted} filas actualizadas`:"",schedule:system.dailySchedule,
          status:runningRatings?"En curso":["PARTIAL","OK"].includes(latest?.status)&&latest.appsError===0&&latest.appsTotal>0&&latest.appsOk+latest.appsNoRating===latest.appsTotal?"Activo":latest?.status||"Sin ejecuciones",updatedAt:latest?.startedAt,done:latest?latest.appsOk+latest.appsNoRating+latest.appsError:0,total:latest?.appsTotal,retryAt:ratingSchedule?.retryAt,error:ratingSchedule?.failure},
        {id:"newsletter",priority:2,group:"Envíos planificados",name:"Newsletter mensual",schedule:system.newsletterSchedule,enabled:system.newsletterDeliveryEnabled,...delivery("newsletter",operations?.newsletter?.startedAt)},
        ...(pipeline?.jobs||[]).map(job=>({...job,name:job.label,
          group:({supervisor:"Supervisor",ios:"Recopilación de reseñas",android:"Recopilación de reseñas",
            alerts:"Envíos planificados",translate:"Traducción de reseñas y respuestas",publish:"Generación de snapshots"})[job.id],
          schedule:job.id==="supervisor"?`Cada ${operations?.interval||15} minutos`:pipeline.day,
          enabled:job.id==="supervisor"?pipeline.installed!==false:undefined,
          updatedAt:job.id==="supervisor"?operations?.supervisorLast:job.lastAttemptAt,
          nextTurnAt:job.id==="supervisor"&&pipeline.workerInstalled&&operations?.nextWorkerAt?new Date(operations.nextWorkerAt).toISOString():"",
          waitingFor:job.id==="supervisor"?(operations?.activeReviewStage||""):"",
          ...(job.id==="translate"&&operations?.translationRetryAt>Date.now()?{status:"Esperando cuota de traducción",retryAt:operations.translationRetryAt}:{}),
          detail:job.id==="supervisor"?([operations?.unifiedAfter?"Supervisión unificada":"Supervisión de reseñas",system.healthMonitorEnabled?"Monitor de salud · "+system.healthSchedule:"Monitor de salud desactivado",operations?.health?.startedAt?dateTimeLabel(operations.health.startedAt):""].filter(Boolean).join(" · ")):
            [job.id==="ios"||job.id==="android"?`${job.added||0} nuevas · ${job.updated||0} actualizadas · ${job.failures||0} errores`:"",
             job.replyPending==null?"":job.replyPending+" respuestas pendientes"].filter(Boolean).join(" · "),
          ...(job.id==="alerts"?delivery("reviewAlerts",job.lastAttemptAt):{})})),
        {id:"index",priority:3,group:"Clasificación de reseñas",name:"Clasificación de comentarios",...index,status:waiting(index),
          detail:index?.complete?"Recorrido completado. El supervisor revisa las nuevas reseñas.":""},
        {id:"geography",priority:3,group:"Inferencia geográfica",name:"Inferencia geográfica Android",...geo,status:waiting(geo),
          done:geo?.processed,total:geo?.last?geo.total:undefined,
          detail:geo?`${integer(geo.processed)} Android sin geografía revisadas · ${integer(geo.counts?.INFERIDO||0)} inferidas · ${integer(geo.counts?.NO_ATRIBUIBLE||0)} no atribuibles`:""},
        {id:"androidMetadata",priority:6,group:"Mantenimiento y backup",name:"Refresco de metadatos Android",...androidMetadata,status:waiting(androidMetadata),
          detail:androidMetadata?`${integer(androidMetadata.pages||0)} páginas · ${integer(androidMetadata.updated||0)} reseñas actualizadas`:""},
        {id:"maintenance",priority:6,group:"Mantenimiento y backup",name:"Mantenimiento incremental",...maintenance,done:maintenance?.total,
          detail:maintenance?.total==null?"":`${maintenance.invalid} inválidas · ${maintenance.duplicates} duplicadas · ${maintenance.archived||0} archivadas`},
        {...backup,id:"backup",priority:6,group:"Mantenimiento y backup",name:"Backup mensual",done:backup?.id?1:0,total:1},
        ...(system.functionalJobs||[]).map(job=>({...job,group:"Catálogo global de funcionalidades",
          detail:job.changed==null?"":job.changed?"Cambios detectados":"Sin cambios"}))
      ];
      const actions={backup:"Crear copia mensual",index:"Clasificar pendientes",geography:"Iniciar inferencia",maintenance:"Iniciar mantenimiento",
        publish:"Generar snapshots",androidMetadata:"Solicitar refresco",taxonomy:"Actualizar catálogo",taxonomyTranslation:"Traducir pendientes"};
      const groups=new Map();
      for(const job of jobs){
        const saved=config[job.id]||{};
        job.priority=saved.priority??job.priority;
        job.enabled=saved.enabled??job.enabled??true;
        job.schedule=saved.time||job.schedule;
        job.timeZone=saved.timeZone||system.timeZone;
        const retry=operations?.jobRetries?.[job.id];
        if(retry){job.retryAt=retry.next;job.error=retry.error}
        if(operations?.queuedJobs?.includes(job.id)&&job.status!=="En curso")job.status="En cola";
        const key=job.priority+"|"+job.group;
        if(!groups.has(key))groups.set(key,{name:job.group,priority:job.priority,jobs:[]});
        groups.get(key).jobs.push(job);
      }
      const statusLine=(label,value)=>value?`<p class="small muted">${label}: ${U.esc(dateTimeLabel(value))}</p>`:"";
      const processCard=job=>{
        const status=job.status||"Programado";
        const tone=!job.enabled?"inactive":job.error||/ERROR|Fallid|Revisar|Sin activador/i.test(status)?"error":
          /^(Activo|OK|Completad)/i.test(status)?"complete":"pending";
        const confirmed=Number.isInteger(job.total)&&Number.isInteger(job.done);
        const progress=confirmed&&job.total>0&&job.done>=0&&job.done<=job.total
          ? `<progress value="${status==="En curso"?job.done:job.total}" max="${job.total}" aria-label="${U.esc(job.name)}"></progress><p class="small muted">${job.id==="alerts"?`${integer(job.done)} / ${integer(job.total)} destinatarios`:`${job.done}/${job.total}`}</p>`
          : status==="En curso"?`<progress aria-label="${U.esc(job.name)}"></progress>`:`<progress value="1" max="1" aria-label="${U.esc(job.name)}"></progress>`;
        return `<article class="process-card"><div class="schedule-heading"><h4>${U.esc(job.name)}</h4>
          <span class="process-state" data-status="${tone}">${job.enabled?U.esc(status):"Inactivo"}</span></div>
          <p class="small muted">${[job.schedule,job.timeZone].filter(Boolean).map(U.esc).join(" · ")}</p>${progress}
          ${statusLine("Última ejecución",job.updatedAt)}${statusLine("Próximo turno estimado",job.nextTurnAt)}${statusLine("Último envío",job.deliveredAt)}
          ${job.waitingFor?`<p class="small muted">Trabajo activo · ${U.esc(job.waitingFor)}</p>`:""}${statusLine("Último avance",job.lastProgressAt)}${statusLine("Último éxito",job.lastSuccessAt)}
          ${statusLine("Reintento",job.retryAt?new Date(job.retryAt).toISOString():"")}
          ${job.detail?`<p class="small muted">${U.esc(job.detail)}</p>`:""}${job.error?`<p>${U.esc(job.error)}</p>`:""}
          ${job.id==="ratings"?`<button id="admin-recovery" class="button" type="button" data-run-job="ratings" ${["En curso","En cola"].includes(status)?"disabled":""}>Solicitar recuperación de ratings</button>`:operations?.owner&&actions[job.id]?`<button class="button" type="button" data-run-job="${job.id}" ${!job.enabled||["En curso","En cola"].includes(status)?"disabled":""}>${actions[job.id]}</button>`:""}</article>`;
      };
      const root=$("admin-jobs");
      root.innerHTML=[...groups.values()].sort((a,b)=>a.priority-b.priority).map(group=>`<section class="process-group">
        <div class="panel-header"><h3>${U.esc(group.name)}</h3><span class="small muted">Prioridad ${group.priority}</span></div>
        <div class="process-grid">${group.jobs.map(processCard).join("")}</div></section>`).join("");
      root.onclick=async event=>{
        const button=event.target.closest("[data-run-job]");
        if(!button||runningPanelJob)return;
        if(button.dataset.runJob==="ratings"){runningPanelJob=true;try{await requestAdminRatingRecovery();}finally{runningPanelJob=false}return;}
        runningPanelJob=true;
        const result=$("admin-jobs-result");
        button.disabled=true;
        result.textContent="Solicitando turno…";
        try{
          const response=await callServer("admin:jobs:run",button.dataset.runJob);
          result.textContent=response.message;
          await refreshAdminJobs();
        }catch(error){result.textContent=error.message}
        finally{button.disabled=false;runningPanelJob=false}
      };
    }
    function renderAdminJobSettings(operations, pipeline, system) {
      const panel=$("admin-job-settings");
      if(!panel)return;
      panel.classList.toggle("hidden",!operations?.owner||!["schedule","storage"].includes($("admin-business-section").value));
      if(!operations?.owner)return;
      const interval=`<form data-job-action="interval"><label for="job-interval">Supervisor (minutos)</label>
        <select id="job-interval" name="minutes">${[1,5,10,15,30].map(value=>U.option(value,value,value===operations.interval)).join("")}</select>
        <button class="button" type="submit">Guardar</button></form>`;
      const jobs=[...(pipeline?.jobs||[]).filter(job=>job.priority),...(system.functionalJobs||[]),
        {id:"index",name:"Clasificación de reseñas",priority:3},{id:"geography",name:"Inferencia geográfica Android",priority:3},{id:"backup",name:"Backup mensual",priority:6},{id:"maintenance",name:"Mantenimiento",priority:6},
        {id:"androidMetadata",name:"Refresco de metadatos Android",priority:6}];
      const forms=jobs.map(job=>{
        const settings=operations.config[job.id]||{};
        const enabled=settings.enabled ?? true;
        return `<form data-job-action="settings" data-id="${U.esc(job.id)}"><fieldset><legend>${U.esc(job.name||job.label)}</legend>
          <label><input type="checkbox" name="enabled" ${enabled?"checked":""}> Habilitado</label>
          <label>Prioridad <input type="number" name="priority" min="1" max="6" value="${settings.priority||job.priority}" required></label>
          <label>Desde <input type="time" name="time" value="${U.esc(settings.time||"08:00")}" required></label>
          <label>Zona horaria <input name="timeZone" value="${U.esc(settings.timeZone||system.timeZone)}" required></label>
          <button class="button" type="submit">Guardar</button></fieldset></form>`;
      });
      const labels={telemetry:"Telemetría",executions:"Ejecuciones",backups:"Backups",captures:"Capturas",alerts:"Alertas",experience:"Incidencias de experiencia"};
      const folders=Object.entries(operations.folders||{}).map(([kind,id])=>`<form data-job-action="folder" data-id="${U.esc(kind)}">
        <label>${U.esc(labels[kind])} <input name="folder" value="${U.esc(id)}" required></label>
        <button class="button" type="submit">Guardar</button></form>`);
      const target=$("admin-job-settings-body");
      target.innerHTML=[$("admin-business-section").value==="storage"?folders.join(""):[interval,...forms].join("")].join("");
      target.onsubmit=async event=>{
        event.preventDefault();
        const form=event.target, action=form.dataset.jobAction;
        if(!action)return;
        const values=new FormData(form), id=form.dataset.id, button=form.querySelector("button");
        const payload=action==="interval"?Number(values.get("minutes")):action==="folder"?{kind:id,id:values.get("folder")}:
          {id,config:{enabled:values.has("enabled"),priority:Number(values.get("priority")),time:values.get("time"),timeZone:values.get("timeZone")}};
        button.disabled=true;
        try{await callServer("admin:jobs:"+action,payload);$("admin-job-settings-result").textContent="Configuración guardada.";await loadAdmin(true)}
        catch(error){$("admin-job-settings-result").textContent=error.message}
        finally{button.disabled=false}
      };
    }

    function adminFilterScopeOptions(kind){
      const options=adminScopeOptions(kind).map(item=>kind==="country"&&item.value!=="ALL"?
        {...item,label:countryLabel(item.value)}:item);
      return [{value:"ANY",label:"Sin filtrar"},...options];
    }
    function nextAdminScopeSelection(current,value){if(value==="ANY")return["ANY"];if(value==="ALL")return["ALL"];const selected=new Set((current||[]).filter(item=>item!=="ALL"&&item!=="ANY"));if(selected.has(value))selected.delete(value);else selected.add(value);return selected.size?[...selected]:["ALL"]}
    function adminSubscriberFilterRows(rows){const filters=state.adminSubscriberFilters,query=filters.query.trim().toLowerCase(),scopeMatches=(values,selected)=>{const configured=values||[];if(selected.includes("ANY"))return true;if(selected.includes("ALL"))return configured.includes("ALL");if(configured.includes("ALL"))return false;return selected.some(value=>configured.includes(value))};return rows.filter(row=>(!query||String(row.email||"").toLowerCase().includes(query))&&(filters.status==="ALL"||(row.active?"ACTIVE":"PAUSED")===filters.status)&&(!filters.newsletter||(row.newsletterEnabled?"YES":"NO")===filters.newsletter)&&scopeMatches(row.countries,filters.countries)&&scopeMatches(row.platforms,filters.platforms))}

    }
    function renderAdminSubscribers(rows){
      const filtered=adminSubscriberFilterRows(rows);
      $("admin-subscriber-results").textContent=`${integer(rows.length)} suscriptores · ${integer(filtered.length)} suscripciones en la selección`;
      const headings=["Suscriptor","Geografía","Idioma","Estado","Último envío","Acciones"];
      const geography=row=>adminSubscriberScopeText("country",row.countries);
      const language=row=>subscriberLanguageNames[row.newsletterLanguage]||"—";
      const stateLabel=row=>row.newsletterEnabled?"Activa":"Pausada";
      const lastDelivery=row=>row.lastNewsletterAt?dateTimeLabel(row.lastNewsletterAt):"Sin envío reciente registrado";
      const size=20,pages=Math.max(1,Math.ceil(filtered.length/size));
      subscriberPage=Math.min(subscriberPage,pages-1);
      const selected=filtered.slice(subscriberPage*size,(subscriberPage+1)*size);
      $("admin-subscribers").innerHTML=selected.length?`<div class="table-wrap"><table class="subscriber-table">
        <caption class="visually-hidden">Suscripciones del equipo</caption><thead><tr>${headings.map(label=>`<th scope="col">${label}</th>`).join("")}</tr></thead>
        <tbody>${selected.map(row=>`<tr><td data-label="Suscriptor"><strong>${U.esc(row.email)}</strong></td>
          <td data-label="Geografía">${U.esc(geography(row))}</td><td data-label="Idioma">${U.esc(language(row))}</td>
          <td data-label="Estado"><span class="status-pill" data-state="${row.newsletterEnabled?"positive":""}">${stateLabel(row)}</span></td>
          <td data-label="Último envío">${U.esc(lastDelivery(row))}</td><td data-label="Acciones"><div class="actions">
            <button type="button" class="button" data-action="edit" data-subscriber="${U.esc(row.email)}" aria-label="Editar ${U.esc(row.email)}">Editar</button>
            ${row.newsletterEnabled?`<button type="button" class="button" data-action="delete" data-subscriber="${U.esc(row.email)}" aria-label="Dar de baja ${U.esc(row.email)}">Dar de baja</button>`:""}
          </div></td></tr>`).join("")}</tbody></table></div>`:'<div class="panel empty"><p>Sin suscripciones.</p></div>';
      const exportButton=$("admin-subscriber-export");
      exportButton.disabled=!filtered.length;
      exportButton.onclick=()=>exportAdminRows("Suscripciones",headings.slice(0,-1).concat(["Plataformas","Alertas","Último acceso"]),
        filtered.map(row=>[row.email,geography(row),language(row),stateLabel(row),lastDelivery(row),adminSubscriberScopeText("platform",row.platforms),
          row.active?"Activas":"Pausadas",dateTimeLabel(row.lastSeenAt)]));
      const pagination=$("admin-subscriber-pagination");
      pagination.innerHTML=`<button type="button" class="button" data-step="-1" ${subscriberPage?"":"disabled"}>Anterior</button>
        <span> ${subscriberPage+1} / ${pages} </span><button type="button" class="button" data-step="1" ${subscriberPage+1<pages?"":"disabled"}>Siguiente</button>`;
      pagination.onclick=event=>{const step=event.target.dataset.step;if(step){subscriberPage+=Number(step);renderAdminSubscribers(rows)}};
    }
    function adminSubscriberDefault(){return{active:true,newsletterEnabled:true,countries:["ALL"],platforms:["ALL"],reviewShareEnabled:false,reviewWarningPct:15,reviewCriticalPct:30,dailyDropEnabled:true,dailyWarningDrop:.1,dailyCriticalDrop:.15,mtdDropEnabled:true,mtdWarningDrop:.3,mtdCriticalDrop:.5,ytdDropEnabled:true,ytdWarningDrop:.3,ytdCriticalDrop:.5,repeatWhileBreached:false,crossoverEnabled:true,crossoverDirection:"BOTH",deliveryMode:"DAILY_DIGEST"}}
    function adminScopeOptions(kind){return kind==="country"?[{value:"ALL",label:"Todos",meta:`${Object.keys(D.config.countries).length} mercados`},...Object.keys(D.config.countries).map(value=>({value,label:D.config.countries[value]}))]:[{value:"ALL",label:"Todas",meta:`${D.config.platforms.length} plataformas`},...D.config.platforms.map(value=>({value,label:value}))]}

    function openAdminSubscriber(email=""){const row=(state.adminCenter?.subscribers||[]).find(item=>item.email===email),draft=Object.assign(adminSubscriberDefault(),row||{});state.adminEditingEmail=row?.email||"";$("admin-subscriber-title").textContent=row?"Editar suscripción":"Alta manual";$("admin-subscriber-save").textContent=row?"Guardar cambios":"Crear suscripción";$("admin-subscriber-email").value=row?.email||"";$("admin-subscriber-email").disabled=Boolean(row);$("admin-newsletter-language").value=row?.newsletterLanguage||appLanguage;$("admin-subscriber-active").checked=Boolean(draft.active);$("admin-newsletter-enabled").checked=Boolean(draft.newsletterEnabled);renderAdminScope("country",draft.countries);renderAdminScope("platform",draft.platforms);[["daily",draft.dailyDropEnabled,draft.dailyWarningDrop,draft.dailyCriticalDrop],["mtd",draft.mtdDropEnabled,draft.mtdWarningDrop,draft.mtdCriticalDrop],["ytd",draft.ytdDropEnabled,draft.ytdWarningDrop,draft.ytdCriticalDrop]].forEach(item=>{$(`admin-${item[0]}-enabled`).checked=Boolean(item[1]);$(`admin-${item[0]}-warning`).value=item[2];$(`admin-${item[0]}-critical`).value=item[3]});$("admin-crossover-enabled").checked=Boolean(draft.crossoverEnabled);$("admin-crossover-direction").value=draft.crossoverDirection||"BOTH";$("admin-repeat-enabled").checked=Boolean(draft.repeatWhileBreached);$("admin-subscriber-error").classList.add("hidden");$("admin-subscription-editor").hidden=false;$("admin-subscription-editor").scrollIntoView?.({block:"nearest"});

    async function requestAdminRatingRecovery(){

    async function unsubscribeAdminNewsletter(button){
      const rows=state.adminCenter?.subscribers||[];
      const row=rows.find(item=>item.email===button.dataset.subscriber);
      if(!row?.newsletterEnabled||!window.confirm(`¿Dar de baja la newsletter de ${row.email}?`))return;
      button.disabled=true;
      try{
        const saved=await callServer("admin:subscriber:save",{email:row.email,preferences:{...row,newsletterEnabled:false}});
        rows[rows.indexOf(row)]=saved;
        renderAdminSubscribers(rows);
      }catch(error){showError(error)}
      finally{button.disabled=false}
    }
    async function testAdminNewsletter(event){
      event.preventDefault();
      const form=event.currentTarget, button=event.submitter||form.querySelector('button[type="submit"]');
      const fields=Object.fromEntries(new FormData(form));
      if(fields.edition==="monthly")fields.period="current";
      const fingerprint=JSON.stringify(fields);
      if(form.dataset.fingerprint!==fingerprint){
        form.dataset.fingerprint=fingerprint;
        form.dataset.requestId="NEWS-REQ-"+(window.crypto?.randomUUID?window.crypto.randomUUID():`${Date.now()}-${Math.random().toString(16).slice(2)}`);
      }
      const target=$("newsletter-test-result");
      target.hidden=false;target.classList.remove("error");target.textContent="Procesando solicitud…";
      button.disabled=true;
      try{
        const result=await callServer("admin:newsletter:test",{...fields,requestId:form.dataset.requestId});
        delete form.dataset.fingerprint;
        target.textContent=result.alreadyAccepted?`La prueba ${result.deliveryId} para ${result.recipient} ya había sido aceptada.`:
          [`Gmail ha aceptado la prueba para ${result.recipient}.`,result.acceptedAt&&dateTimeLabel(result.acceptedAt),
            result.messageId&&`Gmail ID ${result.messageId}`].filter(Boolean).join(" · ");
      }catch(error){target.textContent=error.message;target.classList.add("error")}
      finally{button.disabled=false}
    }

    function bindAnnualChartTooltips(){
      const rating=$("annual-chart"),nps=$("annual-nps-chart");
      const show=(point,event)=>{
        if(point)showChartTooltip(point,event);else hideChartTooltip();
      };
      const pointAt=event=>event.target.closest?.(".chart-point");
      function inspectNps(event){
        const svg=nps.querySelector("svg"),matrix=svg?.getScreenCTM();
        if(!matrix){hideChartTooltip();return}
        const series=Array.from(svg.querySelectorAll(".chart-line"),line=>
          Array.from(line.parentElement.querySelectorAll(".chart-point"),node=>{
            const point=new DOMPoint(Number(node.getAttribute("cx")),Number(node.getAttribute("cy"))).matrixTransform(matrix);
            return {node,index:Number(node.dataset.point),x:point.x,y:point.y};
          }));
        show(C.closestReviewPoint(series,event.clientX,event.clientY)?.node,event);
      }
      rating.addEventListener("pointermove",event=>{if(event.pointerType!=="touch")show(pointAt(event),event)});
      rating.addEventListener("pointerup",event=>{if(event.pointerType==="touch")show(pointAt(event),event)});
      nps.addEventListener("pointermove",event=>{if(event.pointerType!=="touch")inspectNps(event)});
      nps.addEventListener("pointerup",event=>{if(event.pointerType==="touch")inspectNps(event)});
      for(const chart of [rating,nps]){
        for(const name of ["pointerleave","pointercancel","touchcancel","focusout"])chart.addEventListener(name,hideChartTooltip);
        chart.addEventListener("focusin",event=>{
          const point=pointAt(event);
          if(!point)return;
          const box=point.getBoundingClientRect();
          show(point,{clientX:box.left+box.width/2,clientY:box.top});
        });
      }
      window.addEventListener("blur",hideChartTooltip);
      document.addEventListener("visibilitychange",hideChartTooltip);
      document.addEventListener("keydown",event=>{if(event.key==="Escape")hideChartTooltip()});
      document.addEventListener("pointerdown",event=>{
        if(!rating.contains(event.target)&&!nps.contains(event.target))hideChartTooltip();
      });
      const observer=new MutationObserver(hideChartTooltip);
      for(const chart of [rating,nps])observer.observe(chart,{childList:true,subtree:true});
    }
    function showChartTooltip(point,event){const tooltip=$("chart-tooltip");tooltip.innerHTML=`<strong>${U.esc(point.dataset.label)}</strong>${U.esc(point.dataset.month)} · ${U.esc(point.dataset.value)}${!point.dataset.point&&state.country==="ALL"?" · BBVA Empresas":""}`;tooltip.classList.remove("hidden");positionTooltip(event.clientX,event.clientY)}
    function positionTooltip(x,y){const tooltip=$("chart-tooltip"),left=Math.min(window.innerWidth-tooltip.offsetWidth-12,x+13),top=Math.max(10,y-tooltip.offsetHeight-14);tooltip.style.left=`${left}px`;tooltip.style.top=`${top}px`}
    function hideChartTooltip(){$("chart-tooltip").classList.add("hidden")}
    const exportDates=({start,end})=>[["Desde",start],["Hasta",end]];
    const reviewExportHeader=["Fecha","Aplicación","Plataforma","Escaparate","Estrellas","Autor","Título","Comentario",
      "Texto original","Bloques funcionales","Votos útiles","Respuesta","Enlace","Geografía atribuida","Atribución"];
    const reviewAttributionLabels={
      single_storefront:"Escaparate único",review_evidence_inferred:"Inferida",review_evidence_validated:"Validada"
    };
    const reviewExportRow=(row,topics)=>[row.date,row.entities?.join(" · ")||row.app,row.platform,
      row.storefronts?.map(countryLabel).join(" · "),row.rating,row.author,row.title,row.text,row.translated?row.original:"",
      (row.blocks.length?row.blocks:["general"]).map(id=>topics[id]||id).join(" · "),row.helpful,row.reply,row.url,
      row.countries?.map(countryLabel).join(" · "),translate(reviewAttributionLabels[row.attributionMethod]||"No atribuible")];
    let reviewsReady=false, analyticsLoading=false, monthlyReviewsLoading=false;
    function setExportSheet(view,name,country,filters,header,rows,chart=false){
      const sheets=exportSheets[view];
      if(rows.length)sheets.set(name,{name,country,filters:[["Geografía",countryLabel(country)],...filters],header,rows,chart});
      else sheets.delete(name);
    }
    async function downloadReport(){
      const view=state.view, button=$("report-button");
      if(mobileViewport.matches||button.disabled||!state.meta)return;
      const label=button.innerHTML;
      button.disabled=true;
      button.textContent=translate("Preparando Excel…");
      try{
        const country=view==="reviews"?reviewScope().country:view==="analytics"?annualScope().country:state.country;
        if(!country||country==="ALL")throw new Error("Selecciona una geografía para descargar Excel.");
        if((view==="analytics"&&analyticsLoading)||(view==="evolution"&&(state.trendsLoading||monthlyReviewsLoading))){
          throw new Error("Espera a que termine de cargar la selección.");
        }
        let sheets;
        if(view==="reviews"){
          if(!reviewsReady)throw new Error("No hay comentarios cargados para descargar.");
          const scope={...reviewScope(),language:appLanguage};
          const {rows,topics,window:dates}=await callServer("review:export",scope);
          const filters=[["Geografía",countryLabel(country)],...exportDates(dates),
            ["Inferir datos",reviewFilterLabel("inferGeography",scope.inferGeography)]];
          for(const key of ["app","platform","segment","audience","topic","rating","search","reviewKey"]){
            if(scope[key])filters.push([({app:"Aplicación",platform:"Plataforma",segment:"Sentimiento",audience:"Comentarios",topic:"Bloque funcional",rating:"Estrellas",search:"Buscar",reviewKey:"Reseña"})[key],reviewFilterLabel(key,scope[key])||$(`review-${key}`)?.selectedOptions?.[0]?.textContent||scope[key]]);
          }
          sheets=[{name:"Comentarios",filters,header:reviewExportHeader,rows:rows.map(row=>reviewExportRow(row,topics))}];
        }else{
          sheets=[...(exportSheets[view]?.values()||[])].filter(sheet=>sheet.country===country);
        }
        const file=window.MarketsWorkbook.build(sheets);
        const url=URL.createObjectURL(file), link=document.createElement("a");
        link.href=url;
        const title={benchmark:"Resumen",evolution:"Análisis mensual",analytics:"Análisis anual",reviews:"Comentarios"}[view];
        link.download=`EDC Market Pulse - ${title} - ${country}.xlsx`;
        link.click();
        window.setTimeout(()=>URL.revokeObjectURL(url),1000);
        trackUsage("ACTION",view,"REPORT_DOWNLOAD");
      }catch(error){showError(error)}
      finally{button.disabled=false;button.innerHTML=label}
    }
    function showToast(message,success=false){const toast=$("toast");toast.textContent=message;toast.classList.toggle("success",success);toast.classList.remove("hidden");window.setTimeout(()=>toast.classList.add("hidden"),7000)}
    function showError(error){const message=error?.message||String(error);trackUsage("ERROR",state.view,"CLIENT_ERROR",message);showToast(message,false)}
  })();
</script>

<script>
  (()=>{
    "use strict";
    function lineChart(series,options){
      const ui=window.MarketsUI,theme=window.MarketsTheme.chart,finite=window.MarketsDomain.finite;
      const visible=(series||[]).slice(0,options.maxSeries??12).map(item=>({...item,points:(item.points||[]).filter(point=>!options.period||point.month<=options.period)})).filter(item=>item.points.length);
      if(!visible.length)return{svg:ui.empty("Sin datos para esta selección","No existen observaciones con los filtros y el periodo elegidos."),series:[]};
      const months=options.months||[...new Set(visible.flatMap(item=>item.points.map(point=>point.month)))].sort();
      const monthIndex=new Map(months.map((month,index)=>[month,index]));
      const values=visible.flatMap(item=>item.points.map(point=>point.value)).filter(finite);
      let min=Math.max(1,Math.floor((Math.min(...values)-.12)*10)/10),max=Math.min(5,Math.ceil((Math.max(...values)+.12)*10)/10);if(max-min<.4){min=Math.max(1,min-.2);max=Math.min(5,max+.2)}
      const width=theme.width,height=theme.height,left=theme.left,right=theme.right,top=theme.top,bottom=theme.bottom,plotW=width-left-right,plotH=height-top-bottom;
      const x=month=>left+(months.length===1?plotW/2:monthIndex.get(month)/(months.length-1)*plotW);const y=value=>top+(max-value)/(max-min)*plotH;
      const ticks=Array.from({length:5},(_,index)=>min+(max-min)*index/4);const step=Math.max(1,Math.ceil(months.length/8));
      const grid=ticks.map(value=>`<g><line x1="${left}" y1="${y(value)}" x2="${width-right}" y2="${y(value)}" stroke="${theme.grid}"/><text x="${left-12}" y="${y(value)+4}" text-anchor="end" fill="${theme.axis}" font-size="${theme.fontSize}">${options.format(value,1)}</text></g>`).join("");
      const labels=months.map((month,index)=>index%step===0||index===months.length-1?`<text x="${x(month)}" y="${height-16}" text-anchor="middle" fill="${theme.axis}" font-size="${theme.fontSize}">${ui.esc(options.monthLabel(month))}</text>`:"").join("");
      const lines=visible.map((item,index)=>{const color=theme.palette[index%theme.palette.length];const points=item.points.filter(point=>finite(point.value)).sort((a,b)=>a.month.localeCompare(b.month));const path=points.map((point,position)=>`${position?"L":"M"}${x(point.month).toFixed(1)},${y(point.value).toFixed(1)}`).join(" ");const circles=points.map(point=>`<circle class="chart-point" tabindex="0" cx="${x(point.month)}" cy="${y(point.value)}" r="${theme.pointRadius}" fill="${color}" stroke="${theme.surface}" stroke-width="${theme.pointStroke}" data-label="${ui.esc(item.label)}" data-month="${ui.esc(options.monthLabel(point.month))}" data-value="${options.format(point.value,2)}"></circle>`).join("");return`<path d="${path}" fill="none" stroke="${color}" stroke-width="${item.isBbva?theme.focusLineWidth:theme.lineWidth}" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-linecap="round" opacity="${item.isBbva?1:.82}"/>${circles}`}).join("");
      const scope=options.context,idPrefix=options.idPrefix||"markets";
      const svg=`<svg viewBox="0 0 ${width} ${height}" role="img" aria-labelledby="${idPrefix}-chart-title ${idPrefix}-chart-desc"><title id="${idPrefix}-chart-title">Evolución mensual de ratings</title><desc id="${idPrefix}-chart-desc">${ui.esc(scope)}. Periodo hasta ${ui.esc(options.monthLabel(months.at(-1)))}</desc>${grid}<line x1="${left}" y1="${top}" x2="${left}" y2="${height-bottom}" stroke="${theme.axis}"/>${labels}${lines}</svg>`;
      return{svg,series:visible};
    }
    function ratingBars(groups,options){
      const ui=window.MarketsUI,finite=window.MarketsDomain.finite;
      const boards=(groups||[]).map(group=>`<section class="rating-board"><header><strong>${ui.esc(group.platform)}</strong><span>${group.rows.length} ${group.rows.length===1?"referencia":"referencias"}</span></header><ol>${group.rows.map(row=>{const value=finite(row.rating)?row.rating:0;return`<li><span class="rating-bar-label" title="${ui.esc(options.label(row))}">${ui.esc(options.label(row))}</span><span class="rating-bar-metric"><span class="rating-bar-track"><i style="width:${Math.max(0,Math.min(100,value/5*100))}%"></i></span><b aria-label="Rating ${ui.esc(options.format(value,1))} sobre 5">${ui.esc(options.format(value,1))}</b></span></li>`}).join("")}</ol></section>`).join("");
      return boards?`<div class="rating-comparison-grid">${boards}</div>`:ui.empty("Sin ratings comparables","Prueba otro mercado o plataforma.");
    }
    function monthlyMatrix(model,options){
      const ui=window.MarketsUI,finite=window.MarketsDomain.finite;
      if(!model?.periods?.length||!model?.rows?.length)return ui.empty("Sin cierres mensuales","Aún no hay histórico suficiente para esta selección.");
      const header=model.periods.map((month,index)=>`<th scope="col" class="${index===model.periods.length-1?"latest":""}"><span>${ui.esc(options.monthLabel(month))}</span>${index===model.periods.length-1?'<small><i></i>Actual</small>':""}</th>`).join("");
      const nps=cell=>{
        if(!options.npsReady)return '<div class="monthly-nps"><span>NPS</span><span aria-label="Cargando NPS">…</span></div>';
        const delta=finite(cell.npsDelta)&&Math.abs(cell.npsDelta)>=.05;
        return `<div class="monthly-nps"${cell.npsSample?` title="${ui.esc(cell.npsSample)}"`:""}><span>NPS</span><strong>${finite(cell.nps)?options.format(cell.nps,1):"N/D"}</strong>${delta?`<em class="${cell.npsDelta>0?"delta-up":"delta-down"}">${ui.esc(options.signed(cell.npsDelta,1))} pp</em>`:""}</div>`;
      };
      const body=model.rows.map(row=>`${options.showScopes?`<tr class="monthly-scope"><th scope="rowgroup" colspan="${model.periods.length}">${ui.esc(row.country)}</th></tr>`:""}<tr>${row.cells.map((cell,index)=>{const hasDelta=finite(cell.delta)&&Math.abs(cell.delta)>=.005,tone=cell.delta>0?"delta-up":"delta-down";const reviews=cell.platforms.map(item=>{const detail=item.unavailable?"N/D: Google Play no permite desagregar esta ficha por geografía.":`${options.integer(item.value)} reseñas`;return`<span class="monthly-review${item.unavailable?" unavailable":""}" title="${ui.esc(detail)}"><span>${ui.esc(item.platform)}</span><b>${item.unavailable?"N/D":options.compactInteger(item.value)}</b></span>`}).join("");return`<td class="${index===row.cells.length-1?"latest":""}"><div class="monthly-rating"><strong>${options.format(cell.rating,2)}</strong>${hasDelta?`<em class="${tone}">${ui.esc(options.signed(cell.delta))}</em>`:""}</div><div class="monthly-reviews">${reviews}</div>${nps(cell)}</td>`}).join("")}</tr>`).join("");
      return`<div class="monthly-matrix-scroll"><table class="monthly-matrix"><caption>Evolución mensual del rating, volumen de valoraciones y NPS de reseñas</caption><thead><tr>${header}</tr></thead><tbody>${body}</tbody></table></div>`;
    }
    function newReviewImpact(model,options){
      const ui=window.MarketsUI,{finite,monthlyVoiceScope,monthlyVoiceVolumeDetail}=window.MarketsDomain,translate=options.translate||String,summary=model?.summary||{};
      if(!model?.previousPeriod||!model?.rows?.length)return ui.empty("Aún no hay base mensual","Se necesitan dos cierres consecutivos con rating y volumen acumulado.");
      const status=impact=>!finite(impact)?{label:"Sin estimación",tone:"neutral"}:impact>.005?{label:"Impulsa el rating",tone:"positive"}:impact<-.005?{label:"Presiona el rating",tone:"negative"}:{label:"Mantiene el nivel",tone:"neutral"};
      const reason=row=>row.reasons.includes("SHARED_CONFLICT")?"La ficha compartida no presenta cierres consistentes":row.reasons.includes("ROUNDING")?"El redondeo del rating acumulado impide una estimación fiable":row.reasons.includes("NO_NEW_REVIEWS")?"Sin incremento de valoraciones en el mes":"Falta uno de los dos cierres comparables";
      const platformModels=summary.platforms||[],validPlatforms=platformModels.filter(item=>finite(item.rating)),unavailablePlatforms=platformModels.filter(item=>!finite(item.rating));
      const platformCards=validPlatforms.map(item=>{const signal=status(item.impact),platform=item.platform,
        volume=item.sharedMarket?translate(monthlyVoiceVolumeDetail(item)):`${options.integer(item.newReviews)} ${translate("valoraciones")}`;
        return`<article class="new-review-platform-card ${signal.tone}"><header><strong>${ui.esc(platform)}</strong><span>${item.availableSeries}/${item.totalSeries} fichas</span></header><div><strong>${options.format(item.rating,2)}<small> / 5</small></strong><b class="${signal.tone}">${ui.esc(signal.label)} · ${ui.esc(options.signed(item.impact))}</b></div><p>${ui.esc(volume)} · ${item.volumeScope==="SHARED_LISTING"?ui.esc(translate(monthlyVoiceScope(item))):ui.esc(item.platform)}</p></article>`}).join("");
      const unavailableNote=unavailablePlatforms.length?`<div class="new-review-unavailable"><strong>Sin estimación agregada:</strong><span>${unavailablePlatforms.map(item=>`${ui.esc(item.platform)} (${item.availableSeries}/${item.totalSeries} fichas calculables)`).join(" · ")}</span></div>`:"";
      const rows=model.rows.map(row=>{const signal=status(row.impact),scope=row.scopeLabel||row.country;return`<tr><th scope="row"><strong>${ui.esc(row.platform)}</strong>${options.showScopes?`<small>${ui.esc(scope)}</small>`:""}<small>${ui.esc(translate(monthlyVoiceScope(row)))}</small></th><td><strong>${finite(row.rating)?options.format(row.rating,2):"N/D"}</strong>${finite(row.rating)?" / 5":""}<small>${finite(row.rating)?`Estimación ${row.confidence==="HIGH"?"estable":row.confidence==="MEDIUM"?"orientativa":"sensible al redondeo"}`:ui.esc(reason(row))}</small></td><td><strong>${finite(row.newReviews)?options.integer(row.newReviews):"N/D"}</strong><small>${ui.esc(translate(monthlyVoiceVolumeDetail(row)))}</small></td><td><strong class="${signal.tone}">${finite(row.impact)?ui.esc(options.signed(row.impact)):"N/D"}</strong><small>${ui.esc(translate("vs. rating previo de la misma ficha"))}</small></td><td><span class="new-review-status ${signal.tone}">${ui.esc(signal.label)}</span></td></tr>`}).join("");
      const coverage=summary.totalSeries?summary.availableSeries/summary.totalSeries:null;
      return`<div class="new-review-overview"><div class="new-review-platform-grid">${platformCards||'<article class="new-review-platform-card neutral"><header><strong>Sin estimaciones publicables</strong></header><p>El detalle inferior explica qué impide calcular cada ficha.</p></article>'}</div><div class="new-review-mini"><article><span>Cobertura</span><strong>${options.integer(summary.availableSeries)}/${options.integer(summary.totalSeries)}</strong><small>${finite(coverage)?options.format(coverage*100,0)+"% de fichas únicas":"Sin base"}</small></article><article><span>Balance</span><strong>${options.integer(summary.improvingSeries)} / ${options.integer(summary.pressuringSeries)}</strong><small>impulsan / presionan</small></article><article><span>Estables</span><strong>${options.integer(summary.stableSeries)}</strong><small>sin diferencia relevante</small></article></div></div>${unavailableNote}<div class="new-review-table-scroll"><table class="new-review-table"><caption>Rating estimado de las reseñas nuevas por ficha y plataforma</caption><thead><tr><th>Plataforma</th><th>Nota del mes</th><th>${ui.esc(translate("Valoraciones"))}</th><th>Efecto</th><th>Lectura</th></tr></thead><tbody>${rows}</tbody></table></div>`;
    }
    // Geometry, interaction targets and classes from News Radar's trend-chart.js.
    function reviewBalance(months,series,options){
      const {esc}=window.MarketsUI, {monthLabel,fmt,width:availableWidth}=options;
      const width=Math.max(170,Math.min(900,availableWidth||900)), height=width<320?208:260;
      const left=width<320?34:42,right=width<320?12:20,top=24,bottom=42;
      const x=i=>left+(months.length===1?.5:i/(months.length-1))*(width-left-right);
      const y=value=>top+(100-value)/200*(height-top-bottom);
      const ticks=[-100,-50,0,50,100].map(value=>`<line x1="${left}" x2="${width-right}" y1="${y(value)}" y2="${y(value)}" class="chart-grid"/><text x="${left-12}" y="${y(value)+4}" text-anchor="end">${value}</text>`).join("");
      const labels=[...new Set([0,Math.floor((months.length-1)/2),months.length-1])].map(i=>
        `<text x="${x(i)}" y="${height-12}" text-anchor="${i===0?"start":i===months.length-1?"end":"middle"}">${esc(monthLabel(months[i]))}</text>`).join("");
      const lines=series.map(({entity,values})=>{
        let segment=null;
        const points=[], paths=[];
        values.forEach((value,i)=>{
          if(!Number.isFinite(value)){segment=null;return}
          const px=x(i), py=y(value);
          if(!segment){segment=[];paths.push(segment)}
          segment.push([px,py]);
          const period=monthLabel(months[i]), label=fmt(value,1)+" pp";
          points.push(`<circle class="chart-point" tabindex="0" aria-label="${esc(entity+" · "+period+" · "+label)}" data-point="${i}" data-label="${esc(entity)}" data-month="${esc(period)}" data-value="${esc(label)}" cx="${px}" cy="${py}" r="4" fill="${reviewSeriesColor(entity)}"/>`);
        });
        const path=group=>group.map(([px,py],i)=>`${i?"L":"M"}${px.toFixed(1)},${py.toFixed(1)}`).join(" ");
        const areas=options.shade!==false&&series.length===1?paths.filter(group=>group.length>1).map(group=>
          `<path class="chart-area" d="${path(group)} L${group.at(-1)[0]},${y(0)} L${group[0][0]},${y(0)} Z"/>`).join(""):"";
        return `<g>${areas}<path d="${paths.map(path).join(" ")}" stroke="${reviewSeriesColor(entity)}" class="chart-line"/>${points.join("")}</g>`;
      }).join("");
      return `<svg viewBox="0 0 ${width} ${height}" role="group" aria-label="NPS mensual de reseñas por entidad, de menos cien a cien puntos porcentuales">${ticks}${labels}${lines}</svg>`;
    }
    function closestReviewPoint(series,x,y,threshold=12){
      let best=null, distance=threshold**2;
      for(const points of series){
        for(let i=0;i<points.length;i++){
          const point=points[i], previous=points[i-1];
          let candidate=point, dx=x-point.x, dy=y-point.y;
          if(previous?.index===point.index-1){
            const sx=previous.x-point.x, sy=previous.y-point.y, length=sx*sx+sy*sy;
            if(length){
              const fraction=Math.max(0,Math.min(1,(dx*sx+dy*sy)/length));
              dx-=fraction*sx;dy-=fraction*sy;
              if(fraction>=.5)candidate=previous;
            }
          }
          const squared=dx*dx+dy*dy;
          if(squared<distance){best=candidate;distance=squared}
        }
      }
      return best;
    }
    function reviewSeriesColor(entity){
      let hash=0;
      for(const char of entity)hash=(Math.imul(31,hash)+char.codePointAt(0))>>>0;
      return `var(--chart-series-${entity==="BBVA Empresas"?1:2+hash%5})`;
    }
    function reviewBalanceLegend(rows,integer){
      const {esc}=window.MarketsUI, max=Math.max(1,...rows.map(row=>row.total));
      return `<p class="eyebrow">ENTIDADES DE SEGUIMIENTO</p><div class="geo-entities">${rows.map(({entity,total})=>
        `<div class="geo-row"><span class="identity-label"><i aria-hidden="true" style="background:${reviewSeriesColor(entity)}"></i>${esc(entity)}</span><span class="geo-count">${integer(total)}</span><span class="geo-track" aria-hidden="true"><span style="width:${100*total/max}%;background:${reviewSeriesColor(entity)}"></span></span></div>`
      ).join("")}</div>`;
    }
    function reviewGaps(rows,fmt,translate){
      if(!rows.some(row=>row.gap!==null))return "";
      const {esc}=window.MarketsUI, width=960,left=260,right=20,top=16,step=28,height=top+step*rows.length+55;
      const min=Math.min(0,...rows.map(row=>row.gap)), max=Math.max(0,...rows.map(row=>row.gap));
      const interval=[5,10,20,40,50,100].find(value=>value>=Math.max(5,(max-min)/8))||100;
      const low=Math.min(-interval,Math.floor(min/interval)*interval), high=Math.max(interval,Math.ceil(max/interval)*interval);
      const x=value=>left+(value-low)/(high-low)*(width-left-right), zero=x(0), bottom=top+step*rows.length;
      const grid=Array.from({length:1+Math.round((high-low)/interval)},(_,i)=>{
        const value=low+i*interval, px=x(value);
        return `<path class="${value===0?"gap-zero":"gap-grid"}" d="M${px} ${top}V${bottom}"/><text x="${px}" y="${bottom+20}" text-anchor="middle">${value}</text>`;
      }).join("");
      const bars=rows.map((row,i)=>{
        const y=top+i*step, end=x(row.gap);
        return `<path class="gap-grid" d="M${left} ${y+step/2}H${width-right}"/><text x="${left-8}" y="${y+step/2+4}" text-anchor="end">${esc(row.label)}</text><rect class="${row.gap<0?"gap-negative":"gap-positive"}" x="${Math.min(zero,end)}" y="${y+4}" width="${Math.abs(end-zero)}" height="${step-8}"><title>${esc(row.label)}: ${fmt(row.gap,1)} pp</title></rect>`;
      }).join("");
      const mobileX=value=>20+(value-low)/(high-low)*280;
      const mobile=rows.map(row=>`<div class="review-gap-mobile-row"><strong>${esc(row.label)}</strong><span>${row.gap===null?"N/D":fmt(row.gap,1)+" pp"}</span><svg viewBox="0 0 320 28" role="img" aria-label="${esc(row.label)}: ${row.gap===null?"N/D":fmt(row.gap,1)+" pp"}"><rect class="gap-background" x="20" y="4" width="280" height="20"/><path class="gap-zero" d="M${mobileX(0)} 0V28"/>${row.gap===null?"":`<rect class="${row.gap<0?"gap-negative":"gap-positive"}" x="${Math.min(mobileX(0),mobileX(row.gap))}" y="4" width="${Math.abs(mobileX(row.gap)-mobileX(0))}" height="20"/>`}</svg></div>`).join("");
      return `<div class="review-gap-mobile">${mobile}<div class="review-gap-mobile-axis"><span>${fmt(low,0)}</span><span>${fmt(high,0)}</span></div><p>${esc(translate("Brecha de NPS vs. mes anterior (pp)"))}</p></div><div class="review-gap-plot"><svg viewBox="0 0 ${width} ${height}" role="img" aria-label="${esc(translate("Brecha de NPS por bloque"))}"><rect class="gap-background" x="${left}" y="${top}" width="${width-left-right}" height="${bottom-top}"/>${grid}${bars}<text x="${(left+width-right)/2}" y="${height-8}" text-anchor="middle">${esc(translate("Brecha de NPS vs. mes anterior (pp)"))}</text></svg></div>`;
    }
    window.MarketsCharts=Object.freeze({closestReviewPoint,lineChart,ratingBars,monthlyMatrix,newReviewImpact,reviewBalance,reviewBalanceLegend,reviewSeriesColor,reviewGaps});
  })();
</script>
