<script>
  (()=>{
    "use strict";
    const config=Object.freeze({

      countries:Object.freeze({AR:"Argentina",CO:"Colombia",ES:"España",MX:"México",PE:"Perú",TR:"Turquía",UY:"Uruguay",VE:"Venezuela"}),
      platforms:Object.freeze(["Android","iOS","Huawei"]),
      criticalPlatforms:Object.freeze(["Android","iOS"]),
      platformLabels:Object.freeze({ALL:"Todas",Android:"Android",iOS:"iOS",Huawei:"Huawei"}),
      storeLabels:Object.freeze({Android:"Google Play",iOS:"App Store",Huawei:"AppGallery"}),
      segmentLabels:Object.freeze({BANK:"Banca empresas",FINTECH:"Fintech y Neobancos",ALL:"Todo el mercado"})
    });
    const finite=value=>typeof value==="number"&&Number.isFinite(value);
    const sum=values=>values.filter(finite).reduce((total,value)=>total+value,0);
    const sumOrNull=values=>{const clean=values.filter(finite);return clean.length?sum(clean):null};
    const mean=values=>{const clean=values.filter(finite);return clean.length?sum(clean)/clean.length:null};
    const groupBy=(rows,selector)=>rows.reduce((out,row)=>{const key=selector(row);(out[key]||(out[key]=[])).push(row);return out},{});
    const appName=row=>row.isBbva?"BBVA Empresas":row.appName;
    const isCriticalPlatform=platform=>config.criticalPlatforms.includes(platform);
    const selectionRows=(snapshot,selection,segment="BANK",includeBbva=false)=>(snapshot||[]).filter(row=>(selection.country==="ALL"||row.countryCode===selection.country)&&(selection.platform==="ALL"||row.platform===selection.platform)&&(segment==="ALL"||row.segment===segment||(includeBbva&&segment==="FINTECH"&&row.isBbva)));
    const coverageRows=(rows,selection)=>(selection?.platform||"ALL")==="ALL"?(rows||[]).filter(row=>isCriticalPlatform(row.platform)):(rows||[]);
    const trendRows=(trends,selection)=>(trends||[]).filter(row=>(selection.country==="ALL"||row.countryCode===selection.country)&&(selection.platform==="ALL"||row.platform===selection.platform)&&(!selection.app||appName(row)===selection.app));
    function browserMarket(language,timeZone,countries){
      let region;
      try{region=new Intl.Locale(language).region}catch(ignored){}
      if(countries.includes(region))return region;
      const marketsByZone={"Europe/Istanbul":"TR","Europe/Madrid":"ES","Atlantic/Canary":"ES","America/Mexico_City":"MX","America/Bogota":"CO","America/Lima":"PE","America/Montevideo":"UY","America/Caracas":"VE"};
      const market=timeZone?.startsWith("America/Argentina/")?"AR":marketsByZone[timeZone];
      return countries.includes(market)?market:"ALL";
    }
    function benchmarkWeightedRows(rows){
      return Object.values(groupBy(rows,appName)).map(group=>({
        ...group[0],platform:"Media ponderada",storeUrl:"",
        rating:weightedMean(group),delta30d:weightedMean(group,row=>row.delta30d),
        ratingCount:sumOrNull(group.map(row=>row.ratingCount)),fresh:group.every(row=>row.fresh),
        rankingComplete:group.every(row=>row.rankingComplete)
      }));
    }
    function uniqueStoreRows(rows){
      const byKey=new Map();
      (rows||[]).forEach(row=>{const key=row.volumeKey||row.appKey;const current=byKey.get(key);if(!current||quality(row)>quality(current)||(quality(row)===quality(current)&&finite(row.ratingCount)&&(!finite(current.ratingCount)||row.ratingCount>current.ratingCount)))byKey.set(key,row)});
      return[...byKey.values()];
    }
    const quality=row=>(finite(row.rating)?8:0)+(finite(row.ratingCount)?4:0)+(finite(row.ratingCountDelta30d)?2:0)+(row.fresh?1:0);
    function volumeSummary(rows){
      const bbvaOnly=uniqueStoreRows((rows||[]).filter(row=>row.isBbva));
      const counted=bbvaOnly.filter(row=>finite(row.ratingCount));
      const comparable=bbvaOnly.filter(row=>finite(row.ratingCountDelta30d));
      return{accumulated:sumOrNull(counted.map(row=>row.ratingCount)),period:sumOrNull(comparable.map(row=>Math.max(0,row.ratingCountDelta30d))),counted:counted.length,comparable:comparable.length,shared:bbvaOnly.filter(row=>row.volumeScope==="SHARED_LISTING").length};
    }
    function rankRows(rows){
      const sorted=[...(rows||[])].sort((a,b)=>b.rating-a.rating||(a.displayOrder||0)-(b.displayOrder||0)||appName(a).localeCompare(appName(b)));
      return sorted.map(row=>({...row,computedRank:1+sorted.filter(other=>other.rating>row.rating).length}));
    }
    function rankReviewNpsRows(rows){
      const sampled=row=>row.total>0&&finite(row.rating);
      return [...rankRows(rows.filter(sampled)),...rows.filter(row=>!sampled(row))
        .sort((a,b)=>(a.displayOrder||0)-(b.displayOrder||0)||appName(a).localeCompare(appName(b)))
        .map(row=>({...row,rating:null,computedRank:null}))];
    }
    function countBbvaLeaders(rows){
      const groups=groupBy(rows||[],row=>`${row.countryCode}|${row.platform}`);
      let value=0,comparable=0,sole=0,shared=0;
      Object.values(groups).forEach(group=>{
        const ranked=rankRows(group.filter(row=>finite(row.rating)));
        if(ranked.length<2||ranked.some(row=>!row.rankingComplete))return;
        const bbva=ranked.find(row=>row.isBbva);
        if(!bbva)return;
        comparable++;
        if(bbva.computedRank!==1)return;
        value++;
        if(ranked.filter(row=>row.rating===bbva.rating).length===1)sole++;
        else shared++;
      });
      return{value,comparable,sole,shared};
    }
    function availablePeriods(rows){return[...new Set((rows||[]).filter(row=>finite(row.ratingEom)).map(row=>row.month))].sort()}
    function periodModel(rows,preferredYear,preferredMonth){
      const periods=availablePeriods(rows);const latest=periods.at(-1)||"";
      const years=[...new Set(periods.map(period=>period.slice(0,4)))].sort().reverse();
      const year=years.includes(String(preferredYear))?String(preferredYear):(latest.slice(0,4)||"");
      const months=periods.filter(period=>period.startsWith(`${year}-`)).map(period=>period.slice(5)).sort().reverse();
      const month=months.includes(String(preferredMonth).padStart(2,"0"))?String(preferredMonth).padStart(2,"0"):(months[0]||"");
      return{period:year&&month?`${year}-${month}`:"",year,month,years,months,periods};
    }
    function weightedMean(rows, valueGetter = r => r.rating, isGlobalScope = false) {
     const valid = (rows || []).filter(r => finite(valueGetter(r)));
     if (!valid.length) return null;

     // 1. Priorizar pesos explícitos del catálogo si están disponibles
     const weightField = isGlobalScope ? "groupUserWeight" : "countryPlatformWeight";
     const withCatalogWeight = valid.filter(r => finite(r[weightField]) && r[weightField] > 0);
     if (withCatalogWeight.length > 0) {
       const totalW = sum(withCatalogWeight.map(r => r[weightField]));
       if (totalW > 0) return sum(withCatalogWeight.map(r => valueGetter(r) * r[weightField])) / totalW;
     }

     // 2. Fallback: Ponderar por volumen de valoraciones (ratingCount o ratingCountEom)
     const countGetter = r => finite(r.ratingCount) ? r.ratingCount : (finite(r.ratingCountEom) ? r.ratingCountEom : null);
     const volumeRows = isGlobalScope ? uniqueStoreRows(valid) : valid;
     const withVolume = volumeRows.filter(r => finite(countGetter(r)) && countGetter(r) > 0);
     if (withVolume.length > 0) {
       const totalV = sum(withVolume.map(countGetter));
       if (totalV > 0) return sum(withVolume.map(r => valueGetter(r) * countGetter(r))) / totalV;
     }

     // 3. Fallback final: media aritmética simple si no hay pesos ni volumen
     return mean(valid.map(valueGetter));
   }

    function ratingAt(rows,period,isGlobalScope=false){return weightedMean((rows||[]).filter(row=>row.month===period),row=>row.ratingEom,isGlobalScope)}
    function previousAvailable(periods,target){return[...(periods||[])].filter(period=>period<target).sort().at(-1)||""}
    function previousYearClose(periods,period){const priorYear=String(Number(period.slice(0,4))-1);return[...(periods||[])].filter(item=>item<=`${priorYear}-12`).sort().at(-1)||""}
    function evolutionKpis(rows,snapshot,selection,period){
      const matchesApp=row=>selection.app?appName(row)===selection.app:row.isBbva;
      const selected=(rows||[]).filter(row=>matchesApp(row)&&row.month<=period);const periods=availablePeriods(selected);const currentPeriod=periods.includes(period)?period:previousAvailable(periods,`${period}-z`);
      const monthPeriod=previousAvailable(periods,currentPeriod);const yearPeriod=previousYearClose(periods,currentPeriod);
      const current=ratingAt(selected,currentPeriod,selection.country==="ALL"),monthClose=ratingAt(selected,monthPeriod,selection.country==="ALL"),yearClose=ratingAt(selected,yearPeriod,selection.country==="ALL");
      const expectedRows=coverageRows(selectionRows(snapshot,selection,"ALL").filter(matchesApp),selection);
      const observedRows=coverageRows(selected,selection);
      const expected=new Set(expectedRows.map(row=>row.appKey)).size;
      const observed=new Set(observedRows.filter(row=>row.month===currentPeriod&&finite(row.ratingEom)).map(row=>row.appKey)).size;
      return{currentPeriod,yearPeriod,monthPeriod,current,yearClose,monthClose,annual:finite(current)&&finite(yearClose)?current-yearClose:null,monthly:finite(current)&&finite(monthClose)?current-monthClose:null,coverage:expected?observed/expected:null,observed,expected};
    }
    function prepareSeries(rows,selection){
      const buckets=new Map();
      (rows||[]).forEach(row=>{let key,label;if(selection.country==="ALL"){key=`${row.countryCode}|${appName(row)}`;label=`${appName(row)} ${config.countries[row.countryCode]||row.country||row.countryCode}`}else if(selection.platform==="ALL"){key=appName(row);label=appName(row)}else{key=row.appKey;label=appName(row)}const bucketKey=`${key}|${row.month}`;const bucket=buckets.get(bucketKey)||{key,label,month:row.month,rows:[],isBbva:row.isBbva};bucket.rows.push(row);bucket.isBbva=bucket.isBbva||row.isBbva;buckets.set(bucketKey,bucket)});
      const grouped=new Map();buckets.forEach(bucket=>{const item=grouped.get(bucket.key)||{key:bucket.key,label:bucket.label,isBbva:bucket.isBbva,points:[]};item.points.push({month:bucket.month,value:weightedMean(bucket.rows,row=>row.ratingEom)});item.isBbva=item.isBbva||bucket.isBbva;grouped.set(bucket.key,item)});
      return[...grouped.values()].sort((a,b)=>Number(b.isBbva)-Number(a.isBbva)||latestValue(b)-latestValue(a)||a.label.localeCompare(b.label));
    }
    const latestValue=series=>[...(series.points||[])].sort((a,b)=>a.month.localeCompare(b.month)).at(-1)?.value||0;
    function ratingComparison(snapshot,selection){
      const platforms=selection.platform==="ALL"?config.platforms:[selection.platform];
      return platforms.map(platform=>{
        const rows=selectionRows(snapshot,{country:selection.country,platform},"BANK")
          .filter(row=>finite(row.rating)&&(selection.country!=="ALL"||row.isBbva));
        return{platform,rows:rankRows(rows)};
      }).filter(group=>group.rows.length);
    }
    const monthlyAppMatches=(row,app)=>app==="ALL"||(app?appName(row)===app:row.isBbva);
    function monthlyRatingMatrix(trends,snapshot,selection,endPeriod,limit=8,includePreviousMonth=false){
      const rows=(trends||[]).filter(row=>monthlyAppMatches(row,selection.app)&&finite(row.ratingEom)&&(!endPeriod||row.month<=endPeriod)&&(selection.country==="ALL"||row.countryCode===selection.country)&&(selection.platform==="ALL"||row.platform===selection.platform));
      const periods=includePreviousMonth&&/^\d{4}-\d{2}$/.test(endPeriod||"")
        ? [previousCalendarMonth(endPeriod),endPeriod]
        : [...new Set(rows.map(row=>row.month))].sort().slice(-Math.max(1,limit));
      const platforms=selection.platform==="ALL"?config.platforms.filter(platform=>isCriticalPlatform(platform)||rows.some(row=>row.platform===platform&&finite(row.ratingEom))):[selection.platform];
      const metadata=new Map((snapshot||[]).map(row=>[row.appKey,row]));
      const countryCodes=[...new Set(rows.map(row=>row.countryCode))].sort((a,b)=>(config.countries[a]||a).localeCompare(config.countries[b]||b,"es"));
      const matrixRows=countryCodes.map(countryCode=>{
        const cells=periods.map(month=>{
          const platformVolumes=platforms.map(platform=>{
            const matches=rows.filter(row=>row.countryCode===countryCode&&row.month===month&&row.platform===platform);
            const unavailable=platform==="Android"&&matches.some(row=>(metadata.get(row.appKey)||row).volumeScope==="SHARED_LISTING");
            return{platform,rating:mean(matches.map(row=>row.ratingEom)),value:unavailable?null:sumOrNull(matches.map(row=>row.ratingCountEom)),unavailable};
          });
          return{month,rating:weightedMean(rows.filter(row=>row.countryCode===countryCode&&row.month===month),row=>row.ratingEom,false),platforms:platformVolumes};
        });
        cells.forEach((cell,index)=>{const previous=index?cells[index-1].rating:null;cell.delta=finite(cell.rating)&&finite(previous)?cell.rating-previous:null});
        const countryRow=rows.find(row=>row.countryCode===countryCode);
        return{countryCode,country:config.countries[countryCode]||countryRow?.country||countryCode,cells};
      });
      return{periods,platforms,rows:matrixRows,hasSharedAndroid:matrixRows.some(row=>row.cells.some(cell=>cell.platforms.some(item=>item.unavailable)))};
    }
    function previousCalendarMonth(period){
      if(!/^\d{4}-\d{2}$/.test(period||""))return"";
      const date=new Date(`${period}-15T12:00:00`);date.setMonth(date.getMonth()-1);
      return`${date.getFullYear()}-${String(date.getMonth()+1).padStart(2,"0")}`;
    }
    function ratingRoundingHalfStep(value,platform){
      if(!finite(value))return null;
      const text=Math.abs(value).toFixed(6).replace(/0+$/,"").replace(/\.$/,"");
      const observedDecimals=(text.split(".")[1]||"").length;
      // El historico anterior a la preservacion de precision se guardaba a dos
      // decimales. Google Play puede publicar solo uno; en ese caso se respeta
      // la resolucion realmente observada en vez de asumir centesimas falsas.
      const minimumDecimals=platform==="Android"?1:2;
      return .5*Math.pow(10,-Math.max(minimumDecimals,observedDecimals));
    }
    function monthlyNewReviewImpact(trends,snapshot,selection,period){
      const previousPeriod=previousCalendarMonth(period),metadata=new Map((snapshot||[]).map(row=>[row.appKey,row]));
      const scoped=(trends||[]).filter(row=>monthlyAppMatches(row,selection.app)&&(selection.country==="ALL"||row.countryCode===selection.country)&&(selection.platform==="ALL"||row.platform===selection.platform));
      const byApp=groupBy(scoped,row=>row.appKey),rawItems=[];
      Object.values(byApp).forEach(appRows=>{
        const current=appRows.find(row=>row.month===period),previous=appRows.find(row=>row.month===previousPeriod);
        if(!current)return;
        const meta=metadata.get(current.appKey)||current,base={appKey:current.appKey,volumeKey:meta.volumeKey||current.appKey,volumeScope:meta.volumeScope||"MARKET",countryCode:current.countryCode,country:config.countries[current.countryCode]||current.country||current.countryCode,platform:current.platform,previousRating:previous?.ratingEom,currentRating:current.ratingEom,rating:null,newReviews:null,impact:null,confidence:"NONE"};
        const sharedMarket=meta.volumeScope==="SHARED_LISTING"&&selection.country!=="ALL";
        Object.assign(base,{sharedMarket,estimatedCountryRatingVolume:null,
          volumeReason:sharedMarket?(selection.inferGeography==="NO"?"INFERENCE_DISABLED":"NO_REPRESENTATIVE_SAMPLE"):null});
        if(!previous||![current.ratingEom,previous.ratingEom].every(value=>finite(value)&&value>=1&&value<=5)||![current.ratingCountEom,previous.ratingCountEom].every(value=>Number.isSafeInteger(value)&&value>=0)){rawItems.push({...base,available:false,reason:"MISSING_BASE"});return}
        const newReviews=current.ratingCountEom-previous.ratingCountEom;
        const inputSignature=[previous.ratingEom,previous.ratingCountEom,current.ratingEom,current.ratingCountEom].join("|");
        if(!(newReviews>0)){rawItems.push({...base,inputSignature,available:false,reason:"NO_NEW_REVIEWS"});return}
        const rating=(current.ratingCountEom*current.ratingEom-previous.ratingCountEom*previous.ratingEom)/newReviews;
        const currentHalfStep=ratingRoundingHalfStep(current.ratingEom,current.platform),previousHalfStep=ratingRoundingHalfStep(previous.ratingEom,previous.platform);
        const roundingUncertainty=(current.ratingCountEom*currentHalfStep+previous.ratingCountEom*previousHalfStep)/newReviews;
        if(!finite(rating)||rating<1||rating>5||roundingUncertainty>.5){rawItems.push({...base,inputSignature,newReviews:sharedMarket?null:newReviews,available:false,reason:"ROUNDING"});return}
        rawItems.push({...base,inputSignature,newReviews:sharedMarket?null:newReviews,
          rating,impact:rating-previous.ratingEom,available:true,confidence:roundingUncertainty<=.1?"HIGH":roundingUncertainty<=.25?"MEDIUM":"INDICATIVE"});
      });
      let items=rawItems;
      if(selection.country==="ALL"){
        const independent=rawItems.filter(item=>item.volumeScope!=="SHARED_LISTING"),shared=groupBy(rawItems.filter(item=>item.volumeScope==="SHARED_LISTING"),item=>item.volumeKey);
        items=independent.concat(Object.values(shared).map(group=>{
          const first=group[0],countries=[...new Set(group.map(item=>item.country))].sort((a,b)=>a.localeCompare(b,"es")),consistent=new Set(group.map(item=>item.inputSignature)).size===1;
          return{...first,appKey:first.volumeKey,countryCode:"SHARED",country:"Ficha compartida multipaís",scopeLabel:countries.join(" · "),sharedMarkets:countries,...(consistent?{}:{rating:null,impact:null,newReviews:null}),available:consistent&&first.available,reason:consistent?first.reason:"SHARED_CONFLICT"};
        }));
      }
      const rows=items.filter(item=>isCriticalPlatform(item.platform)||item.available).map(item=>({...item,reasons:item.available||!item.reason?[]:[item.reason]})).sort((a,b)=>{
        const countryOrder=a.country.localeCompare(b.country,"es");return countryOrder||config.platforms.indexOf(a.platform)-config.platforms.indexOf(b.platform)||a.appKey.localeCompare(b.appKey);
      });
      const platformSummaries=config.platforms.flatMap(platform=>{
        const platformRows=rows.filter(item=>item.platform===platform);
        const shared=platformRows.filter(item=>item.sharedMarket),local=platformRows.filter(item=>!item.sharedMarket);
        // A country view can show shared listings individually; only comparable
        // rows with observed volume enter its weighted rating.
        const summaries=shared.map(item=>({platform,rating:item.rating,newReviews:item.newReviews,impact:item.impact,
          volumeScope:item.volumeScope,volumeReason:item.volumeReason,sharedMarket:true,availableSeries:Number(item.available),totalSeries:1}));
        if(local.length){
          const valid=local.filter(item=>item.available),newReviews=sum(valid.map(item=>item.newReviews));
          const rating=newReviews?sum(valid.map(item=>item.rating*item.newReviews))/newReviews:null;
          const referenceRating=newReviews?sum(valid.map(item=>item.previousRating*item.newReviews))/newReviews:null;
          summaries.push({platform,rating,newReviews,impact:finite(rating)&&finite(referenceRating)?rating-referenceRating:null,
            volumeScope:local.every(item=>item.volumeScope==="SHARED_LISTING")?"SHARED_LISTING":null,
            availableSeries:valid.length,totalSeries:local.length});
        }
        return summaries;
      });
      const validItems=rows.filter(item=>item.available);
      return{period,previousPeriod,rows,summary:{platforms:platformSummaries,improvingSeries:validItems.filter(row=>row.impact>.005).length,pressuringSeries:validItems.filter(row=>row.impact<-.005).length,stableSeries:validItems.filter(row=>Math.abs(row.impact)<=.005).length,availableSeries:validItems.length,totalSeries:rows.length}};
    }
    function monthlyVoiceScope(row){
      return row.volumeScope==="SHARED_LISTING"?"Ficha Android multipaís":"Ficha independiente";
    }
    function monthlyVoiceVolumeDetail(row){
      if(row.volumeReason==="INFERENCE_DISABLED")return "Volumen local N/D: inferencia desactivada";
      if(row.volumeReason==="NO_REPRESENTATIVE_SAMPLE")return "Volumen local N/D: falta una muestra representativa de valoraciones";
      return finite(row.newReviews)?"Incremento observado en la ficha":"Volumen de la ficha N/D";
    }
    function exclusiveScopeSelection(values,changedValue,checked){
      const selected=[...new Set((values||[]).filter(Boolean))];
      if(changedValue==="ALL"&&checked)return["ALL"];
      const specific=selected.filter(value=>value!=="ALL");
      return specific.length?specific:["ALL"];
    }
    window.MarketsDomain=Object.freeze({config,browserMarket,benchmarkWeightedRows,finite,sum,sumOrNull,mean,weightedMean,groupBy,appName,isCriticalPlatform,selectionRows,coverageRows,trendRows,uniqueStoreRows,volumeSummary,rankRows,rankReviewNpsRows,countBbvaLeaders,availablePeriods,periodModel,ratingAt,evolutionKpis,prepareSeries,latestValue,ratingComparison,monthlyRatingMatrix,previousCalendarMonth,ratingRoundingHalfStep,monthlyNewReviewImpact,monthlyVoiceScope,monthlyVoiceVolumeDetail,exclusiveScopeSelection});
  })();
</script>

<script>
window.MarketRadarFilters = (() => {
  // Search and interaction follow News Radar's searchable-selects.js.
  const normalize = value => String(value).normalize("NFD").replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g,"")
    .toLowerCase().replace(/[^\p{L}\p{N}]/gu,"");

  const filterIcon = `<svg class="filter-icon" aria-hidden="true" focusable="false" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
<path d="M11.9999 8.1001C11.9999 8.5971 11.5969 9.0001 11.0999 9.0001C10.6029 9.0001 10.1999 8.5971 10.1999 8.1001C10.1999 7.6031 10.6029 7.2001 11.0999 7.2001C11.5969 7.2001 11.9999 7.6031 11.9999 8.1001ZM22.3999 7.2001H13.5999V8.8001H22.3999V7.2001ZM20.7999 11.2001H10.3499V12.8001H20.7999V11.2001ZM19.1999 15.2001H10.3499V16.8001H19.1999V15.2001ZM7.43391 14.6341L5.56091 16.5081V5.6001H4.03891V16.5081L2.16591 14.6341L1.03491 15.7651L4.80091 19.5311L8.56691 15.7651L7.43591 14.6341H7.43391Z"/>
</svg>`;

  function flag(code, label) {
    const source = window.MarketRadarFlags[code];
    if (!source) return null;
    const image = document.createElement("img");
    image.className = "radar-flag";
    image.src = source;
    image.alt = label;
    return image;
  }
  function searchable(select, choose) {
    const details = document.createElement("div");
    const label = select.labels[0].firstChild.textContent.trim();
    details.className = "searchable-select";
    details.innerHTML = '<button class="select-trigger" type="button"></button><div class="select-popup" popover="manual"><input type="search" placeholder="Buscar opciones"><div class="select-options" role="listbox" tabindex="-1"></div><p class="small muted" hidden>Sin coincidencias</p></div>';
    const [summary, popup] = details.children;
    const [search, list, empty] = popup.children;
    list.id = select.id + "-options";
    if (select.multiple) list.setAttribute("aria-multiselectable", "true");
    list.setAttribute("aria-label", label);
    const description = select.getAttribute("aria-describedby");
    if (description) summary.setAttribute("aria-describedby", description);
    summary.setAttribute("aria-label", label);
    summary.setAttribute("aria-haspopup", "listbox");
    search.setAttribute("role", "combobox");
    search.setAttribute("aria-autocomplete", "list");
    search.setAttribute("aria-label", "Buscar opciones: " + label);
    for (const control of [summary,search]) {
      control.setAttribute("aria-controls", list.id);
      control.setAttribute("aria-expanded", "false");
    }
    select.before(details);
    details.append(select);
    select.hidden = true;
    select.labels[0].addEventListener("click", event => {
      event.preventDefault();
      summary.focus();
    });

    let active, opened = false;
    function position() {
      const anchor = summary.getBoundingClientRect();
      const viewport = document.documentElement;
      if (!anchor.width || anchor.bottom < 0 || anchor.top > viewport.clientHeight) return close(false);
      const below = viewport.clientHeight - anchor.bottom;
      const above = anchor.top;
      const upward = below < popup.scrollHeight && above > below;
      popup.style.left = anchor.left + "px";
      popup.style.width = anchor.width + "px";
      popup.style.maxHeight = Math.max(0, upward ? above : below) + "px";
      popup.style.top = upward ? "auto" : anchor.bottom + "px";
      popup.style.bottom = upward ? viewport.clientHeight - anchor.top + "px" : "auto";
    }
    function outside(event) {
      if (!details.contains(event.target)) close(false);
    }
    function open() {
      if (opened) return;
      opened = true;
      for (const control of [summary,search]) control.setAttribute("aria-expanded", "true");
      popup.showPopover();
      filter();
      position();
      if (!opened) return;
      (search.hidden ? list : search).focus({preventScroll:true});
      window.addEventListener("resize", position);
      window.addEventListener("scroll", position, true);
      document.addEventListener("pointerdown", outside);
      document.addEventListener("focusin", outside);
    }
    const visible = () => [...list.children].filter(option => !option.hidden && !option.disabled);
    function highlight(option) {
      active?.classList.remove("is-focused");
      active = option;
      active?.classList.add("is-focused");
      for (const control of [search,list]) {
        if (active) control.setAttribute("aria-activedescendant", active.id);
        else control.removeAttribute("aria-activedescendant");
      }
    }
    function filter() {
      const query = normalize(search.value);
      for (const option of list.children) option.hidden = !normalize(option.textContent).includes(query);
      const options = visible();
      empty.hidden = options.length > 0;
      highlight(options.find(option => option.getAttribute("aria-selected") === "true") || options[0]);
    }
    function refresh() {
      const options = [...select.options];
      summary.textContent = [...select.selectedOptions].map(option => option.textContent).join(", ") || "Sin selección";
      if (select.name === "country") {
        const image = flag(select.value, "");
        if (image) summary.prepend(image);
      }
      summary.setAttribute("aria-label", label + ": " + summary.textContent);
      search.hidden = options.length <= 6;
      list.replaceChildren(...options.map((option,index) => {
        const button = document.createElement("button");
        button.type = "button";
        button.id = list.id + "-" + index;
        button.dataset.index = index;
        button.tabIndex = -1;
        button.setAttribute("role", "option");
        button.setAttribute("aria-selected", String(option.selected));
        button.disabled = option.disabled;
        if (["country","countries"].includes(select.name)) {
          const image = flag(option.value, option.textContent);
          if (image) {
            image.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "true");
            button.append(image);
          }
        }
        button.append(option.textContent);
        return button;
      }));
      filter();
      if (opened) position();
    }
    function close(restoreFocus = false) {
      if (!opened) return;
      opened = false;
      popup.hidePopover();
      for (const control of [summary,search]) control.setAttribute("aria-expanded", "false");
      window.removeEventListener("resize", position);
      window.removeEventListener("scroll", position, true);
      document.removeEventListener("pointerdown", outside);
      document.removeEventListener("focusin", outside);
      search.value = "";
      highlight(null);
      if (restoreFocus) summary.focus({preventScroll:true});
    }
    list.addEventListener("click", event => {
      const item = event.target.closest("[data-index]");
      if (!item || item.disabled) return;
      const option = select.options[Number(item.dataset.index)];
      if (select.multiple) {
        const values = choose(select.name, [...select.selectedOptions].map(o => o.value), option.value);
        for (const candidate of select.options) candidate.selected = values.includes(candidate.value);
      } else select.value = option.value;
      select.dispatchEvent(new Event("change", {bubbles:true}));
      if (!select.multiple) close(true);
      else (search.hidden ? list : search).focus();
    });
    list.addEventListener("pointerover", event => {
      const option = event.target.closest("[role=option]");
      if (option && !option.disabled) highlight(option);
    });
    select.addEventListener("change", refresh);
    search.addEventListener("input", filter);
    summary.addEventListener("click", () => opened ? close() : open());
    details.addEventListener("keydown", event => {
      if (event.key === "Escape" && opened) {
        event.preventDefault();
        event.stopPropagation();
        close(true);
      } else if (["ArrowDown","ArrowUp","Home","End"].includes(event.key)) {
        event.preventDefault();
        const wasOpen = opened;
        if (!wasOpen) open();
        const options = visible(), index = options.indexOf(active), step = event.key === "ArrowUp" ? -1 : 1;
        const next = event.key === "Home" ? 0 : event.key === "End" ? options.length - 1 :
          !wasOpen ? (step === 1 ? 0 : options.length - 1) : (index + step + options.length) % options.length;
        highlight(options[next]);
        active?.scrollIntoView({block:"nearest"});
      } else if (event.key === "Enter" && opened && event.target !== summary) {
        event.preventDefault();
        active?.click();
      }
    });
    return {refresh, close, enable: enabled => {
      summary.disabled = !enabled;
      if (!enabled) close();
    }};
  }

  function create(root, {applied, initial, all, commit, prepare, validate, choose, labelValue, translate = value => value, fixedChips = [], alwaysChips = [], omitChips = [], draftChanged}) {
    const form = root.querySelector("form");
    const fields = [...form.elements].filter(field => field.name);
    const labels = Object.fromEntries(fields.map(field => [field.name,field.labels[0].firstChild.textContent.trim()]));
    const combos = fields.filter(field => field.tagName === "SELECT").map(field => searchable(field,choose));
    const id = root.id;
    root.insertAdjacentHTML("afterbegin", `
      <div class="selection-toolbar${form.classList.contains("record-filters") ? " record-toolbar" : ""}">
        <button class="button" data-open type="button" aria-haspopup="dialog" aria-controls="${id}-dialog">${filterIcon} <span>Filtros</span></button>
        <div class="filter-chips" aria-label="Filtros activos" aria-live="polite" hidden></div>
      </div>
      <dialog class="filter-dialog${form.classList.contains("record-filters") ? " admin-record-dialog" : ""}" id="${id}-dialog" aria-labelledby="${id}-title">
        <div class="dialog-header"><h2 id="${id}-title">Filtros</h2><button class="button" data-close type="button" aria-label="Cerrar panel">✕</button></div>
        <div class="mobile-filters"></div>
        <div class="filter-dialog-actions">
          <button class="button" data-restore type="button">Restaurar filtros iniciales</button>
          <button class="button" data-all type="button">Ver todo</button>
          <button class="button primary" type="submit" form="${id}-form">Aplicar filtros</button>
        </div>
      </dialog>`);
    const dialog = root.querySelector("dialog"), opener = root.querySelector("[data-open]"), chips = root.querySelector(".filter-chips");
    root.tabIndex = -1;
    form.id = id + "-form";
    dialog.querySelector(".mobile-filters").append(form);
    form.hidden = false;
    form.noValidate = true;
    const sync = () => combos.forEach(combo => combo.refresh());
    const read = () => Object.fromEntries(fields.map(field => [field.name,field.multiple ?
      [...field.selectedOptions].map(option => option.value) : field.value]));
    const defaults = () => all?.() || {};
    const same = (a,b) => JSON.stringify(a ?? "") === JSON.stringify(b ?? "");
    let previousChips;
    function render() {
      const values = applied(), clear = defaults(), entries = [];

      for (const field of fields) {
        const key = field.name, value = values[key];
        if (omitChips.includes(key) || (!fixedChips.includes(key) && !alwaysChips.includes(key) && same(value,clear[key]))) continue;
        const readable = (Array.isArray(value) ? value : [value]).map(item =>
          labelValue?.(key,item) || (field.options && [...field.options].find(option => option.value === item)?.textContent) || item
        ).join(", ");
        entries.push([key,readable]);
      }
      const period = ['year', 'month', 'start', 'end'];
      entries.sort(([a], [b]) => (period.indexOf(a) + 1) - (period.indexOf(b) + 1));
      const signature = JSON.stringify(entries.map(([key,readable]) => [translate(labels[key]),translate(readable)]));
      if (signature === previousChips) return;
      previousChips = signature;
      chips.replaceChildren();
      for (const [key,readable] of entries) {
        const fixed = fixedChips.includes(key) || same(values[key],clear[key]);
        const button = document.createElement(fixed ? "span" : "button");
        button.className = "filter-chip";
        if (fixed) {
          button.textContent = translate(labels[key]) + ": " + translate(readable);
          chips.append(button);
          continue;
        }
        button.type = "button";
        button.setAttribute("aria-label", translate("Quitar filtro {filter}",{filter:translate(labels[key])}));
        const text = document.createElement("span"), cross = document.createElement("span");
        text.textContent = translate(labels[key]) + ": " + translate(readable);
        cross.textContent = "×";
        cross.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "true");
        button.append(text,cross);
        button.addEventListener("click", () => {
          commit({...applied(),[key]:clear[key] ?? ""});
          (chips.querySelector("button") || (opener.disabled ? root : opener)).focus();
        });
        chips.append(button);
      }
      chips.hidden = !chips.childElementCount;
    }
    function apply(values, action) {
      dialog.close();
      commit(values,action);
    }
    opener.addEventListener("click", () => {
      prepare?.();
      const values = applied();
      for (const field of fields) {
        if (field.multiple) {
          for (const option of field.options) option.selected = values[field.name].includes(option.value);
        } else field.value = values[field.name] ?? "";
      }
      const advanced = form.querySelector(".filter-advanced");
      if (advanced) advanced.open = [...advanced.querySelectorAll("[name]")].some(field => field.value);
      validate?.(values);
      sync();
      dialog.showModal();
    });
    const close = () => dialog.close();
    dialog.querySelector("[data-close]").addEventListener("click", close);
    dialog.addEventListener("click", event => {
      if (event.target === dialog) {
        const bounds = dialog.getBoundingClientRect();
        if (event.clientX < bounds.left || event.clientX > bounds.right ||
            event.clientY < bounds.top || event.clientY > bounds.bottom) close();
      }
    });
    dialog.addEventListener("close", () => combos.forEach(combo => combo.close()));
    dialog.querySelector("[data-restore]").addEventListener("click", () => apply(initial(),"restore"));
    dialog.querySelector("[data-all]").addEventListener("click", () => apply(defaults(),"all"));
    if (validate) form.addEventListener("input", () => validate(read()));
    if (draftChanged) form.addEventListener("change", event => draftChanged(event.target.name,read()));
    form.addEventListener("submit", event => {
      event.preventDefault();
      const values = read();
      validate?.(values);
      const invalid = fields.find(field => !field.validity.valid);
      const advanced = invalid?.closest(".filter-advanced");
      if (advanced) advanced.open = true;
      if (form.reportValidity()) apply(values,"apply");
    });
    return {render, close, refresh: sync, enable: enabled => {
      opener.disabled = !enabled;
      if (enabled && document.activeElement === root) opener.focus();
    }};
  }
  return {create,flag,searchable};
})();
</script>

<style>
/* Spinner y skeleton leídos del proyecto News Radar; integración solo en Administración. */
#view-admin .admin-radar-loading{display:flex;min-height:var(--control-height);justify-content:flex-start;gap:var(--space-2);align-items:center;padding-block:var(--space-2);color:var(--color-primary-text-secondary)}
#view-admin .admin-radar-spinner{width:var(--space-3);height:var(--space-3);border:var(--chart-stroke) solid var(--color-primary-border);border-top-color:var(--color-primary-bg-action);border-radius:50%;animation:admin-radar-turn 1s linear infinite;flex-shrink:0}
@keyframes admin-radar-turn{to{transform:rotate(360deg)}}
#view-admin .admin-tab-panel[data-loading="replace"]>:not(.admin-radar-loading):not(.admin-radar-skeleton){display:none}
#view-admin .admin-radar-skeleton{display:grid;gap:var(--space-2);padding-block:var(--space-2)}

<script>
  (()=>{
    "use strict";
    const spreadsheet="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main";
    const relations="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships";
    const chartNamespace="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/drawingml/2006/chart";
    const sheetDrawingNamespace="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/drawingml/2006/spreadsheetDrawing";
    const drawingNamespace="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/drawingml/2006/main";
    const packageRelations="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/package/2006/relationships";
    const packageContentTypes="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/package/2006/content-types";
    const packageTypes="application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument";
    const xml=value=>String(value??"").replace(/[\u0000-\u0008\u000b\u000c\u000e-\u001f\ufffe\uffff]/g,"")
      .replace(/[&<>"']/g,char=>({"&":"&amp;","<":"&lt;",">":"&gt;",'"':"&quot;","'":"&apos;"})[char]);
    function column(index){
      let letters="";
      for(let n=index+1;n;n=Math.floor((n-1)/26))letters=String.fromCharCode(65+(n-1)%26)+letters;
      return letters;
    }
    const relationship=(id,type,target)=>`<Relationship Id="${id}" Type="${relations}/${type}" Target="${target}"/>`;
    const relationshipFile=entries=>`<Relationships xmlns="${packageRelations}">${entries}</Relationships>`;
    const crcTable=Uint32Array.from({length:256},(_,byte)=>{
      for(let bit=0;bit<8;bit++)byte=(byte>>>1)^((byte&1)?0xedb88320:0);
      return byte;
    });
    function zip(files){
      const encoder=new TextEncoder(), body=[], directory=[];
      let offset=0, directorySize=0;
      const header=(length,fields)=>{
        const buffer=new Uint8Array(length), view=new DataView(buffer.buffer);
        for(const [position,value,width=2] of fields){
          if(width===4)view.setUint32(position,value,true);
          else view.setUint16(position,value,true);
        }
        return buffer;
      };
      for(const [path,content] of files){
        const name=encoder.encode(path), data=encoder.encode(content);
        let crc=0xffffffff;
        for(const byte of data)crc=(crc>>>8)^crcTable[(crc^byte)&255];
        crc^=0xffffffff;
        const local=header(30,[[0,0x04034b50,4],[4,20],[12,33],[14,crc,4],[18,data.length,4],[22,data.length,4],[26,name.length]]);
        const central=header(46,[[0,0x02014b50,4],[4,20],[6,20],[14,33],[16,crc,4],[20,data.length,4],
          [24,data.length,4],[28,name.length],[42,offset,4]]);
        body.push(local,name,data);
        directory.push(central,name);
        offset+=local.length+name.length+data.length;
        directorySize+=central.length+name.length;
      }
      if(offset+directorySize>0xffffffff)throw new Error("El archivo supera el tamaño admitido.");
      const end=header(22,[[0,0x06054b50,4],[8,files.size],[10,files.size],[12,directorySize,4],[16,offset,4]]);
      return new Blob([...body,...directory,end],{type:"application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet"});
    }
    function chartXml(name,header,rows,firstRow){
      const range=(col,start,end)=>xml(`'${name.replaceAll("'","''")}'!$${column(col)}$${start}:$${column(col)}$${end}`);
      const reference=(col,numeric)=>{
        const type=numeric?"num":"str";
        const points=rows.map((row,index)=>row[col]==null?"":`<c:pt idx="${index}"><c:v>${xml(row[col])}</c:v></c:pt>`).join("");
        return `<c:${type}Ref><c:f>${range(col,firstRow,firstRow+rows.length-1)}</c:f><c:${type}Cache>${numeric?"<c:formatCode>General</c:formatCode>":""}<c:ptCount val="${rows.length}"/>${points}</c:${type}Cache></c:${type}Ref>`;
      };
      const series=header.slice(1).map((label,index)=>`<c:ser><c:idx val="${index}"/><c:order val="${index}"/><c:tx><c:v>${xml(label)}</c:v></c:tx><c:marker><c:symbol val="circle"/></c:marker><c:cat>${reference(0,false)}</c:cat><c:val>${reference(index+1,true)}</c:val></c:ser>`).join("");
      return `<c:chartSpace xmlns:c="${chartNamespace}"><c:chart><c:plotArea><c:layout/><c:lineChart><c:grouping val="standard"/>${series}<c:axId val="10"/><c:axId val="20"/></c:lineChart><c:catAx><c:axId val="10"/><c:scaling><c:orientation val="minMax"/></c:scaling><c:axPos val="b"/><c:crossAx val="20"/><c:crosses val="autoZero"/></c:catAx><c:valAx><c:axId val="20"/><c:scaling><c:orientation val="minMax"/><c:max val="5"/><c:min val="1"/></c:scaling><c:axPos val="l"/><c:majorGridlines/><c:crossAx val="10"/><c:crosses val="autoZero"/></c:valAx></c:plotArea><c:legend><c:legendPos val="b"/></c:legend><c:plotVisOnly val="1"/><c:dispBlanksAs val="gap"/></c:chart></c:chartSpace>`;
    }
    function build(sheets){
      const files=new Map(), types=[], workbookRelations=[], workbookSheets=[];
      function part(path,type,content){
        files.set(path,content);
        types.push(`<Override PartName="/${path}" ContentType="${packageTypes}.${type}+xml"/>`);
      }
      sheets.forEach(({name,filters,header,rows,chart},index)=>{
        if(!rows.length)return;
        const id=index+1;
        const content=[...filters,[],header,...rows];
        if(content.length>1048576||header.length>16384)throw new Error("La selección supera los límites de Excel.");
        const columns=Array.from({length:Math.max(2,header.length)},(_,i)=>{
          const lengths=[header[i]?.length||0,...filters.map(row=>String(row[i]??"").length)];
          for(const row of rows.slice(0,100))lengths.push(String(row[i]??"").length);
          return `<col min="${i+1}" max="${i+1}" width="${Math.min(72,Math.max(12,...lengths)+2)}" customWidth="1"/>`;
        }).join("");
        const data=content.map((row,i)=>`<row r="${i+1}">${row.map((value,j)=>{
          const address=column(j)+(i+1);
          if(value==null||value==="")return "";
          if(Number.isFinite(value))return `<c r="${address}"><v>${value}</v></c>`;
          // Inline strings keep public comments and filter text out of Excel's formula evaluator.
          return `<c r="${address}" t="inlineStr"><is><t xml:space="preserve">${xml(String(value).slice(0,32767))}</t></is></c>`;
        }).join("")}</row>`).join("");
        if(chart){
          const from=content.length+2;
          const anchor=(tag,row,col)=>`<xdr:${tag}><xdr:col>${col}</xdr:col><xdr:colOff>0</xdr:colOff><xdr:row>${row}</xdr:row><xdr:rowOff>0</xdr:rowOff></xdr:${tag}>`;
          part(`xl/charts/chart${id}.xml`,"drawingml.chart",chartXml(name,header,rows,filters.length+3));
          part(`xl/drawings/drawing${id}.xml`,"drawing",
            `<xdr:wsDr xmlns:xdr="${sheetDrawingNamespace}" xmlns:a="${drawingNamespace}"><xdr:twoCellAnchor>${anchor("from",from,0)}${anchor("to",from+18,12)}<xdr:graphicFrame><xdr:nvGraphicFramePr><xdr:cNvPr id="1" name="Rating"/><xdr:cNvGraphicFramePr/></xdr:nvGraphicFramePr><xdr:xfrm><a:off x="0" y="0"/><a:ext cx="0" cy="0"/></xdr:xfrm><a:graphic><a:graphicData uri="${chartNamespace}"><c:chart xmlns:c="${chartNamespace}" xmlns:r="${relations}" r:id="rId1"/></a:graphicData></a:graphic></xdr:graphicFrame><xdr:clientData/></xdr:twoCellAnchor></xdr:wsDr>`);
          files.set(`xl/drawings/_rels/drawing${id}.xml.rels`,relationshipFile(relationship("rId1","chart",`../charts/chart${id}.xml`)));
          files.set(`xl/worksheets/_rels/sheet${id}.xml.rels`,relationshipFile(relationship("rId1","drawing",`../drawings/drawing${id}.xml`)));
        }
        part(`xl/worksheets/sheet${id}.xml`,"spreadsheetml.worksheet",
          `<worksheet xmlns="${spreadsheet}" xmlns:r="${relations}"><cols>${columns}</cols><sheetData>${data}</sheetData>${chart?'<drawing r:id="rId1"/>':""}</worksheet>`);
        workbookRelations.push(relationship(`rId${id}`,"worksheet",`worksheets/sheet${id}.xml`));
        workbookSheets.push(`<sheet name="${xml(name)}" sheetId="${id}" r:id="rId${id}"/>`);
      });
      if(!workbookSheets.length)throw new Error("No hay datos para descargar con estos filtros.");
      part("xl/workbook.xml","spreadsheetml.sheet.main",`<workbook xmlns="${spreadsheet}" xmlns:r="${relations}"><sheets>${workbookSheets.join("")}</sheets></workbook>`);
      files.set("xl/_rels/workbook.xml.rels",relationshipFile(workbookRelations.join("")));
      files.set("_rels/.rels",relationshipFile(relationship("rId1","officeDocument","xl/workbook.xml")));
      files.set("[Content_Types].xml",`<Types xmlns="${packageContentTypes}"><Default Extension="rels" ContentType="application/vnd.openxmlformats-package.relationships+xml"/>${types.join("")}</Types>`);
      return zip(files);
    }
    window.MarketsWorkbook=Object.freeze({build});
  })();
</script>
